description: The 2026 iteration of the Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Toro Bravo' stays loyal to the 2013 release, including a red nubuck upper with grey accents on the molded eyelets, collar lining, and Jumpman-branded tongue tag. Black support wings match the heel tab stamped with another Jumpman logo, along with a side panel netting underlay. The bicolor midsole has an Air-Sole heel unit for balanced cushioning.

Faithful to the 1988 original, the Air Jordan 3 Retro 'True Blue' 2026 brings back a colorway from 2001, 2011, and 2016. The upper is built with white tumbled leather, accented by Cement Grey elephant print overlays at the toe cap and heel counter. True Blue details appear at the midsole wedge, lace eyelets, and heel tab. Underfoot, a white midsole houses a visible heel Air unit, with a grey rubber outsole providing traction.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Sail Tropical Pink
description: The Travis Scott x Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG 'Sail Tropical Pink' sports a pastel pink nubuck upper with off-white tumbled leather overlays on the forefoot and heel. A large reverse Swoosh decorates one side, matching the embroidered Cactus Jack and Wings logos adorning the back tab of the left and right shoe, respectively. Both brand logos appear on the tongue as well as the insoles. The cream-colored midsole plays alongside a pink rubber outsole to complete the look.

The 2026 version of the Air Jordan 7 Retro 'Miro' nods to Michael Jordan's gold medal run with the Dream Team during the 1992 Barcelona Olympics. Much like the 2008 release, these shoes take their inspiration from Spanish artist Joan Miro, using a black nubuck upper with white leather overlays. A webbed heel pull tab gets the five colors from the Olympic Rings, while the triangular heel patch gets a '9' — the number Jordan wore as a member of Team USA. The gold and red accents decorate the white foam midsole, anchored by a partially see-through rubber outsole that reveals flag-inspired graphics.

The 2026 iteration of the Air Jordan 8 Retro 'Chrome' stays true to the 2003 release, starting with a black nubuck upper complemented with chrome-plated hardware and bolstered with a cross-strap design. A round chenille Jumpman adorns the tongue, while a brushstroke graphic of white, grey, and black hues comprises the overlays on both sides. A metallic silver midsole works alongside encapsulated Air-Sole forefoot and heel units.

The 2025 version of the Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Black Cat' brings back the classic foam midsole paired with a visible Nike Air heel unit. Loyal to the 2006 design, these kicks have a black nubuck upper tooled with a quarter panel netting, molded eyelets and anchor wings. A matching Jumpman lands on the tongue tag and heel tab.

The 2026 reissue of the Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Black University Blue' uses black nubuck on the upper, accented with contrast stitching and tooled with see-through side panel netting. University Blue knit lines the collar, matching the embroidered Jumpman on the heel. Another Jumpman logo adorns the silver reflective tongue, while a black foam midsole gets white sharktooth details along with an Air-Sole heel unit. A see-through, herringbone-patterned rubber outsole keeps you surefooted through the day.

The 2025 iteration of the Air Jordan 11 'Gamma Blue' shoes have a black ballistic mesh upper with a matching patent leather mudguard. The black leather heel panel showcases an embroidered Gamma Blue Jumpman logo, while a maize-colored '23' signoff appears on the back tab. These kicks have a black Phylon midsole carrying a full-length Nike Air unit. The blue-hued rubber outsole has herringbone traction pods and an exposed carbon fiber shank plate, providing steady traction and stability.

The 2026 version of the Air Jordan 9 Retro OG 'Space Jam' was first seen in the 1996 classic movie. These shoes have a speed lacing system to secure the white leather upper, adorned with matching stitched details and a black synthetic nubuck mudguard. The foam midsole contains encapsulated Air-sole forefoot and heel units for all-around cushioning. The rubber outsole sports phrases in different languages as a nod to Michael Jordan's international fame.

The 2026 iteration of the Air Jordan 14 Retro 'Forest Green' revives the championship design, staying true to the 2005 release. These shoes have a white leather upper with perforated details on the stitched side panels. A Jumpman badge decorates the collar, while the off-white heel panel gets a Jumpman logo and a raised '23' in forest green. The green Phylon midsole contains Zoom Air cushioning in the heel and forefoot for a plush ride. A carbon fiber shank plate ensures the midfoot is stable with every stride.

The 2026 version of the Air Jordan 13 Retro 'Flint' keeps elements similar to the 1998 release. The white leather upper is touched with grey synthetic suede panels and dimpled knit overlays. The 13's holographic cat eye is embedded in the heel, while the Jumpman logo appears on the tongue. These kicks have a Phylon midsole with springy Zoom Air cushioning in the forefoot and heel. The panther-paw rubber outsole keeps the classic herringbone traction pods along with a carbon fiber shank plate.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro Rare Air Tour Yellow (2026)
description: The 2026 version of the Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Rare Air - Tour Yellow' commemorates the model's 20th anniversary. Just like the 2006 release, these kicks have a white leather upper with a matching side panel netting, black support wings, and molded grey, partially see-through eyelets. A hook-and-loop Jumpman patch on the tongue can be removed, revealing a 'Jordan Rare Air' label. Speckled details on the yellow midsole make way for an Air-sole heel unit below. A black, herringbone-patterned rubber outsole keeps you surefooted through the day.

The Air Jordan 6 Retro OG 'White Infrared' stays true to the 1991 release, starting with a white leather upper and an embroidered Nike Air logo on the heel. Black hits adorn the heel tab, collar lining, and molded, two-hole tongue. Infrared touches embellish the midsole, which contains an encapsulated Air-Sole forefoot unit and an exposed one in the heel. A partially see-through rubber outsole keeps traction strong with every step.

The Air Jordan 17 Low 'Black Pack' dons a dark grey nubuck upper topped with a knit cuff. Black stingray-textured leather adorns the collar and eyestay. A glossy chassis engulfs the back of the foam midsole, which contains a forefoot Zoom Air unit and an Air-Sole heel bag. A carbon fiber spring plate ensures rigidity and energy return. The two-part rubber outsole has herringbonepods for steady traction with each step.

shoeName: Jordan 11 Retro Space Jam Magic Ball (Women's)

description: The Air Jordan 15 'Black Pack' comes from a four-piece footwear collection that also includes the Air Jordan 14, AJ16, and AJ17. The classic woven Kevlar build is replaced with snakeskin-textured black-and-grey leather. The rest of the upper has black nubuck panels and a stretchy knit cuff, along with a black rubberized heel counter to help keep your ankles in place. A plush Phylon midsole packs Zoom Air cushioning in the forefoot and heel. A segmented, herringbone-patterned rubber outsole ensures swift traction no matter where the day takes you.

The 2026 version of the Air Jordan 5 'Wolf Grey' keeps the white sharktooth details on the grey foam midsole, equipped with visible Nike Air heel cushioning and a see-through, herringbone-patterned rubber outsole. These sneakers rock a grey layered nubuck upper with white contrast stitching and the traditional side panel netting. An embroidered '23' signoff appears on the heel, while the Jumpman adorns the silver reflective tongue and heel.

The J Balvin x Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Lemonade' features a creamy yellow, croc-embossed leather upper with the classic side panel tooled with leather on the eyelets, support wings, and heel tab. The Nike Air logo can be seen on the heel of the left shoe while J Balvin's signature smiley face logo lands on the right. A leather Jumpman decorates the tongue. The Air-Sole heel unit and foam midsole maintain the monochromatic design.

The 2025 version of the Air Jordan 4 Retro OG 'White Cement' carries a layered white leather upper tooled with the signature quarter panel netting and black molded eyelets. The support wings are painted in grey, decorated with black speckles, matching the Air-assisted foam midsole, and Nike-branded heel tab. The red Jumpman logo matches the Flight-branded tongue tag. The rubber outsole has key flex grooves for a comfortable sensation and a herringbone pattern for smooth traction.

The 2026 version of the Air Jordan 5 Retro 'White Metallic' nods to the OG 2000 release, starting with a white leather upper with matching molded eyelets and a see-through side panel netting. An embroidered '23' signoff on the heel joins a Jumpman adorning the silver reflective tongue and 'Nike Air' insignia on the heel. Metallic silver shark tooth details decorate the white foam midsole, which packs an Air-Sole heel unit, bolstered by a see-through rubber outsole.

Reissued in 2026, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Royal' keeps elements from the 1985 release intact, including a black leather upper with royal blue touches on the toe box, Swoosh, heel, and collar flap. The latter gets a debossed Wings logo on the side, while a Nike Air tag decorates the nylon tongue. The white midsole contains an encapsulated Air-Sole cushioning unit and a royal blue rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Flight Club' nods to the fan membership program that ran from the late '80s and into the '90s. The off-white leather upper gets a mesh side panel netting and contrasting black touches on the molded eyelets and heel tab. A red Flight Club label decorates the tongue, while a black-and-white midsole gets a visible Air-sole heel unit below.

The Nike SB x Air Jordan 4 Retro SP 'Navy' sports a white leather upper with a grey suede forefoot overlay and side panel netting. A red Jumpman embellishes the tongue, while an embossed Nike SB logo adorns the navy heel tab. More navy accents decorate the eyelets and foam midsole, which showcases a visible Nike Air unit in the heel. A herringbone-patterned outsole uses gum rubber in high-wear areas for enhanced durability.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Shy Pink
description: The Travis Scott x Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG 'Shy Pink' rocks a white leather upper with cream-colored, 'Muslin', tumbled leather overlays on the forefoot and heel, matched by the Swoosh on the side. The opposite side gets Scott's iconic reverse Swoosh in pink, matching the rubber outsole and the mismatched Cactus Jack and Wings logo etched on the back tab of the left and right shoe, respectively. The nylon tongue gets a Nike tag joined by an off-center Cactus Jack label.

The 2026 version of the Air Jordan 11 Retro Low 'UNC' pays homage to Michael Jordan's alma mater. True to the original 2001 release, these kicks have a white leather upper with a glossy University Blue patent leather mudguard. These kicks have a white Phylon midsole that packs a full-length Air-Sole unit. The see-through rubber outsole includes a carbon fiber spring plate for more stability and energy return.

The Air Jordan 6 Retro 'Reverse Infrared' takes design cues from its '90s predecessor, flipping the colorblocking for a new design. These shoes sport a layered black nubuck upper with a red Nike Air heel logo. A matching Jumpman emblem lands on the neoprene lace cover. Same as the 1991 original, a splash of red covers the sidewalls of the Air unit on the midsole. A see-through rubber outsole brings strong traction underfoot.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro OG Nigel Sylvester Brick After Brick
description: The Nigel Sylvester x Air Jordan 4 Retro OG 'Sail' uses the same colors from the 'Fire Red' AJ4. The off-white leather upper is complemented by mesh panels on the side and black support wings. Red molded eyelets match the collar lining, and Swoosh embroidered on the forefoot. The Jumpman emblem is showcased on the tongue tag, while 'Bike Air' replaces the classic Nike Air logo on the heel tab.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro 'World's Best Dad' nods to Michael Jordan's first championship after returning from retirement, which happened on Father's Day 1996. That day birthed the iconic photo of Jordan lying on the locker room floor while clutching the game ball. The carpet pattern is represented on the brown leather overlays bolstering the forefoot and heel of the off-white leather upper, replacing traditional elephant print. A Jumpman logo decorates the tongue, while the Nike Air logo graces the heel tab. A touch of black lands on the heel of the foam midsole, which packs an Air-Sole heel unit below.

The 2026 iteration of the Air Jordan 13 Retro 'True Red' sports a Chicago-inspired palette, consisting of a white leather upper complemented with red synthetic suede panels that start at the midfoot and wrap around the heel. An embroidered Jumpman graces the tongue, while the classic 'cat eye' adorns the side of the heel. A plush Phylon midsole is wrapped in red synthetic suede and tooled with Zoom Air forefoot and heel units for a resilient sensation.

The Air Jordan 12 Retro 'Bucks' keeps the model's classic radiating stitch lines inspired by Japan's Rising Sun flag. The white leather upper gets green, lizard-textured overlays, while the molded eyelets shine in a bluish-purple iridescent finish, matching the Jumpman-stamped side panel. A plush Phylon midsole gets full-length Zoom Air cushioning. The rubber outsole below reveals a carbon fiber shank plate for steady footing and energy return.

The 2026 iteration of the Air Jordan 4 Retro OG 'Bred' brings back the shoes Michael Jordan wore when he knocked down 'The Shot" in the 1989 NBA Playoffs. The black nubuck upper gets a matching side panel netting and support wings. grey molded eyelets match the knit collar lining and the raised Nike Air logo decorating the heel tab. A Flight tag on the tongue showcases a red Jumpman logo. The bicolor foam midsole contains an Air-Sole heel unit, anchored by a herringbone-patterned rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Fragment x Travis Scott Sail Military Blue
description: The Fragment Design x Travis Scott x Air Jordan 1 Low OG SP 'Sail Military Blue' dons a white leather upper with a matching Swoosh. A reverse tumbled leather Swoosh in royal blue sparks a pop of color on the opposite side. That same royal blue lands on the collar lining and back tab, which contains the Cactus Jack and Wings logos. An off-white, textured midsole works with a blue rubber outsole to complete the vibe.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Cave Stone' rolls out a smooth nubuck upper with black pops on the side panel netting, molded eyelets and collar lining. A Jumpman emblem lands on the Flight-branded tongue tag, while the Nike Air logo decorates the molded heel tab. A white-and-black foam midsole undergirds the classic design.

The 2026 version of the Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Toro Bravo' keeps true to the 2013 release, starting with a red nubuck upper with the classic side panel netting, black support wings and grey molded eyelets. The Jumpman logo appears on the grey tongue tag as well as a contrasting black heel tab. The foam midsole packs an Air-Sole heel unit, while a grey rubber outsole uses a herringbone pattern for surefire traction.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low SE Space Jam Magic Ball

description: The 2026 version of the Air Jordan 6 'Oreo' stays loyal to the 2010 release. The black nubuck upper is hit with contrasting white leather overlays. The Jumpman logo lands on the heel as well as the neoprene lace cover. White speckles wrap up the spoiler-like heel tab, mirroring the top of the foam midsole. An encapsulated Air-Sole cushioning in the forefoot and a heel unit keep things soft underfoot. The see-through rubber outsole ensures steady traction below.

The Air Jordan 14 Low 'Black Pack' sports a blackout upper with ostrich-textured leather panels and nubuck along the forefoot. A metallic silver Jumpman lands on the side. Metallic silver details land on the Phylon midsole, which packs springy Zoom Air forefoot and heel units. Below, the rubber outsole gets a herringbone pattern for traction in all directions.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro Rare Air Tour Yellow (GS) (2026)

description: The Air Jordan 12 Retro 'Bloodline' sports a black leather upper with radiating stitch lines and matching lizard-textured overlays. The monochromatic look is accented by metallic red molded eyelets and midfoot panels. The Phylon midsole packs full-length Zoom Air cushioning, while the rubber outsole gets herringbone traction pods and a red Jumpman logo underfoot.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Last Dance At The Garden
description: The Air Jordan 1 Low OG 'Last Dance At The Garden' takes desig elements from a historic March 1998 game, as Michael Jordan laced up a pair of Air Jordan 1s for his final Madison Square Garden appearance as a member of the Chicago Bulls. The white leather upper is touched with red and black floral-print knit overlays. A black leather Swoosh is piped in a metallic gold trim, matching the embroidered Wings logo on the heel tab.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High Virgil Abloh Archive Alaska
description: The Off-White x Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Alaska' rolls out an off-white rubber midsole with Virgil's 'Air' signoff on the sidewall. Based on the 2018 limited-release 'Euro' colorway, these sneakers have a white-on-white design on the deconstructed leather upper, which includes semi-detached panels and a Swoosh adorned with visible blue stitching. An off-center Nike Air tag decorates the long, exposed-foam tongue, while an Off-White emblem appears on the side panel.

Originally released in 1996, the 2024 edition of the Air Jordan 11 Retro 'Legend Blue / Columbia' sports a white leather upper, accented with a matching patent leather mudguard and contrasted with a Columbia Blue embroidered Jumpman right below the collar. Bold black accents are carefully-placed in the back tab and collar lining. A white Phylon midsole partners with an Air-sole unit to bring you a lightweight feel underfoot. An icy, see-through rubber outsole showcases a carbon fiber shank plate to keep the midfoot stable.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Bred Reimagined' is a new iteration of the iconic design which replaces the original 1989 release's nubuck material with a black leather upper. Quarter panel netting, gray molded eyelets, and Nike Air branding on the heel tab are heritage details, and a crimson Jumpman logo adorns the woven Flight tongue tag. The PU midsole features encapsulated Air-sole cushioning in the forefoot and an exposed Air unit in the heel, resting on a pre-distressed rubber outsole with a herringbone traction pattern.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Lakers' rocks a purple nubuck upper with black support wings, matching the side panel netting and Nike-Air-branded heel tab. A matching yellow Jumpman adorns the tongue tag. These shoes ride on a black-and-white foam midsole. A yellow Max Air heel unit keeps you comfortable step after step.

The 2026 release of the Air Jordan 14 Retro 'Black University Blue' nods to Michael Jordan's alma mater. Consistent with the 2006 release, these basketball shoes have a black suede upper with deco-style stitching on the sides. Pastel blue touches decorate the heel tab and Phylon midsole, as well as the angular 'teeth' on the forefoot. Springy Zoom Air forefoot and heel units provide responsive cushioning with each step.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Chicago Lost and Found
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Chicago Lost & Found' brings back the famous 'Chicago' colorway with new storytelling elements. Featuring the OG high-cut shape, the leather upper features a white base with Varsity Red overlays and a black Swoosh and Wings logo. Cracked black leather on the padded collar gives it a vintage look, along with a pre-yellowed midsole. The packaging also tells the 'Lost & Found' story, with a damaged-looking box plastered with sale stickers showcasing a different colored lid. A receipt is also included, alluding to finding this vintage gem tucked away in an attic or storage space.

Bringing back a classic OG colorway, the 2024 version of the Jordan 4 Retro 'Military Blue' also known as 'Industrial Blue' returns with an off-white leather upper and nubuck forefoot overlays. The blue Jumpman logo decorates the tongue tag, matching the color of the molded eyelets, back tab and the underneath of the side panel netting. These shoes have a lightweight midsole with an encapsulated Air-sole forefoot unit and a visible Air bag in the heel.

colorway: Off White/Anthracite/Neutral Grey/Fire Pink/Light Arctic Pink/Muslin
Velvet Brown/Light British Tan/Rust Pink/Pearl White
description: The Women's Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Fireside' rocks a rich brown leather upper with matching elephant print overlays, as well as suede details on the eyestay panel, collar, and tongue. The latter gets a cream-colored Jumpman logo, matching the heel. A brown foam midsole packs an Air-Sole heel unit and a dark taupe rubber outsole below to keep you sure-footed.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Velvet Brown
description: Travis Scott's signature reverse Swoosh stands out on the Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP 'Velvet Brown', featuring a black tumbled leather upper with suede upper touches throughout. The brown nylon tongue gets a Nike Air tag, while mismatched Cactus Jack and Wings logos land on each back tab. A brown rubber cupsole gets stitched sidewalls and an encapsulated Air-sole heel unit for a plush sensation underfoot.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Shattered Backboard (2025)
description: Inspired by the jersey Michael Jordan wore during an exhibition game in Italy after his rookie season, the 2025 version of the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Shattered Backboard' have a white leather upper with a black forefoot overlay and a black Swoosh. Orange pops decorate the toe box, heel and Wings-branded collar flap. The Nike Air tag adorns the tongue to maintain the signature look.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Medium Olive
description: The Travis Scott x Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP 'Reverse Olive / Medium Olive' dons a green suede base with chalk white leather overlays on the forefoot and heel areas. Scott's black tumbled leather reverse Swoosh adorns the side, while red pops touch the Nike Air tongue as well as the Wings and Cactus Jack logos on the back tab. These sneakers have an off-white midsole, reinforced by a sturdy olive rubber outsole.

The 2024 version of the Air Jordan 3 Retro OG 'Black Cement' stays true to the 1988 original, rolling out a black tumbled leather upper with grey elephant print forefoot and heel overlays. An embroidered red Jumpman stars on the tongue, while a raised Nike Air logo adorns the heel. A white foam midsole equips Air-sole cushioning, adding a touch of black along the heel, anchored by a grey rubber outsole.

Honoring the team Michael Jordan brought glory to, the 2025 version of the Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG 'Chicago' brings back a traditional rubber cupsole with white sidewalls and a red rubber outsole. The white, all-leather upper tooled with red forefoot and heel overlays. A black Swoosh matches the knit collar lining and the debossed Wings logo decorating the red leather back tab. A Nike Air tag adorns the tongue for a final touch.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Fire Red Black Tongue (2025)
description: The 2025 version of the Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Fire Red' sports a red foam midsole assisted by a visible Nike Air unit. Black sharktooth details on the side meet a see-through outsole, maintaining the classic look. The white leather upper keeps the classic side netting, tooled with contrasting black eyelets. A red Jumpman logo contrasts the black tongue, while an embroidered '23' signoff adorns the heel area.

The 2025 version of the Air Jordan 3 'Pure Money' originally debuted in 2007, sporting a white tumbled leather upper with matching elephant print overlays on the forefoot and heel. Matte silver touches reach the molded eyelets and Jumpman logos on the tongue and heel tab. A white foam midsole gets an Air-sole heel underneath.

shoeName: Jordan 9 Retro Flint Grey French Blue (2026)
description: The 2026 version of the Air Jordan 9 Retro 'Flint Grey' is the first-ever reissue of the 2003 model. These kicks have a white leather upper with grey nubuck overlays. A French blue Air Jordan tongue tag matches the embroidered '23' signoff on the heel. A full-length, grey foam midsole contains Air-sole units in the forefoot and heel for balanced cushioning.

The Undefeated x Air Jordan 4 brings back the collab that initially dropped in 2005, limited to only 72 pairs. Inspired by the MA-1 flight jacket, these shoes sport a deep green nubuck upper with contrasting black pops on the molded eyelets, supports wings, and Nike Air back tab. Hook-and-loop logo patches decorate the tongue, lined with orange knit inside. An off-white foam midsole pairs with a visible orange Nike Air heel unit to round out the look.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Rare Air - White Lettering' dons a black nubuck upper with quarter panel netting, plastic support wings and red-and-black molded eyelets. A grey suede overlay bolsters the forefoot, piped in contrast white stitches. The collar is lined in a blue knit, matching a Nike Air-branded heel tab. Interchangeable Velcro patches adorn the tongue, while a 'Rare Air' logo decorates the insoles. A visible Nike Air unit in the foam midsole is done up in royal blue with a splash of black around the heel.

The Women's Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Iced Carmine' rocks a pink knit upper complemented with a matching suede forefoot overlay and the customary side panel netting. The partially see-through molded eyelets match the color of the support wings, along with a heel tab stamped with a Jumpman emblem. A second Jumpman logo adorns the tongue tag. These sneakers ride on a cream-hued foam midsole, which contains an Air-Sole heel unit and a see-through rubber outsole below.

shoeName: Jordan CJ1 T-Rexx Travis Scott Green Spark
description: The Travis Scott x Air Jordan Jumpman Jack TR 'Green Spark' combines standard laces with an adjustable forefoot strap to secure the black leather upper. Lush green nubuck overlays complement the design, while a lighter green reverse Swoosh decorates the side. An embroidered Jumpman logo graces the tongue, while the Cactus Jack emblem lands on the heel. A 'Jack' signoff is etched in handwritten letters on the rubber outsole.

The 2024 edition of the Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Fear' brings back the 2013 colorway, using a nubuck upper accented with a grey mudguard and toe wrap. White molded eyelets match the Jumpman logos on the tongue tag and heel. White speckles decorate the a black foam midsole, which packs an exposed Air-Sole heel unit.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG SP Fragment x Union LA Varsity Red Sport Royal
description: The Fragment Design x Union LA x Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Varsity Red Sport Royal' carries a tumbled white leather upper with contrasting black accents on the eyestay, Swoosh and forefoot overlay. Sporting the Fragment logo, a blue leather overlay wraps around the heel. The black suede collar is contrasted by red leather overlays stamped with a black Wings logo on the side. An off-white midsole is anchored by a royal blue outsole below.

The 2025 version of the Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Black Cat' was named after one of Michael Jordan's pre-NBA nicknames. Sporting black nubuck on the upper, these shoes have a matching black patent leather mudguard and charcoal elephant-print forefoot and heel overlays. The Jumpman logo graces the tongue and back tab, while a foam midsole contains a visible Air-sole heel unit for a resilient feel.

The 2025 iteration of the Air Jordan 8 'Bugs Bunny' keeps true to the 1993 design, starting with a two-tone midsole with encapsulated Nike Air cushioning in the forefoot and heel. The white leather upper is secured with a unique cross-strap design and touched with perforated details on the side panel. A grey synthetic suede overlay engulfs the collar and heel for a textured feel. A colorful chenille Jumpman tongue patch adds an eye-catching element, while white overlays get a grey, black and red brushstroke design on the heel area.

shoeName: Jordan 9 Retro Boot NRG Black Light Gum
description: The Air Jordan 9 Retro Boot NRG 'Black Gum' features a black suede upper with a black leather mudguard. Finished with a water-resistant coating, the boot-like construction also comes with metal eyelets, a gusseted tongue and a rugged gum rubber outsole. The Air Jordan 9 was the first Air Jordan sneaker released after MJ retired from the NBA in 1994.

Commemorating 35 years of a classic silhouette, the Air Jordan 3 Retro 'White Cement Reimagined' marks the return of an original colorway and duplicating the build of the original 1988 model. The upper combines white leather with overlays on the heel and toe in the trademark elephant print that designer Tinker Hatfield introduced, with Varsity Red pops on the tongue’s Jumpman branding and the lace loops. Additional branding appears on the heel tab with ‘Nike Air.’ Comfort underfoot is ensured by a visible Air-sole unit and the back heel and midsole are imbued with an aged yellow tint to showcase a vintage look.

The Air Jordan 4 'London' honors the British capital with a dark grey hairy suede upper tooled with molded eyelets and a light grey side panel netting. Black support wings match the heel tab, which has a Red Bark Nike logo stamped with an LDN logo. The Jumpman logo embellishes the tongue, which has a label stitched inside that reads 'Say Less.' These kicks have a foam midsole with encapsulated Air-Sole cushioning in the forefoot and an Air heel bag for balanced cushioning.

Originally released in 2006, the 'Defining Moments Pack', also known as 'DMP', paired the AJ6 and AJ11 into a special release. Celebrating championship silhouettes that MJ wore, both shoes feature OG color blocking with gold accents. The 2023 iteration of the Air Jordan 11 Retro 'Gratitude' returns based on the original 'Concord' colorway. Featuring a white tumbled leather upper and a black patent leather rand around the shoe, Metallic Gold accents can be found on the embossed Jumpman logo on the heel and '23' stamped on the back. A Phylon midsole with Nike Air cushioning combines a carbon fiber shank plate and a clear rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Family Affair' has an olive green nubuck upper with matching forefoot and heel elephant print overlays. The Jumpman logo is embroidered on the tongue, while a raised Nike Air logo is showcased on the heel tab. The cream-colored foam midsole packs a visible Air-sole unit and dark olive details on the heel. The gum rubber outsole below brings traction to every step.

The 2025 iteration of the Air Jordan 12 Retro 'Taxi' rocks a Phylon midsole that contains a full-length Zoom Air unit. The outsole contains herringbone traction pods and a carbon fiber shank plate for stability. The white leather upper sports radiating stitch lines and metallic gold molded eyelets. Black lizard-textured overlays bolsters the design, while the Jumpman logo appears on the tongue and heel pull tab.

Released in December 2021, the Air Jordan 11 Retro 'Cool Grey' 2021 brings back a colorway from 2001 and 2010. Faithful to the OG, the shoe's upper is built with leather, finished in grey and supported by a darker grey patent leather mudguard. Tonal webbing eyelets are worked into the lacing system to secure the fit, while underfoot, a contrasting white phylon midsole houses full-length Air for cushioning, with a carbon fiber plate included for added support. An icy translucent rubber outsole provides traction.

The Women's Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Cozy Girl' rocks a thick off-white suede upper with the classic netted panel and support wings. The Jumpman logo decorates the beige tongue tag and molded heel tab. These kicks have a soft foam midsole, aided by encapsulated Air-sole cushioning in the forefoot and an Air heel unit. A herringbone-patterned rubber outsole brings traction to every step.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Love Letter
colorway: Shadow Brown/Shadow Brown/Soft Pearl/Light British Tan/Team Red
description: The Air Jordan 1 High OG 'Love The Game' refrences the open love letter to the game Michael Jordan wrote when he retired from basketball. These shoes have an off-white leather upper with black suede details on the Swoosh as well as the forefoot overlay. Brown nubuck suffuses the heel panel and collar flap, which is stamped with a Wings logo. The opposite end includes the letter's final line: 'Much Love and Respect.'

The 2023 Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Thunder' reintroduces the popular color scheme that was first released in 2006 and later reissued in 2012. The shoe's upper appears in all-black nubuck with yellow accents on the molded eyelets, lower tongue and quarter panel, the latter two draped with black netting. Cushioned comfort underfoot is supplied by a yellow PU midsole and is enhanced by the heel’s exposed Air-sole unit. The Flight tongue tag and molded heel tab bear the iconic Jumpman branding.

The 2026 version of the Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG 'Banned' rolls out a black tumbled leather upper touched with red accents on the toe box, Swoosh, heel overlay, and back tab. The latter gets a matching 'X,' a design feature taken from the 'Banned' AJ1 High released in 2011. The Nike Air tag decorates the tongue, while the rubber cupsole couples with white sidewalls and a red rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Flight Club
description: The Air Jordan 1 High OG 'Flight Club' references Jordan Brand's '80s and '90s mail-in membership program. The blackout upper has leather and knit overlays, touched with white contrast stitching and a red Wings logo on the heel. A red Nike Air tag decorates the exposed-foam tongue. The off-white midsole works alongside a gum rubber outsole to complete the look.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro Spring Is In The Air
description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Spring is in the Air' has an off-white leather upper accented with pale green elephant-print forefoot and heel overlays. An embroidered Jumpman logo lands on the tongue, while the partially see-through heel tab is stamped with a pink Nike Air logo. Light blue on the heel of the cream foam midsole adds a splash of color, packed with Air-Sole cushioning and anchored by a pastel pink rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 6 Retro 'Cap and Gown' sports a blackout upper, which has smooth nubuck accents with perforated satin panels touched with reflective borders. Nodding to the original design, the Nike Air logo decorates the heel in matching embroidery. Matte silver touches accent the foam midsole, complemented with an Air-Sole heel unit underfoot.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Black Toe Reimagined
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Black Toe Reimagined' throws it back to an OG sample colorway worn during Michael Jordan's rookie photo shoot. These shoes have a white leather upper, accented by a black forefoot overlay, collar and Swoosh. Red pops make their way to the heel overlay and collar flap, stamped with an 'Air Jordan' wordmark replacing the classic Wings logo. A woven Nike Air tag adorns the tongue, while these sneakers sport a rubber cupsole, anchored by a red outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG UNC Reimagined
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'UNC Reimagined' nods to Michael Jordan's alma mater, using a white cracked leather upper powder blue leather overlays and a matching Swoosh. The Wings logo is embossed on the collar flap, while the Nike Air tag lands on the tongue. An aged midsole contains an Air-sole heel unit anchored by a distressed powder blue rubber outsole.

The 2025 edition of the Air Jordan 11 Retro Low 'Bred' carries a black ballistic mesh upper with a matching patent leather mudguard. A small Jumpman logo decorates the black leather back tab, while 'Jumpman' and 'Jordan' are etched across the tongue. Full-length Air-sole cushioning couples with a white Phylon midsole, anchored by a see-through rubber outsole and a carbon fiber spring plate for stability.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Canary (Women's)
description: Inspired by the colors of Travis Scott's alma mater, Elkins High School, the Travis Scott x Women's Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP 'Canary' sports Scott's signature reverse Swoosh in Racer Blue, which embellishes the side panel. A white leather upper gets contrasting yellow forefoot and heel overlays for a bold look. A red-and-black Nike Air tag decorates the tongue, while Scott's Cactus Jack and Jordan Wings logos are embroidered on each heel tab. These sneakers have a traditional cupsole, accompanied by white textured sidewalls and a gum rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 16 'Black Pack' rocks a tumbled black leather upper concealed within a magnetic shroud that hides the lacing system. A black patent leather toe cap bolsters the forefoot, while mesh engulfs the heel. The mesh upper has nubuck overlays and tumbled leather panels. The monochromatic Phylon midsole gets a blow-molded Air heel unit and responsive Zoom Air cushioning in the forefoot area.

The 2025 iteration of the Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Black Cat' replicates the 2006 OG release, a nod to one of Michael Jordan's many nicknames. These sneakers have a blackout nubuck upper with an airy mesh side panel netting, lockdown wings and molded eyelets. The Jumpman logo is showcased on the tongue tag and heel tab. These shoes have a matching black midsole with Air-sole cushioning in the heel.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Zion Williamson Voodoo Alternate
description: The Zion Williamson x Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG 'Voodoo Alternate' nods to the Big Easy with a blue suede upper, secured with braided rope laces and bolstered with mismatched burlap-like multicolor overlays. Purple details adorn the black suede toe box, while irregular stitching decorates the forefoot and Swoosh. Green lands on the reverse mini-Swoosh embroidered on the toe, along with inverted Nike Air and Wings logos on the tongue and back tab, respectively. A voodoo doll graphic on the heel finishes it off in style.

shoeName: Jordan 6 Retro Awake NY Midnight Navy
description: The Awake NY x Air Jordan 6 Retro 'Blueberry' nods to the kicks Michael Jordan rocked when he won his first NBA championship. Pink contrast stitching delineates the powder blue suede upper, complemented with pale blue leather midfoot overlays. Textured navy leather surrounds the collar and heel, the latter featuring a red 'Nike Awake NY' callout. Awake's signature 'A' emblem lands on the side panel. A navy foam midsole equips Air technology underfoot, decorated with red speckles throughout.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro Valentine's Day Sierra Red (Women's)
description: The Women's Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Valentine's Day' commemorates the February holiday with an off-white leather upper hit with contrasting red pops on the molded eyelets, collar lining, as well as the Jumpman on the tongue tag and heel. A red foam midsole gets an exposed Air-sole heel unit for a plush feel underfoot.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro OG Black Metallic Reimagined
description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro OG 'Black Metallic Reimagined' sports a black nubuck upper with molded eyelets, its typical side panel netting and reflective piping details. More 3M reflective accents reach the padded Jumpman tongue and the raised Nike Air-branded heel. These shoes have a foam midsole decorated with metallic silver sharktooth details and an exposed Air-sole heel unit. A partially see-through rubber outsole wraps up the look.

Bringing back an OG colorway, the Air Jordan 11 Retro 'Bred' 2019 features a familiar Chicago Bulls look. The shoe's upper is built with a mix of mesh and patent leather, all finished in black, save for the Varsity Red Jumpman and white '23.' Underfoot, a contrasting white midsole houses Air and a midfoot plate, while a Varsity Red rubber outsole provides traction and completes the look.

The 2025 edition of the Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Grape' stays true to the OG release, a white leather upper gets the signature side window net panels and molded eyelets. The teal embroidered Jumpman stands out against a purple backdrop, while the heel gets a Nike Air logo. These shoes have a purple midsole with turquoise shark tooth details and an exposed Air-sole heel unit. The see-through rubber outsole completes the look.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro ‘Red Cement’ is a midtop delivered in a color scheme reminiscent of the original ‘White Cement’ model, with a white leather upper with black accents on the lining and molded eyelets. Fire Red accents with black speckling adorn the support wings, heel tab and midsole. The heel displays an embossed Jumpman logo, and a second Jumpman appears on the tongue tag. The herringbone-patterned rubber outsole provides excellent grip on the court.

shoeName: Jordan 14 Retro Mule Mowalola Burnt Red

description: The Air Jordan 11 Retro 'Rare Air' is inspired by the imperfections found on early Air Jordan samples. These shoes have a white leather upper with a shiny blue patent leather mudguard. A red Jumpman logo adorns the side, while 'Jordan' is spelled out through each of the webbed eyelets, and a stylized '23' signoff lands on the back tab. The Phylon midsole works in tandem with a full-length Air-sole unit and a see-through rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Sail University Red
description: The Air Jordan 1 High Retro OG 'Sail University Red' rocks an off-white upper with soft beige forefoot and heel overlays. Pale grey accents arrive on the knit eyestay, pebbled leather collar, and elephant print Swoosh. A red Nike Air tag adorns the tongue, while the retro Wings logo is debossed on the collar flap. A cream-hued, partially see-through rubber outsole undergirds the design.

Featuring the same color blocking and materials used on the OG 'Military Blue' colorway from 1989 is the Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Military Black.' The upper is made with smooth white leather with a forefoot overlay in grey suede. Black accents are on the TPU eyelets, molded heel tab, and the Jumpman logo on the woven tongue tag. It's built on a two-tone polyurethane midsole with a visible Air-sole unit under the heel.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG SP Union LA Chicago Shadow
description: The Union LA x Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG SP 'Chicago Shadow' combines two OG colorways. Part of the upper is based on the original 'Chicago' colorway, using a white leather upper with contrasting red overlays and a black Swoosh. Separated via exposed zigzag stitches, the collar borrows from the AJ1 'Shadow,' complemented by grey overlays on a black background. The opposite side gets a Wings logo and a yellow 'UN/LA' label, while a Nike Air tongue tag adds to the signature look. A vintage-style midsole finishes the look.

The 2025 edition of the Air Jordan 12 Retro 'Flu Game' brings back the model MJ wore during the infamous Game 5 of the 1997 NBA Finals. Stitch lines adorn the black tumbled leather upper, contrasted by red lizard-textured overlays. The Jumpman emblem decorates the tongue and heel tab. A lightweight Phylon midsole packs a full-length Zoom Air unit for a plush feel. The red rubber outsole uses black herringbone pods for traction and an exposed carbon fiber shank plate for stability.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Medium Soft Pink' rolls out a black foam midsole accented with pink sharktooth details and equipped with a Air-sole heel unit. The white leather upper is complemented with a see-through side panel netting and a pink embroidered '23' on the heel. More pink pops decorate the collar lining, Jumpman logo on the tongue and the Nike Air heel logo.

shoeName: Air Jordan 4 Retro OG SP Nigel Sylvester Brick by Brick
description: The Nigel Sylvester x Air Jordan 4 Retro OG SP 'Brick By Brick' sports a monochromatic, orange suede upper with the traditional quarter netting, molded eyelets and plastic support wings. Off-white accents land on the Flight logo, Jumpman tongue tag and an embroidered forefoot mini-Swoosh. The Bike Air insignia adorns the heel tab, while an off-white foam midsole packs an Air-sole heel unit for soft cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro OG SP A Ma Maniére While You Were Sleeping (Women's)
description: The A Ma Maniére x Women's Air Jordan 4 Retro 'While You Were Sleeping' takes a grey leather upper and adds matching suede forefoot overlays and a deconstructed knit collar. Iconic details like the quarter-panel netting, molded eyelets and prominent support wings are kept intact. The Jumpman and A Ma Maniére logos take turns on each tongue tag, while a raised Nike Air logo graces the heel. A two-tone midsole boasts an exposed Air-sole heel unit for a plush feel underfoot.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro 'White Thunder' rocks a black suede upper with complementing white touches on the eyelets and quarter panel. Matching white Jumpman logos embellish the tongue tag and heel. A white foam midsole equips a visible Air-sole heel unit, anchored by a herringbone-pattern rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro OG GS 'White Cement' 2025 sports white leather on the upper and the unmistakable quarter panel netting to go with black molded eyelets. A red Jumpman logo lands on the Flight tongue tag, while the Nike Air logo adorns the grey speckled heel tab. That same finish can be seen on the wings and on part of the foam midsole, fitted with an Air-sole heel unit. The rubber outsole has a herringbone traction pattern for smooth grip.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Patent Bred
description: Featuring a classic mix of hues, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Patent Bred' also sports an elevated construction. Built entirely with patent leather, the shoe's upper appears in a familiar mix of black and Varsity Red, with perforations on the toe box offering breathability. Underfoot, a white Air midsole provides cushioning and contrast, giving way to a Varsity Red finish on the concentric rubber outsole, which is included for traction.

The 2025 version of the Air Jordan 8 Retro 'Aqua' uses teal and purple hues on the foam midsole, which packs Nike Air in the forefoot and heel areas. Loyal to the original 1993 design, these sneakers have a black and grey nubuck upper secured with a unique cross-strap design. The signature multicolor chenille tongue tag is stamped with a red Jumpman logo, and a teal support panel that sports purple brush strokes.

shoeName: Jordan 6 Retro Awake NY Playful Pink
description: The Awake NY x Air Jordan 6 Retro 'Bubblegum' sports pink touches on the suede and leather upper, which includes Awake's 'A' logo on the partially see-through side panel. A red Jumpman emblem is embroidered on the neoprene lace cover, while an 'Nike Awake NY' signoff adorns the heel. A black foam midsole gets a series of speckled red accents and an Air-Sole heel unit underfoot.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Medium Olive
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG 'Medium Olive' rocks a black Swoosh on the white leather upper, tooled with olive nubuck forefoot and heel overlays. The Nike Air logo appears on the tongue tag, while a debossed Wings logo adorns the back tab. These shoes ride on a rubber cupsole, complemented by off-white sidewalls and an olive-hued rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low Midnight Navy Neutral Grey
description: The Air Jordan 1 Low 'Georgetown' uses the colors of the Hoyas, starting with a white leather upper touched with light grey suede overlays. A navy Swoosh matches the Jumpman logo on the tongue and the Wings emblem on the heel. These shoes have a classic foam midsole coupled with white sidewalls and a gum rubber outsole.

The 2025 version of the Air Jordan 12 Retro 'French Blue' stays loyal to the 2004 OG release, starting with a Phylon midsole equipped with a full-length Zoom Air unit. The blue rubber outsole uses herringbone traction pods and an exposed carbon fiber shank for stability. These shoes have a white tumbled leather upper with radiating stitch lines and a blue lizard-like overlay.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low OG Rookie of the Year
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG 'Rookie of the Year' takes cues from the 2018 AJ1 High of the same name. Inspired by the outfit Michael Jordan wore during his Rookie of the Year acceptance speech in 1985, these shoes have a white and tan leather upper. A black Wings logo adorns the back tab, matching the Swoosh on the side panel and the collar lining. A red-on-black Nike Air tag adorns the tongue, while the rubber cupsole contains an encapsulated Air-sole unit for a soft feel.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Flight Club' nods to the mail-in membership program Nike ran from the late '80s to the early '90s. These sneakers have an off-white leather upper with a matching suede forefoot overlay. Black molded eyelets match the midsole and heel tab, the latter stamped with a raised Nike Air logo. The Flight Club logo decorates the tongue tag and insoles. Red accents inside the tongue match the herringbone-patterned rubber outsole for a dash of contrast.

The Air Jordan 1 Low SE 'Concord' keeps colors from a classic Air Jordan 11 design. The white leather upper is contrasted by black patent leather on the forefoot and heel overlay, as well as the Swoosh. A Jumpman logo adorns the tongue, while a stitched Wings logo decorates the heel. The insoles are stamped with 'Jumpman' and 'Jordan' in dark letters, using the same typeface from the AJ11 tongue signoff. A see-through rubber outsole keeps you surefooted through the day.

The Nike SB x Air Jordan 4 Retro SP 'Pine Green' offers a skateboarding-inspired take on the iconic silhouette. The shoe's leather upper in off-white is complemented by a forefoot overlay light grey suede for added durability. Hits of green can be found on the molded eyelets and heel tab, which displays Nike SB branding. The Flight tongue tag provides a striking pop of color with a crimson Jumpman. The sneaker's foam midsole incorporates an exposed Air-sole unit in the heel and rides on a gum outsole.

The 2026 version of the Air Jordan 5 Retro GS 'Wolf Grey' nods to the 2011 release, sporting a textured grey nubuck upper with partially see-through side panel netting and a '23' signoff on the heel. The Jumpman logo adorns the reflective tongue and heel. Speckled shark tooth details land on the grey foam midsole, which equips an Air-Sole cushioning unit and a see-through rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE 'Space Jam' dons a sleek design with elements from the classic Air Jordan 11 colorway that bears the same name. The black leather upper gets hits of glossy patent leather on the overlays and Swoosh. A debossed Wings logo decorates the collar flap, while the tongue tag showcases the Jumpman logo. The white foam midsole works in tandem with a blue, see-through rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro OG 'Rare Air' has a black leather upper with grey suede overlays on the forefoot and heel areas. Blue touches land on the shoelaces, perforated suede collar, and Air-assisted foam midsole. An embroidered red Jumpman lands on the tongue, matching the raised Nike Air logo on the heel. The Nike Air logo stars on the left shoe, while a mirror image of it embellishes the right one.

This 'Yellow Toe' colorway of the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG also known as 'Taxi' brings back a distinct blocking first seen in the 'Bred Toe' from 2018. The all leather build combines a white base with a yellow toe box and heel/ankle area. Black leather overlays the toe and lace area, as well as appearing on the Wings logo and Swoosh. The classic AJ1 midsole/outsole combination returns, with a crisp white sidewall and yellow rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG 'Obsidian UNC' has a white leather upper with dark navy accents on the Swoosh, eyestay and forefoot overlay. In honor of Michael Jordan's alma mater, Carolina blue engulfs the heel overlay and Wings-branded back tab. A traditional rubber cupsole gets stitched sidewalls and Air-sole cushioning on the heel for a responsive feel.

A new entry in the lineage of the Air Jordan 11, the 'Cherry' also known as 'Varsity Red' features a clean colorway that utilizes a Chicago Bulls inspired palette. The upper features white mesh with tonal webbing eyelets, while a shiny patent leather mudguard wraps around the entire shoe in a deep red hue. A red Jumpman logo appears on the back heel area, while a translucent rubber outsole finishes the look. A lightweight Phylon midsole provides cushioning while a carbon fiber spring plate offers structural support underfoot.

Released to celebrate 30 years of the silhouette, the Air Jordan 6 Retro OG 'Carmine' 2021 emerges with a contrasting look. The shoe's upper features a mix of leather and nubuck, finished in white and carmine, with black contrast completing the team look. Underfoot, the midsole houses visible Air in the heel to provide cushioning.

The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG 'Sail' has an off-white leather upper tooled with a series of perforations on the toe box. The Wings logo is debossed on the heel tab, while a red Nike Air logo appears on the tongue tag. The rubber cupsole keeps the monochromatic design.

Featuring a look similar to Travis Scott's 2019 Air Jordan 1 collaboration, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Dark Mocha' released in October 2020. The shoe's upper is built with leather, sporting a white base overlaid by black leather. The heel and collar incorporate Dark Mocha nubuck, while a nylon tongue and perforations on the toe box maintain the classic aesthetic. Air in the heel of the midsole provides cushioning.

The 2026 version of the Air Jordan 11 Retro Low GS 'University Blue' rocks a white leather upper, touched with a University Blue glossy patent leather mudguard. A stylized '23' adorns the heel tab, joined by a small Jumpman logo right below. The white Phylon midsole works alongside a see-through rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro OG 'Bred' 2019 released to help celebrate the 30th annivesary of the silhouette. Featuring the same OG colorway that Michael Jordan wore while hitting 'The Shot' in 1989, the shoe features a black nubuck upper complemented by hits of Cement Grey. Fire Red accents emerge on the tongue and outsole, while Air in the heel provides cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG SP Fragment x Union LA Sport Royal
description: The Fragment Design x Union LA x Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Sport Royal' takes elements from the OG 'Royal' colorway, sporting a black tumbled leather upper touched with royal blue accents on the toe box, Swoosh, and heel overlay. Union LA's zigzag stitching pipes the outside portion of the collar, made from white hairy suede with matching leather collar flaps. The Union LA label meets a navy Wings logo on the ankle area. A Fragment Design emblem is debossed on the heel, undergirded by a cream-colored rubber midsole.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low Light Smoke Grey Off Noir
Jordan 1 Retro High OG University Blue
description: Paying tribute to Michael Jordan's college alma mater, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'University Blue' features a University of North Carolina look. Built entirely with leather, the shoe's upper appears in a mix of white and University Blue, contrasted by black on the Swoosh, collar, laces and 'Wings' logo. Perforations on the toe box provide breathability, while underfoot, the Air midsole gives way to a concentric outsole with a brighter shade of blue.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro SE Paris Olympics Wet Cement
description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro SE 'Wet Cement' also known as 'Paris Olympics' rocks a monochromatic design, paying tribute to the 2024 Summer Olympics. Multiple shades of grey appear on the nubuck upper, including a suede forefoot overlay and a debossed grid pattern on the side panel. Speckled details on the support wings and molded back tab add a touch of flair, while a Jumpman logo adorns the tongue. These shoes sport a grey midsole with an exposed Air-sole heel unit for plush cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan 11 Retro Low APB Binary Blue

description: The 2025 iteration of the Air Jordan 11 Retro GS 'Gamma Blue' remains faithful to the original 2013 release, sporting a black ballistic mesh upper with a matching patent leather mudguard. A Gamma Blue Jumpman logo decorates the collar, while the back tab is stamped with a maize-colored, stylized '23' signoff. The black Phylon midsole works closely with an ice blue-hued, partially see-through rubber outsole.

Releasing to celebrate 25 years of the iconic silhouette, the Air Jordan 11 Retro 'Jubilee / 25th Anniversary' emerges with a classic look. The shoe's upper is built with a ballistic mesh base, overlaid by patent leather, with both elements finished in black. The 3D metallic Jumpman and '23' heel branding accent the look in silver, with a similar finish on the 'Jordan' that marks the eyelets. Underfoot, a white Air midsole provides cushioning and contrast, giving way to a translucent rubber outsole for traction.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro OG SP A Ma Maniére While You Were Sleeping (Women's)
description: The A Ma Maniére x Women's Air Jordan 3 Retro 'While You Were Sleeping' mixes a black tumbled leather upper with grey hairy suede forefoot and heel overlays. Perforated violet ore nubuck hits adorn the eyestay and quilted satin-lined collar, which is stripped of padding. A slimmed down tongue alternates the luxury brand's 'A' logo next to the iconic Jumpman logo, while a raised Nike Air logo graces the heel tab. A vintage off-white foam midsole packs an exposed Air-sole heel unit for a plush feel underfoot.

The 2016 reissue of the Air Jordan 11 Retro ‘Space Jam’ was successful enough that it surpassed all previous releases in Nike history to become the brand’s highest grossing sneaker to date. The retro launch, marking the 20th anniversary of the shoe’s namesake film, features a design that’s true to Michael Jordan’s original PE colorway, including the ‘45’ printed in white on the heel tab.

The Air Jordan 6 Rings sneaker pays tribute to Michael Jordan's six NBA championships by combining design elements from all the Air Jordan models he wore during those wins. The 'Space Jam' version from January 2018 features a shiny mudguard that wraps around the foot against a mesh upper. It offers customizable support with Velcro straps and a special lace system and rests on Phylon cushioning with Zoom Air units and an icy outsole for traction.

The Women’s Air Jordan 4 Retro ‘Metallic Gold’ has a smooth leather upper with a subtle off-white finish and metallic gold eyelets for a regal look. These shoes have a breathable quarter panel netting and a debossed Jumpman logo on the tongue. The prominent molded heel tab backs a plush collar. Underneath, a soft midsole reveals an Air-sole heel unit for soft cushioning. The classic herringbone rubber outsole provides traction and optimal grip.

shoeName: Jordan 9 Retro Low What The Kilroy
colorway: Black/University Blue/University Gold/Dark Cayenne/Challenge Red/Deep Royal Blue

description: The 2018 version of the Air Jordan 11 Retro ‘Concord’ shows off ‘45’ imprinted on the black heel tab in honor of the jersey number that Michael Jordan wore when he returned to the NBA after his first retirement. The shoe’s other signature details remain intact, including a white ballistic mesh upper, black patent leather overlays, and an icy translucent outsole.

Honoring the uniforms Team USA wore during the 2000 Sydney Olympics, the 2024 version of the Air Jordan 6 Retro 'Olympic' sports a navy tumbled leather upper with contrasting white overlays. Red Jumpman logos appear on the lace guard and the back of the heel, completing the red, white and blue colorway. Traditional details like the molded two-hole tongue, lace locks and a spoiler-like pull tab remain intact. A lightweight foam midsole equips an exposed Air-sole heel unit, anchored by a see-through rubber outsole for steady traction on and off the court.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro SE Craft Medium Olive
description: With a muted Medium Olive green upper in nubuck and suede, the Air Jordan 4 Retro SE Craft in 'Olive' replaces the standard midfoot netting found on the original AJ4 utilizing a hairy suede texture with a debossed grid-like pattern on the quarter panels. The leather support wings, molded eyelets, and woven tongue tag appear in black with Flight branding. A Jumpman logo appears in cream on the tongue and rear tab. Underneath, a clean white polyurethane midsole visible Air-sole heel cushioning ensures comfort and support.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Bred Reimagined' refreshes the iconic silhouette with a black leather upper instead of the original’s nubuck construction. Classic elements appear via the textile lining and molded eyelets with Cement Grey accents. The heel tab displays OG Nike Air branding, and a crimson Jumpman logo adorns the woven Flight tongue tag. The PU midsole has a visible Air-sole unit in the heel for added comfort.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Fire Red' sees one of the original colors of the silhouette return, true to form. A white leather upper is paired with grey elephant print overlays on the toe and heel, while Fire Red accents on the midsole and collor offers a pop of contrast. Designed by Tinker Hatfield, the Air Jordan 3 was the first to feature a visible Nike Air unit, along with the Jumpman logo. This 2022 edition sees the return of the 'Nike Air' logo on the back heel, along with the 'Nike' wordmark on the outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG UNC Toe
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG ‘UNC Toe’ pays homage to Michael Jordan’s college with a color scheme that recalls the 2018 ‘Bred Toe’ AJ1 release. The shoe features white quarter panels and black overlays on the Swoosh and forefoot against an all-leather base. The toe box, heel, and collar flap are adorned with University Blue accents, with a lateral-side classic Wings logo. The breathable nylon tongue has a retro Nike tag, and lightweight cushioning is provided by a white rubber midsole with an Air-sole heel unit within a polyurethane wedge. Underfoot, sturdy traction is ensured by the blue rubber outsole.

Bringing back the mid-top that Michael wore during his 1997 championship campaign is the 2022 edition of the Air Jordan 12 Retro 'Playoff.' It features an essential two-tone color scheme, featuring radiating stitched lines on the black leather upper and lizard-textured overlays in a contrasting white finish. Metallic silver eyelets are molded on, while color-popped crimson accents land on the Jumpman-embroidered tongue and webbing heel loop. Full-length Zoom Air cushioning is underneath with a carbon fiber shank plate and a rubber outsole with herringbone traction pods under the forefoot and heel.

shoeName: Jordan Jumpman Jack TR Travis Scott Dark Mocha
description: The Travis Scott x Jordan Jumpman Jack TR 'Dark Mocha' dons La Flame's signature reverse Swoosh in black suede, matching the black canvas upper and complementing the brown nubuck overlays. The Jumpman logo adorns the tongue, while the Cactus Jack smiley logo graces the heel area. 'TS' is embroidered on the adjustable forefoot strap, while an oversized 'Jack' graphic can be seen on the black rubber outsole. The matching black foam midsole above keeps every step plush and comfortable.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Black Phantom
description: The Travis Scott x Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP 'Black Phantom' sees the Houston-based rapper color up another AJ1 Low. This iteration features a blacked-out look, with nubuck and suede on the upper underscored by white contrast stitching throughout. Scott's signature reverse Swoosh remains, alongside a regular Swoosh on the medial side with Cactus Jack branding. The back heel features mismatched branding, with a Wings logo on the right shoe and a bee graphic on the left.

The Air Jordan 1 Mid 'Palomino' brings a white leather upper hit with contrasting black leather on the forefoot overlay, collar, and Swoosh. A brown nubuck toe box matches the heel and collar flap. The latter is stamped with a Wings logo on the side to maintain the classic look. A red Jumpman logo appears on the black tongue tag, adding that bold contrast. The off-white midsole works alongside a black rubber outsole to complete the look.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Phantom Pine Green
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG 'Phantom Pine Green' has a series of lush accents and distressed details on the pale grey leather upper. Cracked black leather forefoot and heel overlays add a distinctive touch, including a reptile-like green Swoosh that matches a smaller, embroidered version on the forefoot. The Wings logo on the heel tab meets a Nike Air tongue tag to maintain the signature look. The gum rubber outsole below ensures swift traction underfoot.

Arriving in a color scheme MJ first revealed on the court at the 1998 NYC All-Star Game, the Air Jordan 13 Retro 'Playoff' 2023 brings back a favorite colorway true to form. The upper arrives in quilted leather and suede in an allover black finish with pops of color arriving on the tongue with a yellow and red Jumpman logo and ‘Jordan’ in yellow on the toe box. A holographic emblem appears on the back heel. The white-and-red midsole pods and segmented outsole resemble panther paws underfoot as a nod to Jordan’s nickname, the 'black cat.'

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Lakers' comes dressed in a purple nubuck upper complemented with black accents on the side panel netting, collar lining, support wings and heel tab. The latter gets a yellow Nike Air logo dusted in purple speckles. A matching yellow Jumpman logo adorns the tongue tag. These shoes have a black and white midsole bolstered with Air-sole cushioning in the heel.

Released in May 2021, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Shadow 2.0' brings back a neutral colorway from 1985. Built with a black leather base, the shoe's upper is overlaid by Light Smoke Grey suede throughout. More Light Smoke Grey marks the Swoosh branding, while underfoot, a contrasting white midsole houses Air in the heel for cushioning, giving way to a concentric rubber outsole for traction.

The Air Jordan 6 Retro 'UNC Home' pays homage to Michael Jordan’s alma mater, bearing a colorway reminiscent of the University of North Carolina. The classic hoops sneakers feature a white leather upper set against University Blue nubuck underlays. Hits of navy appear on the molded TPU heel tab and collar lining. Navy repeats on the midsole, which houses visible Air-sole cushioning. The jock tag on the heel reinforces the shoe’s varsity athletics theme.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro 'University Blue' looks to Michael Jordan's college days to inform its classic look. Built with suede, the shoe's upper appears primarily in University Blue, with cement detailing on the classic wings and heel overlay. Tonal mesh inserts emerge at the vamp and quarter panel, while the tongue tag is designed to look like a jock tag on the bottom hem of Jordan jerseys. Visible Air in the heel of the speckled midsole provides cushioning.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Fear' stays loyal to the 2013 version, bringing a black nubuck upper accented with grey and silver details. The Jumpman logo graces the tongue tag, matching the white molded eyelets and collar lining. Another Jumpman logo can be found on the molded heel panel, matching the speckled details on the black foam midsole.

The Air Jordan 1 Mid ‘Triple Black’ takes cues from its 1985 predecessor, rolling out a blackout leather upper with classic details like a perforated toe box and a retro Wings logo below the collar flap. The Jumpman logo stars on the tongue, while a traditional rubber cupsole keeps the monochromatic aesthetic intact.

Originally released in 2009 as part of the two-shoe Raging Bulls pack, the Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Raging Bull' 2021 brings back one of those colorways with this April 2021 release. The shoe's suede upper appears entirely in Varsity Red, contrasted by black eyelets and highlighted by a reflective silver tongue. Mesh inserts maintain the classic Jordan aesthetic, with a toggle lacing system securing the fit. Underfoot, the polyurethane midsole includes visible Air in the heel for cushioning, highlighted by the white and red shark-tooth detailing on the forefoot.

The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Bordeaux' emerges with a rich colorway. The shoe's leather upper appears with a white base, overlaid by Bordeaux leather throughout. The Swoosh branding and jewel 'Wings' logo add metallic silver to the look, with a lightly padded nylon tongue supporting the fit. Underfoot, Air in the heel of the midsole offers cushioning, giving way to a concentric rubber outsole for traction.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Reverse Mocha
description: Giving a remix on the original 'Mocha' AJ1 from 2019 is the Travis Scott x Air Jordan 1 Retro Low. The upper features a brown suede base with ivory leather overlays and Scott's signature reverse Swoosh on the lateral side with oversized dimensions and a neutral cream finish. Contrasting scarlet accents distinguish a pair of woven Nike Air tongue tags and mismatched heel tabs with a Cactus Jack and retro Wings logos embroidered. It's built on an off-white rubber midsole with encapsulated Nike Air cushioning in the heel and a brown rubber outsole underfoot.

The Women's Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Orchid' rolls out a lilac-colored suede upper with a visible side netting and grey molded eyelets. Speckled details adorn the support wings and molded back tab, adorned with the Jumpman logo, much like the foam midsole. Encapsulated Air-sole cushioning rests in the forefoot, while the heel equips an exposed Air bag for a soft feel underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Jordan Poole Milk and Cookies
description: The Jordan Poole x Nike GT Cut 3 'Milk and Cookies' nods to the shooting guard's favorite snack. These kicks have a dark tan knit upper, wrapped in irregular brown spots that mirror the look of chocolate chips. Flywire cables are built into the lacing system for a lockdown feel. The mottled design carries into the midsole, which consists of Phylon foam and a full-length ZoomX unit. The two-part rubber outsole gets a modified herringbone pattern for traction in all directions.

The Air Jordan 11 Retro Low GS 'Bred' 2025 brings back the classic Chicago Bulls-based colorway, starting with a black ballistic mesh upper, secured with rope laces that feed through webbed eyelets. A shiny patent leather mudguard bolsters the design, which rides on a white Phylon midsole, aided by full-length Air-sole cushioning and a carbon fiber shank plate. A see-through red rubber outsole uses herringbone pods for better traction.

The Women's Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Forget Me Not', also known as 'Aluminum', carries a white leather upper with contrasting powder blue touches on the collar lining, support wing, and molded back tab. A Jumpman emblem lands on the tongue tag, while a foam midsole works closely with an exposed Air-sole heel unit for a resilient feel.

The 2026 version of the Air Jordan 11 Retro 'Space Jam' throws it back to the kicks Michael Jordan wore during the 1995-96 NBA Playoffs. Made famous during the 'Space Jam' movie, these basketball shoes have a ballistic mesh upper with a matching black patent leather mudguard. A blue Jumpman decorates the collar. The white Phylon midsole packs full-length Air-Sole cushioning for a plush feel underfoot. The see-through rubber outsole reveals herringbone traction pods and an exposed carbon fiber spring plate below.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Seoul 2.0' is a sequel of the 2018 design, celebrating the 30th anniversary of the Seoul Olympics. These sneakers have a worn in vintage-looking foam midsole aided by a visible Nike Air heel unit. The white tumbled leather upper is complemented by grey elephant print forefoot and heel overlays. A royal-colored stitched knit collar and a red interior lining add the first touches of contrast. An embroidered Jumpman emblem decorates the right tongue, while the Korean flag adorns the left.

Recalling the 'Thunder' colorway, the Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Red Thunder', also known as 'Crimson', emerges with similar color-blocking, albeit in a different mix of hues. The shoe's upper is built with a black nubuck base, highlighted by red throughout, including on the molded eyelets and quarter panel. More red marks the midsole, which includes visible Air for cushioning, while a two-tone rubber outsole is included for traction.

The Air Jordan 6 Retro 'Infrared' 2019 is a 2019 re-release of the OG colorway. The shoe's black nubuck upper includes a reflective 3M layer, with perforations throughout for breathability. The heel, tongue and lace lock sport Infrared accents, with the color also featured on the signature midsole detailing. Visible Air in the heel provides cushioning, while the tranlucent sections continue down onto the outsole for traction.

The historical significance of the Air Jordan 11 Retro 'Win Like 96' will be abundantly apparent to Chicago Bulls fans. In 1996, the Bulls capped off the regular season with a record-breaking 72 victories on their way to a fourth NBA title. During that magical run, Michael wore the Jordan 11, and this release in December 2017, dressed in a brilliant red shade, honors the ' 96 squad that couldn't lose.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Rare Air' has a black nubuck upper with matching side panel netting and support wings. A grey suede overlay bolsters the forefoot, while red molded eyelets add a touch of flair. A blue Nike Air heel tab matches the knit collar lining, while an inverted Jumpman logo decorates the left tongue, a nod to the imperfections found on early Jordan samples. The blue midsole contains Air-sole cushioning in the heel and a grey-and-red rubber outsole below.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro SP A Ma Maniére Violet Ore
colorway: Fossil Stone / Metallic Pewter / Burgundy Crush
description: Following the AJ 1, 2 and 3 collaborations, Atlanta-based retailer A Ma Maniére returns with their take on the AJ4. The A Ma Maniére x Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Violet Ore' showcases premium materials and understated colors on the classic silhouette. A nubuck upper in a purple hue is accented with tonal quarter panel netting and a chrome rivet on the lateral collar area. Flight tags on the tongue show mismatched Jumpman and A Ma Maniére branding, while the classic 'Nike Air' can be found on the back heel. The back heel tab features the phrase 'It's not about the shoes...it's about where you're going' hidden on the inside, while a quilted textile lines the inside of the shoe and the insole.

The Tar Heels’ school colors are honored in the Air Jordan 5 Retro SE ‘UNC.’ With shark-tooth details on the black midsole, the University Blue nubuck leather upper is complemented by breathable netting at the quarter panel. The tongue is adorned with a stitched Jumpman in reflective silver. Support and traction underfoot are supplied by a PU midsole in black with an exposed Air-sole unit in the heel atop a herringbone-patterned clear outsole. a translucent herringbone-traction outsole.

The 2026 version of the Air Jordan 14 Retro GS 'Black University Blue' stays loyal to the 2006 release, starting with a black suede upper with matching stitching on the side panel. A Ferrari-inspired Jumpman emblem adorns the side. An University Blue tongue matches the heel tab, as well as the Phylon midsole, which packs Zoom Air cushioning. A chrome-plated shank promotes midfoot stability.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Lucky Green
description: Recalling a legendary 1986 series between the Chicago Bulls and the Boston Celtics is the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG ‘Lucky Green.’ This colorway first surfaced as one pair in the 2009 Air Jordan 1 ‘Defining Moments Pack.' The high-top arrives in a smooth white leather combined with a padded collar, forefoot overlay and signature Swoosh in a contrasting black. Hits of Kelly green adorn the overlay at the heel and the ankle flap, while the lateral side is decorated by a retro Wings logo. Branding is simple with the trademark Nike tongue tag indicating its OG status.

The Jordan Spizike Low 'Black Cat' takes design cues from five classic Jordan models. The black suede upper sports a side panel netting and matching elephant-print leather forefoot and heel overlays. Lockdown wings are built into the laces for containment, while a webbed heel pull loop allows for on and off. These shoes have a black foam midsole that packs an Air-sole heel unit.

The Women's Air Jordan 1 Low 'White Wolf Grey' features a white rubber midsole with cushioning and a translucent rubber outsole for support and style. The tongue features a silver Jumpman logo, and the back heel has a retro Wings logo. The white leather upper displays light grey accents and a matching Swoosh.

shoeName: Nike SB Dunk Low Dashawn Jordan Copperhead
description: The Dashawn Jordan x Nike Dunk Low SB 'Copperhead' nods to the skater's home state of Arizona. Using elements from the Arizona Diamondbacks uniforms, these shoes have a black suede upper with snakeskin-print forefoot and heel overlays. Purple knit lines the collar, contrasted by a teal leather back tab embroidered with the Nike logo. Dashawn Jordan's logo decorates the insoles, which houses Zoom Air heel unit, while the black rubber cupsole completes the look.

The AIr Jordan 4 Retro 'Midnight Navy' heavily borrows from the White/Cement OG colorway, including the grey paint splatter midsole and TPU wings. Midnight Navy hits on the lace loops, Jumpman logos and the midsole add a sharp contrast against the white leather upper. Other defining AJ4 details remain, including a visible Nike Air unit in the heel for cushioning and a modified herringbone traction pattern on the rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 12 Retro 'Cherry' 2023 edition honors Michael Jordan's penultimate championship season with the OG colorway of white stitched leather and vibrant scarlet lizard-textured overlays. The sneaker’s Phylon midsole with full-length Zoom Air cushioning sits atop a semi-clear red rubber outsole with black herringbone traction pods and an exposed carbon fiber shank plate. Jordan branding is stitched in black on the tongue to match the lining of the shoe's textile collar.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG SP Travis Scott Mocha
description: A collaboration between Travis Scott and Jordan brand, the Travis Scott x Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Mocha' features an oversized backward Swoosh on the lateral side. The tumbled white leather and Dark Mocha suede construction is accented by University Red Cactus Jack and Nike branding on the tongue, while the heel sports Scott's face logo in a debossed fashion.

colorway: Off White/Anthracite/Neutral Grey/Fire Pink/Light Arctic Pink/Muslin
description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Comic' showcases vibrant accents inspired by classic comic books. The legacy silhouette features a white leather upper with black TPU support wings as well as pink-and-red molded eyelets. The partially see-through side panel uses a pink, peach, and yellow gradient. Nodding to the comic book art, Ben-Day dots highlight the Jumpman tongue tag, as well as the Nike Air logo on the heel tab. A bicolor foam midsole gets an Air-Sole heel unit, undergirded by a pink, partially see-through rubber outsole for steady traction below.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG All-Star Cool Grey
