description: The Air Jordan 1 High Retro OG 'Cool Grey' sports a white leather upper with grey shaggy suede forefoot and heel overlays. A black Swoosh adorns the side panel, matching the high-cut suede collar. Star-shaped perforations on the toe box and a gold-plated Wings logo add a signature touch. A blue-colored, partially see-through rubber outsole keeps you surefooted through the day.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Hyper Royal
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Hyper Royal' brings a weathered look to the basketball classic. The shoe's upper features a white leather base, overlaid by suede that sports a faded blue aesthetic. Light Smoke Grey complements the Swoosh and padded collar, while underfoot, a white Air midsole is included for cushioning. Further Light Smoke Grey emerges on the concentric rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Fragment x Travis Scott
description: The Fragment Design x Travis Scott x Air Jordan 1 Retro Low released as part of a collaboration with the Houston rapper and Japanese imprint. Featuring a colorway that recalls previous fragment design collaborations, the shoe's upper is built with a white leather base, overlaid by black and royal blue and complemented by inverted Swoosh branding on the lateral side. The heel patch of the left shoe includes Cactus Jack branding and a smiley face logo, while fragment's lightning bolt marks the right shoe. Underfoot, a two-tone rubber cupsole anchors the design.

The Women's Air Jordan 10 Retro 'Hydrangeas' uses ivory-hued leather on the upper, contrasted by vibrant purple accents on the collar and throat. An embroidered Jumpman logo adorns the heel, while a plush Phylon midsole contains a full-length Air-sole unit for a comfortable feel. The rubber outsole lists 10 of Michael Jordan's most important career milestones.

The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Palomino' combines a lavish design with classic color blocking inspired by the original version. The legendary shoe boasts a black leather upper with weathered brown nubuck accents on the toe box, heel overlay, collar flap and Swoosh. The lateral side of the collar flap features a black Wings logo, while a Nike logo in metallic gold lettering adorns the woven tongue tag. The midsole is finished in an off-white shade and features enclosed Air-sole cushioning and stitched sidewall construction. The brown rubber outsole has a grip pattern that provides optimal traction on the court.

The 2024 edition of the Air Jordan 14 Retro 'Black Toe' sports a white leather upper, highlighted by black suede accents on the toe. The tongue, collar lining and back tab are also black, the latter embellished by a Jumpman logo and a large, stylized '23.' A smaller red Jumpman logo complements the toe box, while a Ferrari-inspired Jumpman emblem decorates the collar. A Phylon midsole is equipped with a chrome-plated shank plate for stability and encapsulated Zoom Air units on the forefoot and heel.

Based on the high-top version of its namesake, the Air Jordan 11 Retro Low ‘Space Jam’ rolls out a black ballistic mesh upper with a tonal patent leather mudguard. Rope laces are fed through webbed eyelets to secure the fit, while the back heel has a stylized ‘23’ and Jumpman logo to keep the iconic look. These sneakers have a Phylon midsole bolstered by full-length Air-sole cushioning and a visible carbon fiber plate. The translucent rubber outsole has a herringbone pattern for reliable traction.

The 2025 version of the Air Jordan 1 Retro High '85 OG 'Bred / Banned' tries for a true OG look, keeping the high collar and wider toe box. The leather upper blends black and red panels on the toe, heel, collar and the Swoosh. The Wings logo adorns the collar, while a woven Nike Air tag graces the tongue. A traditional rubber cupsole with white sidewalls contrast the red outsole to wrap up the look.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Fire Red Silver Tongue (2020)
description: Released in May 2020, the Air Jordan 5 Retro 'White Fire Red' 2020 brings back an OG look for the silhouette's 30th anniversary. Built with white leather, the upper includes a reflective silver tongue and a mesh insert at the quater panel. Fire Red accents emerge throughout, including on the shark-tooth detailing underfoot, while visible Air in the heel provides cushioning.

The 2025 iteration of the Air Jordan 5 Retro T23 'Tokyo' brings back a 2011 edition that celebrates the opening of The Jordan Tokyo 23 store in Shibuya, Japan. These shoes have a black-and-white foam midsole accented with yellow speckles on the sharktooth design. Much like the OG, these shoes have a yellow nubuck upper with a see-through netting and grey molded eyelets. A black, embroidered Jumpman logo decorates the silver reflective tongue, matching the collar lining, stylized '23' signoff on the heel, as well as the Jumpman icon on the heel.

Originally released in 1993 when MJ wore it during his third NBA Finals win over the Phoenix Suns, the Air Jordan 8 Retro 'Playoff' returns true to form in 2023. The upper in black nubuck is embellished with graphic-imbued TPU overlays in white, black and True Red. The plush chenille tongue patch on the Jordan 8 'Playoff' features a Jumpman in red, while ‘23’ in stitching adorns the cross-straps. A black foam midsole with interior Air-sole cushioning rides on a colorful rubber outsole which echoes the overlay graphics and includes a Jumpman logo in gold.

The Air Jordan 7 'Tennis Day' takes design elements from Andre Agassi's Air Tech Challenge series. Braided rope-style laces secure the Phantom grey upper, which consists of soft mesh and smooth nubuck overlays. Hairy suede touches land on the toe and collar, the latter touched with a Jumpman logo. A hot pink heel pull tab gets a logo patch stamped with an embossed '23.' The classic AJ7 midsole gets Lemon Twist and Pink Blast accents to finish out the look.

The Air Jordan 1 Mid 'Black Glitter' uses textured black leather on the toe box, while the side panel gets glittery black overlays. The frosted design is contrasted by matte black nubuck on the Swoosh, heel, and collar flaps. A white rubber outsole matches the Jumpman emblem on the tongue tag to round out the look.

The Air Jordan 1 Low 'Shattered Backboard Alternate' nods to a similar release from 2015. These sneakers have a white leather upper contrasted by a black eyestay, collar, and forefoot overlay. Starfish orange pops land on the toe box, Swoosh, as well as on the Wings-stamped heel overlay. The cream-colored midsole is anchored by a sturdy black rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low Midnight Navy University Blue
Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Shy Pink (PS)
description: The Travis Scott x Air Jordan 1 Low OG SP PS 'Shy Pink' sports a reverse pink Swoosh on the side of the white leather upper, touched with pale yellow forefoot and heel overlays. The Cactus Jack and Wings logo take turns on the left and right heel tab, respectively. The pink rubber outsole completes the look.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro DJ Khaled We The Best Crimson Bliss
description: The DJ Khaled x Air Jordan 5 Retro ‘Crimson Bliss’ sees a classic silhouette through a new lens, in his ‘We the Best’ collection. The upper in a vibrant coral leather is contrasted with a silky quilted lining in Leche Blue, with the heel overlays adorned with a blue embroidered Nike Air logo on the right and 'We the Best' on the left. The silver reflective tongue features the classic Jumpman branding, and the translucent rubber outsoles complete the playful logo treatment with additional Jumpman and ‘We the Best’ branding. Underfoot, an off-white polyurethane midsole with blue speckled shark-tooth detailing is complemented by a visible Air-sole unit in the heel.

Michael Jordan and the North Carolina Tar Heels faced off against the Georgetown Hoyas during the 1982 NCAA Tournament, where MJ hit the go ahead basket to cement a win in the final game. This Air Jordan 6 Retro utilizes signature Hoya colors across the retro hoops shoe, commemorating the epic finish. A grey suede upper showcases perforated detailing and a Huarache inner sleeve for a custom fit. Navy accents add a nice pop of contrast on the heel tab, Jumpman logo and the midsole. A visible NIke Air unit gives way to a translucent outsole, finishing the look.

The Air Jordan 15 23RE 'Black Muslin' uses a partially-concealed lacing system on the black knit, bootie-style suede upper. Black knit along the edges matches the former, while cream-colored tumbled leather brings a bold contrast. The Cushlon midsole contains springy Zoom Air forefoot and heel units. A decoupled, partially see-through rubber outsole gets a herringbone pattern for traction in all directions.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro SP A Ma Maniére Dark Mocha
description: The A Ma Maniére x Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Dark Mocha' keeps the visible Nike Air cushioning in the midsole for a comfortable feel. These shoes have a brown nubuck upper lined in a quilted knit for an elevated look. Classic details like the molded eyelets, side panel netting, and support wings remain intact. The Jumpman and A Ma Maniére logos take turns on each tongue tag, while a raised Nike Air logo decorates the heel tab.

The Air Jordan 11 Retro TD 'Gamma' celebrates the signature model's 30th anniversary, using rope-style laces to secure the black ballistic mesh upper. A matching black patent leather mudguard complements the look, while a Gamma Blue embroidered Jumpman adds a touch of contrast. The heel pull tab gets a maize-colored stylized '23' signoff. The black foam midsole works closely with a see-through rubber outsole below.

The Air Jordan 6 Retro GS 'Reverse Infrared Salesman' has a layered black nubuck upper with perforated details on the sides. A sock-like build offers a snug, secure fit, and a spoiler-like heel tab for easy on and off. A red Jumpman logo decorates the lace cover, matching the Nike Air logo on the heel. Red details on the foam midsole add a distinctive touch, alongside the Air-Sole heel unit for plush cushioning.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro GS 'Medium Soft Pink' dons a white reflective leather upper, equipped with quarter panel netting and accented with a pink embroidered '23' on the heel. Matching knit lines the collar and tongue, including a silver reflective touch and pink Jumpman logo outside. These shoes ride on a foam midsole with pink shark tooth details and an Air-sole heel unit.

Bringing back the original 2002 release, the Air Jordan 9 Retro 'Cool Grey' exhibits a grey nubuck upper with a matching patent leather overlay. The Air Jordan tongue label and iconic '23' stamped on the heel maintain the signature look. These shoes have a white foam midsole with encapsulated Air-sole technology in the forefoot and heel. The grey rubber outsole has multilingual touches, a nod to Michael Jordan's influence as a global icon.

Inspired by the fraternity Michael Jordan joined while at UNC, Omega Psi Phi, is the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Brotherhood.' The upper features a white leather quarter panel with nubuck overlays in Light Bordeaux. A University Gold leather toe box is matched by wraparound leather overlays at the collar and heel. A leather Nike Air tag is on the nylon tongue, while a classic Wings logo is stamped on the lateral ankle. The high-top is supported by a rubber cupsole with an Air-sole heel unit in lightweight polyurethane.

The 2024 reissue of the Air Jordan 11 Retro GS 'Legend / Columbia' brings a white leather upper to go with a matching shiny patent leather mudguard. A light blue Jumpman logo adorns the collar, while a stylized '23' accents the black back tab. A lightweight Phylon midsole is equipped with a full-length Air-sole unit, and anchored by a blue rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Olive (Women's)
description: The Travis Scott x Women's Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP 'Olive' sneaker arrives exclusively in women's sizing. These sneakers feature off-white leather overlays against a sleek black suede base. A unique touch is added with the olive suede Swooshes which appear in reverse on one side and a classic design on the other. The muted earthy hues are brought to life with bold crimson accents and finished with Nike Air woven tongue tags and alternating Jordan and Cactus Jack branding on the heel tabs. The vintage off-white sidewalls and olive-green rubber outsole complete the look and provide a sturdy foundation atop the rubber cupsole.

The Levi's x Air Jordan 3 Retro SP 'Denim Blue' replaces the full leather build, opting instead for a dark indigo denim with black elephant-print leather forefoot and heel overlays. An embroidered red Jumpman emblem stands out on the black leather tongue, matching the Levi's tab decorating the side of the right shoe. A Nike Air logo on the heel tab maintains the signature look. A black-and-white foam midsole contains an Air-Sole heel unit for a comfortable ride.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Military Black' throws it back to the 'Military Blue' design originally released in1989. The white leather upper is contrasted by a grey suede forefoot overlay, alongside black accents on the molded eyelets, heel tab and the inside of the tongue. The Jumpman logo decorates the tongue tag. The white netting windows land on the panel, made of soft knit for a ventilated feel. A black-and-white foam midsole contains an Air-sole heel unit for all-around cushioning.

Bringing back color blocking similar to the 2013 release of the 'Green Glow' AJ4 is the Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Infrared.' The upper is made from smooth nubuck in a charcoal finish. A lighter shade of grey is on the forefoot overlay with black accents on the quarter panel netting, structural wings, and Jumpman-branded heel tab. The titular hue lights up the woven tongue tag and molded eyelets. It's built on a polyurethane midsole with visible Air-sole cushioning in the heel.

The Air Jordan 6 Retro ‘Toro Bravo’ pays homage to the Air Jordan 5 Raging Bull Pack with its vibrant monochromatic finish. The sneaker features a bright red suede upper, while the tongue, collar lining, and heel tab appear in black for contrast. The perforated design enhances ventilation, while the inner sleeve provides a snug fit. The two-tone polyurethane midsole offers cushioning and includes an exposed Air-sole unit in the heel. The sneaker sits on a translucent rubber outsole for durable traction.

The Air Jordan 2 Retro 'Chicago' brings back the colorway true to form, including the box and hangtag. Radically different from the AJ1, the AJ2 removes the Swoosh branding and brings in faux lizard skin overlays and a TPU heel counter. A white leather upper is accented with a black midsole and pops of red around the heel, while the Wings logo can be prominently seen on the top of the tongue. The cushioning gets beefed up with a polyurethan midsole with encapsulated Nike Air in the heel.

The 2025 version of the Air Jordan 12 Retro GS 'Flu Game' nods back to an ailing Michael Jordan, who suited up and dominated Game 5 of the 1997 NBA Finals. A black tumbled leather upper gets radiating stitch lines and red, lizard-textured overlays. More red complements the rubber outsole, tooled with herringbone traction pods and an exposed carbon fiber shank plate for stability.

When the Air Jordan 3 was released in 1988, it was the first Air Jordan to feature the elephant print, visible Air Unit and Jumpman logo, and was MJ’s first signature shoe designed by Tinker Hatfield. In 2018, to celebrate the 30th anniversary, the sneaker was re-released in its iconic ‘Black Cement’ colorway boasting the same trademark details—like the black tumbled leather upper—we all remember fondly.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro Levi’s Lunar New Year
description: The Levi's x Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Lunar New Year' gets an Ecru denim upper with faux pony hair forefoot and heel overlays. An embroidered red Jumpman logo lands on the tongue, matching the Levi's tab on the side of the right shoe. The white foam midsole is aided by an Air-Sole heel unit and anchored by a gum rubber outsole below.

The 2025 edition of the Air Jordan 12 Retro 'Melo' celebrates Carmelo Anthony's time with the Denver Nuggets, keeping true to the 2004 original with a white leather upper, radiating stitched lines and a lizard-textured mudguard. University Blue touches adorn the collar lining, pull tab and rubber outsole, which contains an exposed carbon fiber shank plate for stability and herringbone pods for traction.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Black Toe (2023)
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG 'Black Toe' of 2023 revives a popular original color scheme from 1985. The low-cut shape showcases a leather exterior with black and Varsity Red overlays on the forefoot and heel, respectively, against a white backdrop. The design also features a black Swoosh, a black Wings logo on the red leather heel patch and a Nike tongue label. A sturdy cupsole underfoot pairing white sidewalls with a red rubber outsole for optimal traction.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro Teyana Taylor Concrete Rose (Women's)
colorway: Fire red-George green sapin/vert George/rouge feu
description: The Teyana Taylor x Air Jordan 3 'Concrete Rose' has a green leather upper wrapped in decorative rose vine details. Metallic gold eyelets and a red Jumpman tongue tag adorned with rose petals complement the design. A retro Nike Air logo adorns the heel tab, maintaining the signature look. These shoes have a grey foam midsole with ragged and irregular edges that give them an eye-catching look. The Air-Sole heel unit helps keep you comfortable every step of the way.

The 2026 reissue of the Air Jordan 4 Retro PS 'Toro Bravo' stays true to the 2013 OG release including a red nubuck upper with a side panel netting, black support wings, and grey molded eyelets. The Jumpman lands on the tongue, heel tab and the insoles. A black and white foam midsole works alongside a grey, herringbone-patterned rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Midnight Navy
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Midnight Navy' sports a white leather upper contrasted with navy accents on the forefoot, heel and ankle flap. A black Swoosh matches the padded collar and debossed Wings logo, while the Nike Air tag adorns the tongue. These shoes have a traditional rubber cupsole with aged off-white sidewalls and a navy outsole.

This 2024 reissue of the Air Jordan 4 Retro GS ‘Military Blue’ rolls out an off-white leather upper coupled with support wings and signature quarter panel netting. The molded eyelets, tongue tag, and back tab have blue accents and signature branding. The lightweight midsole exposes and Air-sole cushioning unit in the heel to round out the look.

The Women's Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Seafoam Sail' sports a pale green leather upper, tooled with the iconic quarter panel netting. A matching Jumpman logo adorns the tongue tag and heel tab. This monochromatic design is disrupted by metallic silver molded eyelets. An off-white foam midsole pairs with an Air-sole unit nestled in the heel.

The Air Jordan 9 Retro Boot NRG ‘Wheat’ shows off a rugged build, featuring a premium nubuck upper finished in classic tan, alongside rope laces and sturdy metal hardware. A high-traction rubber outsole supports a nubuck midsole, adorned with an embossed Jumpman logo in Baroque Brown.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro A Ma Maniére Dusk
description: The A Ma Maniére x Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Dusk' is part of a two sneaker collaborative pack, with this version arriving in a black nubuck upper. An updated collar supplies a sleeker look, alongside pre-yellowed quarter panel netting featuring an interconnected series of A Ma Maniére's distinctive 'A' logo. The rear heel displays tonal embroidered ‘Nike Air’ branding, while the silver reflective tongues showcase both Jumpman and A Ma Maniére branding. This sneaker rests atop a black PU midsole with shark-tooth detailing in a deep burgundy shade.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro TEX Denim Worn Blue (Women's)
description: The Women's Air Jordan 4 Retro TEX 'Worn Blue Denim' makes use of a soft foam midsole, equipped with a visible Nike Air heel unit and anchored by a gum rubber outsole. Instead of using nubuck or leather, the upper is made from cotton denim in two different washes. The netting in the side panel is swapped with contrast stitch details. The Jumpman logo on the tongue and heel tab, joins a metallic gold 'Family' lace dubrae to keep the signature look.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Chicago Lost and Found (GS)
description: The signature 'Chicago' colorway is revisited in this high-top made for big kids. The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG GS ‘Lost & Found’ receives a distressed look on the white leather in the upper and the padded collar. Pops of color are delivered with the 'Nike Air' tongue tag, bright red overlays and laces and Swoosh in black. The shoe is supported on a cupsole in white rubber with a bright red outsole and white sidewalls. The ankle flap features branding with the classic Jordan Wings logo.

shoeName: Jordan 6 Retro Travis Scott British Khaki
description: A follow-up to a 2019 collaboration, the Travis Scott x Air Jordan 6 Retro 'British Khaki' released with the help of the Houston rapper. Built with a mix of suede and canvas, the shoe's upper appears in British Khaki, highlighted by Bright Crimson on the heel pull-loop and tongue branding. The lateral collar includes a stash pouch, with the medial side sporting zippered detailing. The heels include mismatched Air and Cactus Jack branding, and underfoot, the usual visible Air in the heel provides cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High Court Purple White
description: An unofficial follow-up to a 2018 release, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Court Purple 2.0' dropped in 2020. Sporting 'Chicago'-esque color blocking, the shoe's upper features Court Purple overlays throughout. Otherwise finished in white and black, the tooling adds a final hit of Court Purple via the concentric outsole.

The Air Jordan 4014 'Ferrari' uses design elements from the Air Jordan 40 and Air Jordan 14. Referencing the 2014 colorway of the latter pair — which was modeled after Michael Jordan's Ferrari 550 Maranello — these shoes have a red suede upper complemented with a yellow Jumpman badge on the side. The cushioning setup comes from the Air Jordan 40, which packs a ZoomX foam midsole with a full-length Zoom Strobel. A yellow Jumpman logo decorates the rubber outsole that equips a traction pattern comprised of a series of 40-degree angles.

Celebrating 30 years of the silhouette, the Air Jordan 5 Retro SE 'What The' brings together elements of various Air Jordan 5 models. The right shoe's yellow suede upper draws from the 'Tokyo,' with a stylized '23' on the heel. The left shoe incorporates the Raging Bull pack, with red suede accented by a 'Shanghai' heel emblem. Underfoot, both midsoles house visible Air in the heel for cushioning, while elements of the 'Bel-Air,' 'Laser' and 'Quai 54' are also included.

shoeName: Jordan Jumpman Jack TR Travis Scott Sail
description: A neutral take on Travis Scott's debut signature shoes, the Travis Scott x Jordan Jumpman Jack TR 'Sail' have a dark brown canvas upper with off-white leather overlays and a beige backward Swoosh. These sneakers have an adjustable midfoot strap, paired with regular shoelaces and contrasting red accents on the Jumpman tongue logo. Scott's Cactus Jack face logo is embossed on the back heel, while a white foam midsole and a gum rubber outsole complete the look.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Black Metallic Gold
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Black Gold' sports a black leather upper contrasted by metallic gold accents on the toe box, heel and Wings-branded ankle flap. A white rubber midsole packs an Air-sole heel unit, both anchored by a gum rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Dark Marina Blue
description: Dressing the legendary silhouette in a classic two-tone color block is the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Dark Marina Blue.' The upper is all-leather and features a black base with contrasting dark blue overlays along the forefoot, heel, collar, and eyestay. A matching blue Swoosh is complemented by a Jordan Wings logo stamped in black on the lateral collar flap. A woven Nike Air tag on the nylon tongue gives the nod to the shoe's retro cushioning technology, which is an Air-sole unit encapsulated in polyurethane nestled in the heel of the rubber cupsole.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Brazil' nods to the partnership between the brand and the Brazilian Football Federation. These shoes have a blue leather upper with navy tumbled leather overlays. Lively pink accents highlight the collar and tongue, which has an embroidered yellow Jumpman. Bright green upper molded eyelets match the raised Nike Air logo on the speckled heel tab. The maize-colored midsole packs Air-Sole cushioning in the heel and a matching, partially see-through rubber outsole below.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro ‘Oxidized Green’ comes through in a crisp white leather upper with side netting and grey molded eyelets. Green accents on the wings and back tab give these shoes their signature contrast while a Jumpman logo adorns the tongue tag and heel. Green hits again on a lightweight midsole, accompanied by an exposed Air-sole heel unit for soft cushioning.

The Air Jordan 1 Mid 'Chicago Black Toe' updates an iconic look. Drawing from the 'Chicago' colorway, the shoe's familiar mix of black, Gym Red and white includes black on the perforated toe box. Underfoot, the midsole houses Air in the heel for cushioning, with a concentric outsole providing traction.

Modeled after the Air Jordan 4 'Oreo' from 1999, the Air Jordan 4 Retro 'White Oreo' released in May 2021. The shoe's upper emerges with a white tumbled leather construction, with the usual mesh inserts at the quarter panel and vamp. The molded eyelets sport a cement finish, matched underfoot by the polyurethane midsole. Visible Air in the heel provides cushioning, giving way to a rubber outsole for traction.

The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low ‘85 OG ‘Neutral Grey’ revives a classic palette in its historically original 1985 form. The upper is crafted from white leather and adorned with a grey Swoosh logo. The midsole showcases stitched sidewall construction and is coated in an off-white shade, with a PU-encapsulated Air-sole unit in the heel. The breathable nylon tongue displays a woven Nike Air tag while the back tab is decorated with the iconic Wings emblem.

A collaboration between Virgil Abloh and Jordan Brand, the OFF-WHITE x Air Jordan 5 SP 'Muslin' is a stylized take on the silhouette. Built with faded black textile, the upper includes reflective silver detailing on the tongue. The laces and medial side sport Abloh's signature text, while underfoot, the outsole sports a pre-yellowed aesthetic.

The Travis Scott x Air Jordan 6 Retro 'Olive' showcases the Houston rapper’s unique take on the classic silhouette. Dressed in military green nubuck, the mid-top features a canvas stash pocket on the lateral collar and glow-in-the-dark translucent outsoles. The kicks are finished with Cactus Jack branding on the lace lock and heel embroidery of the right shoe, both rendered in a vibrant red hue.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low SE Black Pinksicle Patent (Women's)
description: The Women's Air Jordan 1 Low SE 'Pinksicle' takes design elements from the 1985 original. The white leather upper is hit with glossy pink leather on the perforated toe box, collar, and heel. The latter is stamped with a stitched Wings logo. The black Swoosh matches the forefoot overlay and eyestay. These shoes have a rubber cupsole, highlighted by textured white sidewalls and a sturdy pink outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low Element Gore-Tex Black Challenge Red
description: The Air Jordan 1 Low Element GORE-TEX 'Bred' brings a black ripstop upper, tooled with nubuck overlays and lined in a waterproof GORE-TEX membrane. A reflective Swoosh and a retro Wings emblem on the heel tab maintain the signature look. A black, trail-ready rubber outsole is wrapped in pronounced lugs, engulfing the dark grey foam midsole dusted with black speckles throughout.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Black White
description: An iconic silhouette with a simple two-tone design, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Black White 2.0' is a high-top sneaker with white accents on the toe, Swoosh, heel, and collar contrasted against a black leather upper. Comfort is supplied by Air-sole cushioning and a rubber cupsole, which combines with white sidewalls atop a black outsole. The shoe features the Jordan Wings logo on the collar and a Nike Air tag on the tongue.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro OG SP A Ma Maniére Diffused Blue Diffused Blue
description: The A Ma Maniére x Air Jordan 3 Retro OG SP 'For The Love' carries a white tumbled leather upper with grey suede forefoot and heel overlays. Blue touches settle on the molded eyelets and the Nike Air heel tab logo. More blue lands on the heel of the foam midsole, complemented with a visible Nike Air unit. The grey rubber outsole completes the iconic look.

shoeName: Jordan 11 Retro Comme des Garçons Homme Plus Black
description: The Comme des Garçons x Air Jordan 11 Retro 'Black' rocks a black leather upper complemented with a glossy patent leather mudguard. 'Comme des Garçons Homme Plus' is stamped on the collar, while a debossed Jumpman lands on the opposite side. A stylized '23' signoff adorns the heel tab. The black Phylon midsole gets a full-length Air-Sole unit and a carbon fiber shank plate. The partially see-through rubber outsole has herringbone pods for more traction.

The 2024 iteration of the Air Jordan 3 Retro OG GS 'Black Cement' brings a tumbled black leather upper complemented by grey elephant print overlays on the forefoot and heel. A red Jumpman contrasts the grey leather tongue, while the heel panel shows a raised Nike Air logo. Black touches on the midsole heel reveal an exposed Air-sole unit underfoot.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Satin Bred (Women's)
description: Paying homage to a highly exclusive AJ1 release from 2016, the Women's Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Satin Bred' is adorned in the iconic black and red color combination, delivered in all-over shiny satin. Drawing inspiration from the original design, it features classic branding details such as a woven Nike tag on the tongue and an embroidered Wings logo on the lateral collar flap. The sneaker is supported by a contrasting white midsole, which incorporates an encapsulated Air-sole unit in the heel for cushioning, while a crimson rubber outsole provides reliable traction on various surfaces.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro SE Craft Photon Dust
colorway: Photon Dust/Pale Vanilla/Off White/Grey Fog/Flat Pewter/Sail
description: Tinker Hatfield’s legacy 1989 model is modernized with new details in the Air Jordan 4 Retro SE Craft ‘Photon Dust.’ Light grey leather forms the base of the upper with color-matched suede appearing on the forefoot overlay and collar. The signature plastic netting that originally appeared on the quarter panel has been replaced with grids of suede accented by support wings constructed from cracked leather. The molded eyelets and tongue and heel Jumpman branding appear in a Pale Vanilla hue. A PU midsole in off-white features an exposed Air-sole unit in the heel for optimal comfort and support underfoot.

The 2024 version of the Air Jordan 9 Retro 'Olive' secures the black leather upper with a speed lacing system. Perforated panels with contrasting, brownish nubuck overlays complement the earthy design. A red 'Air Jordan' is stamped on the tongue tag, matching the molded Jumpman emblem behind the collar. A Jumpman logo stands out on the foam midsole, which packs Air-sole cushioning in the forefoot and heel.

The Air Jordan 6 Retro ‘Midnight Navy’ 2022 arrives in a tumbled leather upper in white. Color is delivered with the contrasting navy blue tongue, heel tab, lace guard and back heel, the latter two adorned with the signature Jumpman logo. Underfoot, support and grippiness are delivered via a clear rubber outsole with a PU midsole and an exposed Air-sole unit inThe sneaker rides on a two-tone polyurethane midsole, enhanced with a visible Air-sole heel unit and supported by a translucent rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Royal Toe' updates a classic colorway. Built with leather, the upper appears in white with black overlays, highlighted by hits of Game Royal on the collar and toe box. A lightly padded nylon tongue supports the fit, while underfoot, a white Air midsole gives way to more Game Royal on the circular outsole.

The Women's Air Jordan 11 Low 'Mother's Day' rocks a white leather upper complemented with a shiny metallic gold mudguard. A small Jumpman logo is debossed on the heel tab, while a white Phylon midsole packs a full-length Air-Sole unit for balanced cushioning. The partially see-through rubber outsole makes way for a carbon fiber spring plate for more stability and energy return.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Mid Patent Black White Gold
description: Boasting familiar design ingredients from previously released Air Jordan 1s, the Air Jordan 1 Mid Patent ‘Black Gold’ features patent leather and metallic gold accents. The first emerges on the overlays that stand out against a classic white leather base. The second makes its appearance on the Swoosh and branding components that deck out the shoe’s collar, tongue tag, and sockliner.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Chinese New Year (2026)
description: The 2026 iteration of the Air Jordan 1 Low OG 'Chinese New Year' nods to the Year of the Horse with a chalk white knit upper, tooled with matching pony hair details on the heel, Wings-branded back tab and Swoosh. An ornate floral print is embroidered on the toe box, matching the one appearing on the Nike tongue tag. An off-white midsole gives it an aged look, anchored by a brown rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Cardinal Red' features a palette inspired by an iconic colorway of the Air Jordan 7. The sneaker pairs a white tumbled leather upper with Cardinal Red accents on the collar lining, molded eyelets and raised Jumpman branding at the heel. A Jumpman logo embroidered in orange appears on the tongue, with signature elephant print overlays positioned on the forefoot and heel. A two-tone polyurethane midsole with visible Air arrives underfoot.

The J Balvin x Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Rio' takes design cues from the reggaeton artist's son. These shoes have a leather upper with grey elephant print overlays on the forefoot and heel areas. Gradient accents land on the back tab, which has the Nike Air logo on the left foot and J Balvin's smiley face logo on the right. The sunset colors repeat on the midsole's rear, anchored by a red see-through rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 11 Low TD Black Anthracite Metallic Silver
Jordan 1 Retro High OG Rare Air
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Rare Air 'Deep Royal Blue' brings a white leather upper with royal blue forefoot and heel overlays. A grey suede collar is overlaid with white leather flaps that sport a Wings logo with 'Nike Air' instead of the classic 'Air Jordan' signoff. The black leather Swoosh wears away to reveal a red hue. A pre-yellowed coating on the midsole works in tandem with a black rubber outsole.

The OFF-WHITE x Wmns Air Jordan 4 Retro SP 'Sail' released as part of a collaboration between Virgil Abloh's luxury brand and Jordan Brand. The classic basketball silhouette emerges with a deconstructed leather build, finished in off-white and complemented by semi-translucent TPU on the eyelets, wings and heel panel. A tonal zip-tie and 'Air' above the visible cushioning complete the look.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS ‘Thunder’ 2023 edition is designed for older kids and features the popular two-tone colorway that first appeared in 2006. The black nubuck upper is accented with bold yellow details that adorn the molded eyelets, quarter panel, and lower tongue. The quarter panel and tongue are also constructed with black netting, harking back to the AJ4’s original design in 1989. The molded back tab and woven tongue tag display classic Jumpman branding. The sneaker is built on a yellow polyurethane midsole that incorporates exposed Air-sole cushioning and is reinforced by a herringbone-patterned rubber outsole for improved grip.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Cave Stone' has a dark taupe nubuck upper with contrasting black touches on the side panel netting, molded eyelets, and knit collar lining. The Jumpman logo lands on the Flight-branded tongue tag, while a raised Nike Air logo adorns the heel tab. The foam midsole has black and off-white hues, aided by a Nike Air unit for a lightweight feel.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Yellow Ochre
description: Distinguished by its white leather backdrop and mustard yellow heel and forefoot overlays, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Yellow Ochre' showcases black detailing on the collar and the Swoosh. The lateral collar flaps display a Wings logo while the breathable nylon tongue bears a woven Nike Air tag. The shoe’s lightweight polyurethane wedge is housed within a robust rubber cupsole, with an interior Air-sole unit positioned in the heel.

The Women's Air Jordan Retro High OG 'Khaki' sports an off-white leather upper touched with sand-colored overlays and an olive green canvas Swoosh. Knit and canvas panels arrive in olive, ivory, and rust brown hues around the collar. A leather Nike tongue tag and a molded metallic gold Wings logo decorate the collar flap. The rubber cupsole packs an Air-Sole heel unit encapsulated within a plush wedge.

Bringing back a design theme first featured on an Air Jordan 11 release from 2015 is the Air Jordan 11 Retro Low '72-10', which makes a nod to the Chicago Bulls' legendary 1996-97 season. The low-top features a black tumbled leather upper with a tonal patent leather mudguard and crimson Jumpman branding accents on the tongue and heel. On the bottom is a white Phylon midsole with full-length Air-sole cushioning and a translucent rubber midsole. The Jordan 11 Low '72-10' will drop on May 14, 2022.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Black Canvas' blends a neutral color scheme with unique materials. The upper is crafted predominately black canvas, with a subtle suede hit on the toe piece. Traditional AJ4 details return, with black TPU molded wings and a visible Nike Air unit in the heel. A subtle red Flight script on the tongue patch adds a burst of constrast, set against grey on the Jumpman logo, eyelets and midsole.

As indicated by its moniker, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Shattered Backboard 3.0' is the third colorway to take inspiration from Michael’s destructive dunk during a 1985 exhibition game in Italy. The high-top is dressed in contrasting black and orange hues, executed on a crinkled patent leather upper for an eye-catching look. The kicks are finished with a cream-colored midsole for a vintage aesthetic.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG A Ma Maniére
description: Following up on a spring 2021 release from the two brands, the A Ma Maniére x Air Jordan 1 High OG 'Airness' dropped later that same year. Rather than leather, the shoe's upper is built with suede, finished in off-white and complemented by the Burgundy Crush Swoosh and collar, which sport a snakeskin finish. Tonal quilted satin makes up the inner lining, while the inside of the collar flap adds Michael Jordan's signature and 'You have to expect things of yourself before you can do them.' The tongue tag adds co-branding to the look, while underfoot, a pre-yellowed midsole provides cushioning via Air, with a concentric rubber outsole offering traction.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro SE Craft in ‘Ivory’ comes to life in a white leather upper with grey elephant print overlays on the heel and forefoot. A double-exposed Jumpman adorns the tongue, while a see-through heel tab lets you see the Jumpman logo above a printed Nike logo. These classic shoes have a white midsole with cream accents on the heel, equipped with Air-sole cushioning for a comfortable feel. A see-through rubber outsole gives you solid traction underfoot.

Revisiting a 2013 colorway, originally released alongside an Air Jordan 4 and 5, the 2023 Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Fear' features a dark grey nubuck upper with matching elephant print overlays on the forefoot and heel. The collar and tongue are crafted from black suede and feature an embroidered Total Orange Jumpman logo. The eyelets and another Jumpman icon on the rear heel also appear in this vibrant orange hue. The sneaker offers lightweight cushioning with an orange-tinged Air-sole unit within the PU midsole in three shades.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High Black Metallic Gold (2020)
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Black Metallic Gold' brings an elevated construction to go with its elevated colorway. The shoe's upper is built with patent leather, finished in black and highlighted by metallic gold on the 'Wings' logo, Swoosh branding, collar and tongue tag. Perforations on the toe box provide breathability, while underfoot, more metallic gold marks the stitching around the Air midsole.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Medium Olive (PS)
description: The Travis Scott x Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP PS 'Reverse Olive / Medium Olive' rolls out an olive suede upper with sail leather overlays at the forefoot and heel. A reverse black leather Swoosh adorns the side, while a red-on-white Nike tag graces the tongue. Red embroidered details on each back tab showcase a Cactus Jack logo on the left shoe and the Wings logo on the right. An aged, off-white rubber midsole meets a sturdy, olive green rubber outsole anchoring the design.

The 2025 version of the Air Jordan 12 Retro GS 'Taxi' keeps the radiating stitch lines on the white leather upper, bolstered with black lizard-textured overlays on both sides. The Jumpman logo lands on the tongue, as well as on the heel pull tab. The midsole contains an Air-sole unit for a plush feel underfoot.

One of three pairs released in the 'City Pack,' the Air Jordan 11 Retro 'H-Town' honors Houston with a beige suede upper, touched with white knit on the collar lining and back tab. The latter gets a stylized '23' signoff, while a molded Jumpman logo lands below the collar. The white Phylon midsole contains a full-length Air-sole unit, anchored by an aqua, partially see-through rubber outsole.

The Women's Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Seafoam' seamlessly blends vintage looks with modern updates. With its retro-inspired color scheme recalling the 1989 ‘Fire Red’ release, this shoe boasts a smooth white leather upper accented with eye-catching Oil Green detailing on the interior lining, eyelets and tongue and heel tab Jumpman branding. The iconic quarter panel netting and support wings remain intact, adding to the shoe's nostalgic appeal. The classic silhouette is supported by a durable PU midsole, with an exposed Air-sole unit in the heel and a pop of green at the forefoot.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High Pine Green Black
description: A two-tone look, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Pine Green 2.0' released in February 2020. The shoe's leather upper sports a mix of black leather and Pine Green tumbled leather, with Gym Red on the tongue tag. Underfoot, the Air-infused midsole offers the only contrast in white, giving way to a rubber outsole with a concentric traction pattern.

The Air Jordan 12 Retro 'Royalty' brings a luxe look to its classic basketball construction. The shoe's upper is built with tumbled leather, finished primarily in white and contrasted by black on the basketball-textured mudguard. The classic radiating stitching remains intact, while the upper eyelets, TPU insert and branding add metallic gold to the look. Underfoot, full-length Zoom Air provides cushioning, working with a carbon-fiber plate for stability and a herringbone rubber outsole for traction.

The Air Jordan 11 Retro ’72-10’ gives the nod to the Bulls’ legendary 1995-96 season, one that saw Michael and co. amassing a historical 72-10 regular season record on their way to a fourth championship. The iconic silhouette is updated here with a black tumbled leather upper, complemented with a matching black patent leather overlay and a contrasting pop of Varsity Red on the Jumpman logo.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Mocha
description: The Travis Scott x Air Jordan 1 Low 'Mocha' is the result of a collaboration between Jordan Brand and Travis Scott. The shoe's nubuck upper construction appears in black and Dark Mocha, accented by hits of University Red. The standout feature is the lateral-side Swoosh, which sports a backward application. A standard Swoosh appears on the medial side, while the tongue, medial quarter panel and sockliner include Cactus Jack branding. The heels sport a 'Wings' logo on the right shoe and Scott's crudely drawn face on the left to complete the collaborative look.

The Women's Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Canyon Purple' features both unique colors and materials on the classic silhouette. Eschewing traditional leather or nubuck seen on most AJ4s, the upper utilizes a shaggy suede in a vibrant purple hue. Lime green accents the eyelets and midsole, while the Jumpman logo on the tongue appears in Safety Orange. Black molded wings and back heel tab are contrasted in black, while the midsole appears in the classic white/black combination with an exposed Nike Air unit in the heel.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG True Blue
description: Recalling an original Air Jordan 3, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG ‘True Blue’ provides a reinterpretation of a familiar colorway. True Blue on the eyestay and forefoot overlay are color-matched by the signature Swoosh, while the heel and collar overlay appear in Cement Grey with a Wings logo on the latter. Additional retro branding appears via the tongue tag with ‘Nike Air.’ Underfoot, comfort on and off the court is afforded by a traditional rubber cupsole with an Air-sole unit in the heel.

The 'Panda' edition of the Women's Air Jordan 1 Low gives the iconic silhouette a stylish and essential two-tone transformation. Built on traditional cupsole tooling, the sneaker features stitched white sidewalls and a black rubber outsole. Sleek and smooth leather distinguishes the upper’s clean white base, while striking black details contrast on the forefoot overlay, collar, heel, and Swoosh logo. A Jumpman icon is positioned on the tongue and a stitched Wings logo appears on the back heel, adding subtle yet recognizable branding touches.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High Light Smoke Grey
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Light Smoke Grey' emerges with a neutral look and a vibrant accent. The shoe's upper features a white leather base overlaid by Light Smoke Grey suede, with black contrast on the Swoosh, collar, laces and tongue tag. The collar flap highlights the look in Varsity Red, matched by the tongue branding, while an Air midsole and concentric outsole support the fit underfoot.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low SE Patent Varsity Red Black

description: The Air Jordan 11 Retro PS 'Gamma' commemorates the 30th anniversary of the championship model, using a black, ballistic mesh upper complemented with a matching shiny patent leather mudguard. The blackout design is disrupted by a Gamma Blue embroidered Jumpman logo and a golden stylized '23.' An ice blue rubber outsole gets blue herringbone traction pods for all-around traction.

The Awake NY x Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Boro - Racer Blue' rocks a classic black midsole, accented with blue sharktooth details and backed by a herringbone-style rubber outsole. These sneakers have a black tumbled leather upper with contrast white stitching and a Nike-Air-stamped heel area. A cutout in the side panel netting forms Awake NY's 'A' emblem, while blue Awake NY and Jumpman emblems appear on the silver reflective tongue. 'NY' and '23' signoffs are embroidered on the heel of the right and left shoe, accordingly.

colorway: Canyon Purple/Off Noir/Violet Dust/Medium Soft Pink

description: The Air Jordan 12 Retro 'Blueberry' brings sunrise-style stitch lines on a white tumbled leather upper, accented with lizard-patterned blue overlays. The Jumpman logo adorns the tongue and heel tab for a signature touch. The Phylon midsole equips a full-length Zoom Air unit, riding on a blue rubber outsole aided by a carbon fiber shank plate for stability.

Duplicating the signature design and colorway of the 1985 original is the Air Jordan 1 Retro High '85 OG 'Black White' also known as 'Panda.' The upper appears in black and white leather, with the midsole and rubber outsole in matching hues. The signature Swoosh and Wings logo alternate between black and white complemented by a black-and-white Nike Air tongue tag.

Originally released in 2006 as part of the Defining Moments Pack, the Air Jordan 6 Retro 'Defining Moments' 2020 dropped in April 2020. Built with nubuck, the upper appears primarily in black, accented by metallic gold. A lace lock supports the fit, as does a cushioned ankle and perforations throughout. Underfoot, the midsole houses visible Zoom Air in the heel for cushioning.

The 2026 edition of the Air Jordan 5 Retro PS 'Wolf Grey' rolls out a grey nubuck upper with a side panel netting, shoelace locks, and a '23' signoff on the heel. The Jumpman logo adorns the tongue and heel, while a grey foam midsole is decorated with speckled sharktooth details. A pale blue rubber outsole gets a herringbone pattern for steady traction.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro SE Space Jam Lola Bunny (GS)
Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Game Royal
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG 'Game Royal' rolls out a white leather upper with royal blue overlays on the forefoot and heel. Black knit lines the collar, matching the Swoosh and the Wings logo stamped on the back tab. An aged, off-white midsole works with a sturdy blue rubber outsole to finish the design.

colorway: Summit White/Hydrogen Blue-Legend Blue-Photon Dust-Pure Platinum-Sail
description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Lucky Shorts' shoes take cues from the UNC shorts Michael Jordan wore underneath his Chicago Bulls uniform. A white tumbled leather upper gets complementing grey suede forefoot and heel overlays. Powder blue eyelets match the Jumpman logos on the tongue and heel tab. More blue engulfs the heel of the off-white midsole, which contains an Air-sole united backed by a grey rubber outsole underfoot.

The 2022 version of the Air Jordan 1 Low ‘Triple Black’ rolls out a stealthy leather upper design, including a stitched Wings logo on the heel and a Jumpman logo embroidered on the tongue. A matching black rubber cupsole keeps the theme strong, coupled with an encapsulated Air-sole heel unit for a plush feel underfoot.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro SP A Ma Maniére (Women's)
description: The A Ma Maniére x women's Air Jordan 3 Retro SP 'Raised By Women' brings a premium build to its classic basketball construction. Made in collaboration with the Atlanta retailer, the shoe emerges with a tumbled leather construction on the upper, finished in white and complemented by grey suede on the collar, eyestay, heel and toe. The tongues includes mismatched co-branding, with a quilted inner collar and tongue lining supporting the fit. Underfoot, visible Air in the heel of the midsole provides cushioning, giving way to a rubber outsole for traction.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Reverse Laney (Women's)
description: Dressed in the colors of Michael Jordan’s high school alma mater in Wilmington, NC, the Women’s Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG ‘Reverse Laney’ reverses the colors of the AJ1 High released in 2013. The upper features a base in Varsity Maize base with the signature swoosh and overlays appearing in Game Royal. The sneaker is supported underfoot on a midsole in white with an Air-sole unit atop a rubber outsole in bright blue. Branding appears on the tongue tag with ‘Nike Air’ and on the lateral collar with a black Wings logo.

This Air Jordan 1 Low SE 'Brown Elephant' has a suede and leather upper, accented with an elephant print Swoosh on the side. The Jumpman and Air logos are stitched on the tongue, while the classic Wings emblems adorn the heel.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High '85 OG Metallic Burgundy
description: Bringing back a 1986 favorite, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High ‘85 OG ‘Metallic Burgundy’ is made with a higher-cut heel collar and a wider toe box than the original. These sneakers have a white leather upper with contrasting glossy red accents. Burgundy hits on the padded collar, Swoosh, tongue tag and the Wings logo give them just the right pop. A durable rubber cupsole and a colored outsole round out the look in style.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High Tokyo Bio Hack
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Tokyo Bio Hack' features inspiration from the Japanese capital. The shoe's upper is built with a mix of leather and suede, finished in a color-blocked look that brings to mind Undefeated's Nike Dunk High NL collaboration from 2005. Underfoot, the painted Air midsole provides cushioning, giving way to a concentric outsole for traction.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low SE Space Jam Lola Bunny (Women's)

description: Featuring a subdued look, the Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Taupe Haze' released in January 2021. The shoe's upper is built with a mix of textured suede and cracked leather, finished in Taupe Haze and contrasted by the laces, wings and heel overlay. Infrared 23 highlights the tongue branding and inside of the tongue, while underfoot, a two-tone midsole houses visible Air in the heel for cushioning, with encapsulated Air in the forefoot. A rubber outsole is included for traction. The usual mesh inserts at the quarter panel and vamp complete the classic look.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG SP Union LA Bephies Beauty Supply Summer of ‘96
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG SP collaboration among Union LA, Bephie’s Beauty Supply, and Jordan Brand, offers a fresh take on the classic silhouette. It features a white leather upper with exposed stitching in green, woven detailing inspired by the Nike Air Footscape Woven and a grey Swoosh. The shoe's traditional lines are accented with yellow trim and match the laces and a discreet 'UN/LA' label on the lateral ankle. Branding appears via a tonal Wings logo on the collar flap and a woven Nike Air tongue tag. Underfoot, the durable rubber cupsole has a vintage pre-yellowed finish, adding to the retro vibe.

Originally worn by Michael Jordan at the 1996 NBA All-Star Game, the Air Jordan 11 Low Retro 'Legend Blue' emerges in low-top fashion with this April 2021 release. Built with leather, the shoe's upper appears in white, bolstered by a tonal patent leather mudguard and sporting ballistic mesh on the tongue. Legend Blue accents the heel branding, while the 25th anniversary of the shoe gets a callout on the sockliner.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Green Glow
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Green Glow' showcases 'Bred Toe' keeps a smooth leather upper, contrasting the side panels with black accents on the Swoosh, collar and forefoot overlay. Green accents hit the heel, toe box and ankle flap, stamped with a black Wings logo on the side, while the Nike Air tag decorates the tongue. A durable cupsole anchors the silhouette, partnered with white sidewalls and a vibrant teal rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 6 Retro A Ma Maniére Smokey Mauve
description: The A Ma Maniére x Air Jordan 6 Retro 'Smokey Mauve' has a grey nubuck upper touched with a violet hue. A Ma Maniére's iconic quilted knit lines the collar, while black pops arrive on the tongue, heel tab, and Jumpman logo on the lace guard. A burgundy-hued Nike Air logo is embroidered on the heel. The grey-and-black foam midsole contains a visible Nike Air unit, anchored by a see-through rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Rabbit Floral Swoosh
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG 'Rabbit Floral Swoosh' dons an off-white colored leather upper adorned with a Swoosh consisting of embroidered florals. A rabbit head and ears poke out of the tip of the Swoosh, while an embroidered Wings logo decorates the back tab. A partially see-through, milk-hued rubber cupsole completes the look.

Featuring a look reminiscent of Gary Payton's 'Away' PE from his time with the Los Angeles Lakers, the Air Jordan 12 Retro 'University Gold' released in 2020. Built with black tumbled leather, the upper includes the usual stitched detailing. The signature mudguard contrasts the look in University Gold, while Zoom Air underfoot provides cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro A Ma Maniére Dawn (Women's)
description: The A Ma Maniére x Women's Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Photon Dust' is part of a two-piece collaboration, arriving via a pale grey leather upper with a slimmer collar and quarter panel netting featuring the A Ma Maniére 'A' logo. A '23' is stitched on the side, Nike Air branding appears on the back, and the silver reflective tongues display alternating logos. The black midsole has blue shark-tooth details and cushioning in the heel, and rests on a pre-yellowed outsole with a herringbone pattern for excellent traction.

The Air Jordan Spizike Low 'Rare Air' shines light on the flaws found in early Air Jordan samples. These shoes have an off-white leather upper with a side panel netting and grey elephant print forefoot and heel overlays. Black support wings match the molded eyelets as well as the tongue. A gold embroidered Jumpman decorates the black neoprene lace cover, matching the webbed heel pull tab. A gold and pink gradient surrounds the foam midsole, which packs Air-Sole cushioning in the heel.

The Air Jordan 11 GS 'Rare Air' makes the most of imperfections that marred early Jordan samples. These kicks use rope-style laces, while each of the eyelets is adorned with block letters that spell out 'Jordan.' The sail-hued leather upper gets an embroidered red Jumpman and a blue patent leather mudguard. These shoes have an off-white Phylon midsole, anchored by a partially see-through rubber outsole below.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low SE Medium Olive Sail
Jordan 1 Low SE Legend Light Brown
Jordan 13 Retro Gym Red Flint Grey
description: Released in May 2021, the Air Jordan 13 Retro 'Red Flint' features a look inspired by the 1998 'Flint' colorway. The shoe's upper is defined by the Gym Red accents on the inside of the tongue, collar lining and reflective mesh overlays, replacing the blue of the OG look. The upper itself is built with a white leather base, overlaid by Flint Grey synthetic suede and sporting the usual hologram logo on the ankle. Underfoot, a panther's-paw outsole provides traction.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro SE 'Burgundy' for 2023 reintroduces a color scheme that originally launched in 2006. The classic design showcases an upper in burgundy suede, intersected on the side panel with ventilated clear netting and complemented by contrasting stitching. The polyurethane midsole matches the color scheme and displays speckled shark-tooth detailing with a visible Air-sole unit in the heel. The outsole delivers optimal grip with its clear herringbone traction pattern. The heel overlay and tongue are adorned with stitched Jumpman branding with reflective properties that enhance visibility in darker conditions.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro ‘Green Glow’ throws a splash of color into a design inspired by the OG ‘Black Cement’ colorway. These shoes have a black leather upper with elephant print overlays on the eyestay, toe cap and heel. Green pops on the upper and lower eyelets add a touch of contrast, coupled with a raised Jumpman logo on the back tab. A soft midsole pairs with an Air-sole heel unit for a lightweight feel.

colorway: Off-Noir/Brigade Blue-Dark Smoke Grey-Light Fusion Red
description: Released in August 2020, the Union LA x Air Jordan 4 Retro is a follow-up to an Air Jordan 1 collaboration from 2018. Built with black suede, the upper includes mesh on the toe box and collar. Translucent wings mark the quarter panel, while the classic eyelets appear in black and white. Contrast stitching emerges throughout, while the Air Jordan tongue tag sports an inside-out aesthetic. The side wall includes 'UN/LA' branding, while underfoot, a yellowed midsole contributes to the retro look, with visible Air in the heel providing cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low SE Craft Dark Smoke Grey Varsity Red

description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Alternate Bel-Air' draws from a 2013 Air Jordan colorway also inspired by the Fresh Prince of Bel-Air. The shoe's 90s-inspired look includes a white leather construction on the upper, with the inner lining sporting a vibrant print mismatched between the shoes. Further mismatched hits include the Jumpman and '23' branding, while underfoot, both shoes house visible Air for cushioning.

Long before his clutch shooting made him an NBA legend, Michael Jordan sank the game-winning jumper to clinch the 1982 NCAA title for the University of North Carolina. The Air Jordan 11 Retro 'Win Like ’82’ celebrates that championship season with a Tar Heels-inspired colorway that is more subtle than many of its similar counterparts. The white ballistic mesh upper is complemented by a patent leather mudguard in Midnight Navy, while UNC-style light blue marks the Jumpman branding and midsole plate underfoot.

The Air Jordan 13 Retro 'Flint' 2020 released in 2020 with a look pulled from the late 90s. The shoe's signature overlay appears in blue, accented by reflective detailing. The heel sports Flint Grey suede, while a hologram logo stands out on the ankle. Underfoot, the panther's paw midsole houses Air for cushioning, with a herringbone outsole for traction.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro Travis Scott Cactus Jack
description: The Travis Scott x Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Cactus Jack' honors the rapper’s hometown of Houston. Its palette borrows from the team colors of the city’s former Oilers football team, and features a Durabuck leather upper in University Blue, while its insole and branding are dressed in Varsity Red. Completing the look are a black lace cage and speckled light blue heel panel.

The 2017 edition of the Air Jordan 13 Retro 'Bred' brings back the classic OG colorway from 1998. This reissue is faithful to the original, featuring 3M reflective mesh overlays atop an upper built with a combination of black tumbled leather and red synthetic suede. Additional hits of True Red appear on the midsole and Jumpman logo embroidered on the tongue.

First published in 1991, the Air Jordan 6 'Maroon' was the only OG color that never saw a retro release. Nike resurrected this classic in 2015, when the retro was released as part of a huge Holiday drop. The design features branding details including the Jumpman logo on the rubber tongue and lace overlay of the shoe, as well as OG elements on the heel like the Nike Air branding and transparent, translucent outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Medium Olive (TD)
description: The Travis Scott x Jordan 1 Low OG SP TD 'Reverse Olive / Medium Olive' sports Scott's signature reverse Swoosh. Sail accents on the forefoot and heel provide contrast, while a Nike tag graces the tongue. The Cactus Jack and Wings logo take turns in the back tab of each shoe. An off-white midsole works with an olive-colored rubber outsole to complete the look.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'White Thunder' keeps the same coloring from the 2006 'Thunder' release. This grade school version has a black nubuck upper with contrasting white accents on the mesh side panel, overlaid with black netting, and molded eyelets. A white Jumpman icon lands on the tongue and heel. A matching white midsole packs an exposed Air-sole unit for a plush feel.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Shattered Backboard (2025) (GS)
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG GS 'Shattered Backboard' takes design cues from Michael Jordan's backboard-breaking dunk during a 1985 exhibition game in Italy. These sneakers have a white leather upper complemented with black accents on the eyestay and forefoot overlay. Orange leather is used on the toe box, heel and Wings-stamped collar flap. A Nike Air tag lands on the black nylon tongue, while the insoles showcase a shattered glass graphic as a nod to the eventful moment.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Cement Grey' rocks white tumbled leather on the upper, accented with a dark grey elephant print on the eyestay and forefoot and heel overlay. A red Jumpman logo decortes the tongue and heel tab. The foam midsole partners with an encapsulated Air-sole forefoot unit and a visible Air bag heel unit for all-around cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro Black Infrared Barely Volt (GS)
description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Black Infrared' has a series of candy-bright accents on the black nubuck upper, accented with volt-colored netting on the side panel window and lower tongue. Gossy black molded eyelets match the support wings, while a red Jumpman logo can be seen on the heel tab and tongue tag. Mango and Infrared hues play off each other on the foam midsole, partially showered with black speckles and tooled with an exposed Air-Sole heel unit.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High Fearless UNC Chicago
description: Dropping in 2019 as part of Jordan Brand’s ‘Fearless Ones’ collection, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Fearless' features a distinctive color scheme that draws inspiration from the first three patent leather colorways of the iconic silhouette. The high-top’s crisp white upper is accented with Gym Red overlays on the forefoot, University Blue on the heel and a blend of black and gold on the jeweled Wings logo.

The Air Jordan 1 Low SE 'Olive Grey' has a black nubuck upper touched with dark taupe pebbled leather overlays and a matching Swoosh. A retro Wings logo decorates the heel, while an embroidered bright red Jumpman contrasts the black nylon tongue. These kicks ride on a black rubber midsole packed with an encapsulated Air-sole heel unit for all-around cushioning.

Emerging with a look similar to the 'Iowa' Dunk from 1985, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Pollen' sports familiar color-blocking. Built with leather, the shoe's upper appears with a black base, overlaid by contrasting Pollen, including on the Swoosh branding. A nylon tongue supports the fit, as doe perforations on the toe box. Underfoot, a white Air midsole offers cushioning, giving way to a concentric rubber outsole for traction.

This 2024 iteration of the Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG 'Shadow' throws it back to one of the original colorways of Michael Jordan's debut signature shoes. These low-top kicks have a black leather upper, complemented with grey accents on the toe box, heel, back tab and the signature Swoosh. A Nike Air tag adorns the tongue, while the Wings logo decorates the back tab. These shoes have a white rubber midsole, equipped with an encapsulated Air-sole heel unit and anchored by a black rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 1 Low 'Black Medium Grey' rocks a white leather upper with bold black forefoot and heel overlays. The latter gets a grey Wings logo to match the leather Swoosh sweeping across the side panel. The classic Jumpman can be found on the tongue and insoles. The rubber cupsole gets stitched sidewalls and an encapsulated Air-sole unit for a plush feel.

From the same color blocking of the original "Bred' colorway, which Jordan wore on the road throughout the 1998 Playoffs until the Finals, is the Air Jordan 13 Retro 'Court Purple.' This mid-top has black mesh overlays throughout the upper built with a blend of black tumbled leather and purple synthetic suede. An embroidered Jumpman branding is on the microfiber tongue, while the classic cat-eye hologram is on the lateral ankle. On the bottom is the panther paw outsole that features herringbone-traction rubber pods for better grip.

colorway: Pearl Pink/Hyper Orange/Pink Bloom/Pink Glow/Light Aqua/Sail
description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro GS 'Spring Flowers' makes use of a white tumbled leather upper with pale grey elephant-print overlays and pink etched lines. More pink accents land on the collar, A Jumpman-stamped heel tab, and ribbon laces maintain the signature look. The latter gets detachable floral patches to help customize the look. The white foam midsole is hoisted by an Air-Sole heel unit and anchored by a fuchsia rubber outsole.

The Women's Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Vivid Sulfur' brings some of the signature AJ4 details like a breathable side netting and support wings for midfoot support. The smooth white leather upper gets contrasting yellow accents on the eyelets, lining, and Jumpman logos on the tongue and back tab. These shoes have a two-tone midsole, equipped with an exposed Air-sole unit inside the heel.

The 2025 edition of the Air Jordan 10 Retro 'Steel' rolls out a Phylon midsole complemented with a full-length Nike Air unit. The rubber outsole has a teal Jumpman, alongside a list of Michael Jordan's career milestones. These shoes debuted when MJ played with the Birmingham Barons, the AA minor league affiliate of the Chicago White Sox. The shoelaces feed through grey webbed eyelets, contrasted by black leather touches on the collar and eyestay. An embroidered Jumpman logo adorns the heel for a final touch.

The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Heritage' reimagines a familiar Jordan franchise color story. The upper arrives in white leather, with hits of University Red on the toe box, Swoosh, heel and ankle flap. The retro Wings logo, laces and high-cut padded collar appear in black, while the woven tongue tag is decorated with Nike Air branding. Underfoot, a rubber cupsole is fitted with encapsulated Air-sole cushioning in the heel.

Recalling the 2018 Air Jordan 1 'Gold Toe,' the Wmns Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Silver Toe' instead looks to a different precious metal. Rather than patent leather, the shoe's upper is built with standard leather, finished in white and black and highlighted by metallic silver on the collar, heel and, of course, toe box. Underfoot, the white Air midsole provides cushioning, giving way to a black rubber outsole with a concentric pattern for traction.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Red Cement' for big kids blends the classic color blocking with a recognizable palette inspired by Chicago. Breathable netting appears on the quarter panel of the white leather upper and is contrasted by black molded eyelets. The sneaker is equipped with a two-tone polyurethane midsole, housing visible Air-sole cushioning and reinforced by a rubber outsole with herringbone traction pattern. The distinctive support wings of the shoe are adorned with crimson accents and speckled black detailing, matching the Jumpman logo on the heel tag. Another Jumpman logo is present on the Flight tongue tag.

The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low '85 OG 'Royal' brings back one of the original 1985 colorways in low-top form. The black leather upper is touched with royal blue accents on the toe box, heel overlay, back tab, Swoosh and Wings logo. A woven Nike Air tag adorns the tongue. True to the OG release, the off-white midsole contains encapsulated Nike Air cushioning in the heel.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Bleached Coral
description: Featuring neutral tones on the foundational sneaker is the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Stage Haze.' Its' upper combines a white leather base with a grey suede heel overlay and a forefoot overlay in cracked black leather. Matching black accents are featured on the signature Swoosh and a retro Wings logo stamped on the lateral ankle. Nike branding is outlined in Bleached Coral on the woven tongue tag while the high-top rests on a rubber cupsole that pairs white sidewalls with a grey rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Trophy Room Rookie Card Away
description: The Trophy Room x Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP ‘Away’ delivers a twist on the ‘Black Toe’ AJ1. The white leather upper gets a bold black Swoosh, contrasted by a red satin forefoot overlay. The latter has an embroidered Trophy Room logo, while the Nike tag adorns the tongue. The metallic gold Wings logo is embossed, contrasting the black knit back tab. These sneakers have an off-white midsole backed by a crimson rubber outsole to finish the look.

Reminiscent of the OG 'Carmine' colorway, the Air Jordan 6 Retro ‘Yellow Ochre’ was designed with a yellow nubuck base and white leather overlays. The upper has the iconic Jumpman logo resting on the neoprene lace cover and the back of the heel. The molded back tab, interior lining and tongue have contrasting black accents. The latter has two grip holes for easy on and off. The lightweight midsole has encapsulated Air-sole cushioning in the forefoot and an Air heel unit for comfort. A clear rubber outsole gives you traction in every direction.

Part of the 2026 Doernbecher Freestyle Collection, the Air Jordan 17 Retro Low 'Doernbecher' keeps the automotive inspiration, using a color-shifting violet leather upper that nods to custom car wraps. The black suede collar mirrors luxury car interiors, while the iridescent heel clip references burnt titanium exhaust tips. A heart on the lace toggle symbolizes CPR awareness, and a '38' signoff on the heel represents the number of days Zach Rumbaugh spent in the hospital. The partially see-through rubber outsole is made to glow in the dark after being exposed to sunlight.

The Air Jordan 1 Mid 'Smoke Grey' brings a subdued look to Michael Jordan's first signature shoe. Built with leather, the upper sports a white base overlaid by Light Smoke Grey, with black on the Swoosh, laces and 'Wings' branding. Underfoot, the midsole houses the usual Air for cushioning. The concentric outsole provides traction.

shoeName: Jordan Jumpman Jack TR Travis Scott University Red
description: The Travis Scott x Jordan Jumpman Jack TR 'University Red' sparks Travis Scott's debut signature sneakers with a black canvas upper, accented by an off-white midfoot strap and tumbled leather overlays. A red Jumpman logo adorns the tongue, jelling with the reverse suede Swoosh on the side. The Cactus Jack face logo stands out on the heel area, while an oversized 'Jack' is inscribed in red, contrasting the cream-colored rubber outsole.

The 2025 edition of the Air Jordan 4 Retro OG TD 'White Cement' stays true to the 1989 original release, starting with a white leather upper tooled with the classic side panel netting. Grey accents are adorned by black speckles on the support wings, Nike Air back tab, as well as the foam midsole. An embroidered red Jumpman logo adorns the tongue as a final touch.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Midnight Navy' showcases the timeless details that made the original design iconic in 1989 and is available in extended sizing for older kids. The classic silhouette features an upper in white tumbled leather, accentuated by a Jumpman-branded heel tab with a speckled grey finish and navy molded eyelets. Enhanced support is supplied by the matching grey wings provide, while quarter panel netting enhances comfortable ventilation. On the tongue, a Fire Red Flight logo accompanies a woven Jumpman tag. The PU midsole provides lightweight cushioning with its visible Air-sole unit in the heel.

A design inspired by a PE colorway that Michael Jordan wore during his time in D.C. distinguishes the Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Washington Wizards.’ The classic silhouette is reminiscent of the OG 'True Blue' 1988 edition and features a tumbled leather upper in stark white with the toe and heel displaying grey elephant-print overlays. The sneaker is complemented by contrasting blue accents on the molded eyelets, interior lining and raised Jumpman logo on the heel tab. A copper-colored stitched Jumpman also appears on the tongue, matching the forefoot’s circular eyelets. A durable grey rubber outsole supports the two-tone polyurethane midsole with a visible Air-sole heel unit underfoot.

The Jordan Spizike Low 'Oreo' takes elements from five past Jordan models. These shoes have a black tumbled leather upper with matching black accents on the side netting, support wings, and suede mudguard. An elephant print is embossed on the heel overlay. White pops on the logos join the molded eyelets and lace locks to contrast the design. The foam midsole includes an exposed Air-Sole heel unit below.

The Women's Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Starfish' brings the orange hue most famously seen on the 'Shattered Backboard' series into a new iteration of the classic hoops silhouette. An all-leather build on the upper features white on the profile and toe area, while the orange Starfish color adorns the overlays and the Swoosh. A rich shade of brown can be seen on the collar of the shoe, along with the Wings logo. A Nike Air tag sits atop the nylon tongue, while a Sail midsole features an encapsulated Nike Air unit leading to a durable rubber outsole.

The 2024 iteration of the Air Jordan 9 Retro ‘Powder Blue’ celebrates 30 years of this original colorway. They have precisely-detailed stitched side panels and a black mesh tongue for contrast. The white leather upper is secured by a speed lacing system, while a powder blue inner sleeve matches the Air Jordan tongue tag and a molded Jumpman heel emblem. These shoes have an encapsulated Air-sole midsole, wrapped in the signature Carolina Blue.

The Air Jordan 7 Retro 'Cardinal' brings back one of the original colorways of the AJ7, first released back in 1992. A white tumbled leather upper showcases perforated detailing across the shoe for ventilation, and a sock-like Huarache interior for a snug fit. A black midsole with pops of white and Cardinal red hide Nike Air cushioning, while AIR JORDAN is stitched across the tongue and a stylized '23' can be found on the back heel piece, completing the OG look.

shoeName: Jordan 12 Retro SP A Ma Maniére Black (Women's)
description: The A Ma Maniére x Wmns Air Jordan 12 Retro SP ‘Black’ delivers a bold incarnation of a Jordan classic. Its black nubuck upper is secured by waxed rope laces, radiating stitched lines and shaggy suede overlays in bold burgundy, all enhanced by a quilted interior lining that echoes the Atlanta retailer’s previous Jordan collaborations. A Ma Maniére’s logo on the left tongue and Jordan branding on the right are a quirky touch for this legacy performance shoe; its maroon outsole features an exposed carbon fiber spring plate and white herringbone traction pods.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low SE Black Sail Light British Tan
Jordan 4 Retro Rare Air Tour Yellow (PS) (2026)

description: The Air Jordan 12 Retro 'Barons' nods to the Birmingham Barons, the Double-A affiliate of the Chicago White Sox, which Michael Jordan played for during his minor league venture. A black tumbled leather upper gets stitched lines throughout, tooled with a grey lizard-textured mudguard. The Jumpman logo appears on the tongue and heel tab. A lightweight Phylon midsole works with a full-length Zoom Air unit underfoot and a carbon fiber shank plate for stability.

The 2025 version of the Air Jordan 8 Retro GS 'Bugs Bunny' brings back the same silhouette Michael Jordan wore during his 1992-93 NBA season. A cross-strap design secures the white leather upper, which has perforated details along the midfoot and collar. The latter is bolstered with a light grey suede overlay that engulfs the heel. The tongue has a chenille patch showcasing the Jumpman logo. A grey, black and red brushstroke design on the foam midsole maintains the classic AJ8 aesthetic.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Washed Pink (Women's)
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG ‘Washed Pink’ for women showcases a subtle color scheme of pastel shades. The upper consists of a white leather base with suede overlays in soft pink.
