The midsole and tongue have an aged pre-yellowed look,while . branding appears via a Nike tag on the tongue, a pink suede Swoosh and an off-white Wings logo on the outside ankle. A traction pattern designed for pivoting on the basketball court is featured on the pink rubber outsole.

Inspired by the classic ice cream in its trio of flavors, the Women's Air Jordan 11 Retro 'Neapolitan' showcases a white leather upper highlighted by a glossy brown patent leather mudguard and white webbing eyelets. Below, a white Phylon midsole features a full-length Air-sole unit atop a translucent rubber outsole with a pinkish tint and grippy herringbone traction pods. A stylish '23' is imprinted on the heel tab while the lateral collar displays a stitched Jumpman logo.

The Air Jordan 6 Retro 'Bordeaux' brings an Air Jordan 7 colorway to the Air Jordan 6. Built with nubuck, the shoe's upper appears in a mix of grey and black, highlighted by a translucent tongue with a multicolor print. The throat and molded heel pull-loop add Bordeaux to the design, while perforations throughout and a lace toggle support the fit. Underfoot, visible Air in the heel of the midsole provides cushioning.

Sitting above a white and navy trimmed Polyurethane midsole with a visible Nike Air unit, the Air Jordan 3 Retro ‘Midnight Navy’ is a classic Jordan silhouette that features a color scheme reminiscent of the timeless ‘White Cement’ iteration that made waves in 1988, with white tumbled leather upper and the unmistakable elephant-print forefoot and heel overlays. A Midnight Navy Jumpman logo adorns the tongue and the molded back tab.

shoeName: Jordan 11 Retro Low Year of the Snake
description: The Air Jordan 11 Retro Low 'Year of the Snake' brings in the Lunar New Year vibes, securing the white tumbled leather upper with matching eyelets and rope-style laces. A grey snakeskin mudguard adds a textured look, while a white Phylon midsole makes use of full-length Air-sole cushioning for a plush feel underfoot. A partially see-through outsole keeps the same herringbone traction zones as the original, coupled with a carbon fiber plate for stability.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low Olive Grey Enigma Stone

description: The Women's Air Jordan 3 'Champagne and Oysters' sports an ivory tumbled leather upper with light tan leather forefoot and heel overlays. A metallic gold Jumpman decorates the tongue, matching the upper molded eyelets. Another Jumpman adorns the heel tab. The cream-colored, Air-tooled foam midsole gets a touch of metallic gold around the heel. The ice blue, partially see-through rubber outsole completes the look.

The Air Jordan 11 Retro Black Barely Volt GS injects modern energy into one of Jordan Brand’s most elegant silhouettes by pairing deep black with sharp barely volt accents. The contrast adds a futuristic edge to the Jordan 11’s flowing lines, making the shoe feel bold and contemporary while preserving its premium identity. Even in grade school sizing, the patent inspired shine and sleek structure feel impactful and confident.

Fans appreciate this release because it brings freshness to a silhouette known for refinement. The Jordan 11 has always balanced performance and style, and this colorway leans into that duality with a look that feels both aggressive and clean. Collectors love it as a modern interpretation of a classic, proving the Jordan 11 can evolve visually without losing the grace that defines it.

The Air Jordan 11 Retro Black Barely Volt GS was released on October 4, 2025 with a retail price of $185.

The Women's Air Jordan 1 Mid 'Wolf Grey Aluminum' rocks an white leather upper with contrasting grey forefoot and heel overlays. A light blue suede Swoosh adds a touch of color, while a Jumpman on the tongue tag and a Wings logo on the collar flap keep the signature look intact. The blue, partially see-through rubber outsole keeps you surefooted throughout the day.

The Air Jordan 3 GS 'Olive Grey' carries dark taupe nubuck on the upper, bolstered with khaki elephant-print forefoot and heel overlays. Aqua blue touches decorate the collar lining, along with a Jumpman logo embroidered on the tongue and a small Jordan tag on the lateral side. Teal molded eyelets match the Jumpman-stamped heel tab to complement the look. The off-white foam midsole packs an Air-sole heel to provide a resilient feel to every step.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Light Fusion Red
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Light Fusion Red' brings a vibrant look to its classic basketball construction. Built with leather, shoe's upper features a white base, overlaid by Light Fusion Red and sporting Laser Orange on the Swoosh branding. The tongue tag features a gradient mix of the latter two hues, while underfoot, the white midsole houses Air in the heel for cushioning, giving way to a concentric rubber outsole for traction.

The Air Jordan 4 RM 'Black Cat' rolls out a blackout nubuck upper with a matching cage that wraps around the heel. The latter gets a raised Nike Air logo in white for bold contrast, while the Jumpman tag adorns the tongue. True to the AJ4 design, the black foam midsole gets Air-Sole heel unit and an encapsulated Air forefoot unit.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low SE Glacier Blue Summit White

colorway: Summit White/Hydrogen Blue/Legend Blue/Photon Dust/Pure Platinum/Sail
description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro GS 'Lucky Shorts' nods back to MJ's habit of wearing UNC shorts beneath his Bulls uniform in every game. These sneakers have a white tumbled leather upper with Photon Dust suede overlays and Carolina blue molded eyelets. The Jumpman logo lands on the tongue, heel tab and insoles. A vintage off-white foam midsole contains an Air-sole unit and a touch of Legend Blue along the heel.

The Air Jordan 1 Low ‘Black Lucky Green’ comes in a simple yet elegant two-tone colorway. The sneaker is constructed from leather with the quarter panel and forefoot overlay appearing in black and contrasting green details arriving via the toe box, Swoosh, collar and heel overlay. The heel is embossed with a Wings logo, and the tongue features a Jumpman icon. The sneaker is completed with a sturdy cupsole with white sidewalls and a green rubber outsole for grip on the hardwood.

The WNBA x Women's Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Desert Camo' brings a tan and brown desert camo print on the knit upper, stamped with the signature Jumpman logo on the tongue and back tab, while an orange WNBA logo graces the insoles. A white foam midsole is equipped with an exposed Air-sole heel unit and anchored by a gum rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 4 RM 'Bred' takes design elements from an OG AJ4 colorway, starting with a black leather upper, a matching suede forefoot overlay and mesh side panels. A red Nike Air logo adorns the heel cage, which extends into the midfoot. The bicolor midsole equips an encapsulated Air-sole forefoot unit as well as an exposed heel unit. A grey-and-red rubber outsole has a herringbone pattern for smooth traction underfoot.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High Rare Air Sail Cinnabar (Women's)
description: The Women's Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Sail Cinnabar' uses rust contrast stitching throughout the off-white leather upper with grey suede on the collar and Swoosh. A Nike logo adorns the tongue, while a Cinnabar-colored Wings logo appears on the collar flap. The classic Wings logo embellishes the opposite side. These shoes have a pre-yellowed midsole with stitched sidewalls and a Nike Air unit.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Mid SE LA to Chicago

description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid GS 'Ice Blue' sports a white leather upper touched with pastel blue accents on the forefoot overlay, eyestay, heel, as well as the collar flap. A black Swoosh on the side matches the toe box and collar. A Jumpman tongue tag meets the Wings logo stamped on the ankle. These shoes keep the classic cupsole with stitched sidewalls and encapsulated Air-sole cushioning for a plush feel.

The Air Jordan 4 RM 'Black Metallic' remixes the classic AJ4, starting with a blackout mesh and leather upper. A red Jumpman logo complements the leather tongue tag, while a raised Nike Air logo adorns the heel cage. These shoes ride on a soft foam midsole, equipped with a red Air-sole heel unit and an outsole that uses translucent rubber in high-wear areas.

Following the two-tone design of the 'Homage to Home' Jordan 1 High from 2018, the Women's Air Jordan 1 Mid SE 'Homage' displays one side of the leather upper in white with black overlays, while the other side is black with white overlays. The midsole is traditional with white sidewalls and a black outsole. A split Jumpman tag adorns the tongue and a printed Wings logo appears on the side.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low Midnight Navy University Blue (GS)

description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE 'Turf Orange' rocks a white leather upper, contrasted by orange patent leather overlays piped in bold black. A matching leather Swoosh gets contrasted with orange stitching, while the black Wings logo on the collar flap and an orange Jumpman tongue tag keep the classic details intact. These shoes ride on a white rubber midsole, anchored by a black rubber outsole.

Evoking its original colorblocking in 1987, the Air Jordan 2 Retro ‘Lucky Green’ gives the all-white base contrasting green-and-black piping for a modern update. Scaly-textured overlays layer the crisp white upper and are framed in piping with additional hits of green on the interior lining, Wings branding on the tongue, and at the heel. The PU midsole arrives in a retro off-white with optimal support provided by the heel’s Air-sole unit.

Designed for grade schoolers, the Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Platinum Gold' dons a platinum leather upper with contrasting black netting on the side panel and throat. Black contrast on the forefoot overlay, molded eyelets, support wings and back tab provide a bold touch. The latter matches with a metallic gold Jumpman, while another reigns the tongue and sockliner. An off-white foam midsole contains an exposed Air-sole heel unit underfoot.

The 2024 version of the Air Jordan 9 Retro GS 'Olive' has a speed lacing system to secure the black leather upper, including perforated details and brown nubuck overlays. A red 'Air Jordan' wordmark is stamped on the tongue tag, matching the molded Jumpman emblem on the back tab. The black foam midsole contains Air-sole cushioning on the forefoot and heel.

The Air Jordan 1 Low 'True Blue Cement' brings a white leather upper contrasted by a grey Swoosh. Blue accented engulf the forefoot and heel overlay, the latter of which is stamped with a stitched Wings logo. An embroidered blue Jumpman decorates the grey nylon tongue. These shoes sport a white foam midsole tooled with encapsulated Air-sole cushioning and anchored by a grey rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Hyper Violet' brings a white leather upper with a padded mid-cut collar and breathable netting underneath. These shoes have bright violet eyelets, matching the molded support wings and the Jumpman logo adorning the tongue tag and back tab. The midsole includes an exposed Air-sole heel unit, anchored by a herringbone-patterned violet rubber outsole.

The 2025 version of the Air Jordan 12 Retro GS 'Flu Game' nods back to an ailing Michael Jordan, who suited up and dominated Game 5 of the 1997 NBA Finals. A black tumbled leather upper gets radiating stitch lines and red, lizard-textured overlays. More red complements the rubber outsole, tooled with herringbone traction pods and an exposed carbon fiber shank plate for stability.

colorway: Denim Turquoise/Smokey Blue/Red Stardust/Light Stone/Denim Turquoise/Light Stone

shoeName: Jordan Hydro XI White Black Legend Blue
Jordan 4 RM White Light Smoke Grey Black

description: Taking the lowtop design of the AJ6 Low 'Chrome' from 2015, the Air Jordan 6 Retro 'Chrome' showcases what a high-top version would look like. Featuring a full black nubuck upper, contrasting metallic silver hits appear on the midsole, lace locks, heel tab and Jumpman logo. The classic AJ6 details remain, including a visible Nike Air unit in the heel and a translucent rubber outsole.

The Women's Air Jordan 1 Low SE 'Patent Valentine's Day' sports a coral leather upper with glossy patent leather touches on the eyestay, collar, forefoot and heel. A red, jeweled Swoosh matches the Jumpman emblem on the tongue and the Wings logo on the heel. These shoes have a matching rubber midsole, made with stitched sidewalls and Nike Air cushioning.

The Women's Air Jordan 1 Low 'Marina Blue' rocks a white leather upper with blue forefoot and heel overlays. The latter gets an embroidered Wings logo, while a blue Jumpman emblem adorns the tongue. The padded collar provides a comfortable feel, while the leather cupsole gets white sidewalls and a vibrant blue rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 9 Retro Low Golf White University Blue
description: The Air Jordan 9 Low Golf 'University Blue' takes cues from the original version. A speed lacing system secures the water-resistant white leather upper, which has perforated details and a Carolina Blue collar lining. The Jumpman logo adorns the memory foam insoles, while the full-length foam midsole sports the same Tar Heel blue consistent with the upper. The outsole plate has seven removable Champs spikes for sturdy traction on the course.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Mid White Black Racer Blue
description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid 'Racer Blue' emerges with OG-style color-blocking on this 2021 release. Built with leather, the shoe's upper sports a white base, with the overlays contrasting the look in black. Suede marks the collar, which appears in Racer Blue, matched by the branding, including the leather Swoosh on the side wall. Underfoot, Air in the heel of the rubber midsole provides cushioning, with the outsole incorporating a concentric pattern for traction.

The Air Jordan Luka 5 Viper Edge brings Luka Dončić’s signature line into a sharper and more aggressive space, combining performance intent with a bold and energetic color palette. The illusion green upper creates a vibrant base, while infrared 23 accents add contrast that gives the shoe a fast and reactive feel. It looks built for quick movement, reflecting Luka’s dynamic and unpredictable style on the court.

What makes this pair stand out is how it captures both personality and performance in one design. The colorway feels alive, almost mirroring the pace and creativity of Luka’s game. It is a shoe that resonates with players who value control and speed, while also appealing to collectors who appreciate expressive signature models.

The Air Jordan Luka 5 Viper Edge was released on January 8, 2026 with a retail price of $145.

shoeName: Jordan Hydro XI Retro Gamma Blue

description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid 'Chicago' dons a black leather upper with flashes of red on the forefoot overlay, eyestay, and collar flap, which is decorated by a black Wings logo. Black pops arrive on the Swoosh and collar, while the signature Jumpman adorns the tongue tag as well as the insoles. A red rubber outsole below keeps you surefooted through the day.

Released in May 2021, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG GS 'Shadow 2.0' features a look that recalls the 1985 Air Jordan 1 'Shadow.' A grade-school shoe, the upper is built with leather, finished in black and overlaid by Light Smoke Grey. A perforated toe box provides breathability, while underfoot, a white Air midsole provides cushioning and contrast. A concentric pattern on the rubber outsole offers traction.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Mid Hyper Royal Tumbled Leather
description: Featuring a look that's almost identical to 1985's Air Jordan 1 'Royal,' the Air Jordan 1 Mid 'Hyper Royal' released in February 2021. The shoe's leather upper features a familiar mix of black and Hyper Royal, adding the latter color to the eyestay to differentiate it from its predecessor. Perforations on the toe box provide breathability, while underfoot, a contrasting white Air midsole provides cushioning, giving way to a black concentric rubber outsole for traction.

The Air Jordan Mid GS 'Armory Navy' is a shoe available in big kid sizing that injects new energy to the classic silhouette via a refreshed color palette. The leather upper features a pristine white base, dark teal overlays, and a black mid-cut collar. It features a Jumpman icon on the woven tongue tag and a standard Wings logo stamped on the lateral ankle. It's built on a durable rubber cupsole with encapsulated Air-sole cushioning under the heel.

Reintroducing the Air Jordan 7 Retro 'Chambray' in the 2023 edition, a timeless colorway that made its debut in 2006. The shoe rests upon a matching black polyurethane midsole, featuring angular detailing in Chambray and Light Graphite. The upper arrives in black nubuck with the lateral ankle adorned with a pale blue stitched Jumpman logo. The sneaker is further adorned with additional branding including the 'Air Jordan' inscription on the patterned tongue and a '23' heel patch. Ensuring a secure and comfortable fit, an interior sleeve is incorporated, while easy on-and-off is ensured by a webbing pull tab at the heel.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro DJ Khaled We The Best Crimson Bliss (GS)
description: A heritage silhouette is treated to a vivid color palette with the DJ Khaled x Air Jordan 5 Retro GS ‘Crimson Bliss,’ a pair from the 2022 ‘We The Best’ collection. Made for little kids, the upper in a brilliant pink features netting at the quarter panel and a luxe interior lining in quilted blue. Built on a foam midsole in off-white with distinctive shark-tooth patterning, Air-sole cushioning and a clear rubber outsole provide comfort and traction underfoot. The tongue in reflective silver is embellished with Jumpman branding and Nike Air and ‘We the Best’ alternate on the overlay on the heel.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Black Raspberry (GS)
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG GS 'Black Raspberry' brings a white leather upper accented with black leather forefoot and heel panels, as well as a Wings-branded back tab. A pastel violet Swoosh matches the Nike Air tongue tag, while a green-colored, partially see-through rubber cupsole glows in the dark along with signature details on the white upper panels.

Inspired by the uniform of Michael Jordan for a charity match in 1988 in which he scored 54 points, the Air Jordan 3 Retro 'International Flight' sports a patriotic color scheme on an off-white leather construction. Sport Royal accents grace the branding of Jumpman's eyelets, midsole, and embossed heel, while Fire Red's contrasting marks stand out on the back midsole section and Jumpman's logo on the tongue, with Michael Jordan's signature on the right. The Jordan elephant print signature on the toe and heel is rendered in light gray on the leather overlays.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro GS 'Plaid' refreshes the timeless design with a textile upper that combines various plaid patterns. Black netting on the side enhances breathability, while molded black eyelets have orange rope laces feeding through them for a snug fit. Orange Jumpman logos are stitched on the tongue and heel. The shoe rests on a translucent rubber outsole while the black foam midsole houses a visible Air-sole unit in the heel and includes orange shark tooth accents.

The women's Air Jordan 9 Retro 'Change the World' features a white leather upper with 'Change the World’ emblazoned on the black heel loops. The overlays, eyelets, collar lining, and midsole all vary in colors made from natural plant-based dyes. The rubber outsole has designs from different languages to represent MJ's global impact.

The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE 'Brushstroke Paint Splatter' brings various art styles to its classic basketball build. The shoe's canvas upper appears with a white base, complemented by Cider overlays that sport multicolor paint drops. The mismatched Swoosh branding includes suede on the medial side and a painted-on black Swoosh on the lateral, while underfoot, more paint splatter appears on the Air midsole, which provides cushioning.

The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG GS ‘Brotherhood’ for big kids pays homage to Omega Psi Phi, Michael Jordan’s fraternity at the University of North Carolina. This high-top model features Light Bordeaux and University Gold forefoot and heel overlays against a leather upper with white quarter panels. Supporting the shoe is a rubber cupsole equipped with Air-sole cushioning in the heel. The toe box, collar flap, and woven ‘Nike Air’ tongue tag also appear in University Gold.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Mid SE Royal Black Toe
description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE 'Royal Black Toe' emerges with classic color-blocking on this July 2020 release. Built with a white leather base, the upper includes Hyper Royal suede over the heel, with black nylon on the eyestay, Swoosh and toe. More Hyper Royal marks the 'Wings' logo, while underfoot, the midsole houses Air in the heel for cushioning. A concentric outsole provides traction while completing the look.

Iconic French soccer club Paris Saint-Germain teamed up with Jordan brand to create the Paris Saint-Germain x Air Jordan 6 Retro 'Iron Grey.' The shoe's nubuck upper is finished in black and Iron Grey, with Infrared 23 accents on the Jumpman branding, lace toggle and heel pull-tab. The heel sports a hybrid logo, with 'Paname' appearing on the flag near the ankle. Visible Air in the heel provides cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan 1 High OG First in Flight (Women's)
description: The Women's Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'First in Flight' has a tumbled leather base in a subtle off-white finish, accented by powder blue nubuck on the forefoot and Swoosh. Navy blue hits the leather heel overlay and collar flap, stamped with an amber Wings logo. The classic Nike Air logo sports a 'First in Flight' phrase proudly above the tongue. The midsole equips an encapsulated Air-sole heel unit for all-around comfort.

The Air Jordan MVP 92 'Medium Olive Khaki' dons an olive green suede upper with matching knit side panels and a molded heel counter. The latter is stamped with a raised Nike Air logo, while the tongue has a red Jumpman icon laid over a retro Flight logo. A taupe-colored foam midsole keeps the jagged details lifted from the Air Jordan 7 as a nod to its inspiration.

A surprise release on the SNKRS app in June 2019, the Air Jordan 4 Retro NRG 'Raptors - Drake Signature' gives the nod to one of Toronto's biggest celebrity fans. Featuring the same colorway as the first 'Raptors' model, the standout feature is the tongue patch, which includes a purple Jumpman and Drake's signature. The upper is built with black nubuck, while University Red and Court Purple throughout complete the team look.

The Air Jordan 11 Retro Low GS 'Concord-Bred' is a grade-school hybrid look. Drawing from two iconic OG colorways, the shoe's leather upper appears in white, overlaid by black patent leather and modeled after the 'Concord.' Underfoot, a white Air midsole and True Red rubber outsole are taken from the 'Bred.'

Released in October 2018, the Air Jordan 6 Retro Trainer SC II stands out as part of a larger collection that takes classic Air Jordan silhouettes and combines them with classic Nike models, all designed by Tinker Hatfield. This Air Jordan 6 features a distinctive white, grey, and Infrared palette typically associated with the Air Trainer SC II, the cross trainer made famous by Bo Jackson and worn off-court by MJ.

As part of their collaboration with the Paris Saint-Germain Football Club, Jordan Brand launched the Air Jordan 5 edition in Paris. The shoe features black nubuck tops with the crest of the team embroidered on the heel with a centered Jumpman. Other signature details include "Paris" text on the midfoot net, "75" Paris zip code instead of "23" stitched on the lateral heel, and "ICI C'EST PARIS" team slogan on the insole that translates to "Here is Paris."

The Air Jordan 1 Low 'Shattered Backboard' delivers a chopped down version of the massively popular colorway of the sneaker that started it all. Like its predecessor, this low-top edition features a blend of white, black and orange on the upper, built with leather and nubuck instead of the all-leather construction of the high-top. Branding elements include a Jumpman on the tongue and the Wings logo on the heel.

shoeName: Jordan Max Aura 7 White Summit White Black

description: Recalling on the neutral two-tone palette of the iconic colorway from Jordan's debut signature shoe is the Air Jordan 1 Mid GS 'Shadow.' The upper is made with smooth grey leather and contrasting black leather overlays and features a color-matched Swoosh. Gym Red hints make their way to the Jumpman icon on the woven tongue tag and the Wings logo debossed on the lateral collar flap. It's built on a rubber cupsole with crisp white sidewalls, a black rubber outsole, and encapsulated Air-sole cushioning in the heel.

Echoing the original 'Olive' colorway of this legacy silhouette, released in 1993, the Air Jordan 9 Retro ‘Olive Concord’ add black, brown, bright blue and aqua to give it a new identity. The black leather upper with abstract inlaid patterning is layered with neutral brown nubuck. Branding in Bright Concord appears on the tongue's 'Air Jordan' and the signature Jumpman on one heel and a stitched ’23' on the other. The black midsole offers Air-sole cushioning and is embellished with another Jumpman, also in Bright Concord.

shoeName: Jordan Dub Zero White Varsity Red (2022)
Air Jordan 1 Mid Black Fire Red (GS)

description: The Air Jordan 12 Low Golf ‘Masters’ displays a white leather upper with the same radiating stitched lines from the original Air Jordan 12, along with a durable lizard-like mudguard and metallic gold molded eyelets. More gold hits the midfoot overlay and embroidered Jumpman on the tongue. An Air-enhanced foam midsole, works with a partially see-through rubber outsole with seven removable gold spikes to keep you surefooted on the course.

The Air Jordan 12 Retro GS 'Arctic Pink' brings a distressed finish to grade-school sizes. The design emerges throughout the cracked suede upper, with the abstract pattern contrasted by synthetic white leather on the mudguard. The heel pull-loop, molded eyelets, inner lining and tongue branding add a more vibrant pink to the look, while underfoot, the phylon midsole works with a shank plate for cushioning and stability. A herringbone pattern on the outsole offers traction.

The Air Jordan 13 Low ‘Hornets’ pays tribute to the NBA franchise that’s now immediately associated with the basketball great. The low-top sports a synthetic suede base in Midnight Navy, contrasted by white leather overlays and a metallic silver Jumpman on the lateral heel. It all rides on a signature panther paw outsole in turquoise.

After having no releases the year before, the Air Jordan 14 Retro 'Thunder' was one of four Air Jordan colorways to drop in 2014. Inspired by the design of the Air Jordan 4 'Thunder,' the black suede upper sports Vibrant Yellow accents on the heel and Jumpman badge, with the color also making its way to the midsole.

shoeName: Jordan Why Not Zer0.6 White Light Liquid Lime Pink Blast Black

description: The Nike Air Air Jordan 9 Retro ' Statue ' is based on the famous bronze sculpture of Michael Jordan outside the United Center in Chicago. Built during his first retirement, the statue depicts Jordan wearing the Air Jordan 9 — a sneaker he never played in for the Bulls. Released in August 2015, the sneaker features a white leather upper with bronze accents including a sprinkled bronze midsole.

The Air Jordan 9 Retro 'Bred' is influenced by the past's Player Exclusive colorways in a nod to the Jordan Brand legacy. The high-cut silhouette features an upper black leather with corresponding laces and heel pull tab. Details include a branding on the midsole, tongue and insole at the University Red Jumpman, and a tonal ' 23 ' on the heel.

The Air Jordan 13 Retro gets the classic ‘Wheat’ treatment, executed on an upper that features a soft light-brown hue throughout. A mesh base is overlaid with premium suede construction on the tongue, vamp and signature quilted overlays. The holographic ‘cat eye’ emblem delivers a contrasting shot of color, while the gum rubber outsole maintains the monochromatic theme.

The Nike Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Cavs' celebrates the 23rd anniversary of 'The Shot,' the last-second bucket of Michael Jordan over Craig Ehlo that defeated the Cleveland Cavaliers in the '89 Playoffs. With Safety Orange and Game Royal accents, the design features a black nubuck top. The sneaker fell in limited amounts in May 2012.

The Air Jordan 10 Retro ‘Tinker’ dropped in October 2018 as part of a special collection featuring classic Jordan silhouettes finished in colorways inspired by classic Nike models, all designed by Tinker Hatfield. In this case, the Air Jordan 10 mixes with another Tinker creation from 1994, the Air Huarache Light. The latter’s predomonant blue color scheme, complete with contrasting orange accents, highlights MJ's tenth signature shoe.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Flight Club (PS)
description: The Jordan 1 High OG PS 'Flight Club' nods to the mail-in membership program Jordan Brand ran from the late '80s through the early '90s. White contrast stitching pipes the contours of the blackout leather upper, touched with knit overlays. A red Nike tab decorates the foam nylon tongue, matching the Wings logo stamped on the collar flap. An off-white midsole is anchored by a sturdy gum rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro Spring Is In The Air (PS)

description: The 2025 version of the Air Jordan 8 Retro PS 'Bugs Bunny' sports a cross-strap, white leather upper touched with a light grey suede overlay bolstering the collar and heel. An embroidered Jumpman patch decorates the tongue, while black, grey and red brushstrokes on the side panels add a dynamic look.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro PS 'Medium Soft Pink' rocks a white leather upper coated in a 3M reflective finish. Pastel pink touches embellish the embroidered '23' signoff on the side, a Jumpman icon on the silver reflective tongue, and a Nike logo on the heel. These kicks ride on a black foam midsole, which contains an Air-sole cushioning, anchored by a see-through rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro TD 'Medium Soft Pink' has a white reflective leather upper with a side panel netting and a pink '23' embroidered on the heel. Soft pink touches land on the Nike heel logo and the Jumpman on the reflective silver tongue. Pink shark tooth details decorate the black foam midsole, anchored by a see-through rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 9 Retro Flint Grey French Blue (2026) (TD)

description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG GS 'Royal Toe' brings a classic colorway to grade-school sizes. The shoe's upper is built with leather, finished in black and white and accented by Game Royal on the toe box and collar. Underfoot, the white midsole houses Air in the heel for cushioning, with a final hit of Game Royal on the concentric outsole underfoot.

This 2024 iteration of the Air Jordan 11 Retro TD 'Legend Blue / Columbia' reinforces the white leather upper with a matching patent leather mudguard. This toddler version has contrasting black accents on the collar lining and back tab, stamped with the signature '23.' A powder blue Jumpman complements the side of the heel, while a blue rubber outsole finishes the look.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG UNC Reimagined (PS)
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG PS 'UNC Reimagined' have a cracked, sail-colored leather upper complemented with smooth, powder blue leather overlays. The Nike-branded tongue tag joins a debossed Wings logo on the side of the collar. The aged aesthetic carries into a pre-yellowed midsole and blue outsole.

Available in toddler sizes and celebrating the 20th anniversary of the neutral colorway is the 2021 edition of the Air Jordan 11 Retro TD 'Cool Grey.' Similar to the original, the upper is constructed from grey nubuck with tonal webbing eyelets and a shiny patent leather overlay. A white Jumpman logo is on the lateral ankle with '23' inscribed on a pull loop on the heel. It's built on a Phylon midsole with a translucent rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Love Letter (GS)
colorway: Shadow Brown/Shadow Brown/Soft Pearl/Light British Tan/Team Red

shoeName: Jordan 6 Retro Craft Paris Olympics Pearl (Women's)
description: The Women's Air Jordan 6 Retro Craft 'Pearl' rolls out gold accents throughout the platinum suede upper in celebration of the 2024 Summer Olympics. Perforated details and a spoiler-like heel tab distinguish the look, while a Jumpman logo adorns the lace cover and back heel. Golden sidewalls add a luxe touch to the midsole, fitted with an Air-sole heel unit and supported by a rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Mid SE Metallic Team Gold (Women's)

description: The Air Jordan 1 Low 'White Toe' rocks a leather upper that sports black on most of the panels except for white leather on the toe box. A red collar lining adds a subtle touch of contrast, matching the Swoosh and the Wings logo on the heel. The traditional midsole and outsole stay true to the original design.

Releasing in 2017, the Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Motorsports Alternate' dropped alongside a primarily white colorway, both drawing from Michael Jordan's motorcycle racing team. Modeled after a very limited 2006 colorway released to members of the team, the shoe's upper appears in black leather, with Matte Silver complementing the molded eyelets, collar lining and heel branding. Game Royal accents the inside of the tongue and tongue tag, while underfoot, more Game Royal marks the rubber outsole. Visible Air in the heel provides cushioning.

The 2023 Air Jordan 8 Retro GS 'Playoff' for big kids marks the 30th anniversary of the iconic sneaker that Michael Jordan wore during his third consecutive NBA championship victory. Underfoot, a black foam midsole arrives with with encapsulated Air-sole cushioning in both the forefoot and heel. The black nubuck upper features a unique cross-strap closure system, a crimson-colored pull tab and eye-catching brush-stroke overlays in black, white, and red. The tongue showcases a chenille Jumpman patch, and the interior lining features a vibrant multicolor pattern.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro JTH NRG 'Bio Beige' updates the Justin Timberlake and Tinker Hatfield collab with a neutral earth tone. The soft tan suede upper featuers a Swoosh on the lateral side, taken from an early Tinker sketch on the AJ3. 'Nike Air' adorns the back heel tab and a visible Max Air unit are mainstays of the AJ3, while Timberlake details including HIGHER on the medial ankle area and "FAME IS A LIE" and "STRESS IS CRUEL" printed on the sockliner.

Nike celebrated the NBA titles of Michael Jordan with a two-shoe Championship Pack featuring dual silhouette colorways. In 2016, the Air Jordan 8 joined the annual 'C&C Championship Pack' with two colorways, 'Champagne' and 'Confetti. ' The pack pays homage to the three-peat season of the Chicago Bulls in ' 92-'93. The Air Jordan 8 ' Champagne / Trophy ' features distinctive details including a midsole gold panel with a ' fingerprint ' look that mimics Jordan's handprint on the Larry O'Brien trophy, and a message under the cross straps of ' World Championships ' and ' Again and Again. '

Jordan Brand teamed up with Supreme to create the Supreme x Air Jordan 14 Retro SP 'Black Varsity Royal,' released in June 2019. The shoe features a premium leather construction in black, outfitted with metal studs throughout the design. The signature Jumpman badge at the ankle sports co-branding, as do the heel, tongue and vamp. Underfoot, Zoom Air works with a shank plate to provide cushioning and support, with a herringbone pattern on the outsole for traction.

As the last sneaker Michael Jordan ever laced up on an NBA court, the Air Jordan 18 reappeared in April 2018. And in this ‘Toro’ colorway—meaning ‘bull’ in Spanish—the sneaker seems to reimagine history as if MJ has retired as a Chicago Bull. It boasts a University Red suede upper, with contrasting black accents on the midsole, heel wrap, lining and branding.

The 2026 edition of the Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Valentine's Day' updates this kids-exclusive edition with spring-ready pastels. The retro silhouette employs a white pebbled leather upper with Vapor Green accents on the quarter panel netting and leather tongue tag. The latter is marked with a pink Jumpman logo, matching the second Jumpman icon that adorns the heel tab. Icy blue accents make their way to the molded eyelets and TPU support wings. The sneaker sits atop a two-tone foam midsole in pink and white, fitted with a visible Air-Sole unit in the heel and supported by a semi-translucent rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 6 Retro PSG Paris Saint-Germain Silver
description: The Paris Saint-Germain x Air Jordan 6 Retro 'Silver' sports a polished metallic silver leather upper, tooled with perforations on the midfoot underlays as well as the collar. Classic touches like the extended heel tab, lace locks, and two-hole tongue remain intact. A round heel badge builds in the Jumpman logo into the classic PSG logo. These sneakers ride on a matching silver foam midsole, which includes an exposed Air-Sole heel unit, anchored by a partially see-through rubber outsole.

colorway: Gym Red/Soft Pearl/Gum Medium Brown/Metallic Gold
description: The Air Jordan 11 'China' nods to the country's exuberant hoops scene with beaded details on the light grey knit upper, accented with matching suede on the eyelets and collar. The latter gets a Jumpman logo on the side. Brown silk lines the inside, matching the leather mudguard. The Phylon midsole is wrapped in soft suede, equipped with full-length Air-sole cushioning. The gum rubber outsole keeps you surefooted through the day.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG SP Fragment x Union LA White Black
description: The Fragment Design x Union LA x Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG SP 'White Black' rolls out a white leather upper with black accents on the toe box, Swoosh, heel overlay, and Wings-stamped collar flap. Union LA's iconic zigzag stitching delineates the royal blue base of the collar. Fragment Design's lightning bolt emblem lands on the heel, while a Nike Air tag decorates the tongue. The rubber cupsole gets printed tooling code along the sidewall as a final touch.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Medium Olive (GS)

description: The Air Jordan 15 Retro 'Obsidian' 2017 features a dark Obsidian throughout its woven Kevlar upper, with white contrast on the heel and protruding tongue. The split color-blocking continues down onto the midsole, which, unlike the OG model, only houses Zoom Air in the heel.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro Spring Is In The Air (TD)

description: Originally released as part of the two-shoe Thunder and Lightning pack in 2006, the Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Thunder' 2012 dropped six years later. The shoe's upper is built with a black nubuck base, highlighted by Tour Yellow on the molded eyelets, quarter panel and tongue lining. Underfoot, more Tour Yellow accents the polyurethane midsole, which includes the usual visible Air in the heel for cushioning. A rubber outsole is included for traction.

The Women's Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Ruby' feature a white leather side panel with contrasting black pops on the forefoot overlay, eyestay, collar, and Swoosh. The red panels get a cracked leather finish inspired by the gemstone. An embossed black Wings logo on the collar flap and a Nike Air logo on the tongue keep the signature look.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High Satin Snake Chicago (Women's)
description: A follow-up to the 2019 'Satin Black Toe,' the Wmns Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Satin Red' released in August 2020. The shoe emerges with flipped color-blocking, although it's finished in the same mix of red, black and white. A snakeskin texture marks the heel, collar and Swoosh branding, while the tongue and inner lining are made with satin to give the shoe its name. A white Air midsole provides cushioning underfoot.

The 2025 iteration of the Air Jordan 1 Mid 'Shattered Backboard' has a white leather upper with a contrasting black forefoot overlay, eyestay and soft collar. An orange Swoosh matches the heel as well as the Wings-stamped collar flap. A Jumpman logo adorns the black tongue, while an off-white midsole contains Air-sole cushioning, both undergirded by a sturdy black rubber outsole below.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Top 3' is a hybrid look that combines three OG colorways. The shoe's 'Black/Metallic Silver' influence becomes apparent on the black nubuck construction of the upper, with silver on the quarter panel netting. A Fire Red '23' accents the heel, joining the midsole in drawing from the 'Fire Red.' The two-tone tongue instead takes its cue from the 'Grape' colorway.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Mid TD Cleat Bred Toe

description: Celebrating the vibrant streetwear culture of Capetown, South Africa, the Shelflife x Air Jordan 2 Retro Low brings an elegant feel to a heritage shoe. The low top's smooth all-white upper is complemented by shots of color delivered with the Wings logo and the 'TEAM ONLY' stitching on the inner lining of the tongue tab. The mudguard in smooth leather and semi-clear heel counter are built on an Air-sole cushioned midsole. The insoles are emblazoned with 'Shelflife' to salute South Africa's leading sneaker storefront.

The Air Jordan 2 Retro 'White Cement' is a minimalist take on Michael Jordan's second signature shoe. The shoe's white leather upper is accentuated by a tonal lizard-textured overlay that is bordered by black and grey piping. The grey molded heel tab is embossed with the Nike wordmark, while the tongue is adorned with a grey Wings logo. The polyurethane midsole features encapsulated Air-sole cushioning that ensures comfortable underfoot. The sockliner showcases a skyline graphic and the words 'Look, Up in the Air.'

The Air Jordan 13 Retro ‘CP3 Away’ hit store shelves in 2015, treating Chris Paul’s PE colorway to a retail launch. Inspired by the athlete’s time with the New Orleans Hornets, the colorway reflects the team’s road uniforms, featuring black mesh paneling atop an upper built with tumbled black leather and synthetic suede in Orion Blue. Sunstone pops appear on the outsole and CP3 logo at the tongue.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Mid SE Black Metallic Reimagined (GS)
description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid GS 'Black Metallic Reimagined'rocks a blackout leather upper with a reflective finish on the heel, collar flap and Swoosh. The Jumpman logo adorns the red tongue tag for a modest contrast. The black foam midsole contains Air-sole cushioning, undergirded by a see-through rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan MVP Sky J Light Olive

description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG ' Sail ' features a tone Sail rubber outsole with an off-white Sail leather upper. The design also involves branding on the tongue tab of the University Red Nike Air. The ' Sail ' fell alongside a ' Triple Black ' colorway as part of the ' Premium Essentials ' pack in June 2017.

The 2011 Air Jordan 14 Retro 'Last Shot' brings back the shoe that Michael wore when he sank the series-clinching bucket in Game 6 of the 1998 Finals, his final shot with the Chicago Bulls. This reissue is true to the original, featuring an all-black upper built with a blend of tumbled leather and suede. Contrasting Varsity Red appears on the shoe’s branding hits and shank plate underfoot.

Making its debut in 1999, the Air Jordan 15 Retro 'Stealth' 2007 sneaker boasts a timeless design. The shoe showcases a sleek all-black upper in premium full-grain leather. Adding a touch of durability and visual interest, a woven Kevlar aramid fabric runs across the top half of the shoe. The design is further enhanced by a hidden lace system, a Dynamic Fit inner sleeve for a secure fit, and a distinctively extended tongue, which draws inspiration from Michael Jordan's signature move of sticking his tongue out before executing a powerful dunk. The sneaker incorporates Varsity Red accents on the Pebax external heel counter, and underfoot, Zoom Air cushioning ensures a smooth and enjoyable wearing experience.

The Air Jordan 12 Low Retro 'Wolf Grey' features a neutral look on its elevated construction. The upper emerges with a microperforated suede build, finished in Wolf Grey and overlaid by a synthetic leather textured mudugard. The heel and sockliner add yellow to the look via the branding, with a heel pull-loop included for easy on and off. Underfoot, a tonal phylon midsole offers cushioning, working with full-length Zoom Air. A carbon-fiber shank plate offers stability.

colorway: Red Plum/Black/Hyper Royal/Yellow Strike/Football Grey/Dynamic Turquoise

shoeName: Jordan Franchise Slide Black Metallic Gold

description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro TD 'Cave Stone' uses dark taupe nubuck on the upper, contrasted by black eyelets, a matching side panel netting, and a knit collar lining. The Jumpman logo adorns the tongue, while a raised Nike logo lands on the heel tab. The foam midsole provides a plush feel underfoot.

The Women's Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Praline' gives a fresh look to the legendary sneaker by incorporating neutral shades that perfectly match the shoe's classic design. A combination of white and tan overlays on the all-leather upper are accompanied by a matching Swoosh. The lightly padded nylon tongue is adorned with a woven Nike Air tag, and the lateral collar flap displays a Jordan Wings logo. The sneaker's classic cupsole has textured white sidewalls, and the rubber outsole is a grippy tan hue.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Craft Vibrations Of Naija
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Craft 'Vibrations of Naija' is a classic and understated take on Michael Jordan's first signature shoe. The upper is made from off-white tumbled leather and features a black-speckled Pale Vanilla Swoosh. The same speckling appears on the high-cut collar, which is wrapped in ankle flaps whose lateral sides bear the iconic Wings logo. The high-top shoe is supported by a sturdy rubber cupsole with off-white sidewalls and a cream-colored outsole for optimal grip on the hardwood.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low SE Multi-Color Sail Light Bone

description: The Jordan Session 'Black Gum' nods to late '90s and early 2000s skate shoes. White laces secure a black suede upper, which has matching details along the side panel. The Jumpman logo adorns the toe as well as the heel. The matching black foam midsole works alongside a gum rubber outsole with red herringbone traction pods for surefire grip.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat White Grey Fog

description:
The Air Jordan Tatum 3 Tunnel Walk delivers a bold and fashion forward take on the silhouette through a clean base and premium accents. The white upper creates a bright and structured look, while black details add contrast that defines the design. Metallic gold elements introduce a refined touch, reflecting pre game style influence.

Fans of tunnel walk aesthetics appreciate how this colorway blends performance with off court fashion. The combination of white, black, and gold gives it a sleek and elevated feel. It is a sneaker that reflects modern basketball culture and personal style.

The Air Jordan Tatum 3 Tunnel Walk was released on April 15, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High Rookie of the Year
description: In 1985, after starting his career with a remarkable point per game average, Michael Jordan won the NBA's Rookie of the Year Award. To celebrate, Jordan Brand released the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Rookie of the Year.' The high top features a white-based leather cap with breathability finger box perforations and mudguard, knee, eyestay, and heel overlays of Gold Harvest leather. Hidden on the inside of each upper strap are callouts to the exceptional rookie season of MJ. On the inside of one strap can be discovered ' 1984-85 R.O.Y. 2313 POINTS 28.2 PPG ' and on the other a quote from Jordan.

The Air Jordan 12 Retro 'Reverse Flu Game' takes the iconic 'Flu Game' colorway and flips its blocking. Built with suede, the upper appears in Varsity Red, with stitched detailing modeled after Japan's Rising Sun Flag. A reptilian overlay contrasts the forefoot, while Air underfoot provides cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro SP 30th Anniversary Union Desert Moss
description: The Union LA x Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Desert Moss' released to celebrate 30 years of the retailer. Bringing back a modified AJ4 created by the two brands in 2020, the shoe's aesthetic is informed by outdoor gear from the 80s and 90s, as noted by its inclusion in the Tent and Trail capsule. Built with a purple mesh base, yellow suede overlays the design, while turquoise on the molded eyelets and heel patch adds further color. Maintaining signature features of its predecessor, the shoe also includes a stitched fold-down tongue, yellow 'UN/LA' tag and translucent TPU wings, while underfoot, visible Air in the heel of the polyurethane midsole provides cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low Method of Make V3 Black Metallic Silver (Women's)

description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE 'Diamond' gives a new iteration of the legendary shoe design, renewed in White and Black. Its upper spotlights a leather base with overlays and the standard Wings’ Logo. On the upper, a Swoosh branding emphasizes the design with a breathable nylon tongue. The midsole is built on top of a rubber outsole with a circular design for traction.

The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Prototype' brings a contrasting look to its classic basketball construction. Built with leather, the shoe's upper appears in white, overlaid by grey and black leather and tan nubuck. The collar highlights the design in various shades of blue, with perforated detailing that can be cut away to turn the build into a low-top. Underfoot, the midsole houses Air in the heel for cushioning, with a concentric rubber outsole for traction.

The women’s Air Jordan 1 Low ‘University Blue’ utilizes a colorway at the heart of MJ's college days. The upper in a light grey leather pairs with University Blue overlays at the forefoot and heel, the signature Swoosh and the collar. Branding appears on the heel and tongue with sstitched Wings and Jumpman logos. Underfoot, support and comfort are ensured by a traditional rubber cupsole with an internal Air-sole unit housed in a cushy foam wedge.

The Air Jordan Tatum 3 Tie Dye delivers swirling color across the performance driven silhouette, mixing University Blue, Pale Ivory, Royal Tint, and Camellia into a dynamic upper. The layered tones create movement that mirrors Tatum’s fluid style of play, while the streamlined structure keeps the focus on speed and agility. Subtle branding details ground the vibrant execution in Jordan heritage.

This release stands out because it embraces bold pattern without sacrificing structure. The tie dye effect adds individuality and energy, giving the shoe a standout identity on and off the court. Fans of Tatum’s signature line appreciate when expressive color meets serious performance intent. It is a confident and creative take on a modern basketball model that balances flair with function.

The Air Jordan Tatum 3 Tie Dye was released on July 11, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low SE Metallic Team Gold (Women's)

description: The Air Jordan 1 Low 'Alternate Bred Toe' has black and red leather panels and a white Swoosh to decorate the upper. Red hits on the toe box and heel areas liven up the design, along with a small Jumpman on the tongue. A black Wings logo is embroidered on the heel to keep the signature look.

The Wmns Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Tie-Dye' brings a faux hand-dyed effect to its classic basketball construction. A women's shoe, the upper is built with a white leather base, with black leather on the collar and toe box. The overlays define the look, while underfoot, a classic midsole houses Air for cushioning, with a concentric outsole for traction.

Replicating the hues of the 2018 ‘Bred Toe,’ the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG GS ‘Yellow Toe’ is a big kids’ shoe presented with standout color blocking. A Taxi yellow toe box pairs with overlays at the heel and forefoot in black contrasting against white quarter panels. A traditional cupsole with an interior Air-sole unit provides support underfoot. The lateral ankle displays a retro Wings logo while ‘Nike Air’ appears on the tongue tag.

The Women's Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Net - Black' has the laces fed through free-floating molded eyelets, securing a blackout leather upper that expands to the side panel netting so it wraps over the tongue. The Jumpman logo lands on the tongue and heel, which is ornamented with detachable silver charms. A matching black foam midsole contains a visible Nike Air bubble for cushioning.

Bringing a revamped color palette to the basketball classic that introduced visible Air cushioning to the Jordan franchise is the Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Dark Iris.' It features a white tumbled leather upper with signature elephant print overlays in a dark grey finish. Violet splashes are on the eyelets, perforated collar, and the rear of the polyurethane midsole. Jumpman branding adorns the leather tongue and molded heel overlay. It's built on a grey rubber outsole for better grip.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Mid SE Red Cracked Leather (Women's)

description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Turbo Green' features a two-tone look with unique detailing. Released ahead of the 2019 NBA All-Star Game, the shoe features a white leather base overlaid by distressed suede in Turbo Green. The quarter panel sports 'SP 19 Air Jordan 1 High OG' branding, while underfoot, a Sail midsole continues the vintage aesthetic while providing cushioning via Air. A grey concentric outsole provides the usual traction.

The Air Jordan 4 RM 'Black Varsity Red' presents a black mesh and leather upper. Anthracite pops embellish the suede forefoot overlay and midfoot cage. The latter surrounds the heel, which is stamped with a raised, red Nike Air emblem. More red lands on the tongue and herringbone-patterned rubber outsole. A black foam midsole contains an Air-Sole heel unit for balanced cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Oxidized Green (Women's)
description: The Women's Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG 'Oxidized Green' brings a white leather upper, contrasted by dark green accents on the Swoosh, back tab and the collar. The collar rocks the retro Wings logo, while a Nike Air tag decorates the tongue. An off-white midsole contains an encapsulated Air-sole unit, anchored by a green rubber outsole.

The Jordan Tatum 3 Pink turns heads with a vibrant palette and court-ready design built for confident play. Dressed in Pink Tint with accents of Lava Glow, Hot Punch, and Guava Ice, this signature model balances bold style with functional details from heel to toe. A breathable upper keeps air flowing during intense runs, while the padded collar and sculpted heel help lock you in without adding bulk. The midfoot support frame works with a dynamic lacing system to create a secure, adaptive fit that stays comfortable through quick cuts, hard stops, and full-speed transitions.

Underfoot, responsive cushioning delivers a smooth, springy ride that keeps you light on your feet and close to the floor for precise footwork. A durable rubber outsole features a multi-directional traction pattern engineered for grip on polished hardwood and blacktop alike, providing confident control when you pull up from deep or drive the lane. Finished with Tatum branding and the style code FZ6598-600/FZ6601-600, this men’s basketball shoe brings modern performance with standout flair, ideal for both game day and everyday wear. The Jordan Tatum 3 Pink released on May 12, 2025, adding a fresh, high-energy colorway to the Air Jordan Tatum lineup.

Our team loves this product because it blends dependable court performance, eye-catching color blocking, and a dialed-in fit that’s great for players who want speed, support, and style in one shoe.

shoeName: Jordan CMFT Era Black Sail Coconut Milk Starfish

description: The Air Jordan 13 Retro Low 'Dongdan' commemorates the streetball tournament held annually in Beijing. These shoes have a soft foam midsole wrapped in synthetic suede, undergirded by a Zoom Air unit for cushioning. These sneakers have dimpled tumbled leather overlays, hemp-colored nubuck on the toe, while matching suede covers the midfoot, collar and heel areas. The tongue has a classic Jumpman logo on the right shoe and a rubberized Dongdan patch on the left.

Jordan Brand paid homage to an old ad campaign classic by releasing the Jordan 6 Retro Hare, now available on StockX. The Hare colorway originally made its debut on an Air Jordan 7 in one of the first Jordan ads that featured Bugs Bunny. Jumpman keeps the tradition alive by transferring this iconic colorway to a new silhouette.

This Jordan 6 consists of a white leather upper with grey underlays and a red detailing. A translucent tongue, patterned outsole, and a purple Jumpman on the heel complete the design. These sneakers released in April of 2020 and retailed for $190.

The Air Jordan 2 Retro Low 'Cherrywood' is a shoe that features OG-inspired color blocking that pays homage to 1987’s 'Varsity Red' AJ2 Low. The shoe's smooth white leather upper features shaggy off-white suede midfoot paneling. The heel tab, interior lining, midfoot piping, and the Wings logo that appears on the tongue all deliver hits of bold maroon. A two-tone durable rubber outsole adds support beneath a white PU midsole.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High Golf Eastside Golf Out of the Mud
description: It's all about the fairway with the Eastside Golf x Air Jordan 1 High Golf ‘Out the Mud.’ The hoops favorite is treated to the lifestyle golf brand's reinvention, combining a leather upper in stark white with overlays in Burnt Sunrise and a Swoosh in Midnight Navy. The collar is adorned by the legacy Wings logo and the tongue salutes both brands with a Jumpman on the right and on the left an Eastside Golf logo. The high-top is constructed on a rubber outsole and with grippy patterning for enhanced traction on the links.

shoeName: Jordan CMFT Era Cool Grey White
description: The Air Jordan CMFT Era 'Cool Grey' decorates the grey mesh upper with matching suede overlays and a white Swoosh. A blue Jumpman emblem adorns the tongue tag, while a red Nike logo embellishes the heel. The full-length white foam midsole works alongside a rubber outsole underfoot.

The Wmns Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Laser Orange' brings vibrant accents to its OG-inspired look. Built with tumbled leather, the upper appears in white, with elephant print overlaying the forefoot and heel. The heel also accents the look in Laser Orange, with the color featured on the tongue and eyelets as well. Underfoot, visible Air in the heel provides cushioning.

The Air Jordan 13 Retro 'White Wolf Grey' showcases an elegant color scheme of the classic model which was inspired by Michael Jordan's 'Black Cat' persona. The shoe's upper unit is made up of a base in white leather intersected by grey synthetic suede paneling and dimpled overlays in white tumbled leather. Stitched on the tongue is a scarlet Jumpman, while the lateral collar is adorned with the 13's holographic cat eye design. The Phylon midsole is covered in grey synthetic suede, supported by a carbon fiber shank plate and a red panther-paw outsole for stylish support underfoot.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low SE White Fire Red Black Matte Silver
description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE 'White Black Matte Silver' rolls out a white leather upper with contrasting black accents on the eyestay, Swoosh and forefoot overlay. A reflective silver coating adorns the collar and Wings-branded heel panel. A matching red Jumpman logo adorns the tongue for a signature vibe. These shoes ride on a classic rubber cupsole, which has white sidewalls and pairs with a black rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 2 Retro Low 'UNC' is a tribute to Michael Jordan's alma mater and features a color palette that fans will recognize. The white leather upper is highlighted by hits of University Blue on the interior lining, midfoot piping and molded heel tab, while the tongue is adorned with a blue Wings logo. The shoe's white PU midsole has encapsulated Air-sole cushioning that delivers a comfortable ride while the two-tone rubber outsole provides additional support underfoot.

Part of the 2019 All-Star collection, the Social Status x Air Jordan 6 Retro 'Pony Hair’ emerges with an elevated construction. The Charlotte retailer puts reptilian underlays and pony hair overlays on the classic silhouette, finished in a minimalist mix of black, silver and Dark Concord. Underfoot, a visible Air unit in the heel provides cushioning, giving way to a translucent outsole for traction.

Released to celebrate the Chinese commercial holiday, the Wmns Air Jordan 6 Retro 'Singles Day' emerges with unique accents on its neutral construction. Built primarily with textile, the upper sports a tonal floral and basketball print throughout. A woven lace shield offers the only contrasting color, with a metallic gold Jumpman hanging off of the element. Underfoot, the midsole includes visible Air in the heel to provide cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT Gold Laser
Jordan Max Aura 2 White Black Gym Red
description: The Jordan Max Aura 2 'White Gym Red' takes design cues from the Air Jordan 11. The white knit upper has matching leather panels and a black patent leather mudguard. A red Jumpman logo lands on the tongue as well as the side. The foam midsole gets a Max Air heel unit for a plush sensation underfoot. A segmented, partially see-through rubber outsole uses a herringbone pattern for swift traction.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low SE WRMK Sashiko Denim
description: The Air Jordan 1 Low 'World Make Japan' rocks a white twill upper with a bold black leather Swoosh. Washed denim overlays, touched with frayed edges and deco-style stitching, appear on the eyestay, forefoot and heel areas. A Jumpman icon decorates the denim tongue tag, while a stitched Wings logo adorns the heel. A pre-yellowed midsole packs an Air-sole heel unit encapsulated in a lightweight foam wedge for a plush feel.

Jordan Brand meshed luxe materials with functional design to create the Jordan 3 Retro SE Animal Pack Fur, now available on StockX. While the first Jordan 3 SE Animal Instinct featured faux fur inspired by Zebras and Giraffes, this release delivers a cold-blooded approach, primarily using reptilian-inspired materials throughout the upper.

The Jordan 3 Retro Animal Instinct 2.0 is comprised of a black croc-textured leather upper with snake and ostrich inspired overlays. Green, yellow, red, and grey detailing prevalent throughout the silhouette. A red Jumpman logo paired with a white sole and yellow heel tabs completes the design. These sneakers released in June of 2020 for $225.

The Air Jordan 10 Retro SoleFly 10th Anniversary is a sneaker edition that was released to celebrate ten years since Michael Jordan's return to basketball. The sneakers were designed as a collaboration between SoleFly and Jumpman23.

The SoleFly 10th Anniversary Air Jordan 10 Retro is constructed using premium leather materials throughout the upper, with accents of Turbo Green. The insoles are designed using Zoom cushioning insoles, a mesh tongue to improve ventilation, the Jumpman logo at the back, and adjustable straps across the midfoot area.

The Air Jordan 10 Retro SoleFly 10th Anniversary was released on May 10, 2020 at a retail price of $200.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High Aleali May Court Lux (Women's)
description: The Aleali May x Women's Air Jordan 1 Retro High showcases the L.A. celebrity stylist collaborating with Maya Moore and Jordan Brand on a Court Lux pack featuring the Jordan 1 and Jordan 10. The upper is wrapped in an all-suede build with hues taken from Moore's career favorite uniform colors. Aleali May’s AJ1 also incorporates waxed laces and a detachable faux fur overlay on the tongue.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low Golf Triple White
Jordan 1 Retro High OG Self Expression (GS)
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG GS 'Self Expression' has a black leather upper with a wear-away top layer. The surface layer wears away, while the individual panels showcase red, yellow, neon green, and fuchsia colors. The Nike Air tongue tag meets a Wings logo debossed on the collar flap. These shoes ride on a vintage off-white midsole, which contains an encapsulated Nike Air unit, backed by a black rubber outsole below.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Mid SE French Blue Light Steel (GS)
description: Introducing the Air Jordan 1 Mid SE GS 'French Blue,’ a sneaker delivered with a weathered, vintage vibe. The upper features a white leather base accented by a faded blue suede overlay, with the light grey Swoosh and crimson Jumpman on the tongue adding pops of color. Additional branding appears on the lateral collar with a red Wings logo. The mid-top silhouette sits on a standard rubber cupsole with an interior Air-sole unit for added comfort. The outsole is made of durable grey rubber, ensuring a stable stride with every step.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low SE Craft Taupe Haze
description: The 'Taupe Haze' Air Jordan 1 Low SE Craft 'Inside Out' delivers a deconstructed design in subdued earthy hues. The upper combines suede and breathable canvas materials in varying shades of tan and brown. An off-white textile overlay is applied to the toe box, while the heel features airy mesh in a taupe shade, stitched with the Wings logo in Celestial Gold. The same gold hue is repeated on the suede Swoosh and the mesh tongue branded with the Jumpman logo. To add to the vintage appeal, the midsole features a weathered finish and is equipped with encapsulated Air-sole cushioning for comfort. The sneaker is supported by a brown rubber outsole for durability and traction.

The Air Jordan 1 Mid 'Hulk' gives a new iteration of the legendary shoe design, redesigned in Aloe Verde and Court Purple. Its upper spotlights a leather base with overlays and the trademark Wings’ Logo. On the upper, a Swoosh emphasizes the design with a breathable nylon tongue. The Air-sole is built on top of a rubber outsole with a circular build for traction.

The 2024 release of the Air Jordan 5 Retro GS 'Olive' brings back a classic color scheme from the Jordan Brand's 2006 Lifestyle Series archive. A reflective silver tongue features an orange Jumpman logo which matches the interior lining, while a second Jumpman emblem is stitched on the rear heel. The olive suede upper showcases signature AJ5 elements, including lace locks and quarter panel netting. An Air-assisted polyurethane midsole in an olive drab color with eye-catching orange shark tooth accents rests on a clear rubber outsole.

After debuting in 2006 to support Hurricane Katrina relief efforts, the Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Hall of Fame' was re-released in 2018 to celebrate both Michael Jordan’s humanitarianism and his induction into the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame. The sneaker boasts a white leather upper, accented by black, Fire Red, cement grey, and elephant print details. The iconic Jumpman logo appears on the heel.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low Black Light Smoke Grey Gym Red

description: Featuring a look modeled after the 2015 'Shattered Backboard,' the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG GS 'Electro Orange' is a grade-school shoe. Built with a white leather base, the shoe's upper is contrasted by black on the eyestay, forefoot and tongue, with the padded collar adding Electro Orange to the design. Perforations on the toe box provide breathability, while underfoot, Air in the midsole provides cushioning. More Electro Orange marks the concentric rubber outsole.

With sleek style, the Nike Air Jordan 14 Retro SE 'Black Ferrari' is a streamlined revamp of the profile's initial Italian sportscar inspiration. Introduced in December 2019, the offering portrays a divergent design with ventilated leather on the lateral side and padded grey suede on the medial. AThe heelstay features a Jumpman badge and an etched '23' logo. Carbon fiber elements dress the Air-infused midsole, and red chrome divides the patterned rubber outsole.

Taking a famous color scheme from the championship silhouette and adapting it for the golf course, the Air Jordan 6 Retro Low Golf 'Olympic' features white overlays and a spoiler-like heel tab against its waterproof leather upper in a navy hue. The lace locks and Jumpman logo on the back heel and lace cover appear in crimson. The outsole has removable spikes for good traction, and supports a foam midsole with a visible Air-sole unit in the heel for comfort.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low Triple Stack Team Red Pale Ivory (Women's)

description: The Air Jordan 11 Retro Low 'UNC' features a colorway modeled after Michael Jordan's alma mater. The University of North Carolina look is created through a white mesh upper and a University Blue patent leather overlay that covers the base of the shoe. The carbon fiber shank plate features more University Blue, as do the outsole inserts on the translucent outsole.

Celebrating the iconic Beijing streetball courts, the Air Jordan 5 Retro Low 'Dongdan' features eye-catching pink stitching and clear quarter-panel netting on the black nubuck upper. Underfoot, the black polyurethane midsole has visible Air-cushioning and is adorned with black-speckled pink shark-tooth detailing atop a pink-tinted clear rubber outsole. The silver reflective tongue proudly displays the Jumpman icon, while the back heel presents the Dongdan tournament's logo in stitching.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG SP Utility Quai 54 (2022)
description: In honor of the renowned Parisian streetball tournament, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High Utility ‘Quai 54’ showcases a renewed design. Emphasizing the tournament's identity, the orange woven tongue tag proudly displays both the Jumpman and Quai 54 branding. Continuing the vibrant theme, the rubber outsole and contrast stitching wrapping around the midsole feature the same eye-catching hue. The upper of the sneaker seamlessly blends a navy textile base with white canvas overlays, while a touch of functionality arrives via a snap-button stash pouch on each quarter panel. A third pocket with a zippered closure is secured to the heel with webbing straps.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro AJKO Low Black White
description: Blending the timeless design of the Air Jordan 1 KO with a fundamental two-tone color scheme, the Air Jordan 1 KO Low in 'Black White' combines classic lines with simplicity. The canvas upper appears in clean white enhanced by bold black detailing on the eyestay, forefoot overlay, and iconic Swoosh. The tongue is adorned with a woven Nike tag, while the black leather heel tab features an embroidered AJKO Wings logo. Adding a vintage touch, the midsole boasts an off-white finish, while the black radial-traction rubber outsole provides reliable grip and durability.

The 2024 version of the Air Jordan 14 Retro GS 'Black Toe' sports a white leather upper with a black suede forefoot overlay, hence the name. A red Jumpman logo is embroidered on the toe box, joining a Jumpman emblem below the collar and an embossed one on the molded back tab. These shoes have a Phylon midsole equipped with springy Zoom Air cushioning. A herringbone-patterned rubber outsole works in tandem with a chrome-plated shank plate for midfoot stability.

A white tumbled-leather upper with grey elephant-print forefoot and heel overlays distinguishes the Air Jordan 3 Retro GS ‘Midnight Navy, designed for older children. Touches of navy hue adorn the Jumpman logos present on the tongue and molded back tab. The sneaker is supported by a lightweight PU midsole with visible Air-sole cushioning, with a hint of Midnight Navy at the heel, while the outsole appears in durable grey rubber.

The 2025 iteration of the Air Jordan 1 Mid GS 'Shattered Backboard' takes cues from a past 2015 design cues ideated from the time Michael Jordan broke a backboard during an exhibition game in Italy. These shoes have a white leather upper tooled with a contrasting black forefoot overlay. A starfish orange Swoosh matches the heel and Wings-stamped collar flap. These sneakers have a traditional cupsole with off-white sidewalls and a sturdy rubber outsole.

The Jordan Tatum 3 6th Man is a lightweight performance basketball shoe, Jayson Tatum's signature model, designed for versatility and explosive scoring. The shoe features Ghost Green, Electric Green, and Black. The design prioritizes court feel and quick responsiveness, utilizing a streamlined, low-profile cut. The upper construction focuses on minimal material while providing crucial containment for lateral movements. Slated for release on January 14, 2025, this energetic model carries a retail price of $125. The intense, bright tones of Ghost Green and Electric Green dominate the aesthetic, creating a high-visibility, aggressive look. The use of Black provides strategic grounding contrast. This model is engineered to support dynamic play while making a bold statement. Our experts highlight the lightweight construction optimized for quickness and the highly visible, energetic contrast of Ghost Green and Electric Green.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro GS 'Fire Red' returns in a 2022 edition designed for big kids and showcasing one of the original four colorways of this heritage classic. The upper appears in white tumbled leather upper, accompanied by the signature elephant-print overlays adorning the forefoot and heel. Scarlet accents bring vibrant pops of color to the Jumpman icon embroidered on the tongue and the Nike Air branding embossed on the heel tab, and the shoe features molded eyelets and a perforated leather collar. Adding a final touch of flair, the polyurethane midsole is adorned with a splash of Fire Red, accentuating the visible Air-sole unit nestled in the heel for cushioning and comfort.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Mid SE Craft Inside Out White Grey
description: Showcasing a unique design with a reassembled build, the Air Jordan 1 Mid SE 'Inside Out' utilizes an inverted layering style. The upper arrives with a crisp white leather base topped with an off-white suede toe box. Eye-catching orange stitching adds a pop of color to the lateral-side textile Swoosh in white, while a stitched Wings logo is showcased on the grey suede heel overlay. The off-white midsole has a vintage feel and is fitted with top-notch Air-sole cushioning, supported by a durable grey rubber outsole. The deconstructed look of the shoe is accentuated with exposed foam on the collar and tongue.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low Method of Make V3 Suit & Tie (Women's)

description: The Jordan Spizike Low GS 'Rare Air' takes design cues from five classic Air Jordan models. The off-white leather upper has a ventilated side panel netting, black support wings, and grey elephant-print overlays on the forefoot and heel areas. A gradient that goes from amber to pink lands on the foam midsole, which packs a plush Air-sole heel unit for a plush feel.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Chicago Lost and Found (PS)
description: A nostalgic hoops shoe for little feet, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG PS ‘Chicago Lost & Found’ delivers a modern take with a distinctively vintage feel. With distressed crackled leather on the white upper and black collar, contrasting red overlays and a black signature Swoosh anchor this retro silhouette. The tongue tag is adorned with Nike branding, and underfoot is a traditional cupsole with off-white sidewalls and a rubber outsole in red.

The Women's Air Jordan Mule SE 'Velvet Brown' has a loafer-style upper made with snakeskin-like leather. A metallic Jordan nameplate decorates the upper, while an Air Jordan wordmark is debossed on the molded footbed. These mules have a dark brown platform midsole that works closely with a rubber outsole that uses a traction pattern inspired by the original Air Jordan 1 design.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Fire Red Black Tongue (2025) (TD)
description: The 2025 iteration of the Air Jordan 5 Retro TD 'Fire Red' dons a white leather upper with the customary side panel netting and an embroidered '23' signoff on the heel. The red Jumpman logo lands on the black tongue, while a Nike logo is present on the heel. The red foam midsole has black sharktooth details, anchored by a classic rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 11 Retro PS 'Gratitude / Defining Moments' is available in pre-school sizing and pays homage to the original 'Concord' colorway with a white leather upper and a sleek black patent leather overlay. Underfoot, a semi-translucent rubber outsole supports a white Phylon midsole. Laces thread through matching webbing eyelets while metallic gold accents adorn the shoe, including a Jumpman logo on the side collar and a stylized '23' on the back tab.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low Triple Stack Pale Ivory Iced Carmine (Women's)

description: Bringing back the popular 2001 colorway, the Air Jordan 11 Retro 'Cool Grey' 2010 dropped in 2010. Built with a nubuck base, the shoe's upper appears in grey, overlaid by darker grey patent leather on the mudguard. Underfoot, a white phylon midsole houses full-length Air to provide cushioning and contrast, working with a partially visible carbon-fiber shank plate for stability. Herringbone pods on the rubber outsole provide traction.

In 2015, to celebrate 'Cyber Monday,' Nike releasedpublished this Air Jordan 1. The shoes come with a smooth white outsole in an all jet black colorway. They display the initial Air Jordan 1 line branding details, including the tongue-shaped Nike Air logo and a tidy heel. Also included in this specific version is premium leather, mesh interior lining and an embossed Jordan logo.

Taking on a popular Air Jordan 1 colorway, the Air Jordan 14 Retro 'Black Toe' 2014 originally debuted in 1998. Like its inspiration, this sports car-inspired design features a black overlay at the toe, but unlike the Jordan 1, the majority of the upper appears in white. Varsity Red touches are limited to the branding and the heel, while the silhouette’s signature Jumpman badge stands out near the ankle.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low SE Space Jam Magic Ball (GS)

description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid ‘Bred Toe’ rocks a black leather upper that includes white side panels with contrasting black overlays at the forefoot and heel. Red accents hit the perforated toe box, collar and signature Swoosh. A Jumpman tag settles on the tongue, while a retro Wings logo is debossed on the side flap. True to the 1985 original design, the rubber cupsole and encapsulated Air-sole heel unit remain intact.

colorway: White/Pine Green-Neutral Grey-Wolf Grey-Varsity Red-Gum Dark Brown
description: The Air Jordan 4 RM 'Pine Green' sports a white mesh upper with a grey forefoot overlay. A white cage is built into the lacing system, extending from the midfoot and wrapping around the Nike-branded heel. A red Jumpman logo decorates the tongue tag, matching the visible Air-sole heel unit assisting the foam midsole.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro SP 30th Anniversary Union Taupe Haze
description: Made with the help of Union LA, the Union LA x Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Taupe Haze' celebrates the retailer's 30th anniversary. Drawing on a 2020 reimagining of the silhouette from the two brands, the shoe features inspiration from outdoor gear from the 80s and 90s. As a result, the shoe released as part of the Tent and Trail capsule, outfitted with a neutral finish on the mesh and suede upper, highlighted by Roma Green on the lower eyelets and heel patch.
