Blue Fury instead accents the collar lining and stitched fold-down tongue, which is joined by the translucent TPU wings and yellow 'UN/LA' tag in keeping in line with its predecessor. Underfoot, visible Air in the heel of the midsole provides cushioning, with a rubber outsole offering traction.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low Golf Royal Toe

description: Featuring the color blocking of the original 1985 ‘Banned’– except in reverse – the Air Jordan 1 Mid GS ‘Reverse Bred’ is a modern remake sized for big kids. The upper in Gym Red leather is intersected by a black collar flap, heel overlay, toe box and signature Swoosh. Branding appears on the lateral side with a debossed Wings logo and the tongue tag and sockliner display the Jumpman logo. The mid-top rides on a traditional rubber cupsole with an interior Air-sole heel unit atop a sturdy rubber outsole in red.

The Lance Mountain x Air Jordan 1 Retro SB QS pays tribute to The Search for Animal Chin, a 1987 skate video showing Pasadena Pro Skater Lance Mountain wearing an Air Jordan 1 ' Royal ' sneaker on his left foot and a white / Carolina blue Air Jordan 1 on his right. Back then, for its durable leather, strong ankle coverage, and Nike Air technology, West Coast skaters adopted the Jordan. Skaters wore mismatched pairs to extend the lives of their Jordans, sometimes painting them the same color to recreate a uniform appearance. Reviving this DIY aesthetic, the Lance Mountain x Jordan 1 SB features a black / red colorway and a black / royal colorway with a black paint coat that wears away with each ollie and flip trick to produce a design that is special to each skater. Released in limited quantities in June 2014, the sneaker released in a two-pack alongside a colorway given a black paint treatment.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro GS 'Family Affair' rolls out an olive green nubuck upper with matching forefoot and heel elephant print overlays. An embroidered Jumpman logo decorates the tongue, while the Nike Air logo stars on the molded heel tab. The foam midsole gets Air-sole cushioning, accented with dark olive hits around the heel. A gum rubber outsole completes the look.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Year of the Dragon (2024)
description: This Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG ‘Year of the Dragon’ pays homage to the Year of the Dragon Chinese New Year with an off-white leather upper and scaled green nubuck overlays at the heel and forefoot. The inside of the tongue tag shows a Jumpman intertwined with a dragon. The laces have dark crimson accents while an off-white midsole and see through rubber outsole complete the look.

shoeName: Jordan Flight Court Who Decides War Coconut Milk (Women's)

description: The Air Jordan Spizike Low 'Beef & Broccoli' uses design cues from five classic Jordan models. These shoes have an olive green knit upper tooled with a matching side panel netting and a brown suede mudguard. Black pops arrive on the molded eyelets, support wings, as well as the elephant-print overlays bolstering the forefoot and heel. The Air Jordan 3 foam midsole pairs with an Air-Sole heel unit for a plush feel with every step.

Featuring a contrasting look, the Wmns Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG SE 'Bubble Gum' emerges with an elevated construction. The shoe's upper is built with a white leather base, overlaid by pink patent leather on the toe box, heel and collar. Obsidian contrast emerges throughout, including on the 'Wings' logo on the collar and Swoosh branding on the side wall. Underfoot, a white midsole with Air in the heel offers cushioning, giving way to more pink on the concentric rubber outsole, which provides traction.

The Wmns Air Jordan 1 Mid SE 'Dutch Green' brings a pastel look to the classic basketball silhouette. Built with leather, the shoe's upper sports a pale green finish, overlaid by darker green leather and contrasted by black on the Swoosh branding. The laces accent the design in pink, matched by the tongue tag, while underfoot, a white Air midsole provides cushioning. A concentric rubber outsole is included for traction.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro El Vuelo Summit White
description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro 'El Vuelo' commemorates Mexican heritage with a bright lucha libre tradition. These shoes have a white leather upper with a jagged midfoot overlay wrapped in a scaly texture. The same reptilian-like pattern has a green padded collar, as well as red forefoot and heel overlays. Metallic gold molded eyelets match the Jumpman logos on the tongue and heel. 'Más vale maña que fuerza' is etched inside the tongue of each shoe, which roughly translates to 'Brains over brawn.'

The Air Jordan Luka 5 Bred delivers a bold and performance driven take on Luka Dončić’s signature line through a classic and high impact color palette. The black upper creates a strong and sleek base, while bright crimson accents add a sharp pop of color that enhances the design’s energy. The silhouette feels modern and streamlined, built for speed and control on the court.

Fans of Bred colorways appreciate how this combination continues to define Jordan footwear across generations. The contrast between black and red gives it a timeless and aggressive look. It is a sneaker that reflects performance innovation with a heritage inspired edge.

The Air Jordan Luka 5 Bred was released on January 15, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low Golf Endless Pursuit Pack
description: The Air Jordan 1 Low Golf 'Endless Pursuit' puts a waterproof coating on a white synthetic leather upper with black stingray leather accents on the eyestay, toe wrap and heel. Black patent leather lands on the forefoot overlay and Swoosh, stacked above an iridescent Swoosh for an eye-catching look. The Jumpman tongue tag mirrors the same finish, while the phrase 'For the endless pursuit' is inscribed on the insoles. The midsole includes an encapsulated Air-sole heel unit, mounted on a rubber outsole made to grip all parts of the course.

The Air Jordan 6 Retro Low GS 'Fierce Pink' features a design with a sleek leather upper in white with bold black midfoot and heel overlays. Adding a pop of vibrant color are hot pink accents on the the iconic Jumpman logo found on both the tongue and back heel, molded pull tab, and interior lining. The two-tone rubber outsole repeats the striking hue. The sneaker features a foam midsole with visible Air-sole cushioning, ensuring comfort and support with each step.

colorway: Summit White/Pine Green/Canyon Gold/Black/Gum Light Brown/Infinite Sable

shoeName: Jordan 1 Mid French Blue Fire Red
description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE 'French Blue' showcases blue suede overlays that have a faded appearance against a white leather upper, with the Swoosh arriving in Light Steel Grey. A standard rubber cupsole with white sidewalls rides on a partially see-through grey outsole. The Wings logo and the Jumpman tongue tag appear in Fire Red.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Low SE Twine Orange Quartz Corduroy (Women's)
description: Adding an autumnal makeover to Peter Moore's original design is the women's Air Jordan 1 Low SE 'Twine.' A faint trace of pink suffuses the plush corduroy upper with tan suede overlays and accented with a dark coral Wings logo on the back heel. The latter hue is repeated on a Jumpman icon embroidered on the corduroy tongue. Supporting the low-top is a durable rubber cupsole with an encapsulated Air-sole unit in the heel.

Giving the nod to Spike Lee's Do the Right Thing, the Wmns Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Do The Right Thing' features a look inspired by one of the movie's more notable scenes. Modeled after the Air Jordan 4 'White Cement' worn by Buggin' Out, the shoe also draws from the character's custom lacing job. The usual tooling includes visible Air underfoot.

The Air Jordan 2 Retro gets a colorful makeover by Colombian reggaeton artist J Balvin. The upper is crafted with powder blue ripstop material and grey suede accented by multicolor stitching, while an all-over graphic featuring cloudy blue skies can be seen on the heel counter and interior lining. J Balvin's signature smiley face graphic is affixed on the back heel, while the Wings logo on the tongue has a glow-in-the-dark finish. A contrasting white midsole leads to a translucent outsole, while encapsulated Nike Air offers lightweight cushioning.

A nod to the AJ3’s OG colorway, the Air Jordan 2 Retro 'Black Cement' stays true to the original 1986 design of Michael Jordan's second signature model. A lizard-textured midfoot overlay outlined in grey piping intersects the black leather upper. The Nike-branded heel tab and tongue appear in Cement Grey, and an embossed Wings logo in Fire Red adorns the tongue. A sturdy two-tone rubber outsole supports an off-white PU midsole with encapsulated Air-sole cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan 2 Retro A Ma Maniére Airness
description: Reuniting the Atlanta-based retailer with Jordan Brand for their third collaboration is the A Ma Maniére x Air Jordan 2 Retro SP 'Airness'. The new take on the AJ2 showcases an off-white cracked leather upper with burgundy piping and a translucent heel counter extending into the midfoot. 'Maniére' is stamped in white lettering on the burgundy leather heel tab while contrasting black accents are featured on the laces, quilted interior lining and tongue with snakeskin detailing and a retro Wings logo. The black snakeskin motif is repeated on the midsole inspired by the 1986 Air Jordan 2 that was made in Italy and featured a subtle reptilian texture on the leather upper.

shoeName: Jordan 2 Retro SP Union Grey Fog
description: Delivering a modern take on the legacy silhouette originally released in 1986 is the Union LA x Air Jordan 2 Retro SP 'Grey Fog.' Chris Gibbs and the Union crew give the sneaker a pale blue textile upper with tonal suede construction on the mudguard and quarter panel with perforated detailing that reveals a bright blue underlay that reappears on the sneaker's molded eyelets. A yellow 'UN/LA' tag is on the lateral side and a woven tag looped over the collar displays a retro Wings logo, while an oversized Jumpman label is on the exposed foam tongue. On the bottom is a blue-tinged polyurethane midsole with encapsulated Air-sole cushioning. The Union x Jordan 2 'Grey Fog' will drop on April 15, 2022.

shoeName: Jordan 2 Retro Low SP Off-White White Red
description: Virgil Abloh provides his take on the retro basketball shoe with the Off-White x Air Jordan 2 Retro Low SP. Modeled after the OG 'White/Varsity Red' colorway, the shoe's upper is built with white leather, accented by red throughout, including on the piping and heel overaly. A plastic zip tie, medial-side Helvetica text and an exposed-foam tongue and collar add signature Abloh touches, with Michael Jordan's signature marking the lateral side. Underfoot, a pre-yellowed midsole with a crumbling aesthetic supports the fit, giving way to a two-tone rubber outsole for traction.

shoeName: Jordan 2 Retro Low SP Off-White Black Blue
description: The Off-White x Air Jordan 2 Retro Low SP is Virgil Abloh's take on Michael Jordan's second signature shoe. The shoe's low-top construction is built with black leather on the upper, with the usual basketball-textured overlay appearing in tonal fashion. Royal blue accents the look, with exposed-foam marking the tongue, while a plastic zip tie, Helvetica text on the medial side and 'SHOELACES' on the laces bring signature Abloh features to the look. Underfoot, the midsole includes a crumbling aesthetic.

shoeName: Jordan 2 Retro SP Maison Chateau Rouge
description: Designed in collaboration with the Parisian fashion label, the exalted design of the Maison Château Rouge x Air Jordan 2 ‘United Youth International’ spotlights heritage and community. Designer Youssouf Fofana joins once more with Jordan Brand to provide his unique look for the Air Jordan 2, with orange hand-stitching on the tongue and collar echoing his 2019 Air Jordan 1 Mid collaboration. The off-white leather upper's forefoot and heel are layered in orange nubuck, and custom insoles feature artwork of the iconic Jumpman image. Nike and Maison Château Rouge share branding real estate, with a yellow Wings logo on the tongue, the left heeltab displaying 'Nike' while the Maison Château Rouge branding is on the right.

Making over the iconic silhouette with a tan textile upper and tonal suede overlays is the Union LA x Air Jordan 2 Retro SP 'Rattan.' An amber underlay is revealed through perforated detailing on the quarter panel that matches the molded eyelets and an attached 'UN/LA' tag. A woven Jumpman tag is featured on the exposed foam tongue with an embossed Nike wordmark on the heel tab. Decorating the woven tag on the lateral collar is a retro Wings logo with a cream-colored polyurethane midsole with encapsulated Air-sole cushioning on underneath. The Union x Jordan 2 'Rattan' will drop on April 15, 2022.

The Two 18 x Air Jordan 2 Retro Low SP bring a new look and feel to the AJ2 franchise. Blue-and-red piping contrasts against tan nubuck on the upper with overlays of earthy brown. Also elevating the classic silhouette are refined details including tortoiseshell eyelets and interior lined in leather with Two 18 branding. The tongue is embellished with the Wings logo. The cream midsole offers cushion via an Air-sole unit, and ease of wear and durability are ensured by the rubber outsole.

shoeName: Li-Ning Way of Wade 12 Curry Moments White

description: Inspired by the Chicago Bulls colors, the Air Jordan 1 Low 'Bred Toe 2.0' has a leather upper with contrasting black accents on the forefoot overlay, collar and Swoosh. Red pops land on the perforated toe box and heel panel, stamped with a stitched Wings logo, while the Jumpman emblem graces the tongue. The rubber cupsole gets white sidewalls and a red outsole to complete the vibe.

shoeName: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Teyana Taylor A Rose From Harlem (Women's)
description: The collaboration between Teyana Taylor and Jordan Brand results in the Women's Air Jordan 1 High Zoom Comfort 2. Its updated design showcases forefoot and heel overlays in Gym Red and chocolate brown against an all-leather white upper. One shoe displays an oversized black leather Swoosh framed in zigzag stitching while the other features a stitched red Swoosh adorned with green thorns. The woven tongue tags continue the mismatched theme, with a thorny Swoosh graphic on the right shoe and metallic gold lettering that spells 'TEY’ on the left. Notable details include 'A Rose From Harlem' inscription on the interior of each collar flap, etched X symbols on the toe box and a lace jewel in the shape of a rose.

The Air Jordan 1 Low GS 'Bred Toe 2.0' brings back the iconic Chicago Bulls colorway, rolling out a smooth white leather upper contrasted with black accents on the eyestay, collar, forefoot and the iconic Swoosh. Red pops land on the toe box and back of the heel, which gets a stitched Wings logo to keep the iconic look. A traditional cupsole pairs with white sidewalls and a red rubber outsole to wrap up this classic design.

shoeName: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Día De Muertos
description: The Air Jordan 1 High Zoom Comfort 2 'Día De Muertos' is presented as part of Nike's Day of the Dead celebration and has a leather upper with a faux distressed look in black and ivory. The rubber cupsole now contains a Zoom Air heel unit and a Jordan Formula 23 foam interior wedge for added comfort. The lateral heel features a gold-embroidered skull graphic for contrast, and striking floral designs adorn the toe box and quarter panel.

The Air Jordan 2/3 'UNC To Chicago' mixes the upper of the Air Jordan 2 with elements from the Air Jordan 3. A nod to Michael Jordan's alma mater, the white leather upper has University Blue accents on the molded heel tab. Jordan's time with the Chicago Bulls comes to light on the black collar lining and the embossed red Wings logo on the tongue. A black foam midsole contains an Air-sole heel unit, anchored by a white and red rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 2 Retro 'Chicago Home' emerges in one of the silhouette's OG colorways. Featuring a white leather upper with the signature faux lizard skin overlay near the ankle, perforations along the forefoot are included for breathability. Black and Varsity Red on the detailing, with the latter color also on the heel and tongue branding, complete the Bulls look, while grey emerges on the outsole. Air in the midsole provides cushioning.

The Air Jordan 2 Retro Low 'Christmas' introduces holiday-inspired details to Michael Jordan's second signature sneaker, its sleek black leather upper complemented by a lizard-textured midfoot overlay with red piping. The crimson hue repeats on the molded heel tab and the tongue’s embossed Wings logo, while green graces the extended heel counter. The black PU midsole houses an encapsulated Air-sole unit in the heel and pairs with a rubber outsole in grey and red.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Twist 2.0 Medium Grey (Women's)
description: Recalling the AJ1 'Twist' colorway from 2019, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Twist 2.0' features the same build but with subtle differences. The upper still features black pony hair with smooth leather underlays, but now it's a light grey hue instead of white. A molded Wings logo in metallic silver adorns the lateral heel area, and a crisp white midsole is framed with a black rubber outsole.
The Air Jordan 2 Retro 'Alternate 87' is reimagined as a Player Exclusive that Michael Jordan would have worn during his career.

This legacy high-top, first released in 1986, is brought back true to form in the Air Jordan 2 Retro GS ‘Chicago’ 2022 made especially for big kids. The white leather upper delivers an overlay at the midfoot with reptilian detailing, and the extended heel counter is reminiscent of the original. Pops of Varsity Red appear on the heel tab with Nike branding, the Wings logo on the tongue and in the heel's Air-sole unit. The latter is Varsity Red accents make their way to the Nike-branded heel tab and the embossed Wings logo displayed on the tongue.

Jordan Brand published an Air Jordan 2 in White, Varsity Maize and University Blue for Carmelo Anthony, a retail version of a PE that he wore at the tail end of his debut year with the Denver Nuggets in 2004. Jordan retrofitted the Air Jordan 2 ' Melo ' in May 2018 to mark Melo's time in Denver, returning the Nuggets colorway and adding ' Melo ' branding to the insole.

This brightly hued low-top was the colorful result of a design collab with Chi Loyzaga-Gibbs, visual artist and granddaughter of Filipino basketball hero Carlos Loyzaga. The Titan x Women’s Air Jordan 2 Retro Low, part of a capsule collection with the Manila-based retail brand, delivers an off-white upper in tumbled leather with a suede overlay at the midfoot. Bright green appears in an unexpected corduroy toe wrap. Further color details include teal eyelets and Safety Orange accents at the collar, tongue and outsole, with a cream midsole in tropical speckles.

The Air Jordan 2 Retro ‘Python’ brings a white leather upper with a snakeskin-style midfoot overlay piped in black. The Wings logo on the tongue is embossed in black, while a crimson Nike wordmark decorates the back tab. The extended heel counter and midsole get an off-white finish to round out the look. The latter has an encapsulated Air-sole heel unit for a plush feel.

The 2022 version of the Women's Air Jordan 2 Retro 'Chicago' delivers a white leather upper touched with perforated details and a lizard-textured midfoot overlay. A red molded heel counter matches the Wings logo on the tongue and a Nike wordmark on the back tab. The black foam midsole gets Air-Sole cushioning in the heel.

The Air Jordan 2/3 'White Cement' mixes the upper from the Air Jordan 2 with AJ3 details. A white leather upper gets perforated details and a lizard-textured overlay. A cement grey knit collar matches the back tab and the embossed Wings logo on the tongue. An off-white midsole packs Air-sole cushioning and gets a touch of grey that wraps around the heel.

The Air Jordan Luka 2 White Hyper Pink channels Luka Dončić’s dynamic playing style through sharp contrast and modern lines. White covers the upper with a clean and focused base, while hyper pink accents add energy and vibrancy that reflect speed and flair. Black elements provide grounding structure, keeping the silhouette cohesive and performance driven.

Collectors appreciate this colorway because it balances simplicity with bold expression. The hyper pink hits stand out without overwhelming the streamlined build of the Luka 2. Fans of Luka’s signature line value how the design merges innovation and personality, offering a look that transitions naturally between on court intensity and everyday styling. It stands as a confident continuation of his evolving footwear identity, rooted in performance and expressive color storytelling.

The Air Jordan Luka 2 White Hyper Pink was released on April 12, 2024 with a retail price of $130.

The 2020 version of the Air Jordan 1 Mid 'Triple White' consists of a white leather upper with a tumbled leather Swoosh to match the forefoot and heel overlays. A debossed Wings logo decorates the collar flap, while a matching Jumpman tag adorns the tongue. A rubber cupsole rounds out this classic design.

The Jordan Max Aura 2 'Black Cement' is a basketball shoe that draws from Jordan history. The shoe's ballistic mesh upper appears in black, overlaid by tonal leather and highlighted by Gym Red on the inner lining and branding. Underfoot, a white foam midsole the includes visible Max Air in the heel for cushioning, giving way to a herringbone rubber outsole for traction.

The Air Jordan 2 Retro 'Black History Month' 2019 released in February 2019 as part of Nike's Black History Month collection. The shoe's leather upper features a subtle pattern throughout the black portion of the build, highlighted by vibrant kente cloth-inspired prints on the heels that differ between the shoes. Underfoot, a white Air midsole gives way to a colorful rubber outsole, while metallic gold 'BHM' branding gives the nod to the occasion.

This special edition sneaker is part of Jordan Brand's educational impact program and pays homage to Howard 'H' White, the Vice President of Jordan Brand and the founder of 'Believe to Achieve,' a seminar focused on empowering youth. The Air Jordan 2 Retro '"H" Wings' features a unique feathery graphic adorning the midfoot overlay against the upper in clean white leather. The sneaker ensures lightweight cushioning and support with its black PU midsole, which is equipped with an encapsulated Air-sole unit. The Nike-branded back tab and the tongue’s retro Wings logo appear in contrasting green. To further commemorate Howard White's contributions, the letter 'H' is prominently displayed on the sockliner and can also be found underneath the semi-translucent heel counter.

The Jordan Luka 2 Nebula represents a collaboration between the Jordan brand and NBA star Luca Doncic. This lightweight, stable basketball shoe is high-octane, eye-catching, and delivers on the court.

The upper of this sneaker begins with lightweight, breathable white mesh overlaid with durable synthetic leather in swirling shades of white, purple, pink, peach, and mint to call to mind images of a cloud of cosmic dust. The white midsole is crafted from full-length Formula 23 foam surrounded by firmer foam. The medial sides sport a gray wedge of Cushion 3.0 foam, while the lateral features an IsoPlate on the sidewall for supportive stability during side-to-side court movements. The translucent outsole with hits of peach and mint is treaded for traction and grooved for flexibility.

The aspect of this sneaker we enjoy most is the black branding. A Jumpman logo appears on the midsole and outsole, Luka branding hits the tongue, and mottos that translate to "Never Give Up and Never Surrender" hit each heel. The Jordan Luka 2 Nebula was released on July 27th, 2023, for $140 retail.

Inspired by the original ad campaign that accompanied the launch of the shoe, the Air Jordan 2 Retro ‘Wing It’ showcases the luxurious aesthetic that helped the mid-top stand out on store shelves. A prominent reptile texture is used throughout the leather upper, while the white and black color scheme reflects an iconic print ad, its ‘Wing It’ tagline inscribed across the heel of each shoe.

shoeName: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Valentine's Day (2023) (Women's)
Jordan 2 Retro Low Craft Melon Tint
description: The Air Jordan 2 Retro Low 'Melon Tint' gives a fresh look to Michael Jordan's second signature shoe with bright touches and a high-quality construction. The low-top silhouette is made of perforated, off-white leather with a matching overlay in textured suede at the midfoot. Orange piping adorns the overlay, complementing the Wings logo on the tongue and the molded back tab. The interior lining and Nike Air logo on the sockliner are highlighted in Light Curry accents. The sneaker sits on a Sail-colored polyurethane midsole and a sturdy two-tone rubber outsole for optimal support and comfort underfoot.

Snakeskin overlay accents over a clean white leather upper make the Air Jordan 2 Retro Low ‘Python’ a retro classic. The embossed Wings logo on the tongue matches the grey textile collar lining and the color of the insole. The off-white midsole is lightweight, equipped with an encapsulated Air-sole unit and a rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 2 Retro Low 'Seersucker' gives Michael Jordan's second signature shoe a perfect look for summer. The typical leather material of this low-top is replaced with a striped textile upper in an array of pink hues. The shoe has Pale Vanilla highlights on the molded heel tab, TPU eyelets and midfoot piping. The sockliner bears the classic Nike Air branding while the tongue features a vintage Wings logo. The shoe's white polyurethane midsole provides support underfoot and is supported by a two-tone grey and yellow rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Zoom CMFT 2 Bleached Aqua Bright Citrus

description: The Air Jordan 6 Retro ‘Infrared 23’ showcases Nike’s signature vibrant hue, providing an energetic pop of color to an otherwise neutral colorway. The mid-top blends a black leather base with speckled grey overlays on the collar and mudguard. Pops of Infrared 23 appear on the quarter panel, outsole and molded heel piece, as well as the Jordan ‘Wings’ logo on the tongue and Nike wordmark on the heel tab.

shoeName: Jordan 2 Retro SE Nina Chanel Abney (Women's)
description: The Nina Chanel Abney x Air Jordan 2 Retro SE brings a new look and feel to Michael Jordan’s second signature shoe. Abney's take is austere and modern, in contrast with the frenetic nature of her own paintings. The minimalist white leather upper features a lizard-textured midfoot overlay, and the oversized heel counter in vivid crimson is a nod to the shoe's Chicago roots. The heel tab has Nike branding and the sockliners feature a Jumpman logo on the left and ‘Nina Chanel Abney’ on the right. The midsole delivers cushioning with a midsole in off-white, supported by a durable rubber outsole underfoot .

The Air Jordan 2/3 'White Black Metallic Silver' takes cues from two different retro models. The white leather upper gets a matte silver heel tab and a black knit collar lining, taking cues from the Air Jordan 2. A red Wings logo adds a dash of color. The off-white foam midsole contains visible Nike AIr cushioning in the heel, just like the AJ3.

Built on a chunky cream midsole with a grey and peach-pink outsole, the Women’s Air Jordan 2 Retro ‘Sunset Haze’ is an elegant reboot of MJ's second signature shoe. The scaly tan midfoot overlay stands out the leather upper in white, with grey-and-white molded eyelets securing the laces. The oversized tongue is embellished with the embossed Wings logo with 'Nike' on the heel tab.

The Air Jordan 2 Retro 'Origins' presents a unique color palette that pays homage to the shoe's luxurious roots. Drawing inspiration from the original 1986 release, made in Italy and featuring a sleek design without the iconic Swoosh logo, this iteration’s white leather upper is intersected by a midfoot overlay with faux lizard skin. Two-tone piping in red and green outlines its edges, and the same hues reappear on the Nike-branded heel tab. The high-cut collar is lined with vibrant crimson textile, to match the tongue’s embossed Wings logo. The vintage aesthetic is complemented by the PU midsole, which appears in an off-white finish and equipped with encapsulated Air-sole cushioning. The two-tone rubber outsole adds a final touch to the shoe's overall design.

shoeName: Jordan 2 Retro Low SE Nina Chanel Abney White Malachite (Women's)
description: The Nina Chanel Abney x Wmns Air Jordan 2 Retro Low SE showcases the artistic vision of contemporary artist Nina Chanel Abney in a modern, minimalist take. The upper arrives in white leather with a lizard-textured midfoot overlay paired with a white suede toe wrap. The heel panel, pull tab, and an embossed Wings logo on the tongue appear in vivid green. The off-white polyurethane midsole with encapsulated Air-sole cushioning provides optimal comfort. The sockliners of the shoe are intentionally mismatched, featuring a Jumpman logo on the left shoe and 'Nina Chanel Abney' inscribed on the right.

Crafted in Italy, Don C took inspiration from the Italian roots of Air Jordan 2s by incorporating a quilted texture inspired by bags produced in Italy by Chanel. The Air Jordan 2 Retro 'Just Don' was even more prized with the 2015 release did not drop on Nike.com. The sneaker came with unique packaging, dustbags, logo pins of gold 'Wings,' and released alongside a matching bomber jacket.

shoeName: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Legend Coffee
Jordan 2 Retro Low Black Metallic Gold (Women's)
description: The Women's Air Jordan 2 Retro Low 'Black Metallic Gold' has a smooth black leather upper with perforated details and a plush, padded collar. A suede midfoot overlay is piped in white, while a dull gold finish adorns the back tab. The Wings logo appears on the tongue, while a white midsole with an encapsulated Air-sole unit rounds out the look.

shoeName: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Phantom University Blue (Women's)
Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Muslin Blackened Blue
Jordan Westbrook One Take II Black Red
Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Light Iron Ore (Women's)
Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Dark Powder Blue

description: The Air Jordan 2 Retro ‘Nightshade’ dropped in 2014, complementing a nontraditional blue finish with a number of unique details. They include Nike’s iconic Safari print on the collar and mudguard, as well as speckled detailing in Volt on the black laces and midsole. Additional pops of Volt appear on the shoe’s piping, outsole and branding elements at the tongue and heel.

Paying homage to the original colorway of Michael Jordan's second signature shoe from 1987, the Women's Air Jordan 2 Retro Low 'Chicago' for 2023 is faithful to the OG design, with perforated details and a midfoot overlay in white, outlined by red piping, against a white leather upper. A two-tone rubber outsole supports a solid black polyurethane midsole with interior Air-sole cushioning. Crimson accents repeat on the molded back tab and the iconic Wings logo on the tongue.

The Air Jordan 2 'Soft Pink' adds a touch of pastel to Bruce Kilgore’s iconic sneaker. The upper is made of pristine white leather, with a lizard-textured overlay on the midfoot and perforated accents for enhanced breathability. The Nike-branded heel tab and the lining of the shoe display hints of soft pink. The polyurethane midsole has a vintage off-white hue and contains an interior Air-sole unit, providing maximum comfort, while the two-tone rubber outsole ensures durability and traction.

shoeName: Jordan 2 Retro & Converse Fastbreak Mid Alumni Pack

description:
The Air Jordan Tatum 2 Lemonade delivers vibrant energy through a bright and playful palette built around performance. Light citron leads the upper with a refreshing tone, while aurora green and atomic pink accents add contrast and motion. Sail elements soften the color mix, ensuring the silhouette feels balanced despite its bold personality. The streamlined build reinforces the Tatum line’s emphasis on speed and agility.

Fans connect with this pair because it mirrors Jayson Tatum’s expressive style on the court. The lemonade inspired palette feels lively and confident, offering a look that stands out without sacrificing structure. Collectors appreciate how the Tatum 2 continues to evolve through color storytelling rather than drastic redesign. It stands as a dynamic and youthful entry in the signature lineup, blending performance focus with vibrant flair.

The Air Jordan Tatum 2 Lemonade was released on August 22, 2024 with a retail price of $120.

The CLOT x Jordan Delta 2 ‘Flint’ borrows elements from the OG ‘Flint’ Air Jordan 13, including a white leather upper with grey suede accents and blue dimpled mesh overlays. Blue touches decorate the webbed heel tab, while the Jumpman and CLOT logos appear on each tongue. A CLOT-branded hangtag includes the AJ13 hologram as a nod to the partnership. These shoes have a soft React foam midsole, bolstered by durable rubber pods in high-use areas.

The Air Jordan Luka 2 Space Hunter debuts one of the launch colorways of Luka Doncic’s sophomore signature shoe.

Ghillie style lacing secures the upper of the Air Jordan Luka 2 Space Hunter, crafted from breathable black mesh with tonal nubuck overlays accented with violet stitching. Luka’s personal logo decorates the tongue, while ‘Non Desistas’ and ‘Non Exieris’ are inscribed on the back heel of each shoe, which translate to ‘Never Surrender’ and ‘Never Give Up.’ Speckled detailing lands on support pieces embedded in the foam midsole, reinforced by a semi-translucent rubber outsole underfoot. Jordan branding elements include the Jumpman on the midsole, outsole, and tongue tag pull tab.

What our experts love about the Air Jordan Luka 2 Space Hunter is its cutting-edge midsole technology, utilizing the Formula 23 platform. This technology provides exceptional cushioning and support, ensuring that every step you take is comfortable and responsive. The sneaker debuted for $130 on July 11th, 2023.

shoeName: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Bicoastal

description: The Air Jordan 2 Retro GS 'Origins' is made for big kids and draws inspiration from the original 1986 release, which combined premium materials with meticulous Italian craftsmanship. This shoe maintains the iconic lizard-textured overlay from the OG AJ2 against a smooth white leather upper. Surrounding the midfoot panel, vibrant red and green piping adds contrast, with these striking hues also adoring the heel and interior lining. Underfoot, the sneaker is anchored by a supportive foam midsole in off-white with interior Air-sole cushioning technology. The branding elements appear on the back tab with a Nike wordmark on the back tab and on the tongue with an embossed Wings logo, representing the iconic Jordan brand.

The Air Jordan Zion 2 Voodoo is Zion Williamson's second signature design in honor of New Orleans.

The Zion 2 Voodoo Air Jordans display an asymmetric color blocking on these shoes' right and left sides. The shoe, featuring a blend of Fauna brown, Flax, olive green, and Muslin, is dressed in materials from altars of the African-born religious movement and traditional dolls. From the hemp canvas and suede strips to the hairy exterior, these Zion 2 shoes have a distinctive aesthetic. The voodoo doll logo is stamped on the heel and insoles.

The Air Jordan Zion 2 Voodoo was released in June 2022 for a retail price of $40.

Introducing the Women's Air Jordan 2 Retro Low in 'Varsity Royal,' a sneaker distinguished by a white leather upper enhanced by intricate perforated detailing. Adding a touch of texture is a lizard-textured midfoot overlay, outlined with royal blue piping, a hue echoed by the molded back tab and laces. The tongue is adorned by an embossed Wings logo while the sockliner displays Nike branding. An Air-assisted polyurethane midsole painted in sleek black provides support underfoot and rides on a two-tone rubber outsole for reliable traction.

shoeName: Jordan 2 Retro Low NC to Chi (Women's)
description: The Women's Air Jordan 2 Retro Low 'NC to Chi' pays homage to Michael Jordan's basketball career journey from college to the pros through the use of classic colors. The shoe's upper is made of white leather, with piping in Gym Red piping and a molded heel tab in Dark Powder Blue providing accents. The tongue is adorned with a crimson Wings logo, and Nike Air branding is featured on the sockliner. A lightweight polyurethane midsole supports the low-top design and arrives in an off-white finish.

colorway: Laser Orange/Hyper Jade/Black/Light Orewood Brown/Gum Light Brown

shoeName: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Particle Grey
Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Cacao Wow Picante Red (Women's)

description: The Air Jordan 2 Retro GS 'Black Cement' for older kids showcases the timeless OG color scheme inspired by the AJ3, with a lizard-textured midfoot overlay with subtle grey piping appearing on the sleek black leather upper. The sneaker sits atop an Air-cushioned polyurethane midsole in an understated off-white shade. Cement Grey elements adorn the Nike-branded back tab and tongue, while the embossed Wings logo adds a bold touch of Fire Red.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Zoom CMFT 2 Orewood Brown Bright Citrus Sail
description: Presenting a modernized iteration of the 1985 original, the Air Jordan 1 High Zoom Comfort 2 'Light Orewood Citrus' combines refreshed design elements with vibrant accents. Genuine suede overlays and subtly distressed synthetic leather on the toe box and quarter panel appear on the upper in varying shades of tan. Underfoot, the rubber cupsole houses a Zoom Air heel unit, encapsulated within Jordan Brand's signature Formula 23 foam. The iconic Wings logo is stamped on the lateral collar flap in a bright teal hue, while a die-cut Swoosh reveals an orange mesh underlay for added visual interest.

The Air Jordan 2 Retro Low GS 'Christmas' is crafted for older kids and presents a festive rendition of Michael Jordan's second iconic sneaker. A sleek jet-black leather construction combines with a lizard-textured midfoot overlay and red piping. the molded back tab of the shoe and the tongue’s Wings logo appear in red. A forest green extension on the heel counter enhances rearfoot stability. A two-tone rubber outsole in shades of grey and red supports a sturdy black PU midsole.

The Wmns Air Jordan 2 Retro 'Raptors' looks to Toronto's NBA team for inspiration. Drawing from the team's vintage uniforms, the shoe's leather upper construction appears in University Red, complemented by faux lizard skin paneling and Court Purple detailing. Underfoot, the midsole houses encapsulated Air to provide cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Terra Burnt Sunrise

colorway: Light Soft Pink/Mint Foam/Smoke/Lilac/Medium Soft Pink/Copa
description:
The Jordan Tatum 2 Sidewalk Chalk is a high top athletic shoe featuring a Light Soft Pink upper in multiple textures of mesh fabric with leather overlays. The sides feature Smoke insets accented by marbled Lilac, Medium Soft Pink, and Copa borders. The Jumpman logo appears on the side inset and rear heel in Mint Foam, while JT branding adorns the tongue. 

American sneaker brand Nike knows how to nurture partnerships with athletic champions, having forged this path since the 1980s. Jayson Tatum is a Boston Celtics player who has been an NBA All-Star All-NBA selection multiple times over since his pro career began in 2017. With the Tatum 2 Sidewalk Chalk, Nike crafted the shoe’s aesthetic in a manner meant to evoke the energy of a new game.

Our experts feel that the best feature of the Tatum 2 Sidewalk Chalk is its pastel color palette, which highlights the shoe’s unique construction. The Jordan Tatum 2 Sidewalk Chalk released on May 10, 2024, and retailed at $125.

shoeName: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Pine Green Orange Blaze (Women's)

description: The Nike Women's Air Jordan 2/3 'Washed Coral' brings a pink leather upper from the Air Jordan 2 with coral accents on the midfoot piping, heel counter and knit collar lining. An Air-boosted foam midsole couples with a rubber outsole taken from the Air Jordan 3.

The Women's Air Jordan 2 Retro 'Cool Grey' sneaker incorporates a classic color scheme with Michael Jordan's second signature shoe. The iconic silhouette features a nubuck upper in sleek grey intersected by a tonal suede overlay at the midfoot trimmed in piping in an Ice Blue hue. This vivid shade also dresses the laces, heel tab, and the embossed Wings logo on the tongue. The crisp white PU midsole offers optimal cushioning, while a two-tone rubber outsole provides support and stability underfoot.

colorway: Wolf Grey/Speed Yellow/Black/Hyper Jade/Psychic Purple/Pink Prime
description: The Jordan Luka 2 All-Star is a striking addition to the Air Jordan lineup, designed to celebrate the NBA All-Star game while showcasing Luka Dončić's dynamic playing style. This eye-catching sneaker features a vibrant colorway of Wolf Grey, Speed Yellow, Black, Hyper Jade, Psychic Purple, and Pink Prime, creating a visually stunning shoe that demands attention on and off the court. The innovative design incorporates advanced performance technologies to enhance comfort, support, and responsiveness, catering to the needs of elite athletes and casual wearers alike. Crafted with premium materials, the Jordan Luka 2 All-Star boasts a breathable upper that promotes airflow and keeps feet cool during intense gameplay. The shoe's responsive cushioning system provides excellent energy return, while the strategically placed support structures offer stability and lockdown for quick cuts and explosive movements. With its unique colorway and performance-driven features, this sneaker is not only a testament to Luka Dončić's rising star status but also a versatile option for basketball enthusiasts and sneaker collectors. Our team thinks this product is great for players looking to elevate their game with a shoe that combines style and substance in one eye-catching package.

shoeName: Jordan Max Aura 2 Black Gym Red
Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Muslin Plum Chalk (Women's)
Jordan Zion 2 SP Naruto vs. Sasuke
colorway: Black/Laser Blue/Yellow Strike/Dark Purple Dust/Metallic Silver
description:
Unleashing a fierce blend of anime inspiration and on-court prowess, the Air Jordan Zion 2 Naruto vs Sasuke steps onto the scene, capturing the essence of the legendary rivalry from the beloved Naruto series. This sneaker is a tribute to the dynamic between Naruto and Sasuke, emblematic of determination and skill.

The design infuses elements from both characters, with a striking color palette of black, laser blue, yellow strike, dark purple dust, and metallic silver. It's more than just a sneaker; it's a narrative of perseverance, friendship, and competition. The Zion 2's cutting-edge technology, including responsive cushioning and superior grip, ensures top-notch performance, mirroring the abilities of the anime heroes. Its aesthetic is a harmonious mix of style and substance, appealing to both sneakerheads and anime fans alike.

Released on February 28, 2023, the Air Jordan Zion 2 Naruto vs Sasuke, priced at $130, has since captivated a wide audience. It’s not just a shoe; it’s a statement piece that resonates with the spirit and the passion of the basketball court.

The Women’s Air Jordan 2 Retro ‘Sail' dresses the upper in cream-colored leather, adding perforated details and a lizard-textured midfoot overlay. The signature Wings logo is embossed on the tongue, while the Nike logo sits on the back tab. These high tops have a lightweight midsole with encapsulated Air-sole heel cushioning for a soft feel.

shoeName: Jordan Legacy 312 Tech Challenge 2 Hot Lava
description: A collaboration between Don C and Jordan Brand, the Just Don x Jordan Legacy 312 'Hot Lava' combines basketball and tennis heritage. The hybrid silhouette combines elements from the Air Jordan 1, Air Jordan 3 and Nike Air Alpha Force Low while finishing it with the Air Tech Challenge 2's iconic 'Hot Lava Colorway.' The shoe is supported by a midfoot strap, with Air in the heel providing cushioning.

The Air Jordan 2 Retro GS ‘Python’ takes design cues from the Air Jordan 11 Low, rolling out a snakesin-patterned midfoot overlay piped in black. The Jumpman logo on the tongue and a crimson Nike wordmark on the back tab provide the white leather upper a dash of contrast. The heel counter and midsole add another subtle touch with an off-white finish. The latter has an encapsulated Air-sole heel unit for cushioning underfoot.

colorway: Coconut Milk/Black/Fossil/Lemon Drop/Gum Light Brown/Total Orange
description: The Jordan Luka 2 'Neutral' brings a patterned, milky-colored mesh upper with synthetic leather overlays. Black accents on the knit collar lining and a Luka Doncic-branded tongue give these shoes a bold presence. The IsoPlate anchors the midsole, equipped with full-length Formula 23 foam for a plush feel. A gum rubber outsole gives you traction in every spot of the court.

Peace. Love. Respect. The Air Jordan 2 Retro SP Low 'Responsibility' showcases a unique message coupled with premium materials on a heritage silhouette. The insole tag reads "Responsibility" as well as "wear your shoes, show the world where you've been." The upper is crafted with black nubuck, while the ankle area showcases a textile elephant print. The Wings logo on the tongue is blacked out, while the midsole sports a shaggy suede build. All of this put together makes for a unique take on the classic Air Jordan 2.

shoeName: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Royal Pulse Alpha Orange
Jordan Westbrook One Take II White Marble
Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Palomino Wild Berry

description:
The Jordan Luka 2 Lake Bled blends performance and style, perfect for the young and dynamic crowd. Inspired by the picturesque Lake Bled, this sneaker showcases a stunning color palette of Polar, Bright Crimson, Psychic Blue, and Diffused Blue. Its design is a nod to Luka Dončić's fluid playing style, embodying agility and grace on the court.

With a focus on comfort and durability, the Jordan Luka 2 Lake Bled integrates advanced basketball technology. Its innovative cushioning system provides excellent responsiveness, while the sleek upper ensures breathability and a snug fit. These sneakers are not just about performance; they're also a fashion statement, embodying the spirit of modern basketball culture.

The Jordan Luka 2 Lake Bled, originally priced at $140, was released on September 14, 2023. Its unique colorway and state-of-the-art design elements have made it a must-have for sneaker enthusiasts and basketball players alike.

shoeName: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Black Fire Red Cement

description: A 2016 release, the Air Jordan 2 'Quai 54' gives the nod to Paris' Quai 54 streetball tournament. Featuring a premium leather upper in Light Bone, metallic gold accents emerge throughout, including on the 'Wings' and Quai 54 logos on the tongues. The heel sports additional gold, including on the heel branding, while a white midsole provides cushioning and contrast.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Element Low A/T Cream Light Orewood Brown Ridgerock

description:
The Jordan Tatum 2 Vortex is a cutting-edge performance sneaker designed for the modern basketball player. Featuring a striking Mint Foam, Lava Glow, Black, Hyper Jade, and Key Lime colorway, this shoe is as visually captivating as it is functional. The innovative design incorporates advanced cushioning technology and responsive materials to provide superior comfort and support on the court.

Engineered with the needs of elite athletes in mind, the Jordan Tatum 2 Vortex boasts a lightweight construction that doesn't compromise on durability. The breathable upper ensures optimal ventilation during intense gameplay, while the strategically placed support structures offer enhanced stability for quick cuts and explosive movements. With its sleek profile and eye-catching color scheme, this sneaker seamlessly blends style and performance.

Our team thinks this product is great for players seeking a high-performance basketball shoe that delivers both on-court excellence and off-court appeal. The Jordan Tatum 2 Vortex's combination of innovative technology and bold design makes it a standout choice for serious athletes and sneaker enthusiasts alike.

The Women's Air Jordan 2/3 'Earth' fuses elements from two legacy Air Jordan silhouettes. The off-white leather upper has a lizard-textured overlay piped in brown, taken from the Air Jordan 2. Matching brown pops land on the collar lining and molded heel tab, while the Wings logo adorns the tongue. The Air Jordan 3-inspired midsole has an Air-sole heel unit just like the original.

shoeName: Jordan 2 Retro Low Look, Up in the Air (Women's)
colorway: Summit White/Varsity Red-Ice Blue-Iced Lilac-Muslin-Light Steel Grey
description: The Women's Air Jordan 2 Low 'Look, Up in the Air' pays tribute to one of Michael Jordan's iconic posters with a white leather upper adorned with perforated accents and a light grey suede midfoot overlay. The padded collar features a soothing Ice Blue textile, while the embossed Wings branding and Iced Lilac trim add details to the tongue. The polyurethane midsole is given a vintage look and is paired with a sturdy two-tone rubber outsole. Custom sockliners display a skyline graphic and the printed phrase 'Look, Up in the Air.'

shoeName: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Year Of The Rabbit
Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Muslin Vivid Orange
Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Yellow Ochre (Women's)

description:
The Jordan Tatum 2 Momma's Boy is a basketball shoe designed in collaboration with American basketball star Jayson Tatum.

This version of the Jordan Tatum 2 is constructed with a white upper that is patterned with outlines of calla lily flowers and bright yellow accents. The calla lily is his mother’s favorite flower, while the yellow accents represent her favorite color. The black tongue features a JT logo in bright yellow, while the black heel collar features a yellow Jumpman logo The number 0 appears on the heel collar over a pink background. Bright yellow supports outlined in black appear on each midsole, and a pink Jumpman can be found on the lateral side. The shoes also feature a full-length Air Strobel unit for performance enhancement.

What we like most about this shoe are the hits of bright pink that perfectly complement the use of yellow on the otherwise black-and-white shoe. The Jordan Tatum 2 Momma's Boy was released on March 5, 2024, for a price of $125.

The 'Crystal Mint' edition of the Women's Air Jordan 2 Retro honors the rising talents of New York's streetball culture. The white leather upper features a Wolf Grey tumbled leather overlay at the midfoot, while the PU midsole sports an off-white vintage finish atop a two-tone rubber outsole. Inspired by the Statue of Liberty, the shoe incorporates touches of mint green accents, along with Rose Gold metallic eyelets and a marbled Wings logo adorning the tongue.

shoeName: Jordan Why Not Zer0.2 SE Birthday Scorpio
description:
The Jordan Why Not Zer0.2 SE Birthday Scorpio is a basketball shoe whose design was inspired by Russel Westbrook’s zodiac sign to celebrate his 31st birthday.

This version of the Jordan Why Not Zer0.2 SE features a mostly black textile upper for flexibility. Gray and yellow overlays form the mudguard, while red flywire appears on the lateral side of the laces and red stitching on the other side. Transparent supports cross the sides of the shoes from the laces to the arch, revealing 2.0 SE branding underneath on top of a yellow background. A shiny black support branded with the Jumpman logo forms the heel counter, while the heel itself is yellow textile attached to a black ankle strap with red stitching. The tongue also sports a Jumpman logo on the pull tab and the heel tab is branded, as well. The shoe sits on top of a white and black wavy outsole.

Our favorite thing about this shoe is the branding that appears very subtly on the lateral side of the toe. The Jordan Why Not Zer0.2 SE Birthday Scorpio was released on November 12, 2019, for $130.

shoeName: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Olympic

description: The Air Jordan 38 Low ‘Fundamental 2.0’ has black embroidered details throughout the midfoot and heel to complement a nubuck upper. Red accents on the inner lining give these shoes some contrast, while a Jumpman badge decorates the tongue. These sneakers have a full-length Zoom strobel, a lightweight Phylon midsole and Cushlon 3.0 foam wedge for a plush feel. A see-through rubber outsole gives you smooth traction underfoot.

shoeName: Jordan Delta 2 White Black Tan Infrared
description: The debut colorway of the silhouette, the Jordan Delta 2 'Thermo White' released in May 2021. Featuring a layered construction, the shoe's upper is built with a mix of semitranslucent textile and suede, supported by a TPU frame designed for lateral stability. The neutral look is highlighted by Flash Crimson throughout, while underfoot, a React foam midsole is included for cushioning. The outsole incorporates rubber pods that offer traction in high-wear areas.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low ALT Bred Toe 2.0 (TD)
description: 1 Low Alt TD DR9747-161

Part of a special collection created in collaboration with the renowned reggaeton artist, the J Balvin x Air Jordan 2 Retro SP TD features a soft pastel Celestine Blue hue throughout its upper in nubuck and puffed-up ripstop materials. The solid white foam midsole rests on a glow-in-the-dark rubber outsole. Vibrant rainbow stitching outlines its distinctive lines, and J Balvin's signature yellow smiley face is prominently displayed on a leather heel overlay, adorned with a fluffy cloud graphic.

shoeName: Jordan 2 Retro QF Candy Pack Red
description: Releasing as part of a Candy Pack alongside green and yellow colorways, the Air Jordan 2 Retro QF ‘Candy Red’ features Nike’s signature Varsity Red throughout its upper. The vibrant, candy-like look stands out against white contrast stitching, black detailing and a black heel counter. A faux lizard-skin appears at the quarter panel, while the black and white sole unit has Air in the heel for cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan 2 Retro Low Year of the Dragon (Women's)
colorway: Sail/Cedar-Dark Smoke Grey-Dark Team Red-Metallic Gold Grain
description: Only 2,024 pairs are available on the Women's Air Jordan 2 Retro Low 'Year of the Dragon.' The upper features off-white leather with perforated details and embroidered dragon graphics. An embossed Wings logo adorns the tongue, matching the molded eyelets and the red midfoot outline. Dark grey accents make their way to the back tab and inner lining. These shoes have a soft midsole, thanks to an encapsulated Air-sole unit.

The Women's Air Jordan 2 Retro 'Off Noir Mauve' showcases the shoe in dark grey nubuck, with the lining, midfoot piping, molded back heel and tongue’s Wings logo appearing in light purple. The laces match in the same pale violet hue. The rubber outsole has a pivot circle and grooves for traction and supports the comfortable off-white midsole.

shoeName: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Barely Grape (Women's)
Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Citron Tint (Women's)
Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Chicago Women's Collective (Women's)
Jordan Luka 2 TB University Red White

description: Part of a larger collection that released for Black History Month 2019, the Air Jordan 2 Retro GS 'Black History Month' 2019 is a grade-school iteration of the shoe. Both shoes feature the same pattern worked into the black portions of their respective uppers, but the heels differ, with unique kente cloth-inspired patterns in various colors. Underfoot, Air in the midsole provides cushioning, with a colorful finish on the rubber outsole. Metallic gold 'BHM' branding completes the look.

shoeName: Jordan Jumpman Team 2 Black White Taxi
Jordan 2 Retro QF White Varsity Red (2010)
description: The Air Jordan 2 Retro QF 'Varsity Red' 2010 features a familiar Chicago Bulls-style colorway. The white leather upper sports a mix of smooth and lizard-textured leather, with the prominent tongue 'Wings' logo and the heel appearing in Varsity Red. Black on the laces, lining and Air midsole completes the 'Bred' look, with a final touch of Varsity Red on the heel of the outsole.

shoeName: Jordan Max Aura 2 White Black Gold
Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Honeydew

description: The Air Jordan 2 Retro BG ‘Wing It’ features a minimalist design that draws inspiration from the original ad campaign that accompanied the shoe’s launch in 1986. The pristine white leather upper is contrasted by black hits on the tongue, midsole and heel. The latter detail is printed with the words ‘WING IT.’ across the left and right shoe, mimicking the caption on the vintage print ad.

The Air Jordan 2 Retro Low 'Gym Red' features an eye-catching monochromatic finish throughout the sneaker’s upper and tooling. The former is built with leather construction that’s entirely treated to a lizard-skin texture for a premium touch. Unexpected pops of Hyper Turquoise appear on the rubber outsole and sockliner, the latter accented with a Jumpman logo it.

Don C and Jordan Brand teamed up to release the Just Don x Air Jordan 2 Retro 'Beach.' Featuring quilted detailing on the collar and midfoot, the shoe's leather and suede upper is finished in neutral Beach. Metallic gold branding adds a complementary touch, while the 'Wings' logo on the tongue contrasts the look in peach. Air underfoot provides cushioning.

The Jordan Luka 2 Matador is a double nod to Luka Dončić’s time with Real Madrid before he entered the NBA and his smart, determined on-court style that can be compared to a real-life matador.

The Jordan Luka 2 Matador is a Jordan-esque sneaker dressed in a tropical twist, washed teal, and barely green color combination with metallic gold accents. The semi-transparent mesh upper incorporates synthetic suede overlays that add support where the shoe needs it, while textile portions ensure breathability while not weighing it down. Luka’s branding is found on the top of the tongue in golden stitching, and a semi-translucent rubber outsole with a radial traction pattern provides traction and coverage on smooth surfaces.

Apart from the eye-catching design, our experts think that other standout features include cutting-edge Nike technology like an IsoPlate foot frame, a Cushlon 3.0 wedge foam, and the Formula 23 foam that runs the full length of the midsole. Innovation to the max. The Jordan Luka 2 Matador debuted on August 3, 2023, and sold at a retail price of $140.

shoeName: Jordan Zion 2 Noah White Black Multi-Color

description: The Air Jordan 2 Retro GS 'White Cement' has a sleek white leather upper, a textured overlay at the midfoot, and a padded high collar. The Nike-branded heel tab and the vintage Wings logo on the tongue appear in Cement grey. The insoles feature a skyline image with the words 'Look, Up in the Air.' A lightweight cushioning PU midsole with Air technology provides optimal comfort underfoot.

shoeName: Jordan 2 Retro Low Year of the Dragon
description: The Air Jordan 2 Retro Low ‘Year of the Dragon’ sports a white leather upper with jade eyelets and a dragon-scale midfoot overlay. The aforementioned gets a metallic gold trim, matching the embossed Wings logo on the tongue. Red accents line the interior and make their way to the back tab for a lively hit. The midsole is equipped with an encapsulated Air-sole unit for a plush feel, anchored by a jade-and-burgundy rubber outsole to round out the look.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High Golf NRG 2 Michelle Wie West Aloha
description: The collaboration between Michelle Wie West and Jordan Brand brings forth the limited-edition Air Jordan 1 High Golf NRG 2 'Aloha,' a special golf version of the iconic silhouette. The off-white leather upper is adorned with metallic silver 'Just Do It' lace jewels and embroidered wave-inspired Swooshes, while pink laces secure the shoe. The sneaker rests on an integrated-traction outsole, featuring blue-tinted translucent rubber that reveals an oversized 'Aloha' graphic. Unique touches include tongue tags that alternate from the initials of Wie West's daughter to the Korean word for 'mom.'

The J Balvin x Air Jordan 2 Retro SP PS dons a blue nubuck and puffy ripstop upper, accented with rainbow stitching. Fluffy cloud graphics adorn the look, while J Balvin’s signature smiley face logo decorates the heel. A white foam midsole is bolstered by a fluorescent blue rubber outsole for an eye-catching look.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low ALT Bred Toe 2.0 (PS)
Jordan Luka 2 TB Game Royal White
Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 SE You're Welcome (Women's)

description: The Air Jordan 2 Retro Low 'Chicago' dropped in 2016, resurrecting an OG colorway initially released in 1987. The design of the retro low-top is true to the original, featuring a white leather upper embellished with a tonal lizard texture on the collar overlay. The shoe’s traditional Chicago-inspired color scheme is complemented by a Jordan ‘Wings’ logo on the tongue and Nike branding on the sockliner.

shoeName: Jordan Zion 2 Photon Dust Flash Crimson

description: The Air Jordan 2 ‘Radio Raheem’ pays tribute to the pivotal character from Spike Lee’s groundbreaking 1989 film, ‘Do the Right Thing.’ Inspired by the graphic design on Raheem’s ‘Bed Stuy Do or Die’ T-shirt, the retro silhouette sports a tumbled black leather upper, with contrasting blue accents and subtle pops of Atomic Orange and Fire Pink on the eyelets. It all rides on an all-white sole unit.

The Air Jordan 2 Retro TD ‘Python’ has a white leather upper bolstered by a snakeskin-patterned overlay that draws inspiration from the Air Jordan 11 Low. A black Wings logo is embossed on the tongue, while a crimson Nike wordmark on the back tab gives them a minimalist splash of color. A wider heel counter provides support, color-matching the off-white foam midsole. The rubber outsole delivers traction for growing feet.

colorway: Light Soft Pink/Mint Foam/Smoke/Lilac/Medium Soft Pink/Copa

shoeName: Jordan Max Aura 2 Black University Blue
Jordan Zion 2 White Volt Dynamic Turquoise
Jordan Zion 2 Out of This World
description:
The Jordan Zion 2 Out of This World is a special colorway of the Air Jordan Zion 2, a basketball shoe designed by the Jordan Brand in collaboration with Zion Williamson, a highly regarded NBA player known for his athleticism and versatility.

The shoe’s upper is constructed using a combination of leather and suede material which immediately gives the shoe a luxurious feel. The upper is predominantly purple with black accents covering the lace area plus the entire collar of the shoe and the heel area. The shoe retains a majority of the features on the Air Jordan Zion 2 line including the midfoot strap and perforated detailing around the side panels.

One thing our experts love about the Air Jordan Zion 2 Out of This World is the incorporation of responsive cushioning systems like Zoom Air units in the forefoot and heel which are primarily aimed at improving comfort. The shoes were initially released for retail in August 2022 for $140.

shoeName: Jordan 2 Retro Low Sky J Orange (Women's)
colorway: Sky J Orange/Varsity Red/Sky J Mauve
description: The Women's Air Jordan 2 Retro Low 'Sky J Orange' combines a suede overlay at the midfoot in rustic orange with tonal nubuck on the upper. It has a plush lining and a molded heel tab in mauve for contrast. The shoe sits on a cream-colored midsole with Air-sole cushioning and a tough rubber outsole. The tongue features an embossed Wings logo, and Nike branding appears on the insole.

Inspired by the iconic OG colorway of the AJ3, the Air Jordan 2 Retro TD 'Black Cement' for little kids features a lizard-textured midfoot overlay against the sleek black leather upper. A Fire Red Nike wordmark on the heel tab is color-matched by the embossed Wings logo on the Cement Grey tongue. A plush foam midsole with a vintage off-white appearance provides comfort underfoot.

The Air Jordan 2 Retro BG 'Alternate 87' imagines the classic silhouette as a PE colorway made for Michael Jordan’s early days with the Bulls. Consequently, the sneaker is dressed in traditional ‘Bred’ coloring, highlighted by a black leather upper with contrasting Gym Red hits on the eyelets, heel, outsole and branding elements. A snakeskin texture on the midfoot overlay adds a premium touch.

shoeName: Jordan 2 Retro QF Univ. Blue Black (2010)
description: The Air Jordan 2 Retro QF 'University Blue' features significant inspiration from the University of North Carolina. The shoe's leather upper is finished almost entirely in University Blue, with black accents on the trim, heel, laces and lining. A black Air midsole gives way to a translucent outsole underfoot.

The Air Jordan 2 Retro Low GS 'UNC' takes cues from Michael Jordan's alma mater. These shoes have a white leather upper with perforated details and a lizard-textured midfoot overlay. The latter is piped in University Blue piping, matching the knit collar lining, heel counter, as well as the molded Wings logo on the tongue. A plush foam midsole packs an Air-Sole heel unit for a resilient feel.

shoeName: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 University Blue Volt (Women's)
Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 FIBA
Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Bordeaux (Women's)

description:
The Jordan Zion 2 Hope Diamond is the second shoe of New Orleans Pelicans basketball player Zion Williamson in collaboration with the sneaker brand, Jordan.

The upper of the Hope Diamond Air Jordan Zion 2 shoe is made up of a mix of synthetic and textile materials for breathability and comfort. It features geometric shapes and lines that run throughout the shoe, embodying the diamond's facets. The shoe comes in a Half Blue, Pink Prime, and Deep Royal Blue colorway. The sole is designed with a curved shape, which provides support for explosive movements and landings. It features Nike React foam technology, which enhances comfort and provides cushioning during intense basketball games or training sessions. The sneaker also has a strap that helps improve its fit.

Our experts think that one of the standout features of the Jordan Zion 2 Hope Diamond shoe is the perforations all around. These perforations help to improve breathability and add to the overall comfort of the shoe. The sneaker was released on June 30th, 2022 at a retail price of $140.

The Air Jordan 2 Retro Deconstructed 'Sail' updates the classic silhouette with a lighter-weight build, replacing traditional leather with soft suede construction in monochromatic off-white Sail. The sneaker keeps its distinctive lines and perforated detailing, but adds branding elements at the tongue and heel in Bio Beige leather for a rustic look.

shoeName: Jordan 23/7.2 EasyOn Black Fire Red White Sesame (PS)
Jordan Stay Loyal 2 Black University Red Wolf Grey White

description: Showcasing a unique color palette that pays homage to the model's debut in 1986, the Air Jordan 2 Retro TD 'Origins' is specifically designed for little kids. Departing from its predecessor, the original AJ2 featured a sleek design designed in Italy without the iconic Swoosh logo. On this incarnation, a lizard-textured midfoot overlay outlined with piping in red and green adorns the white leather upper. Fire Red accents beautifully adorn the interior lining, Nike-branded back tab, and the retro Wings logo embossed on the tongue, while the green hue is also present on the heel counter. Completing the design, the shoe features a comfortable foam midsole with a vintage off-white finish.

The Air Jordan 21/2 Retro ‘Countdown Pack’ dropped in 2008 as part of a series of thematic packs that bring together two Jordan models that add up to 23. Here, the dual silhouettes were originally released nearly two decades apart: an Air Jordan 21 in black suede with contrasting red accents, twinned with the Air Jordan 2 in the OG White/Red colorway from 1987.

Bruce Kilgore defied conventional footwear design in 1986 with the Air Jordan 2. He removed the intricacies of the shoe and instead concentrated on asymmetric and textural aspects while retaining the highest performance elements. The Air Jordan 2, re-released in 2004, features the initial color scheme with upper and black white leather detailing on the laces, lining and midsole. The Varsity Red accents on the heel counter, outsole, lining and tab highlight the colorway.

Nike's Doernbecher program allows children and teenagers design their own shoes as part of a collaboration with OHSU Doernbecher Children's Hospital. While the program has gone on to spawn several popular colorways, the Air Jordan 2 High 'Doernbecher' represents the very first. Designed by Sheridan Brenton, who survived a car accident that required more than 40 surgeries, the shoe emerges with a Pro Gold and Lucky Green reimagining of Michael Jordan’s second signature shoe that features a paisley design throughout. Representing Brenton's school colors, the shoe also has 35 perforations on the forefoot as a nod to his jersey number and black lizard skin detailing on the side panel.

The Air Jordan 2 Retro ‘Iron Purple’ updates the classic silhouette with a pastel violet hue, applied to a smooth nubuck upper that adds Nike’s Safari print on the collar and mudguard. Unexpected pops of Infrared 23 appear on the ‘Wings’ logo atop the tongue and Nike branding at the heel. The kicks are finished with speckled Infrared detailing on the shoe’s purple laces and midsole.

shoeName: Jordan 2 Retro Just Don Arctic Orange (GS)
description: Originally released as a kids' and grade-school exclusive, the Just Don x Air Jordan 2 Retro GG 'Arctic Orange' was designed by Don C for friends and family who missed out on his first two Air Jordan collaborations. Featuring an Arctic Orange upper with quilted detailing throughout, the Air midsole also sports a tonal finish. Underfoot, the outsole includes a hit of University Red. The shoe released on Mother's Day 2017.

The Air Jordan 2 Retro Low 'Midnight Navy’ dropped in 2016, featuring a familiar color scheme first seen on a retro low-top release from 2004. Like its predecessor, this pair draws inspiration from Michael Jordan’s North Carolina alma mater, featuring a white leather upper with complementary University Blue and Midnight Navy accents. A crisp white finish replaces the navy-hued midsole of the original.

The Air Jordan 2 Retro Premio ‘Bin23' in Dark Cinder dropped in 2010, representing the inaugural offering from Jordan Brand’s premium Bin 23 collection. Individually numbered and limited to just 1,097 pairs, the sneaker features a chocolate brown leather upper with croc-skin overlays, waxed laces and a Bin 23 red wax seal on the lateral collar of the left shoe.

shoeName: Jordan Stay Loyal 2 Black Metallic Silver

description: Released as part of Nike's 2019 Black History Month collection, the Jordan Why Not Zer0.2 'Black History Month' features a series of Afrofuturism-inspired prints on its bold performance construction. The shoe's mixed-material upper includes a padded, patterned collar and a vibrant forefoot strap worked into the lacing system, with a bright yellow heel counter supporting the fit. Underfoot, Phylon and Zoom Air combine to provide cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan Stay Loyal 2 Black White Gym Red
Jordan Delta 2 Light Photo Blue Orange
colorway: Light Smoke Grey/Total Orange-Light Photo Blue-White
description: Sporting a series of vibrant accents, the Jordan Delta 2 'Light Smoke Grey Total Orange' is a lifestyle shoe. Built with translucent mesh, the shoe's upper is overlaid by suede, highlighted by Total Orange on the stabilizing midfoot insert. The lateral eyestay adds green via a Jumpman tag, with the woven tongue tag and suede heel patch further accenting the look in Light Photo Blue. Underfoot, a React midsole is included for cushioning, giving way to an outsole with translucent rubber pods in high-wear areas.

During his rookie year with the Denver Nuggets, Carmelo Anthony wore this version of the Air Jordan 2 as a Player Exclusive, featuring a white top with a color palette of Carolina Blue and Varsity Maize. The signature pair of Anthony featured his nickname ' MELO ' along the back collar, but there was ' NIKE ' on the back of the general release edition.

The Air Jordan 2 Retro Low ‘Midnight Navy’ gives the nod to Michael Jordan's college alma mater. Released in 2016, the shoe's luxury-inspired construction includes a lizard skin texture on the white overlays, while Midnight Navy and University Blue on the heel panel, midsole, outsole and branding complete the team look.

shoeName: Jordan Heir Series 2 Precious Medal WNBA Gold (Women's)
description: The Women's Jordan Heir Series 2 'WNBA' sports a black mesh upper with matching no-sew overlays. Tan synthetic leather details land on the eyestay, padded collar, and forefoot overlay. The Jumpman and WNBA logos take turns on each tongue, while a removable hair band adorns the heel. A see-through rubber cupsole houses a foam midsole with springy Zoom Air technology in the forefoot.

The Jordan Why Not Zer0.2 'All Star' gets a bold colorway to match Russell Westbrook's signature style. The shoe's upper features a mesh base with two camoflauge prints, with elephant print on the toe. Volt and Infrared bring color to the midfoot strap, matched by a similiar vibrant look on the Air midsole. An external heel counter is included for stability, with tongue and heel pull-loops for easy on and off.

shoeName: Jordan 2 Retro Low Year of the Dragon (GS)
colorway: Sail/Cedar/Oil Green/Dark Team Red/Metallic Gold Grain
description: Honoring the Lunar New year, the Air Jordan 2 Retro Low GS 'Year of the Dragon' is limited to just 2,024 pairs. The upper is made of an off-white leather, contrasted by scaly midfoot overlays for a textured look. Burgundy hits on the eyelets, back tab and the embossed Wings logo on the tongue give them that subtle contrast. These shoes have a lightweight midsole, equipped with an encapsulated Air-sole unit and supported by a see-through rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Concord (Women's)

description: The Jordan Delta 2 'White Royal' brings a clean colorway to its lifestyle running constructijon. Built with a mix of mesh, leather and suede, the shoe's upper appears in white, with a prominent heel pull-loop included for easy on and off. The tongue tag and quarter panel flag add blue to the look, with black 'Jordan' branding contrasting the side wall, while a molded TPU mudguard is included for stability. Underfoot, a React midsole provides cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Twist 2.0 Medium Grey (PS)
Jordan Team Elite 2 Low White Pure Platinum (GS)

description: The Air Jordan 2 Retro Deconstructed ‘Mint Foam’ swaps out the silhouette’s traditional leather build with suede construction free of interior padding for lightweight comfort. The mid-top keeps the Air Jordan 2’s signature elements, including forefoot perforations and Nike branding at the heel. A matching Mint Foam midsole and outsole maintain the shoe’s monochromatic aesthetic.

shoeName: Jordan 23/7.2 EasyOn Black Cool Grey White University Red (TD)
Jordan 2 Retro J Balvin (Friends and Family)
description: Step into elite tournament style with the Air Jordan 2 Retro Low EYBL PE "Mint Foam / Flash Crimson / Barely Green". Designed as an exclusive player edition for the Elite Youth Basketball League, this rare low-top pairs high-end court fashion with a fresh, vibrant aesthetic. A premium upper dressed in refreshing mint and barely green hues is dynamically contrasted by sharp flash crimson accents. Retaining its luxury Italian-inspired heritage, it features a textured premium construction, signature Jordan branding, and a supportive encapsulated Air sole for timeless comfort.

shoeName: Jordan Jumpman Team 1 II White Cool Grey Black

description: The Air Jordan 2 Retro Deconstructed 'Mineral Gold' offers a pared-down version of the OG Italian-made model from 1986, once known for its premium materials and construction. The sneaker swaps out its traditional leather upper in favor of lightweight suede, finished in a monochromatic dark yellow hue that extends to the Air-infused midsole and rubber outsole.

A largely neutral look, the Jordan Delta 2 'Lightning' is subtly highlighted by mismatched pastel accents. The shoe's textile upper appears in white, overlaid by grey suede at the forefoot. A semitranslucent molded overlay supports the lateral side, while the left shoe includes yellow suede to accent the look, with green on the right. Underfoot, a React midsole provides cushioning, giving way to durable rubber pods on high-wear areas of the outsole.

The Air Jordan 23/7.2 EasyOn PS 'Anthracite Game Royal' has a black mesh upper with an adjustable midfoot strap, a stretchy collar and a collapsible heel. The side panel has a blue Jumpman logo that matches the piping on the synthetic mudguard. Wavy lines on the white foam midsole that anchors the slip-on design.

shoeName: Jordan 2 Retro SP Maison Chateau Rouge (TD)
Jordan Stay Loyal 2 Black Hyper Royal
Jordan Why Not Zer0.2 Don't Care
description: The Jordan Why Not Zer0.2 'IDC' features a look fit for Russell Westbrook's flamboyant style. The shoe's mesh upper includes a greyscale camouflage pattern at the collar, with a midfoot strap for support. Hyper Pink on the eyestay and Cyber on the heel counter bring color to the look, while underfoot, the grey midsole includes Zoom Air cushioning and a stabilizing TPU plate, giving way to a multidirection rubber tread on the outsole.

shoeName: Jordan Why Not Zer0.2 SE Orange Pulse
description: The Jordan Why Not Zer0.2 SE 'Orange Pulse' showcases graffiti-like writing on the sneaker’s lightweight upper, fitted with a translucent midfoot saddle for added stability. The hectic design rests atop a solid white midsole that houses Zoom Air cushioning in the forefoot for responsive cushioning. Underfoot, a rubber outsole is curved upward at the heel and finished in a unique cored-out traction pattern.

The Air Jordan 32 ‘Pure Platinum’ showcases a refined color scheme on a silhouette inspired by the luxurious build of the original Italian-made Air Jordan 2. The mid-top makes use of a Pure Platinum Flyknit upper with a silver heel overlay engineered to deliver lateral support. Metallic silver on the shoe’s branding elements are complemented by an icy translucent rubber outsole underfoot.

shoeName: Jordan Delta 2 SE Light Pumice Racer Blue

description: Adding contrasting accents to a neutral colorway of the lifestyle silhouette is the Jordan Delta 2 '3D.' The breathable black mesh base upper has tonal suede and leather overlays throughout the forefoot with mismatched color blocking on the synthetic heel panel, while the lateral midfoot features and orange TPU mudguard with overlapping translucent films in assorted vivid hues make an impression of depth that pays homage to retro 3D technology. It's built on a black foam midsole with durable rubber pods in a crisp white finish.

The 0.2 ' Wheat ' Jordan Westbrook uses a classic tan colorway that recalls traditional work boots. On Russell Westbrook's lifestyle shoe, it is implemented in monochromatic fashion, featuring a deconstructed suede upper branded on the tongue with Russ' personal logo and a Jumpman stamped on the heel.
