The gum rubber tooling connects to the heritage of Jordan with an outsole tread pattern taken from the Air Jordan 1 KO.

shoeName: Jordan Ultra.Fly 2 Low White Gym Red
Jordan Jumpman Team 2 White Black Red

description: The Air Jordan 23/7.2 EasyOn TD 'Anthracite Game Royal' sports a Jordan logo on the adjustable midfoot strap securing the black mesh upper, contrasted with lively blue touches. Webbed tongue and heel pull tabs works alongside a stretchy knit collar and a collapsible heel for quick on and off. The foam midsole is bolstered with sturdy rubber in high-wear areas.

The Air Jordan 2 Retro PS 'Black Cement' is a young kids’ shoe inspired by the original Air Jordan 3. A lizard-textured perforated midfoot overlay is outlined in grey and intersects the sleek black leather upper. The Nike-branded back tab and tongue display additional touches of Cement Grey, the latter bearing an embossed Fire Red Wings logo. The foam midsole showcases a vintage off-white shade, and rides on a two-tone rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 2 Retro SP Maison Chateau Rouge (PS)

description: During its debut in 1986, the Air Jordan 2 sneaker swiftly established itself as an icon, mirroring its namesake, and has enjoyed enduring popularity and continued success. The Air Jordan 2 Retro BG sneaker was released in June 2014 and paid homage to its heritage by reintroducing design elements from the original AJ2 and giving them a modern twist. Constructed with pristine white leather, the shoe showcases signature faux lizard skin panels and vibrant red accents. Completing this kids' shoe is a cushioned sole for optimal comfort underfoot.

The Jordan Delta 2 'Black Infrared' brings a classic Jordan Brand colorway to a modern Jordan Brand silhouette. The shoe's upper emerges in mesh, finished in black and supported by tonal suede overlays. The lateral side adds a molded rubber mudguard for support, while the woven Jumpman tag and webbing heel pull-loop highlight the look in Infrared 23. Underfoot, an off-white React foam midsole provides cushioning, giving way to rubber pods in high-wear areas of the outsole.

The Jordan Delta 2 SE ‘White Multi’ has an off-white knit upper reinforced with matching synthetic suede overlays. Mismatched bursts of blue, red, green and yellow appear on the webbed eyelets, heel and the partially see-through rubber mudguard. A full-length Nike React midsole keeps things soft underfoot, anchored by sturdy rubber pods in high-wear areas.

shoeName: Jordan 2 Retro Low White Varsity Red
Jordan Team Elite 2 Low White Metallic Silver

description: The Jordan Tatum 2 ‘Vortex’ is inspired by Jayson Tatum’s innate ability to remain calm in the eye of the storm. These basketball shoes have a mint green mesh upper with large foam and knit pods that engulf the midsole. The rubber outsole has a herringbone-pattern for solid traction in all directions.

American music-video director Vashtie Kola and Nike teamed up to create the Air Jordan 2 Retro Gs 'Violette,' a grade-school shoe meant to celebrate female empowerment. The shoe's leather upper emerges in a light lavender shade, with a darker Deep Purple making up the heel counter and eyelets. A complementary sole unit includes Air cushioning.

The Air Jordan 2 Retro ‘Black Chrome’ launched in 2004, marking the first time that the classic silhouette had been rendered in a black colorway. The sneaker carries an upper in black nubuck, complemented by various chrome accents and side panels constructed from black pebbled leather. Traditional branding hits including the ‘Wings’ logo on the tongue and Nike wordmark at the heel.

The Levi's x Air Jordan 3 Retro SP 'Black Denim' sports a black tumbled leather upper with grey denim on the eyestay, collar, as well as the forefoot and heel overlays. Black denim engulfs the mudguard, while a red embroidered Jumpman decorates the tongue, matching the Levi's tab on the side panel of the right shoe. The Nike Air logo on the heel brings an OG touch, while a white foam midsole packs an Air-Sole heel unit for all-around cushioning.

The Women's Air Jordan 3 'Orange Citrus' takes design cues from an unreleased sample pair produced in 2007. These kicks have a white tumbled leather upper, complemented with grey elephant print overlays etched with irregular orange lines. The orange collar lining adds a burst of color, along with a red Jumpman logo on the tongue and molded heel tab. These shoes ride on a white foam midsole, which packs an Air-Sole heel unit that works in conjunction with an orange rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro 'UNC' looks to Michael Jordan's college days for inspiration. As a result, the shoe's white leather upper is accented by hits of Valor Blue, while the toe and heel sport elephant print overlays. Underfoot, more Valor Blue emerges on the midsole above the visible Air unit.

The SoleFly x Air Jordan 3 'Miami' nods to the Miami Hurricanes, using an off-white leather upper tooled with orange and green suede forefoot and heel overlays. A green embroidered Jumpman logo decorates the tongue, matching the upper eyelets and the raised Nike Air logo on the heel tab. An off-white foam midsole contains an Air-sole unit, touched with a splash of green on the heel. An orange rubber outsole keeps things soft underfoot.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro SP J Balvin Medellín Sunset
description: Collaborating once again, the J Balvin x Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Medellín Sunset' delivers the partners' interpretation of the beloved silhouette in a vibrant and tropical color scheme. Drawing inspiration from the awe-inspiring sunsets of Medellin, Colombia, J Balvin's hometown, this special-edition AJ3 showcases an ivory leather upper with matching forefoot and heel elephant print overlays. The rear midsole and molded back tab feature a captivating gradient blend of yellow, orange, and dark purple, with the left shoe displaying Nike branding and the right featuring J Balvin's iconic smiley face symbol. The tongue is adorned with an embroidered gold Jumpman logo. Completing the design is a translucent rubber outsole with a blue tint, providing a stylish foundation for the sneaker.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro Worlds Best Dad GS brings a heartfelt and lifestyle driven theme to one of the most celebrated silhouettes in Jordan Brand history. Built on the classic Air Jordan 3 foundation, the shoe combines Sail, Black, University Red, Pale Ivory, and Palomino tones to create a warm vintage inspired palette that feels personal and nostalgic rather than performance focused. The Air Jordan 3 remains iconic because of its visible Air cushioning, elephant print heritage, and direct connection to Michael Jordan’s rise in the late 1980s, and themed releases like this show how the silhouette continues evolving emotionally beyond basketball alone.

Fans appreciate storytelling driven Jordan releases because they give familiar silhouettes a more personal identity while preserving the details that made them timeless in the first place. The Worlds Best Dad concept gives the pair a softer and more sentimental atmosphere compared to aggressive sport focused colorways, making it feel especially unique within the Jordan 3 lineup. Collectors also enjoy how the earthy neutral tones and vintage inspired colors make the shoe versatile for everyday wear while still standing out through subtle thematic details. The result feels thoughtful and expressive without sacrificing the heritage driven personality that defines the Jordan 3.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro Worlds Best Dad GS was released on May 16, 2026 with a retail price of $155.

Using materials and color blocking that stay true to the iconic silhouette's original 1988 release is the Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Desert Elephant.' The black tumbled leather upper features signature elephant-print overlays in a light tan finish that repeats on the collar, eyestay, and tongue that also has a crimson Jumpman logo. The mid-top is built on a white polyurethane midsole with a visible Air-sole unit under the heel. The Jordan 3 'Desert Elephant' will drop on April 30, 2022.

Releasing in February 2021, the Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Cool Grey' 2021 is the first reissue of a 2007 colorway. Featuring an updated construction, the shoe's upper is built with leather, finished in grey and overlaid by elephant print at the forefoot and heel. Orange Peel eyelets highlight the look, with Sport Red marking the tongue branding. Underfoot, the midsole continues the subdued look, with visible Air in the heel providing cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro SP Nina Chanel Abney Bicoastal (Women's)
description: The Nina Chanel Abney x Women's Air Jordan 3 Retro SP 'Bicoastal' has a green canvas upper with matching forefoot and heel overlays. Cream-hued eyelets match the back tab, which has the Nike Air wordmark. A lightweight foam midsole pairs with an encapsulated Air-sole unit in the forefoot and a visible Air heel unit.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro Valentine's Day Treat Yourself (2025) (Women's)
description: The Women's Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Treat Yourself', also known as 'Valentine's Day', rolls out a coral tumbled leather upper with matching elephant print overlays on the forefoot and heel. Red molded eyelets match the Jumpman logos on the tongue and heel tab. The foam midsole is complemented with an Air-sole heel unit, while a pink rubber outsole rounds out the look.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Pine Green' combines updated materials with OG color blocking. The upper's traditional leather construction is replaced with textured nubuck. Pops of green appear on the perforated leather collar, molded eyelets and embroidered Jumpman branding on the tongue. The 3's classic elephant print arrives on the forefoot and heel overlays, with a second Jumpman icon displayed on the molded heel tab. The theme continues underfoot in the form of a white polyurethane midsole with contrast green accents and a grey rubber outsole.

The 2025 iteration of the Air Jordan 3 Retro GS 'Black Cat' uses black nubuck on the upper, matching it with a patent leather mudguard and contrasting it with charcoal elephant-print overlays on the forefoot and heel areas. The Jumpman emblem decorates the tongue and molded heel tab to keep the iconic look. A matching black foam midsole gets a glossy finish, tooled with an Air-sole heel unit for a resilient feel.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro OG GS 'Rare Air' takes design cues from imperfections found on early Air Jordan samples. These shoes have a black tumbled leather upper with suede forefoot and heel overlays. A red Jumpman emblem on the tongue matches the Nike Air logo on the heel — the right shoe has a flipped logo suggesting a factory defect. Blue pops on the collar, tongue and foam midsole complete the look.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro GS 'White Cement Reimagined' is a shoe design that is available in grade school sizes that brings back the beloved original color scheme of the classic silhouette. The upper is crafted using pristine white leather, with gray elephant print overlays that are modeled after the distinctive design from 1988. The polyurethane midsole has a vintage finish and comes with an encapsulated Air-sole unit in the forefoot, as well as an exposed unit in the heel. The white leather tongue is adorned with a stitched crimson Jumpman logo, and the pre-yellowed back tab features embossed Nike Air branding.

Jordan Brand teamed up with Hiroshi Fujiwara's design label to create the Fragment Design x Air Jordan 3 Retro SP. Built with tumbled lather, the upper appears primarily in white, overlaid by black leather on the mudguard, toe and heel. fragment design's double lightning bolt logo appears on the heel, while underfoot, Air in the heel of the midsole provides cushioning.

Giving the nod to the Georgetown Hoyas, the Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Georgetown' emerges in the school's mix of hues. The shoe's tumbled leather upper appears in Midnight Navy, with grey on the eyestay, tongue and collar complementing the design. More grey marks the elephant print overlays at the toe and heel, while underfoot, visible Air in the heel of the polyurethane midsole provides cushioning.

The 2025 version of the Air Jordan 3 GS 'Pure Money' rolls out a white tumbled leather upper bolstered by light grey elephant print forefoot and heel overlays. White micro-perforated leather lands on the eyestay and collar, while a metallic silver Jumpman logo adorns the tongue and heel tab. A white foam midsole contains Air-sole cushioning in the heel for a resilient feel.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro Spring Is In The Air (GS)
description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro GS 'Spring Is in the Air' brings an off-white leather upper with pale green elephant-print forefoot and heel overlays. The Jumpman emblem appears on the leather tongue, while a pink Nike Air logo decorates the heel tab. Light blue touches wrap around the heel of the cream-colored foam midsole, tooled with an Air-Sole heel unit and anchored by a pink rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro SE 'Red Cement' released for All-Star Weekend 2020 in Chicago. As a result, the shoe features a Chicago Bulls-style colorway, with Fire Red on the tumbled leather upper and a classic cement print on the toe and heel. Underfoot, the white midsole houses visible Air for cushioning.

colorway: Light Orewood Brown/Metallic Gold/Light British Tan/Palomino
description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Palomino' revamps the classic silhouette with a rustic vibe, accentuated by subtle earthy hues. The off-white suede upper is adorned with elephant-print overlays in brown on the forefoot and heel, with the distinctive pattern repeated on the eyestay. The padded collar features a perforated nubuck in tan, while the tongue and molded heel tab sport the iconic Jumpman logo. A sturdy grey rubber outsole provides support beneath a vintage-finished PU midsole with an exposed Air-sole unit in the heel.

Using refreshed materials and prints to the iconic model is the Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Patchwork.' A dark beige hue is featured on the canvas and textile upper with diverging overlays in moss green and woodland camo. The segmented mudguard has a mix of beige herringbone twill and grey rain camo with an olive green shaggy suede heel overlay. The heel tab has a customization option with a removable hook-and-loop fastener patch. Lightweight cushioning is provided by a two-tone polyurethane midsole with a red-tinged Air-sole unit under the heel.

Launched in December 2019, the Nike Air Jordan 3 Retro SP from the 'Animal' collection is an exotic retool of the basketball legend. The sneaker shows off an upper draped in black pony hair with leopard-print elements, zebra-stripe accents, and the word 'Instinct' inscribed under the tongue. A vivid Jumpman embroidered on the tongue and bright heel tab further enhance the eye-catching look. Underneath the Air-infused midsole, a gum rubber outsole offers traction and grip.

The Levi’s x Air Jordan 3 Retro 'All-Star' released only in Los Angeles as part of the 2026 NBA All-Star Weekend. The white leather upper gets washed indigo denim details. The cotton twill forefoot and heel overlay complements the look, joined by the collar and eyestay. The latter is stamped with a red Levi's tab on the side. The Jumpman logo lands on the tongue, while the Nike Air emblem graces the molded heel tab. The plush foam midsole contains an Air-Sole unit for a comfortable sensation underfoot.

The Women's Air Jordan 3 Retro TEX 'Starfish' rocks a two-color midsole assisted with visible Nike Air cushioning and anchored by a rubber outsole. Instead of traditional leather, these sneakers have a light tan knit upper. Matching hairy suede appears on the collar and eyestay, while orange suede overlays bolster the forefoot and heel areas to match the collar lining and the Jumpman on the tongue and heel tab.

colorway: Team Red/Metallic Gold/Burgundy Crush/Coconut Milk/Smokey Mauve/Gym Red
description: Only 2,300 pairs of the Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Bin23' were made. These sneakers have a red nubuck upper lined in genuine leather. Burgundy elephant-print overlays complements the design, while an embossed 'Bin 23' wax-seal emblem graces the tongue. A cream-colored foam midsole packs Air-Sole cushioning in the heel. The partially see-through rubber outsole ensures swift traction underfoot.

Featuring 'Fire Red'-style color-blocking, the Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Racer Blue' released in July 2021. The shoe's tumbled leather upper appears in white, highlighted by Racer Blue on the eyelets, collar and branding. The forefoot and heel elephant print overlays add a crackle effect, while underfoot, more Racer Blue accents the polyurethane midsole, which houses visible Air in the heel for cushioning.

The Nike Air Jordan 1 Retro Mid 'Infrared 23' offering retains the well-known design first drafted by Peter Moore in 1985, staying true to the heritage feel. Rendered in Black, White, and Infrared, this colorway offers a more vibrant take on the original Black and Red model. The black underlay on this iteration is formed with resilient nubuck, with smooth leather encompassing the remainder of the shoe. The shoe retains the iconic Wings logo on the collar, which was designed for the classic AJ1.

Recrafting the build of the original 1988 design by Tinker Hatfield is the Air Jordan 3 Retro SE 'Muslin.' The upper is constructed from Muslin canvas with the forefoot and heel overlays in Cement Grey suede. University Red accents land on the sneaker's lower eyelets, as well as Jumpman branding on the tongue and molded heel panel. It's built on an off-white polyurethane midsole with visible Air-sole cushioning in the heel and a durable grey rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan Tatum 3 Welcome to the Garden Alternate
description:
The Jordan Tatum 3 Welcome to the Garden Alternate is a colorful kinetic green, white, and black colorway from the Jordan Tatum 3 line, which is NBA player Jayson Tatum’s signature shoe.

The Welcome to the Garden Alternate colorway pays homage to Jayson Tatum’s mindset of putting energy where it matters most, such as his game and legacy. This high-top silhouette boasts a conforming fit that stretches when quick moves are needed. The upper is made of light textile and is dressed in black and white with wavy kinetic green accents and a floral pattern that is interspersed throughout. Black laces and a black tongue sporting a white JT logo round out this sneaker.

In our opinion, we love this colorway was brought to life thanks to a growth mindset intertwined with a garden motif and floral pattern and that makes the Jordan Tatum 3 Welcome to the Garden Alternate standout from the rest. Released on October 10, 2024, this sneaker had a $125 retail price.

The 2016 edition of the Air Jordan 3 Retro OG ‘True Blue’ brings back one of the silhouette’s OG colorways from 1988. This remastered edition of the iconic mid-top is true to the original, highlighted by a white leather upper with True Blue hits on the eyelets, collar lining and Nike Air branding at the heel. Elephant print detailing and a red Jumpman logo hit on the tongue make up the finishing touches.

With throwback flair, the Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Knicks Rivals' flaunts a palette influenced by a team Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls had to battle for Eastern Conference victory, the New York Knicks. The AJ3 was the first of countless Air Jordans designed by Tinker Hatfield and featured the debut of the iconic Jumpman emblem on the tongue. This 'Knicks Rivals' offering, issued in September 2019, retains the original profile with a white textured leather upper, elephant print on the toe cap and heel, Old Royal and University Orange color splashes, and a visible Nike Air unit.

colorway: Archaeo Brown/Dark Smoke Grey-Fossil Stone-Light Bordeaux-Cement Grey
description: Tinker Hatfield's original 1988 design gets an all-weather revamp in the Air Jordan 3 Retro SE ‘Winterized.’ The upper is built with brown nubuck leather, with dark grey nubuck overlays in the forefoot and heel, a pink suede mudguard and purple ballistic mesh around the collar. The molded heel and exposed-foam tongue are decorated with the Signature Jumpman branding. A multi-colored polyurethane midsole with a visible Air-sole unit offer lightweight cushioning.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Varsity Royal' features an OG-inspired look to that draws from Michael Jordan's college days. The upper is built with tumbled leather, finished in Varsity Royal and complemented by grey and elephant print panels. Underfoot, the white midsole houses visible Air in the heel for cushioning, with a tricolor rubber outsole providing traction.

Part of the Doernbecher Freestyle XIX collection, Hugo Covarrubias Molina honored his beloved Seattle Seahawks in this rendition of the Air Jordan 3 Retro. It has a navy leather upper with the classic elephant print overlays. The drip pattern in Seahawks' green and glow-in-the-dark laces give the upper contrast. Hugo's nickname "Juice" and a stylized logo appear on a transparent heel next to the embossed Jumpman. A nod to creativity, the phrase 'it's OK to be different' can be seen through the outsole.

The Women's Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Off Noir' features grey elephant print on the forefoot and heel overlays against a sleek black nubuck upper. Eyelets in an off-white contrast against the eyestay and padded collar in black perforated leather. The shoe features a two-tone polyurethane midsole with an exposed Air-sole unit nestled in the heel for comfort. Traditional Jumpman branding arrives via the tongue and back heel.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro GS ‘Green Glow’ sprinkles fluorescent green on a ‘Black Cement’-inspired design. The upper has black tumbled leather and grey elephant print overlays on the forefoot, eyestay and the heel. The upper and eyelets get a dash of mint green, as well as the Jumpman logos on the tongue and heel. The two-tone midsole is soft and lightweight, fortified by a visible Air-sole heel unit for a plush feel.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Jordan Poole PE
description:
The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Jordan Poole PE is a player-exclusive colorway designed in honor of Washington Wizards guard Jordan Poole. Dressed in an energizing palette of soft yellow, alabaster, pale ivory, sail, and metallic gold, this low-top silhouette blends performance with elevated style.

The upper of these Air Jordans Cut 3 Poole arrives in a breathable mix of pale ivory and sail, with subtle perforations that enhance airflow while adding texture. Flywire cables integrated with the laces ensure a secure fit around the midfoot, while metallic gold Swooshes bring a luxe feel with one Swoosh extending to wrap around the heel for extra flair. Soft yellow accents brighten up the tongue, sock liner, and outsole, giving the sneaker an energized pop.

What our experts love most are the branded details on the tongue, such as the embroidered sun graphic and the helpful pull tab. All these are subtle nods that make this pair stand out from the crowd. The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Jordan Poole PE was released on November 11, 2024, with a retail price of $190.

The Air Jordan 3 adapts the classic ‘Chlorophyll’ colorway of the Nike Air Trainer 1. The commonality between the two silhouettes is Tinker Hatfield, the subject of an Air Jordan x Nike Icons pack that features classic Jordan silhouettes showing off colorways taken from iconic Nike retro models. Here, the Jordan 3 is rendered in light grey, contrasted with black and Chlorophyll green accents throughout the upper and midsole.

The Women’s Air Jordan 3 Retro ‘Lucky Green’ revisits a Tinker Hatfield design and adds a modern look to this heritage shoe. The leather upper in stark white showcases Hatfield's iconic elephant print on the forefoot and heel, while Lucky Green makes its appearance on the rear insole, eyelets, and outside collar. MJ soars in Varsity Red on the tongue and molded heel tab.

The women’s Air Jordan 3 Retro ‘Black Gold’ reimagines this classic silhouette. The iconic elephant print overlays at the forefront and heel adorn the black tumbled leather upper. A metallic sunflower gold adorns tongue, eyestay and collar. Gym Red Jumpman branding is featured on the tongue and against the black heel tab. Comfort and traction are delivered via a clear rubber outsole.

Inspired by an early Tinker Hatfield sketch, the Air Jordan 3 Retro NRG ‘Tinker’ adds an unexpected detail to the legendary silhouette – namely, a Nike Swoosh in black on the shoe’s lateral side. The rest of the design is largely unchanged from the original, including a tumbled leather upper with Nike Air branding and elephant-print overlays at the toe and heel.

The Women's Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Rust Pink' rolls out a pink nubuck upper with off-white leather details on the eyestay and collar. Pink touches cover the grey elephant-print overlays on the forefoot and heel areas. The Jumpman emblem is embroidered on the heel, while a red one graces the tongue. More red hits land on the molded eyelets, as well as the wraparound touches on the foam midsole underfoot.

Pale pink and elephant print distinguish this otherwise low-key women's mid-top. The women’s Air Jordan 3 Retro ‘Neapolitan’ delivers an allover white upper in tumbled leather with a subtle powder pink constrasting with Dark Mocha brown in the signature elephant-print overlays; pink is repeated in the heel at the midsole. The tongue and back heel feature Jumpman branding in shades of matching brown and pink. The classic midsole in off-white PU ensures cushion with its visible Air-sole unit and rides on a brown rubber outsole.

The 2025 version of the Air Jordan 3 Retro PS 'Black Cat' has a black nubuck upper with charcoal elephant print overlays and a shiny black patent leather mudguard. A metallic silver Jumpman adorns the tongue, while another emblem graces the heel tab. A glossy black foam midsole keeps every step soft and lightweight.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Chalk & Track Red' rolls out an off-white leather upper complemented with grey and blue elephant print forefoot and heel overlays. The red mesh collar matches the inner lining and molded eyelets. The Wings logo lands on the tongue tag, while a red Jumpman adorns the heel. A touch of lively green wraps around the ivory foam midsole, which contains an Air-Sole heel unit backed by a blue rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro SE Fire Red Denim (2020)
description: Inspired by premium Japanese denim, the Air Jordan 3 Retro Denim SE 'Fire Red' features the material on its elephant-print overlays that mark the toe, heel and eyestay. Otherwise built with white tumbled leather, the upper is highlighted by hits of Fire Red on the eyelets and perforated collar. Underfoot, the midsole incoporates visible Air in the heel to provide cushioning.

Nike merged three original Air Jordan 1 colorways (Bred, Chicago, and Royal ) into a fresh colorway in 2016, known as the 'Top 3'. With the Wings logo on the ankle and the Nike Air branding on the insole and tongue, the sneaker comes in mismatched' color panels and outsoles while remaining true to the original design. 'Top 3' also refers to Jordan being drafted third overall in the NBA draft.

shoeName: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Chris Paul
description: Chris Paul and Jordan Brand present the Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG 'Give Them Flowers,' showcasing an intricate floral pattern pressed into the white leather upper. The off-white signature Swoosh arrives in shaggy suede, while the toe box and back tab in the same suede display a classic Wings logo. A interior of the woven Nike Air tag on the suede tongue delivers the phrase 'Give Them Flowers.'

The Jordan Tatum 3 Blueprint is a high-top athletic shoe featuring a mesh and nylon upper with an all-over wavy aesthetic, created by pairing overlays and underlays in Royal Blue and Blue side by side, delineated by Blue stitched borders.

In collaboration with NBA Boston Celtics player Jayson Tatum, Nike created his signature style, the Tatum 3. The Blueprint Jordan Tatum 3 references an architectural blueprint through its gridded ripstop nylon fabric panels and handwritten text branding, a nod to Tatum’s status as the architect of the game. The wavy two-tone palette continues throughout the mid- and outsole combination. White is used for the laces and accents that appear throughout the shoe, text branding elements that read 23, Roots, smooth, and more.

In our opinion, the best feature of the Tatum 3 is its Blueprint style details, which are unique and uncommon. The Jordan Tatum 3 Blueprint was released on February 17, 2025, and retailed at $125.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro GS 'White Cobalt Bliss' dons a white leather upper with powder blue elephant print forefoot and heel overlays. Light blue denim is used on the padded collar, while pink molded eyelets add that touch of contrast, matching the Jumpman on the tongue and heel tab. A white foam midsole gets Air-sole cushioning in the heel for a plush feel.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro ‘Mocha’ 2018 resurrects the unique colorway initially released in 2001. The mid top retains the original construction, showcasing a white tumbled leather upper accentuated with contrasting bursts of Dark Mocha on the shoe’s recognizable elephant-print overlays. The brown tone also emerges on the outsole and Jumpman branding emblems that decorate the tongue and heel panel.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro Free Throw Line White Cement
description: During the 1988 Slam Dunk Contest, Jordan Brand released the Air Jordan 3 Retro NRG 'Free Throw Line' in celebration of Michael Jordan's iconic launch from the free throw line thirty years earlier. The sneaker comes dressed in white with Cement Grey accents on the toe box and heel and Fire Red detailing on the eyelets and tongue. The model also features a red stripe translucent sole, precisely where MJ started off the line. Other details include the lettering of "3:51" on the back pull tab to remember when Jordan flew, and "147" on the tongue as a node to his final score.

The Women’s Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Sail Metallic Silver' rolls out an off-white midsole with visible Nike AIr cushioning with a dash of silver on the heel, paired with a grey rubber outsole. The ivory leather upper gets metallic silver elephant print overlays. The Jumpman logo adorns the tongue, heel tab and insoles for a signature look.

Drawing inspiration from an original colorway of the Air Jordan 7, the Air Jordan 3 Retro GS 'Cardinal Red' is a mid-top made for kids. It features a white tumbled leather upper with dark red accents on the eyelets, collar lining, and the raised Jumpman logo on the heel. Additional Jumpman branding is embroidered in orange on the tongue. The 3's signature elephant print is on the eyestay and forefoot and heel overlay. On the bottom is a white and red polyurethane midsole with visible Air-sole cushioning in the heel.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro LE 'Chicago All-Star' released as part of Nike's NBA All-Star 2020 collection, dropping exclusively in Chicago. As a result, the shoe's heel sports 'NIKE CHI' branding. The shoe otherwise remains true to its general-release counterpart, with a Fire Red tumbled leather upper complemented by elephant print on the toe and heel. Visible Air in the heel provides the usual cushioning.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Powder Blue' dresses Michael Jordan's third signature shoe in a vibrant Dark Powder Blue, which emerges on the upper's mix of leather and suede. The elephant print panels at the toe and heel also incorporate the color, with a white Air midsole providing contrast. The outsole is finished in grey, matched by the lining.

The 2024 version of the Air Jordan 3 Retro OG TD 'Black Cement' dons a black tumbled leather upper fortified with grey elephant print overlays at the forefoot and heel. A red Jumpman and a Nike Air back heel logo give these shoes their signature style. A white foam midsole, with black details wrapping around the heel keep every step soft and comfortable.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro GS 'Cement Grey' shoes sport a crisp tumbled leather upper, donning a dark grey elephant print on the eyestay, as well as the forefoot and heel overlays. A red Jumpman logo can be found on the tongue and heel tab for a signature look. A soft foam midsole anchors the model, fitted with an exposed Air-sole heel unit for plush cushioning.

Dropped in October 2019, the Nike Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG GS 'Shattered Backboard 3.0' pays homage to the uniform Michael Jordan wore when he shattered the backboard glass during a 1985 Nike exhibition basketball game in Italy. The upper is informed by black and orange patent leather with a textured finish. An embossed Wings logo and Swooshes brand the design. The pale rubber cupsole nods to the shoe's heritage.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro Tinker White University Red
description: Based on Tinker Hatfield's original sketches of the 1988 silhouette, the Air Jordan 3 Retro Tinker 'Air Max 1' emerges with an updated build. The shoe's upper is built with leather, sporting perforated detailing on the eyestay and collar and University Red suede on the mudguard. The lateral-side Swoosh can swapped out for a customizable look, while the inside of the tongue includes Tinker Hatfield's signature. Underfoot, the classic midsole houses visible Air in the heel for cushioning.

colorway: Particle Grey/Dark Smoke Grey-Smoke Grey-Platinum Tint
description:
The Air Jordan Tatum 3 St Louis delivers a hometown inspired colorway that reflects Jayson Tatum’s roots through a clean and tonal design. Particle grey and smoke grey tones create a layered and cohesive base, while platinum tint accents add subtle contrast that enhances the structure. The overall look feels understated and refined.

Fans of player inspired releases appreciate how colorways like this bring personal storytelling into performance footwear. The tonal execution makes it versatile while still meaningful. It is a sneaker that reflects identity and performance in a cohesive way.

The Air Jordan Tatum 3 St Louis was released on April 28, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

The 2023 Air Jordan 3 Retro GS 'Fear' brings back a 2013 color scheme. Grey elephant print overlays on the front and back appears against a matching nubuck upper. The mid-top has an Air-assisted foam midsole featuring a gradient blend of grey and black on the top edge for contrast. The eyelets, Jumpman tongue branding and molded heel tab appear in Total Orange.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro Tinker Black Cement Gold
description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro Tinker SP 'Black Cement' puts an elevated build on its classic construction. The shoe's upper is built with a mix of suede and leather, finished in black and Cement Grey, with a stylized Swoosh on the quarter panel. Reflective detailing appears on the Swoosh and perforated panels, with metallic gold upper eyelets accenting the look. Underfoot, a visible Air unit in the heel provides cushioning, giving way to a rubber outsole for traction.

In 2014, Jordan Brand dropped the Air Jordan 3 'Sport Blue', a riff on the Air Jordan 3 'Black Cement'. The sneaker combines on the eyestay, internal lining, tongue and heel branding the classic black stacked leather upper and gray elephant print. With this retro, True OG branding returns as it features on the tongue the Jumpman logo and on the heel the Nike Air brand. The shoe was published next to the ' Sport Blue ' Air Jordan 6.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro GS 'Washington Wizards' is designed for big kids and is inspired by a colorway Michael Jordan wore during his first season with the NBA team. The shoe features an upper in white tumbled leather with detailing in grey elephant print on the toe wrap, heel overlay and eyestay. A vibrant True Blue dresses the molded eyelets, interior lining, and foam midsole with visible Air-sole cushioning in the heel. The stitched Jumpman branding in a copper hue appears on the tongue while the heel is decorated with a contrasting True Blue Jumpman logo.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro SE-T CO.JP Fire Red Denim
description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro SE-T 'Fire Red' Japan Exclusive released exclusively in Japan. Built with tumbled leather, the upper appears in white, with raw denim making up the elephant-print overlays, inspired by Japanese denim. Fire Red highlights the look throughout, while the translucent heel overlay sports 'Nike' in Japanese characters. Underfoot, visible Air in the heel provides cushioning.

The 2011 reissue of the Air Jordan 3 Retro ‘White Cement’ brings back the OG colorway of the iconic silhouette that introduced elephant print, visible Air cushioning and the Jumpman logo to the Jordan franchise. Constructed from white tumbled leather with Fire Red accents, the mid-top is finished with a second Jumpman hit on the heel panel, replacing the OG Nike Air wordmark.
he Air Jordan 3 'Crimson' comes with a Bright Crimson midsole and lining that stands out against the upper black leather tumbled leather, and features reflective paneling on the top.

shoeName: Jordan 12 Retro Chris Paul Class Of 2003
description: The Air Jordan 12 Retro CP3 'Class of 2003' gives the nod to Chris Paul's high school alma mater, West Forsyth in North Carolina. The shoe's olive upper is built with a mix of nubuck and canvas, with metallic gold eyelets and an embroidered Jumpman on the tongue accenting the look. The sockliner of the left shoe reads 'Class of 2003,' with Chris Paul's personal logo on the right. A Sail midsole contrasts the look underfoot, revealing a two-tone shank plate.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro TD 'White Cement Reimagined' provides new sneaker aficionados a popular Jordan colorway. The mid-top sneaker replicates the appearance of the original 1988 design, featuring an upper in white tumbled leather with forefoot and heel overlays in grey elephant print. A crimson stitched Jumpman on the tongue adds a pop of contrast, while the pre-yellowed heel tab preserves the shoe's vintage style with Nike Air. The foam midsole also has an aged finish and provides lightweight cushioning underfoot.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro ‘Wool’ updates Tinker Hatfield’s classic 1988 design with an unexpected build. The mid-top replaces its customary leather upper and elephant-print detailing with a cozy woolen construction in monochromatic dark grey. Jumpman branding at the tongue and heel continue the all-grey theme, while the midsole and rubber outsole are executed in off-white Sail.

colorway: Summit White/Hydrogen Blue/Legend Blue/Photon Dust/Pure Platinum/Sail
description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro TD 'Lucky Shorts' references Michael Jordan's habit of wearing his UNC shorts underneath his Bulls uniform every game. These sneakers have a white tumbled leather upper with suede overlays. The upper has Legend Blue-colored molded eyelets, matching the Jumpman emblem on the heel tab and the touch of color that livens up the aged foam midsole.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro ‘Infrared 23’ delivers a revised take on the silhouette’s OG White/Cement colorway from 1988. Like the original, the mid-top makes use of a white leather upper with elephant print overlays at the toe and heel. Updates include Infrared eyelets and added hits of basic black coloring on the tongue, collar, midsole and outsole.

The Air Jordan 3 'Black Cement' was originally released as one of the four OG colorways in 1988 and saw several retro releases in 1994, 2001 and 2008 as part of the Air Air Jordan 20/3 Collezione (Countdown) Pack. This release in 2011 is part of commemorating the Air Jordan 3's 23rd anniversary. This version has the Jumpman logo on the tongue and heel segment, which is a non-OG retro release.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro White Cement '88 Dunk Contest (2013)
description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro 88 released in 2013 to commemorate the 25th anniversary of the free-throw line dunk of Jordan. The sneakers display the time at 3:51 pm, the precise time Jordan took off, sealing his win. This was the first Retro since the first retros in 1994 to feature NIKE AIR branding on the heel.

colorway: Pearl Pink/Hyper Orange/Pink Bloom/Pink Glow/Light Aqua/Sail

description: Released in 2024, this version of the Air Jordan 3 Retro OG PS 'Black Cement' has a black tumbled leather upper with grey elephant print forefoot and heel overlays. A red Jumpman logo on the tongue and a Nike Air raised logo on the heel panel provide that signature vibe. A white foam midsole gets a splash of black along the back heel, supported by a grey rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro GS 'Moto' brings a sized-down colorway inspired by Michael Jordan's love of motorsports. A black tumbled leather upper is complemented by green elephant print overlays on the forefoot and heel areas. A red Jumpman icon graces the tongue and heel panel, which has a checkerboard pattern nodding to the motor racing theme. A soft foam midsole packs an exposed Air-sole heel unit for plush cushioning.

The Air Jordan 6 Retro 'Infrared 23' features an upper class Infrared leather with a black midsole, tongue, and heel tab. The sneaker also comes with an icy white translucent outsole, released in February 2014.

Honoring the lauded Paris streetball tournament, the Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Quai 54' dons a white tumbled leather upper with 'Off Noir' suede accents on the collar, eyestay, forefoot and heel. Royal blue touches hit the Jumpman and Quai 54 logos on each tongue, while the aforementioned appear again on the see-through heel panel. An aged, cream-colored midsole is fitted with an exposed Air-sole unit, anchored by a dark grey rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro TD 'Black Cat' 2025 blends black nubuck with a matching patent leather mudguard along with charcoal elephant print forefoot and heel overlays. The Jumpman logo is showcased on the tongue and molded heel tab for an iconic aesthetic. A glossy black foam midsole keeps the monochromatic appeal while providing a plush feel underfoot.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Court Purple' brings subtly vibrant accents to its classic construction. Built with tumbled leather, the upper features a black base, highlighted by Court Purple on the collar, eyelets and midsole. Elephant print marks the forefoot and heel, while the inner tongue and branding add further color to the look. Visible Air in the heel provides cushioning.

The Air Jordan 4023 'Stealth' blends the design of the Air Jordan 40 with cues from the Air Jordan 23. Taking from the latter's 'Stealth' 2008 release, these kicks have a black nubuck upper with deco-stitched details on the side panels. The Jumpman and '23' logos decorate each tongue, while a red Nike logo adorns the heel panel. These shoes ride on a ZoomX foam midsole that partners with a full-length Zoom Strobel for all-around cushioning.

Worn by Justin Timberlake during his Super Bowl LII Halftime show—and released as a surprise drop on the Nike SNKRS app simultaneously—the Air Jordan 3 Retro JTH NRG in ‘White Cement’ combines the classic colorway with a newer Tinker Hatfield design, and features a Swoosh on the lateral side and ‘NIKE’ printed on the medial collar. Timberlake’s embroidered signature is seen on the inside of the tongue.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro SP J Balvin Medellín Sunset (PS)
description: Featuring tropical colors inspired by the Colombian artist's homeland, the J Balvin x Air Jordan 3 Retro PS 'Medellín Sunset' for young kids features an upper in off-white tumbled leather with tonal forefoot and heel elephant print overlays. The heel tab proudly displays J Balvin's iconic smiley face graphic with gradient colors evoking the sunsets of Medellin, while the tongue showcases a gold Jumpman logo. Orange, pink, and violet hues repeat on the rear of the midsole, which rides on a clear rubber outsole.

colorway: Light Orewood Brown/Metallic Gold/Light British Tan/Palomino
description: Designed for older children, the Air Jordan 3 Retro GS in 'Palomino' revitalizes the beloved silhouette with updated materials in subtle, earthy shades. Departing from the conventional leather construction, the upper is expertly crafted from sand-colored suede, while the forefoot and heel are adorned with dark tan elephant print overlays. Metallic gold Jumpman branding accents the tongue and molded heel tab. The sneaker is elevated by an off-white foam midsole, which showcases visible Air-sole cushioning and a subtle hint of brown along the heel. Providing reliable traction, the grey rubber outsole ensures durability on various surfaces.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro SE ‘Quai 54 2018’ features inspiration from the Parisian streetball tournament of the same name. The premium design emerges with black tumbled leather throughout the upper, with suede on the toe and heel replacing the iconic cement print. Instead, the shoe is highlighed by a mix of bright blue, pink and green, which appear on the midsole stabilizer and eyelets. A Quai 54 logo appears on the heel, while the icy blue outsole sports pink and green inserts for a final hit of color.

The Jordan Zion 3 Pink Lotus combines athletic performance with a bold color palette and innovative design to create an eye-catching addition to Jordan's lineup. This shoe merges vibrant colors with Zion Williamson's distinct style to improve its appeal.

The Pink Lotus Zion 3 by Jordan showcases a vivid-pink color scheme with accents in contrasting tones. Made with lightweight, supportive materials for flexibility, the upper includes breathable mesh paired with synthetic overlays. Inspired by Zion Williamson's unique approach, the shoe has his logo on the tongue and heel, with a small Jumpman logo on the sole of the heel. A responsive cushioning system supports dynamic movement on the court. Jordan’s design influence improves the shoe’s recognizable silhouette.

Something we love about the Jordan Zion 3 Pink Lotus is the cushioning technology, which optimizes your agility during quick movements. Also, the textured outsole gives you effective grip for multidirectional play. The shoe retailed at $140 when it was released on January 30, 2024.

The simple colorway of the Air Jordan 3 ‘5Lab3’ takes a backseat to its construction, which takes the Jordan 5’s signature 3M reflective material and puts it all over the Jordan 3. As a result, the shoe's all-black upper shines in light, while the Air-infused midsole maintains the Jordan 3’s tooling. An icy blue outsole adds color underfoot.

The Jordan Tatum 3 Zero Days Off pays homage to Jayson Tatum’s work ethic and dedication to his craft with a colorful colorway full of design elements associated with the basketball player.

Dressed in a tranquil seafoam green as the base, apricot agate and soft earthy tones are mixed into the wavy design that blends performance tech with a Zen-inspired aesthetic. The curvy-lined upper of this Tatum 3 Air Jordan shoe features mesh, suede, and nylon overlays that shift between textures, from perforated grids to smooth embroidery. An embroidered JT logo adorns the tongue. Underfoot, there is responsive Zoom Air and a Cushlon 3.0 midsole on the semi-translucent rubber outsole.

In our opinion, a standout design element of the Jordan Tatum 3 Zero Days Off colorway is the motivational aspect, with the phrases "Do The Work" and "Never Settle" on the heel tags echoing the hours of discipline behind every game. Released on October 17, 2024, this sneaker sold for $125 retail.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro GS ‘Vintage Floral’ has a white tumbled leather upper with pink elephant print heel and forefoot overlays. The Jumpman logo adorns the tongue, back tab and insoles, while the inside gets a floral print knit lining. These shoes have a two-tone foam midsole with an exposed Air-sole heel unit supported by a pink rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan Tatum 3 Highlights delivers a refined and performance driven take on Jayson Tatum’s signature silhouette through a soft and layered color palette. Sail and muslin tones create a clean and neutral base, while pale ivory adds warmth that enhances the overall design. Dark iris accents introduce a subtle pop of color, giving the shoe a balanced and expressive feel.

Fans of the Tatum line appreciate how colorways like this blend performance with understated styling, making them versatile on and off the court. The mix of neutral and accent tones gives it a polished and modern look. It is a sneaker that reflects precision and creativity within a performance focused design.

The Air Jordan Tatum 3 Highlights was released on March 4, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro GS 'Top 3' is a grade-school shoe with a hybrid colorway. Drawing from three OG looks, the 'Black/Silver Metallic' becomes apparent on the shoe's black nubuck upper. The '23' and midsole instead draw from the 'Fire Red,' although the shark-tooth detailing is still taken from the former. Finally, the tongue sports a look borrowed from the 'Grape.'

Giving the nod to the Georgetown Hoyas, the Air Jordan 3 Retro GS 'Georgetown' is a grade-school shoe. Built with tumbled leather, the shoe's upper appears in Midnight Navy, with elephant print marking the toe and heel overlays. A synthetic leather mudguard supports the fit, while underfoot, a contrasting white polyurethane midsole houses visible Air in the heel for cushioning.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro goes greyscale, thanks to a tumbled leather upper in a refined Wolf Grey finish. The neutral shade is accentuated by contrasting black hits on the tongue, collar, heel, eyelets and midsole. The shoe’s signature elephant print overlays are given a new look, with metallic silver accents standing out in relief against a black backdrop.

shoeName: Jordan Tatum 3 Year of the Snake

description:
The Air Jordan Tatum 3 Zen are a striking pro basketball shoe designed by NBA star Jayson Tatum. Incorporating technology designed for the game without skimping on style designed for life, these Tatums bring a new level of lightweight performance to the game.

Primarily in white, gray, back, and Vapor Green, the Zen Air Jordan Tatum 3 deliver an intricate design. Compartmentalized waves with different textiles in each on the upper are separated by black outlines and continue down mid and outsoles for a contained, stylish look. Midsoles have cushioned foam and Air Zoom Unit for rebound, and the shoes provide a solid structure, despite being incredibly light. A teal JT logo appears on the tongue, while the Jumpman sits on the outer upper. Rubber outsoles provide the traction needed for quick turns.

We love how the design of these Tatum’s spreads from the upper downwards to contain the whole shoe in one slick move. Also great for lifestyle sneaker fans, the Air Jordan Tatum 3 Zen performance shoe was released on November 14, 2024, priced at $125.

The Air Jordan 8 'Three-Peat,' also known as the 'Three Time's A Charm,' celebrates Michael Jordan's first three-peat NBA championship season. The colorway includes hues from the LA Lakers, the Portland Trail Blazers, and the Phoenix Suns — the teams from 1991 to 1993 who had to settle for second place. Released in October 2015, the sneaker also includes a distinctive tongue-branding graphic of the NBA championship trophy.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro pares down for this exclusive women’s colorway. In addition to a subtly deconstructed build that employs less padding on the collar, the upper's monochromatic design finshes the look beautifully. The suede upper is dipped in a wine-red Bordeaux, as are the smooth leather overlays that replace the AJ3’s original elephant print. Off-white Sail provides contrast on the midsole.

colorway: Pearl Pink/Hyper Orange/Pink Bloom/Pink Glow/Light Aqua/Sail

description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro PS 'White Cement Reimagined' is a downsized version of the classic sneaker perfect for little kids. The shoe features the iconic OG colorway of Tinker Hatfield's 1988 design, and like the original, features an upper in white tumbled leather with overlays in the ubiquitous grey elephant print on the forefoot and heel. Stitched in Fire Red on the tongue is the Jumpman logo, while the molded heel tab displays traditional Nike Air branding. The sneaker is supported by a lightweight foam midsole with a vintage look provided by its pre-yellowed finish.

The 2018 kids’ edition of the Air Jordan 3 Retro OG ‘Black Cement’ brings back the iconic colorway of the legacy silhouette. The build is faithful to the original, featuring a black tumbled leather upper with elephant-print overlays at the toe and heel. A red embroidered Jumpman at the tongue is complemented by Nike Air branding on the heel panel.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Cyber Monday' followed 2015's Air Jordan 1 'Cyber Monday' with a smiliar two-tone look. The shoe's premium leather upper is finished entirely in black, sporting a mix of smooth and tumbled leather. The Jumpman on the tongue and heel add non-OG branding, while the midsole, which houses visible Air in the heel, is contrasted in white.

The 2016 grade-school edition of the Air Jordan 3 Retro OG ‘True Blue’ brings back an always popular OG colorway from 1988. The mid-top complements its crisp white leather upper with elephant print overlays and hits of True Blue at the eyelets, collar lining and midsole. An embroidered red Jumpman at the tongue complements Nike Air branding on the heel.

colorway: Summit White/Hydrogen Blue/Legend Blue/Photon Dust/Pure Platinum/Sail
description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro PS 'Lucky Shorts' calls back to Michael Jordan's gametime tradition of wearing UNC shorts underneath his Chicago uniform. A white tumbled leather upper is bolstered with suede overlays and touched with Carolina Blue molded eyelets. An embroidered Jumpman embellishes the tongue, while another Jumpman logo is embossed on the heel tab. The off-white foam midsole gets a splash of Legend Blue on the heel to highlight the look.

The 2025 edition of the Air Jordan 3 Retro PS 'Pure Money' rocks a white leather upper with pale grey elephant print forefoot and heel overlays. Metallic silver details land on the molded upper eyelets and the Jumpman decorating the tongue, while another adorns the heel tab. A matching white foam midsole couples with a classic rubber outsole below.

Limited to just 2,323 pairs, this 2008 collaboration between Levi’s and Jordan Brand also released with a pair of limited edition co-branded jeans and a t-shirt. The Levi’s x Air Jordan 1 Retro ‘23/501 Denim Pack’ puts a navy denim base on Michael Jordan's first signature shoe, working a Varsity Red elephant print into the construction. The leather overlays add Varsity Red, while a subdued tan Swoosh matches the outsole.

Celebrating the Jordan Brand Wings initiative, a global scholarship program first introduced in 2015, the Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Wings' showcases a white leather upper, contrasted by red and teal eyelets and classic grey elephant print overlays on the forefoot and heel. A twill desaturated floral print decorates the midfoot, collar and eyestay, while more florals can be seen through the back tab. A red embroidered Jumpman adorns the tongue, while a tag inside reads 'Up, rose … I, too, have thorns.' Anchoring it all, a foam midsole fitted with an exposed Air-sole heel unit works in tandem with a pink rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro GS ‘Desert Elephant’ stays true to the original released in 1988 with updated details. The familiar elephant print dresses the upper’s overlays in brown suede while a contrasting grey suede with textural perforations appears on the tongue, eyestay and collar. Branding is featured on the tongue with a Jumpman in orange which is also repeated on the heel, while custom black-and-white graphics adorn the sockliner.

Bringing back the 2007 colorway, the Air Jordan 3 Retro GS 'Cool Grey' 2021 released in February 2021, appearing here in grade-school sizes. The shoe's upper is built with leather, finished entirely in grey and complemented by tonal elephant print at the toe and heel. The molded eyelets accent the look in Orange Peel, while Sport Red hits highlight the branding. Underfoot, visible Air in the heel of the midsole provides cushioning.

The 2011 edition of the Air Jordan 3 Retro ‘True Blue’ celebrates the 23rd anniversary of the classic silhouette. The release is mostly true to the original, highlighted by a tumbled white leather upper with True Blue accents and grey elephant-print overlays along the toe, heel and eyestay. A red Jumpman on the tongue is matched by a second Jumpman icon on the heel, in lieu of the OG Nike Air branding.

Tinker Hatfield’s classic design gets a familiar color treatment in the Air Jordan 3 Retro GS ‘Dark Iris,’ a hoops favorite for big kids. With a white upper in tumbled leather as the backdrop, overlays in the trademark elephant print appear on the forefoot and heel intersected by hits of purple on the tongue’s Jumpman, the eyelets and the suede collar. Underfoot, the sneaker is built on a white PU midsole outfitted with an Air-sole unit atop another hit of purple supporting the heel. The heel tab features additional Jumpman branding.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro GS 'Hide N' Sneak' is made for older kids and pays tribute to 2023 Children's Day with a versatile colorway of the iconic silhouette. The upper is constructed with white tumbled leather, accentuated by grey elephant print overlays at the forefoot and heel. The tongue is adorned with a stitched Jumpman, while a molded Jumpman icon embellishes the back tab. Providing cushioning and impact protection is the two-tone midsole in shades of grey and Sail.

Appearing in a citrus color palette designed especially for kids is the Air Jordan 3 Retro GS ‘Kumquat.’ The familiar elephant print overlays arrive in orange and black and combine with black leather on the upper. The Jumpman branding on the heel and tongue, collar lining in textile and molded eyelets contribute additional hits of Team Orange. Underfoot, the PU midsole features an Air-sole unit in the heel and rides on a rubber outsole with a marbled finish.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro TD 'Georgia Peach' brings a white tumbled leather upper, contrasted with orange eyelets and reinforced with grey elephant print accents on the forefoot and heel. The Jumpman logo appears on the tongue and the back of the heel. A touch of grey wraps around the midsole heel, finished with an aged off-white coating to give these shoes a lived-in look.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro TD ‘Midnight Navy’ features robust grey elephant-print overlays on the forefoot and heel against a white tumbled-leather upper. Midnight Navy-hued Jumpman branding embellishes both the tongue and the molded back tab. The two-tone foam midsole guarantees lightweight cushioning and rides on a grippy grey rubber outsole, while the cushioned mid-cut collar ensures a snug and cozy fit.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Black Flip' blows up the silhouette’s signature elephant print detailing, applying the print throughout the mid-top’s black leather upper. The monochromatic finish is accented with Jumpman branding on the heel and black leather tongue. Additional hits of black appear on the shoe’s tumbled leather overlays and Air cushioned midsole, the latter reinforced by a grey rubber outsole.

shoeName: Nike Zoom Vapor AJ3 Fire Red
description: A collaboration between Jordan Brand and Roger Federer, the Zoom Vapor Tour AJ3 'Fire Red' features a look inspired by the Air Jordan 3 'Fire Red.' The shoe's white leather upper is accented by black elephant print overlays on the heel and toe, with Fire Red accents appearing on the eyelets, branding and midsole. The shoe debuted at the RF19 pop-up shop at Kith Soho in August 2017 ahead of the US Open, receiving a wider release the following month.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro PS 'Georgetown' is a preschool shoe that gives the nod to the Georgetown Hoyas, who lost the 1982 title to Michael Jordan and North Carolina. Appearing in a school colorway, the shoe's upper is built with tumbled leather, finished in Midnight Navy and complemented by Cement Grey throughout. Elephant print marks the forefoot and heel, while underfoot, a white foam midsole provides cushioning.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro LS ‘Cool Grey’ launched in 2006, updating the iconic silhouette with Jordan Brand’s always popular color scheme. The neutral hue is applied throughout the smooth nubuck upper, accented with elephant-print overlays on the toe and heel. Contrasting pops of color appear on the shoe’s orange eyelets and red Jumpman logo hits at the tongue and heel.

Following Air Jordan 1 collaboration, the partnership between Jordan and Vogue expanded to Air Jordan 3. The top features a complete black tweed upper, inspired by the appreciation of tweed suits from Anna Wintour. Premium leather details are also used on the upper side in both black and Sail accents, while ' AWOK ' is stamped on the shoe's heel, which is ' Anna Wintour OK '

Dressing the vintage 1988 silhouette in a black nubuck upper with signature elephant-print overlays at the forefoot and heel is the Air Jordan 3 Retro GS 'Pine Green.' The kids' shoe has lush green accents on the eyelets, a perforated leather collar, and embroidered Jumpman branding on the tongue. A secondary Jumpman logo rests on the sneaker's back heel, with the mid-top being built on a two-tone polyurethane midsole, fitted with visible Air-sole cushioning in the heel and reinforced by a durable rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro OG PS 'Rare Air' sports a black tumbled leather upper with charcoal and light grey suede forefoot and heel overlays, respectively. The blue midsole matches the collar as well as the inside of the tongue, which has a red Jumpman on the opposite side. More red lands on the heel tab, with the right shoe showcasing a flipped logo that comes off as a factory defect.

The Air Jordan 3 5Lab3 ‘Reflective Silver’ features a design inspired by one of the signature elements of the Air Jordan 5 – the silhouette’s 3M reflective tongue. Here, the unique treatment is rendered entirely across the shoe’s leather upper, with the neutral silver tone contrasted by pops of black on the laces and midsole. An additional homage to the 5 is seen on the translucent outsole.

Originally a 2010 release, the Air Jordan 3 Retro ‘Doernbecher’ 2013 re-released three years later. Designed by Cole Johanson while he was fighting cancer, the shoe features a Varsity Red upper accented by a diamond pattern throughout. Red elephant print emerges on the overlays, while black accents create a ‘Bred’ look, an intentional choice by Johanson. ‘COURAGE’ and ‘STR3NGTH’ appear on the insole, with Cole’s name subtly etched into the base and spaghetti and chocolate designs inside the back flap.

The Air Jordan Luka 3 Blurred Vision delivers a vibrant and performance driven take on Luka Dončić’s signature silhouette through a dynamic mix of colors. Vapor green creates a bright and energetic base, while cone, psychic purple, and hyper jade accents add layers of contrast that give the design a fast and expressive feel. The structure emphasizes agility and control on the court.

Fans of the Luka line appreciate how bold colorways like this reflect his creative style and on court energy. The mix of tones creates a standout look while maintaining performance focus. It is a sneaker that reflects innovation and personality within a modern signature series.

The Air Jordan Luka 3 Blurred Vision was released on July 30, 2024 with a retail price of $130.

The 2025 version of the Air Jordan 3 Retro TD 'Pure Money' dons a white leather upper with pale grey elephant print forefoot and heel overlays. Metallic silver upper eyelets stand out, matching the Jumpman logo decorating the tongue and heel tab. A matching white foam midsole wraps up this classic design.

shoeName: Jordan Tatum 3 Welcome to the Garden Alternate (GS)

description: The Air Jordan 13 Retro 'CP3 Home' features a look based on an unreleased player exclusive model that was made for Chris Paul during his time with the New Orleans Hornets. Released in China in 2015, the shoe features a white leather upper with white quilted overlays complemented by Blue Lagoon on the underlays and midsole. The tongue sports a Court Purple CP3 logo, while both colors come together on the outsole.

shoeName: Jordan Flight Origin 3 White Midnight Navy Neutral Grey
Jordan Zion 3 Black Vivid Purple Barely Volt Solar Red (GS)

description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro PS 'Cement Grey' shoes the unmistakable elephant print on the eyestay, as well as the forefoot and heel overlay, standing out on the white tumbled leather upper. A red Jumpman logo enlivens the tongue, while a matching one can be found on the heel tab. These little kids' shoes ride on a lightweight foam midsole for a comfortable feel underfoot.

Bringing back an iconic colorway from its original release, the Air Jordan 3 Retro TD 'Fire Red' makes a triumphant return in 2022. This shoe holds significant historical value as it introduced the iconic Jumpman logo to the world. This shoe's tongue is stitched with a crimson Jumpman logo against the clean white upper in tumbled leather, with grey elephant-print overlays gracing the forefoot and heel. The molded heel tab showcases color-matched Nike branding for a nostalgic flair. Offering lightweight cushioning, the two-tone foam midsole ensures a comfortable experience with every step.

Part of the Countdown Pack in 2008, the Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Countdown Pack' features a colorway similar to the silhouette's OG 'Black Cement' look. Featuring a tumbled leather upper, elephant overlays accent the toe and heel. Red on the branding, eyelets and lining completes a familiar 'Bred' look, while the heel sports a Jumpman rather than the usual Nike Air branding.

shoeName: Jordan Luka 3 TB White Grey Fog
description:
The Air Jordan Luka 3 TB White Grey Fog delivers a slightly softer and more refined variation of the team bank silhouette through a muted color palette. The white upper creates a clean base, while grey fog accents add depth and subtle contrast. Black elements provide structure, keeping the design balanced.

Fans of understated colorways appreciate how this version blends neutral tones to create a versatile and wearable look. The combination of white and grey gives it a modern and polished feel. It is a sneaker that reflects performance and simplicity within the Luka signature line.

A grade-school shoe, the Air Jordan 3 Retro GS 'Racer Blue' features the color-blocking of the OG 'Fire Red' with cooler hues. The shoe's upper is built with white tumbled leather, overlaid by elephant print on the toe and heel and complemented by Racer Blue throughout, including on the polyurethane midsole underfoot. Visible Air in the heel offers cushioning, with a Cement Grey rubber outsole providing traction.

The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE 'Rivals' pays tribute to Michael Jordan's rivals over his storied career. His first signature shoe emerges with a blue tongue tag and orange Jumpman as a nod to the New York Knicks, with Gym Red and black on the collar to callout the Portland Trailblazers and Field Purple and yellow on the Swoosh branding to represent the Los Angeles Lakers. Finally, the toe box sports a royal blue finish for the Detroit Pistons. Underfoot, Air in the midsole provides the usual cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan Zion 3 Mud, Sweat and Tears
Jordan 3 Retro & Nike Air Max 1 atmos Pack
description: Released for Air Max Day in March 2017, the Atmos x Air Jordan 3 Retro & Air Max 1 'Safari Pack' is a two-pack comprised of the Air Max 1 'Elephant Print' and an Air Jordan 3 decked out in a Air Safari-inspired colorway. The Air Max 1 retains the design of the original, with the addition of Jumpman branding on the outsole. The Jordan 3 features a black nubuck and leather upper with a safari print trim, orange accents, and green Nike Air branding.
Based on 2015's Air Jordan 1 'Cyber Monday,' the 2016 Air Jordan 3 Retro BG 'Cyber Monday' features a complete white sole black leather upper and Jumpman branding on the tongue and heel.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro SE Dunk on Mars (GS)

description: Originally exclusive to ComplexCon, the Nike Air Jordan Retro High OG NRG in 'Gold Top 3' made waves before later becoming available online for Cyber Monday in 2017. The distinct feature of this iteration is the mis-matched patent leather construction, paying homage to the iconic 2016 Air Jordan 1 'Top 3' shoe. This highly sought-after release reimagines the revered black and metallic gold patent colorway of the Air Jordan 1.

A performance court shoe is delivered in a heritage colorway with the Air Jordan 36 ‘Black Infrared.’ The upper appears in black Leno-Weave bolstered by a TPU ribbon and secured with reflective laces, while the collar arrives in synthetic nubuck. Infrared dresses the heel tab, Jumpman branding and Phylon midsole, the latter featuring a Zoom Air Strobel and forefoot Zoom Air unit. Quick moves on the court are ensured by the clear rubber outsole with strategically patterned tread.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro Flyknit 'Black' features a subdued colorway on its updated build. Maintaining the classic shape of the shoe, a patterned Flyknit construction emerges throughout the build. Panels at the toe and heel recreate the signature elephant print detailing, while the Air-infused midsole gives way to the contrasting outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro Premium Heiress Metallic Silver (GS)
description: A girls'-exclusive shoe, the Air Jordan 3 Retro Premium HC GG 'Chrome' is defined by its smooth leather upper, which has been finish in a vibrant metallic chrome. Cool Grey suede emerges on the tongue, collar and eyestay, with both colors on the traditional elephant print overlays, while the crisp white tooling, which includes visible Air in the heel, contrasts the look.

In honor of the 30th anniversary of the Air Jordan 3, Nike released a Premium ‘Brown’ colorway of the sneaker’s Golf silhouette. Boasting a tonal leather upper, the shoe also features an elephant print across the toe box and heel, and bronze metal detailing on the eyestay and eyelets. Completing the look are a supportive full-length Lunarlon midsole in white, and a Nike Golf shield logo on the back heel.

shoeName: Nike Zoom Vapor AJ3 Racer Blue
Jordan 3 Retro SP J Balvin Medellín Sunset (TD)
description: A mid-top shoe for little kids, the J Balvin x Air Jordan 3 Retro TD 'Medellín Sunset' takes inspiration from the Colombian artist's homeland. The off-white tumbled leather upper features tonal forefoot and heel elephant print overlays. A gradient blend of orange, pink, and violet hues adorns the heel tab and foam midsole, emulating the colors of the Medellin skies at dusk. Alternating Nike and J Balvin branding appears on the heel.

colorway: Light Orewood Brown/Metallic Gold/Light British Tan/Palomino
description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro TD 'Palomino' for little kids utilizes a sand-toned suede upper enhanced by rich dark tan elephant-print forefoot and heel overlays. The off-white foam midsole has a hint of chocolate brown at the heel and rides on a reliable grey rubber outsole that ensures stability with every step. The mid-top’s molded heel tab and tongue display gilded Jumpman branding with a touch of beige nubuck.

In 2018, thirty years after its debut, Nike celebrated its iconic Air Jordan 3 by re-releasing the fan-favored ‘Black Cement’ colorway—this time for toddlers. The sneaker’s black leather upper and Cement Grey accents are maintained while its red exclusive Jumpman branding is made miniature.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro Do the Right Thing (DTRT)
description: Inspired by Spike Lee's 1989 film Do The Right Thing's poster, this limited 2007 Air Jordan 3 Retro Lifestyle comes with an upper Brisk Blue suede, elephant print panels, and heel and toe accents of Pro Gold. It also features a gray tongue with a Jumpman Radiant Green embroidered, Radiant Green toe stitching, and a noticeable Radiant Green air unit.

colorway: Light Orewood Brown/Metallic Gold/Light British Tan/Palomino
description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro PS 'Palomino' for little kids showcases an ivory-toned suede upper complemented by intricate dark tan elephant print forefoot and heel overlays. A golden Jumpman emblem is featured on the molded heel tab while a matching stitched version appears on the beige nubuck tongue. An off-white PU midsole is equipped with a chocolate brown wrap and visible Air-sole cushioning unit at the heel.

This new edition of the Air Jordan 3 Retro PS 'Fire Red' stays faithful to Tinker Hatfield's original 1988 design, sporting a white tumbled leather upper with the recognizable elephant-print forefoot and heel overlays. The scarlet Jumpman logo embellishes the tongue, matching the raised Nike logo that graces the heel tab. These kicks have a two-tone midsole enlivened by a layer of red.

Inspired by Michael Jordan saying, 'By the time you see me coming, it's too late,' the Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Joker' features a stealthy colorway with vibrant accents. The shoe's black leather upper includes elephant print overlays, while Electric Green and Canyon Purple hits recall the shoe's namesake Batman villain. Visible Air in the heel provides cushioning, and the shoe released for the 2013 NBA All-Star Game.

Celebrating the 30th anniversary of Michael Jordan's first All-Star MVP award and his second Slam Dunk Contest win, the Air Jordan 3 Retro GS 'Hall of Fame' features a leather upper in white, black and Cement Grey, accented by elephant print and Fire Red details. Originally designed as a Player Exclusive, the sneaker was later auctioned to support Hurricane Katrina relief efforts and was showcased during Jordan’s Basketball Hall of Fame induction.

One of four OG colorways of the silhouette in 1988, the Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Fire Red' 2013 was the second retro of the look. Featuring a white tumbled and smooth leather upper, the look is complemented by the signature elephant print in black. Fire Red on the midsole, ankle and branding completes the Chicago Bulls look, while the Jumpman on the heel separates it from the launch colorway.

The Jordan Tatum 3 GS '6th Man' commemorates the Boston Celtics' devoted fan base, using multiple shades of green on the paneled mesh and knit upper. Jayson Tatum's JT logo on the tongue and a Jumpman logo etched on the forefoot. A collapsible heel allows for easy on and off. A full-length Cushlon midsole is housed within a rubber cupsole underfoot.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Triple White' washes out its iconic basketball construction, with a colorway even more minimalist than 2007's 'Pure Money.' The shoe's smooth and tumbled leather upper appears in white, matched by the elephant print overlays at the toe and heel. The midsole includes visible Air in the heel, while underfoot, the only color is provided by a translucent blue outsole.

The Air Jordan XXXIV Infrared 23 is a basketball shoe from Nike's Jordan brand. 

The Infrared 23 Air Jordan XXXIV features a predominantly Infrared 23 colorway, which is a shade of red and black colors on the midsole, tongue, and heel. The shoe also boosts Nike's innovative FlightSpeed technology, which enhances the shoe's energy return and provides responsiveness. The sneaker has a streamlined design to improve overall performance. It also has a low-cut collar for flexibility and range of motion and incorporates Eclipse Plate technology in the midsole to provide stability and support.

We love the Air Jordan XXXIV Infrared 23 for its modern and unique design. The shoe has a futuristic look that combines both style and performance. A thin, permeable mesh is used to make the upper, which promotes ventilation and comfort. This material is also very durable and ensures the longevity of the sneaker. The Air Jordan XXXIV Infrared 23 was released on March 4, 2020 at a retail price of $180.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro GS 'Chlorophyll' paiys tribute to some of Tinker Hatfield's greatest non-Jordan designs. The AJ3 'Chlorophyll,' debuted in October of 2018 as one of four 'Nike Icons' sneakers, exemplifies Nike Air Trainer 1 lineage with elements that include its Light Smoke Grey and Chlorophyll color palette. Overlays of black leather embossed with AJ's iconic elephant pattern are complemented by a Sail midsole, grey air unit, and multi-toned outsole.

shoeName: Jordan Flight Origin 3 White Black Gym Red
description: The Jordan Flight Origin 3 'Bulls' takes after the Air Jordan 3, using a white leather upper with a red Jumpman logo on the tongue and heel. A matching red Flight logo is etched on the black tumbled leather back tab to complement the design. A two-tone foam midsole works with an exposed Max Air heel unit underfoot.

Nike merged three original Air Jordan 1 colorways (Bred, Chicago, and Royal ) into a fresh colorway in 2016, known as the 'Top 3'. With the Wings logo on the ankle and the Nike Air branding on the insole and tongue, the sneaker comes in mismatched' color panels and outsoles while remaining true to the original design. 'Top 3' also refers to Jordan being drafted third overall in the NBA draft.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Mid Retro MCS Black Cement
description: Based on the OG colorway, the Air Jordan 3 Retro MCS 'Black Cement' rolls out a black tumbled leather upper with grey elephant print overlays on the forefoot and heel areas. A red, embroidered Jumpman logo matches the color of the round eyelets and insoles, while a white Jumpman logo adorns the heel. A cleated outsole delivers smooth traction on the field.

shoeName: Jordan 6-17-23 Black White Red Contrast Stitching

description: A limited-edition 2014 release, the Jordan Future Premium 'Infrared' takes cues from the Air Jordan 11 Retro. Sought after for their lightweight, woven black upper, these shoes have reflective 3M fibers that aid visibility in low-light conditions. A debossed leather Jumpman adorns the tongue, while asymmetrical shoelaces are embellished with golden aglets. The midsole pairs with an 'Infrared' outsole brought together by a carbon fiber plate.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro SE-T JP Fire Red Denim (GS)
description: The Air Jordan 3 SE-T GS 'Fire Red' Japan Exclusive is a grade-school shoe that released exclusively in Japan. The shoe's upper is built with white tumbeled leather, with the elephant print overlays built with raw indigo denim as a nod to Japan's premium repro jeans. The heel includes 'Nike' in Japanese characters, while 'CO.JP' appears on the sockliner. Underfoot, visible Air in the heel provides cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan Hydro III Retro White University Red Cement
description: The Jordan Hydro 3 Retro Slide showcases a foam-injected sole and a Solarsoft footbed, providing incredibly lightweight cushioning while its grooved outsole offers flexibility. The wide leather strap, featuring perforations for enhanced breathability, can be easily adjusted to achieve the ideal fit. Adding stylish touches are the Elephant print on the midsole and the iconic Jumpman logo.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro Golf Black Green Glow
description: With a fresh golf shoe, Jordan Brand is celebrating the 30th anniversary of the iconic Air Jordan 3. The Air Jordan 3 Retro Golf ' Green Glow ' features on the toe box, heel and eyestay a black tumbled leather bottom with contrasting elephant prints. A padded collar, a Lunarlon midsole and a Green Glow outsole are also available on the mid-top. The classic branding of Nike Air was substituted on the heel by the Nike Gold crest.

To celebrate the 30th anniversary of the Air Jordan 3, Nike released a ‘White Cement’ colorway of the sneaker’s Golf silhouette. Sporting an all-white leather upper, the shoe also boasts an elephant pattern on the mudguard, and bright red accents on the Jumpman logo, tongue lining and lower eyelets. Finishing it off is a full-length Lunarlon midsole.

To celebrate Air Max Day in 2017, Japanese streetwear retailer atmos dropped this unique edition of the Air Jordan 3.
