Borrowing design components from the classic atmos 2002 Air Max 1 ' Safari, ' the shoe features an upper black nubuck, toe and heel safari overlays, and reduced eyelet and inner tongue orange accents. Other characteristics include embroidered green branding of Jumpman on the tongue and embossed green branding of Nike Air on the heel. With a Sail and black midsole and an icy blue translucent outsole with orange Nike branding, the classic basketball shoe is completed off.

The Paris Saint-Germain x Jordan Mars 270 'Infrared' is a collaboration between the iconic French soccer club and Jordan Brand. The Jordan Mars 270, a hybrid look inspired by Spike Lee's Mars Blackmon, emerges in a mix of Infrared 23, Reflect Silver and black on its tumbled leather and mesh build, accented by PSG branding on the quarter panel flag and heel. Underfoot, the midsole incorporates a bold Max Air unt in the heel, with an icy translucent outsole providing traction.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro PS 'Cardinal Red' is made for little kids and showcases familiar colors inspired by the Air Jordan 7. The dark scarlet hue appears on the upper eyelets, collar lining, and Jumpman heel logo, making the details pop against a white tumbled leather backdrop. Grey elephant print overlays keep the Air Jordan 3 aesthetic. Lightweight cushioning comes from a two-tone foam midsole with a durable grey rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro BG ‘Infrared 23’ showcases a straightforward colorway that delivers a twist on the OG ‘White/Cement’ offering from 1988. A crisp white leather upper is accented with contrasting hits of black on the collar, tongue, eyestay and midsole. The kicks are finished with the silhouette’s signature elephant print overlays and vibrant pops of Infrared on the eyelets and Air sole unit.

The Jordan System.23 ‘Sail Cement’ rocks the iconic elephant print on the detachable inner bootie, made with stretchy knit and tooled with pull tabs for easy on and off. The sock-like sleeve is housed in a lightweight foam shell, while perforations on the upper enhance breathability. A lone embossed Jumpman on the side of the heel adorns the look.

Inspired by the 2008 advertising campaign "Be Legendary" by Jordan Brand, this colorway of the Air Jordan 3 features an upper Night Stadium leather with Total Orange accents. The sneaker comes with elephant overlays, a black and white spotted midsole, and a black outsole. The ' Fear Pack ' released in August 2013 also included colorways for the silhouettes Jordan 4 and Jordan 5.

Designed specifically for toddlers, the Air Jordan 3 Retro TD 'Cardinal Red' offers a miniature rendition of the iconic silhouette. Crafted with a white tumbled leather upper, this shoe incorporates a touch of familiarity from the Air Jordan 7 in the form of a vibrant crimson accent. The striking cardinal red hue adorns the Jumpman logo on the heel, the collar lining, and the cushioned foam midsole. An additional nod to the OG-inspired look appears via grey elephant overlays. The tongue features a stitched orange Jumpman, creating a contrasting and eye-catching detail.

Introducing the Air Jordan 3 Retro TD 'Dark Iris,' a downsized rendition of the iconic silhouette tailored for a younger generation of Jordan enthusiasts. The upper arrives in white tumbled leather with the forefoot and heel adorned by the unmistakable elephant print overlays. The tongue and molded heel tab are embellished with Jumpman branding. The perforated suede collar and plush foam midsole display vibrant violet accents and help ensure a cushioned and comfortable experience for young feet.

A sized-down version of the original, the Air Jordan 3 Retro TD ‘Green Glow’ is made from black tumbled leather and grey elephant print overlays on the forefoot, eyestay and the heel. Fluorescent green accents liven up the eyelets, matching the Jumpman logos on the heel and tongue. The foam midsole is soft and lightweight while the rubber outsole gives you smooth traction underfoot.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro BG 'Sport Blue' updates the silhouette’s original Black/Cement colorway with an additional pop of color. The mid-top sports a black leather upper with Sport Blue hits on the collar lining, eyelets and midsole. OG details remain intact, including elephant print overlays and a visible Air sole cushioning. The kicks are finished with Jumpman branding at the tongue and heel.

This Air Jordan Legacy 312 features white, light brown and navy color scheme is borrowed from the ‘Medicine Ball’ colorway of the Air Trainer III, the cross-training shoe commonly associated with two-sport phenom Bo Jackson. The 312 silhouette takes its name from Chicago’s 312 area code, while the shoe’s hybrid design is drawn from models worn by Michael Jordan - such as the Jordan 1, Jordan 3 and Nike Air Alpha Force Low.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro SE Fire Red Denim (GS)
Jordan Why Not Zer0.3 Zer0 Noise
description:
The Air Jordan Why Not Zer0.3 Zer0 Noise was released as part of a collaborative effort between Nike and NBA star Russell Westbrook. It was part of the Why Not Zer0.3 collection, a part of the Air Jordan line.

The shoe’s upper is made from a mix of lightweight mesh and synthetic overlays, which provide breathability on the foot during intense court action. The upper also showcases an avant-garde aesthetic, highlighted by angular lines and contrasting color accents, true to Westbrook's unique fashion sensibilities. The "Zer0 Noise" colorway typically combines vibrant hues and bold patterns, with a white base complemented by Neutral Gray accents.

A standout feature on the Air Jordan Why Not Zer0.3 Zer0 Noise is the sole unit, which consists of Zoom Air and foam units to ensure optimal impact protection and energy return, as well as a multidirectional traction pattern to provide grip. The shoe was initially released for retail at the price of $130 on January 2nd, 2020.

shoeName: Jordan Why Not Zer0.3 White Bright Crimson Black
description: The Air Jordan Why Not Zer0 3 White Bright Crimson Black is a high-performance basketball shoe designed for explosive players who demand speed and agility on the court. The shoe features a lightweight and breathable upper made of mesh and synthetic materials, with a secure lace-up closure for a snug fit. The midsole is equipped with Zoom Air units in the forefoot and heel for responsive cushioning and impact protection. The outsole is made of durable rubber with a multidirectional traction pattern for superior grip and control. The colorway combines white, bright crimson, and black for a bold and dynamic look. The Air Jordan Why Not Zer0 3 White Bright Crimson Black was released on January 16, 2020, and retails for $130.

The Air Jordan 1 Low SE GS 'Mismatched Infrared' features an asymmetrical design inspired by 'home' and 'away' basketball uniforms, designed for older kids. The upper includes a toe box in white perforated leather and white jersey-inspired textile on the quarter panel. Alternating leather accents include a left-shoe black heel with Infrared accents on the signature Swoosh and forefoot overlay, with the opposite combination on the right. Underfoot, mismatched rubber outsoles in black and Infrared complement a clean white midsole.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro GS 'Rio Teal' is a grade-school exclusive colorway, featuring a black tumbled leather upper complemented by Rio Teal on the elephant print overlays and perforated collar. The tongue, heel and eyelets add metallic gold to the look, which is contrasted by a white midsole. Visible Air in the heel provides cushioning.

Paying homage to Zion Williamson's offseason training facility's stained glass windows is the Jordan Zion 3 'Sanctuary.' The textile upper exhibits a gradient blend that transitions from fuchsia to violet and emerald hues. Cushioning courtesy is delivered by the drop-in midsole, constructed with Formula 23 foam and featuring a responsive forefoot Zoom Air unit. Innovative glossy mud-splatter graphics are derived from 3D imaging of Zion's foot last in motion through mud, while teal accents arrive via the tongue’s Jumpman icon and Zion's personal logo on the back heel.

The Air Jordan 1 Low 'Rivals' displays a new iteration of the iconic shoe form, updated in Black and Court Purple-University Gold-Bright Crimson-Game Royal-White. Its upper spotlights a leather base with overlays and the standard Wings’ Logo. On the upper, a Swoosh emphasizes the design with a Nike branded nylon tongue. The Air-sole is built on top of a rubber outsole with a circular design for traction.

The Jordan 6-17-23 ‘Black Metallic Silver’ is an elegant reinterpretation that evokes past models of both the Air Jordan 6 and 17. Airy perforations and overlays with stitched embellishment layer the upper in black nubuck which repeats in black leather on the heel and mid-cut collar panels. A black Phylon midsole with an interior Air-sole unit in the forefoot and heel rides on a clear rubber outsole with pods of herringbone-patterned traction for superior grip on the court. Air Jordan branding adorns the tongue and the heel displays a tonal Jumpman logo.

Although it releaesd after he'd been traded to the Los Angeles Clippers, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High 'CP3' features a look inspired by the New Orleans Hornets, who drafted him in 2005. The shoe's nubuck, leather and mesh upper is finished in a mix of Midnight Navy, University Blue and white, with Chris Paul's logo replacing the usual Nike Air branding. The shoe released alongside Carmelo Anthony and Blake Griffin models.

The 2023 Air Jordan 3 Retro PS 'Fear' reintroduces a dark and subtle colorway from 2013, made for pre-schoolers, to mark the 35th anniversary of this iconic shoe. The upper part of the shoe arrives in dark grey nubuck, with matching elephant print overlays on the front and back. The shoe has a three-tone foam midsole for lightweight cushioning. The eyelets, molded back tab, and Jumpman logo appear in Total Orange.

The Air Jordan 8 Retro BG 'Three-Peat' gives the nod to the three teams that Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls defeated during their first run of three NBA titles. A 2015 release, the simple black and white look features purple, yellow and red hits representative of the Los Angeles Lakers, Portland Trailblazers and Phoneix Suns.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro SE Dunk on Mars (TD)
Jordan 3 Retro SP A Ma Maniére (TD)
description: Made with the help of James Whitner's luxury boutique, the A Ma Maniére x Air Jordan 3 Retro SP TD 'Raised By Women' is a toddlers' shoe. Built with a white tumbled leather base, the shoe's upper is overlaid by grey suede and lined with quilted satin, while the tongues include mismatched Jumpman and A Ma Maniére branding. The yellowed heel patch instead sports 'Nike Air,' with the hue matched underfoot by the foam midsole, giving way to a grey rubber outsole that offers traction.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro TD 'Racer Blue' brings classic color-blocking to toddlers' sizes. Built with tumbled leather, the shoe's upper appears in white, overlaid by grey elephant print at the forefoot and heel. The perforated collar, interior tongue and foam midsole all add Racer Blue to the look, while the grey rubber outsole is matched by the perforated eyestay up top.

shoeName: Nike Zoom Vapor AJ3 Black Cement
description: The Nike Zoom Vapor Tour AJ3 contains a black leather upper with cement elephant print overlays on the heel and toe. Also featuring Clear Jade Accents, the sneaker was inspired by the classic Atmos x Air Max 1 'Elephant.' and is a collaboration between Jordan Brand and Roger Federer.

shoeName: Nike Zoom Vapor AJ3 atmos Jade
description: Released three years after the original, the Atmos x Zoom Vapor Tour Air Jordan 3 is Atmos’ twist on Robert Federer’s signature tennis shoe. Brought back in Fall 2017, the silhouette features an elephant print heel and toe, black tumbled leather upper, and Clear Jade accents throughout.

shoeName: Jordan Hydro III Summit White Cement Grey Black Fire Red
description: The Jordan Hydro 3 Retro Slide 'White Cement' takes cues from the iconic OG colorway of the Air Jordan 3. An embroidered red Jumpman logo adorns the synthetic leather midfoot strap. Wavy lines are etched onto the molded footbed, which rides on a lightweight, elephant print midsole.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro AWOK Vogue University Red (Women's)
description: This limited edition of Anna Wintour x Air Jordan 3 ' AWOK ' features an unmistakable tweed design inspired by her known appreciation for tweed suits. On the eyelets, branding, and midsole, the red and black upper are met with premium leather detailing and Sail accents. The approval seal of the Vogue editor, "AWOK," meaning "Anna Wintour OK," finishes the signature display on the tab on the back heel.

Launching in 2007 as a women’s exclusive colorway, this Air Jordan 3 Retro presents a refreshed two-tone take on the legacy silhouette. A tumbled white leather upper is accented with pops of Harbor Blue on the shoe’s eyelets, outsole and branding elements. A lighter shade of blue appears on the silhouette’s signature elephant overlays at the toe and heel.

Releasing for the 23rd anniversary of the Air Jordan 3, the Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Stealth' features a colorway reminiscent of the 'Cool Grey' and 'Black/Cement.' The upper emerges in various grey shades, complemented by black and accented by hits of Varsity Red. Visible Air in the heel provides cushioning.

The Air Jordan 1 Retro Mid 'Top 3' sneaker merges three distinct color schemes from previous AJ1 Retros. The leather upper is adorned with a variety of striking colors. The black nubuck leather is used for the liner, Swoosh, middle eyestays, and mudguard, while the side panels and laces are white and contrast with the tongue in black. Hits of red appear on the toe box and collar, and the heel and forefoot overlays are bright blue. The look is tied together with a plain white and black sole.

shoeName: Jordan Brazil World Cup Pack (AJ6 CP3 III)
description: Inspired by the trademark colors of Brazil, Nike released an exclusive colorway that balances design and function. There are two comparable colorways in the Air Jordan 6 Retro x CP3.VII 'Brazil Pack.' The first sports a black suede bottom on the ankle counter and midsole with leather overlays and multi-color speckles. The second displays an intricate elephant-print pattern with black mesh overlays and matching support Flywire cables. Both shoes for responsive cushioning sport air systems in the midsole.

shoeName: Jordan 12 Retro Chris Paul Class Of 2003 (GS)
description: Crafted for young kids, the Nike Air Jordan 12 Retro CP3 GS ‘Class of 2003’ departs from the typical AJ12 leather construction with a blend of nylon and suede in black and olive, the school colors of Chris Paul's alma mater, West Forsyth High School. The insole includes a 'Class of 2003' inscription and gold-colored metallic lace stays and a sail-colored outsole elevate the overall appeal.

shoeName: Jordan Stay Loyal 3 Wolf Grey White Cool Grey
Jordan 1 Retro Low OG & Jordan Tatum 3 Jayson Tatum Welcome to the Garden Pack

description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro GS ‘Purple Dust’ features a Dark Purple Dust base accented by Blue Cap elephant print overlays. The grade school shoe also sports Atomic Pink hits on the branding and eyelets, while the Blue Cap and white midsole keeps the usual Air in the heel for cushioning. A final hit of Purple Dust emerges on the outsole.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro PS 'Georgia Peach' rolls out a white tumbled leather upper with grey elephant print accents on the forefoot and heel. Grey eyelets match the Jumpman logos on the tongue and the back of the heel. Orange hits make their way around the heel of the midsole, finishing with an off-white coating to give them a vintage aesthetic.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro PS 'White Cobalt Bliss' rolls out a white tumbled leather upper with a padded denim collar and powder blue elephant print forefoot and heel overlays. Pastel pink pops engulf the molded eyelets and the Jumpman on the tongue and heel tab. A white foam midsole keeps every step soft and resilient.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro PS ‘Washington Wizards’ is a version of the classic silhouette designed for little kids, paying tribute to Michael Jordan’s time with the DC-based NBA team. The shoe features a white tumbled leather upper with detailing in grey elephant print on the toe wrap, heel overlay and eyestay. The Jumpman logo on the tongue is embroidered in a dull copper color, while a second Jumpman in True Blue appears on the heel tab, matching the interior lining, molded TPU eyelets, and foam midsole. The circular eyelets also come in a dull copper finish.

shoeName: Jordan Tatum 3 Welcome to the Garden Alternate (PS)

description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro PS 'Hide N' Sneak' honors Children's Day 2023 and offers a kid-friendly version of the beloved sneaker. This model for little feet showcases a neutral color scheme that embraces simplicity. The upper is constructed with white tumbled leather adorned by Cement Grey elephant print overlays. The tongue and molded back tab display the iconic Jumpman logo. For lightweight cushioning, the sneaker features a two-tone foam midsole in contrasting shades of grey and off-white.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro SP A Ma Maniére (PS)
description: Jordan Brand teamed up with James Whitner's luxury boutique to create the A Ma Maniére x Air Jordan 3 Retro SP PS 'Raised By Women.' A preschool iteration of the shoe, the shoe's theme centers around the women in Whitner's life, including the silhouette itself, as it was the first Jordan his mother bought for him. Built with tumbled leather, the shoe's upper appears in white, overlaid by grey suede at the toe and heel and lined by grey quilted satin on the collar and tongue. The tongues themselves sport Jumpman branding on the right shoe and A Ma Maniére on the left, while underfoot, a yellowed foam midsole provides cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan Zion 3 SE M.U.D. Light Bone
Jordan Stay Loyal 3 White Team Red

description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro SE GS ‘Quai 54 2018’ celebrates the annual Parisian streetball tournament of the same name. This grade-school edition of the retro silhouette features a textured black nubuck upper with tonal suede overlays and vibrant pops of color on the eyelets and midsole. Mismatched Jumpman and Quai 54 logos adorn both the tongue and heel of the left and right shoes.

shoeName: Jordan Stay Loyal 3 Black White Metallic Gold

description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro GG 'Barely Grape' is a girls'-exclusive look. The shoe's white leather base is highlighted by an elephant print on the toe and heel, finished in a mix of Barely Grape and Fire Pink. Hyper Crimson marks the Jumpman branding, while the collar and eyestay sport ribbed textile. Underfoot, the midsole houses visible Air in the heel for cushioning.

Featuring a basketball-inspired construction, the Jordan ADG 3 'White Tech Grey' is a golf shoe that draws from the Air Jordan 4. The shoe's leather upper appears in white, with variable eyelets securing the heel. The heel and forefoot include cement detailing, while netting on the tongue continues down onto the vamp. Underfoot, the white and cement look extends to the midsole, which houses Zoom Air in the forefoot for cushioning, with the rubber outsole sporting an integrated pattern for traction.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro GS ‘Crimson’ gives the retro silhouette a minimalist design that stays true to classic Jordan heritage. A black leather upper is accented by pops of Bright Crimson on the eyelets, collar lining and midsole. The shoe’s signature elephant-print overlays, placed in their traditional locations, are tinted in purple, with the same hue reappearing on the rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 13 Retro Premium GS 'Infrared 23' features a mostly neutral color scheme, highlighted by a combination of matte silver leather and black suede on the upper. Contrasting color arrives via the green holographic ‘cat eye’ on the lateral collar and Infrared rubber outsole, both of which are outshone by the 3M reflective treatment applied to the shoe’s silver paneling.

The Air Jordan 9 Retro Premio 'Bin23' is limited to just 1,331 pairs globally and features a premium design, highlighted by a white leather design with a metallic nubuck overlay that wraps around the base of the top and collar. On the midsole, eyelets and tongue tag, the metallic gold decoration remains, while on the lateral collar a Bin23 stamp features a faux wax seal in red.

Part of the premium Bin23 program that showcased unreleased models in unique builds, the Air Jordan 13 Retro Premio ‘Bin23’ released in 2010 in a run of 1,734 pairs. Paying tribute to Michael Jordan's love of cigars, the shoe features a mix of Team Red and Desert Clay on its suede and nubuck upper, with white tumbled leather adding clean contrast. A wax seal replaces the Jumpman on the tongue, while the hologram at the heel and the shank plate underfoot maintain heritage Jordan 13 features.

A collaboration beteween Nike and DJ Khaled that celebrates the producer's career and the birth of his son, the DJ Khaled x Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Grateful' shares a name with DJ Khaled's 2017 album. The Air Jordan 3 build emerges with University Red tumbled leather throughout the upper, accented by the signature elephant overlays on the toe and heel. A unique hang-tag reads 'We the Best,' with the same application on the heel, while the classic tooling includes visible Air.

The Jordan Air Rev 'Bred' has a black waterproof synthetic leather upper, secured with a dial lacing system and a leno weave midfoot strap. Flight Lock technology sports a moveable Air Zoom unit, which is put into a pouch along the sidewall of the golfer's trail foot to put the right level of pressure with every swing. The lead foot has a Formula23 foam insert for plush stability. A red, partially see-through outsole has a built-in traction pattern taken from pressure mapping.

shoeName: Jordan One Take 3 Black White Bright Crimson

description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro GS 'Joker' uses a white tumbled leather upper with purple elephant print overlays. More purple adorns the collar, eyelets and the Jumpman-embossed heel tab. Another Jumpman logo is etched on the tongue. Off-white wraps the heel portion of the foam midsole, aided by Air-sole cushioning underfoot.

In 1985, Michael Jordan wore his eponymous iconic basketball shoe for the first time as a rookie. The Nike Air Jordan 1 Mid BG ‘Infrared 23’ sneaker celebrates that model in sizes made for smaller feet. This kids' AJ1 retains an old-school color blocking scheme in black and red with white on the Swoosh. The white continues on to the rubber midsole that rests above the classic, bouncy cupsole. The solid rubber outsole sports deep grooves to encourage a natural footstrike.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro GS ‘International Flight’ features a unique color scheme lifted from the uniform that Michael wore during an exhibition game in the summer of ‘88. The mid-top features a leather upper in off-white Sail, accented with contrasting pops of Fire Red and Sport Royal on the eyelets and color-blocked midsole. Elephant print overlays in a pale grey shade appear at the toe and heel.

shoeName: Jordan 3 Retro Explorer Lite XX Sail Multi-Color (Women's)
description: A women's-exclusive look, the Wmns Air Jordan 3 RTR EXP Lite 'Sail Blue Void' reimagines the hoops classic. The shoe's upper includes a ripstop collar that extends high above the ankle, with two pull-loops for easy on and off. The varied eyestay allows for a customizable fit while also bringing color to the Sail construction. Underfoot, the tricolor outsole includes visible Air in the heel for cushioning.

Paying homage to the 1988 Olympics, the Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Seoul' sports Korean characters on the inside of each tongue: ‘서울’ (meaning Seoul) on one, and ‘화합과 전진’ (meaning “harmony and progress,” the game’s motto) on the other. The sneaker also draws inspiration from the colors of the South Korean flag, and features black, red, and blue accents on the inner lining and collar. The classic silhouette maintains its white tumbled leather upper and elephant print accents.

The Jordan 6-17-23 ‘Motorsport’ arrives in color blocking that is distinctively reminiscent of design elements from the AJ 6 and 17. Ventilated details and a cushy mid-cut collar distinguish the hybrid silhouette in white leather, with hits of black adorning the stitched Jumpman on the back heel, the molded pull tab and the tongue. The midsole in black with an interior Air-sole unit ensures comfort and support underfoot.

Boys and girls get their own version of the ‘Wolf Grey’ with the Air Jordan 3 Retro BG ‘Wolf Grey.’ Michael Jordan’s third signature shoe features smooth and tumbled Wolf Grey leather throughout the majority of the upper, highlighted by the crackled black and metallic silver elephant print overlays on the toe, heel and eyestay. A padded collar is included for comfort, while partially visible Air provides cushioning in the midsole, which gives way to a translucent gray outsole.

The Jordan Tatum 3 TD '6th Man' uses a mix of mesh and knit on the upper. Black pops land on the Jayson Tatum-branded tongue and knit collar lining. No-tie laces and a webbed heel pull tab allow for easy on and off. Tatum's jersey number is embossed on the foam midsole heel to round out the look.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro OG 'Fire Red' 2020 released in 2020, bringing back the OG colorway of the silhouette. The shoe's upper is built with white leather, accented by hits of Fire Red throughout, including the signature eyelets. Underfoot, the midsole houses visible Air in the heel for cushioning, while a Nike Air logo on the heel completes the throwback look.

Bringing back a 2006 colorway, which released alongside the 'Thunder,' the Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Lightning' 2021 features inspiration from Michael Jordan's motorsports team. The shoe's upper is built with nubuck, finished in Tour Yellow and contrasted by the mesh netting and signature wings. Underfoot, a white PU midsole houses visible Air in the heel to provide cushioning, giving way to a herringbone rubber outsole for traction.

The 2025 version of the Air Jordan 4 Retro PS 'Black Cat' mimics the 2006 OG release, sporting a black nubuck upper tooled with a side panel netting, lockdown wings and molded eyelets. The Jumpman insignia adorns the tongue tag and heel tab. These shoes have a matching black foam midsole for lightweight cushioning with each step.

Looking to one of Michael Jordan's oldest nicknames, the Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Black Cat' 2020 brings back a 2006 colorway. Built with suede, the upper appears entirely in black, save for a hit of Light Graphite on the tongue branding. Underfoot, the Air midsole continues the tonal look, giving way to a rubber outsole for traction.

colorway: Off White/Anthracite/Neutral Grey/Fire Pink/Light Arctic Pink/Muslin

description: The 'Frozen Moments' edition of the Women's Air Jordan 4 Retro showcases an upper made of pale grey suede, accompanied by a glossy leather overlay on the front of the shoe. The throat and quarter panel incorporate breathable netting, while a metallic silver coating adorns the molded eyelets and support wings. The tongue and molded heel tab display Jumpman branding in the same shade. The sneaker's midsole is crafted from grey foam and includes visible Air-sole cushioning in the heel for optimal support.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro SE 'What The 4' combines the silhouette’s four OG colorways on a single pair. The mismatched designs on the left and right shoe both make use of a white leather upper, complete with original details that include a woven flight tongue tag, quarter panel netting, visible Air cushioning on the midsole and Nike Air branding on the heel panel.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro Rare Air Tour Yellow (TD) (2026)

description:
The Air Jordan Tatum 4 Green Glow delivers a vibrant and high energy take on the silhouette through a bold and eye catching color palette. The green glow upper creates a bright and standout base, while black accents add contrast that defines the structure. The overall look feels dynamic and modern, emphasizing speed and movement.

Fans of bright colorways appreciate how this version pushes the silhouette into a more expressive space while maintaining performance focus. The contrast between neon green and black gives it a strong visual identity. It is a sneaker that reflects bold styling within a performance driven design.

The Air Jordan Tatum 4 Green Glow was released on October 23, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

The 2025 version of the Air Jordan 4 Retro TD 'Black Cat' takes cues from the 2006 original release, sporting a black nubuck upper with the classic side panel netting, lockdown wings and molded eyelets. The Jumpman emblem is present on the tongue and heel tab. The black foam midsole maintains the monochromatic aesthetic.

shoeName: Jordan 4 RM SP Nigel Sylvester Driveway Grey
description: The Nigel Sylvester x Air Jordan 4 RM SP 'Driveway Grey' showcases the BMX star's remixed edition of a classic. Crafted with soft suede, the upper has a plastic side panel with molded eyelets built into the lacing system. A red mini-Swoosh is embroidered on the side of the forefoot, while a modified 'Bike Air' logo appears on the heel. Taking cues from the original Air Jordan 4, the midsole equips an exposed Air-sole heel unit for a plush feel.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Red Thunder' uses a similar colorblocking from the 2006 'Thunder' release. These kicks have a black nubuck upper with red pops on the molded eyelets, inside the tongue and the side panel, which has a black window netting. The Jumpman logo appears on the tongue tag and heel tab. These kicks have a red foam midsole with Air-sole technology in the heel.

colorway: Off White/Anthracite/Neutral Grey/Fire Pink/Light Arctic Pink/Muslin
Guava Ice/Light Bone-Brigade Blue-Light Fusion Red
description: A collaboration between Jordan Brand and Union LA, the Union LA x Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Guava Ice' released in 2020 as a follow-up to the brands' joint 2018 effort. Built with pink suede the upper includes mesh at the toe box, quarter panel and collar to provide breathability. The TPU wing sports a semitranslucent finish, while the lateral quarter panel includes a Union LA flag. Underfoot, the yellowed midsole houses visible Max Air in the heel for cushioning.

Released in August 2019 to help celebrate the 30th anniversary of the silhouette, the Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Cool Grey' 2019 brings back a 2004 colorway. The shoe's nubuck upper appears in Cool Grey, with Dark Charcoal providing a complement on the signature eyelets. The tongue sports a Flight tag with a hit of Varsity Maize, while underfoot, a white midsole houses a visible Air unit in the heel. The rubber outsole underfoot includes a herringbone traction pattern.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro OG ‘White Cement’ returned to store shelves in 2016, featuring a design that’s true to the original 1989 release. The build makes use of a white leather upper, accented with speckled Cement Grey hits on the shoe’s structural wings, midsole and heel panel, the latter adorned with Nike Air branding. A red Jumpman logo on the woven Flight tongue tag offers a contrasting pop of color.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro TD Cleat White Cement
description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro TD Cleat 'White Cement' has a white leather upper that keeps the classic AJ4 details, including the traditional side panel netting, black molded eyelets, and grey support wings covered in speckles. A red Jumpman on the woven tongue tag adds a dash of color. Another Jumpman logo adorns the speckled grey heel tab. Wide-placed studs on the outsole allow for swift traction on the field.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro PS 'Flight Club' recalls the mail-in membership program during the late '80s and early '90s. The off-white leather upper has a matching suede forefoot overlay and contrasting black molded eyelets, foam midsole, and Nike Air-stamped heel tab. The Flight Club tag adorns the tongue, lined in red knit. A tricolor, herringbone-patterned rubber outsole completes the look.

A collaboration between Jordan Brand and Paris Saint-Germain, the Paris Saint-Germain x Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Bordeaux' emerges with an elevated colorway. Featuring color-blocking modeled after the 'Fire Red,' the shoe's white leather upper includes Bordeaux hits on the eyelets, inner tongue and heel. The heel itself sports Jumpman and PSG branding, while Paname appears on the lateral forefoot tag. Visible Air in the heel provides cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro SE Craft Photon Dust (GS)
colorway: Photon Dust/Pale Vanilla/Off White/Grey Fog/Flat Pewter/Sail
description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro SE Craft GS ‘Photon Dust’ is a neutral-toned sneaker designed for big kids. It updates Tinker Hatfield’s 1989 design with a pale grey leather upper, complemented by a shaggy suede forefoot overlay in a matching color. The shoe's molded eyelets are finished in a Pale Vanilla hue along with Jumpman branding on the tongue and heel tab. Grid-embossed detailing on the suede quarter panels replaces the traditional netting. The white foam midsole is enhanced with an exposed Air-sole unit and supported by a two-tone rubber outsole with herringbone-patterned traction.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Royalty' brings elevated accents and an elevated construction to the classic basketball silhouette. Built with suede, the shoe's upper appears in black, overlaid by synthetic leather on the heel and highlighted by metallic gold on the signature eyelets and heel branding. Underfoot, visible Air in the heel of the contrasting polyurethane midsole provides cushioning, giving way to a herringbone rubber outsole for traction.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro PS 'Lakers' dons a layered, purple nubuck upper touched with black netting that matches the support wings, collar lining and heel tab. A yellow Jumpman arrives on the tongue tag, matching the Nike heel logo. A black and white foam midsole works closely with a grey, herringbone-patterned outsole.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Lightning' 2021 is a grade-school shoe that brings back a 2006 colorway. Built with nubuck, the shoe's upper appears in Tour Yellow, with the molded eyelets and netting contrasting the look in black. The wings, inside of the tongue and heel branding all add grey to the design, as does the rubber outsole, which provides traction underfoot through its herringbone pattern. The white foam midsole anchors the design, with visible Max Air in the heel included for cushioning.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'University Blue' is a grade-school shoe with a familiar University of North Carolina colorway. As a result, the shoe's upper includes a woven jock tag on the tongue, with the look recalling the labels on throwback Nike basketball jerseys. Otherwise finished primarily in University Blue, the upper includes cement detailing throughout, matched by the midsole underfoot, which houses visible Air in the heel for cushioning.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Infrared' features solid black elements on the quarter panel netting, structural wings, and the Jumpman logo on the heel against a dark grey nubuck upper. The front part of the shoe is a lighter grey, and there are vibrant Infrared accents on the eyelets and Jumpman tongue tag. The shoe provides comfort with a cushioned Air-sole unit in the heel of the two-tone midsole.

The Air Jordan Tatum 4 First Ring delivers a bold and narrative driven take on the silhouette through a layered and symbolic color palette. The black base creates a strong foundation, while infrared 23 accents add energy that highlights the design. Moss green and camper green tones introduce depth, giving the shoe a unique and textured look that reflects achievement and growth.

Fans of the Tatum line appreciate how storytelling elements are woven into the design, making each release feel more personal and meaningful. The mix of colors creates a dynamic and expressive identity. It is a sneaker that reflects performance innovation with a strong narrative edge.

The Air Jordan Tatum 4 First Ring was released on February 12, 2026 with a retail price of $140.

Paying tribute to legendary coach Phil Jackson is the Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Zen Master.' Nodding at Jackson's 'Zen Master' persona, it features a textile upper in a tie-dye mix of pink, purple, and blue. Flight branding and a scarlet Jumpman icon are on the black woven tongue with a translucent TPU heel tab displaying a raised Jumpman logo in black. The polyurethane midsole has a visible Air-sole unit in the heel.

Inspired by the OG colorway of the Air Max 95, the Air Jordan 4 Retro LE 'Neon 95' features vibrant accents on its largely neutral costruction. The shoe's upper is built with suede, finished in a greyscale pattern and highlighted by the eyelets, quarter panel netting and heel branding. Underfoot, more Volt marks the Air unit in the heel.

Originally released in 1999, the Air Jordan 4 Retro LS 'Oreo' 2015 dropped more than a decade and a half later. Built with tumbled leather, the shoe's upper appears in black, secured by oval laces and replacing its signature netting with perforations on the quarter panel. Speckled detailing accents the signature molded eyelets, matched by the polyurethane midsole underfoot, which houses visible Air for cushioning. A herringbone rubber outsole is included for traction.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro Winter 'Loyal Blue' brings a winterized build to Michael Jordan's fourth signature shoe. The upper is built with Loyal Blue nubuck, with a fleece inner lining insulating the fit. The shoe's signature eyelet flange remains intact, while underfoot, the white Air midsole provides cushioning and contrast. A herringbone rubber outsole provides traction.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'White Oreo' is a grade-school iteration of the shoe known for 'The Shot.' Appearing here in a neutral colorway, the shoe's upper is built with tumbled leather, finished in white and complemented by Tech Grey throughout, including on the speckled, molded eyelets. The usual mesh inserts mark the quarter panel and vamp, while the tongue adds Fire Red via the Jumpman branding. Underfoot, visible Air in the heel of the midsole provides cushioning.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Metallic Pack - Court Purple' released as part of the three-shoe Metallic Pack. Built with white leather, the upper includes tonal mesh on the quarter panel and vamp. The look is highlighted by metallic Court Purple on the eyelets, while more Court Purple marks the branding, tongue and Max Air unit in the heel.

The KAWSx Air Jordan 4 Retro is a collaboration between Brooklyn street artist KAWS, a.k.a. Brian Donnelly, and Jordan Brand. The design removes the traditional plastic accents of the silhouette and dresses in a premium grey suede over the entire upper and midsole. The sneaker also has a branding of KAWS' 'XX' on the heel tab. The shoes were released in March 2017 along with a small capsule collection that included a jacket, hoodie, t-shirt and hat. The hype for this release was so intense that police read the riot act at the in-store raffle at Patta in London and sneakerheads hacked into Donnelly's website for an opportunity.

The 2025 version of the Air Jordan 4 Retro OG PS 'White Cement' sports a white leather upper with the classic side panel netting and molded black eyelets. Grey support wings are touched with black speckles, matching the Nike Air heel tab as well as the foam midsole. A red Jumpman logo adds the lone color pop on this classic design.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro PS 'Valentine's Day' nods to the February 14 holiday with a white pebbled leather upper, a mint green side panel netting and a pink Swoosh on the tongue and heel tab. Pale blue support wings match the molded eyelets, while a candy-heart graphic adorns the insoles. A touch of pink engulfs the heel portion of the foam midsole as a final nod.

colorway: Black/Fire Red/Deep Royal Blue/Dark Smoke Grey/Tech Grey
description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro TD 'Rare Air' sports a black nubuck upper complemented with a dark grey suede forefoot overlay. The OG details stay the same, including the iconic side netting and support wings. The blackout design is offset by red eyelets and a Nike-stamped blue heel tab. A blue knit collar lining and a foam midsole keep every step soft and comfortable.

Designed specifically for older kids, the Air Jordan 4 Retro SE GS 'Black Canvas' presents a fresh take on the iconic silhouette. This version departs from the usual leather or nubuck construction with an upper in sleek black canvas, accentuated by a forefoot overlay in tonal suede while the quarter panel is finished with breathable mesh panels. The allover black of the upper is intersected by light grey molded eyelets and a matching heel tab Jumpman logo. The tongue features a woven Jumpman tag with 'Flight' branding in vibrant crimson lettering. The polyurethane midsole is enhanced with visible Air-sole cushioning for exceptional comfort and support, while herringbone-patterned rubber outsole ensures traction on various surfaces.

The 30th anniversary of the Jordan Brand is celebrated by the Nike Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Teal.' A teal premium leather top with tropical teal and black accents are combined in the design. Released in March 2015, a white midsole, tropical teal air unit and a white, black and tropical teal outsole are also featured in the sneaker.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro PS 'Bred Reimagined' features a black leather upper instead of the original nubuck. Ventilated quarter panel netting and leather support wings are adorned with Cement Grey eyelets, and the tongue showcases a red Jumpman logo while the heel tab displays Nike Air branding. Underfoot, a comfortable foam midsole rests on an aged herringbone-traction rubber outsole for dependable traction.

Releasing in November 2020, the Air Jordan 4 Retro OG GS 'Fire Red' 2020 brings back an OG colorway. A grade-school shoe, the upper is built leather, finished primarily in white and accented by Fire Red on the eyelets, tongue tag and inner lining. Black offers contrast throughout, while more Fire Red marks the midsole, which includes visible Air in the heel for cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro SE Paris Olympics Wet Cement (GS)
description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro SE GS 'Wet Cement' nod to the cobblestone streets of Paris, using multiple shades of grey on an upper crafted of leather, nubuck and suede. An embossed grid pattern graces the side panel, while subtle speckles decorate the support wings and eyelets. The Jumpman logo adorns the tongue and heel areas, giving them a signature look. A dark grey foam midsole packs an exposed Air-sole unit for a plush feel.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro PS 'White Thunder' keeps the same colors from the 2006 'Thunder' release. These shoes have a black nubuck upper with white molded eyelets. Overlaid with black netting, portions of white mesh appear on the sides to provide a textured look. The Jumpman logo adorns the tongue and heel, while a lightweight foam midsole anchors the design.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro TD 'Lakers' rocks a purple nubuck upper decorated with a black panel netting, support wings, a knit collar lining, and Nike-branded heel tab. The latter matches the Jumpman emblem on the tongue tag. A black and white midsole brings lightweight cushioning with every step.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro Photon Dust Blue Chill (GS)
description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Photon Dust Blue Chill' sports a white leather upper with contrasting greyscale molded eyelets, support wings, and heel tab. A Jumpman emblem adorns the chrome-plated tongue tag. These shoes ride on a white foam midsole with Air-Sole cushioning in the heel. The icy blue, partially see-through rubber outsole gets a herringbone pattern for steady traction.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro Black Infrared Barely Volt (PS)

description: The Women's Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Net - White' is made with white leather on the upper, expanding the side netting so that the grid covers the tongue. A padded collar, molded eyelets and support wings maintain some of the key elements intact. A raised Jumpman heel tab logo and removable metallic gold charms decorate the signature look. A white foam midsole underfoot contains an exposed Air-sole unit to keep every step plush.

The Wmns Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Shimmer' is a neutral take on the iconic basketball design. The shoe's upper features a leather construction, finished in a series of tan hues and complemented by the quarter panel netting. Molded eyelets secure the fit, while the tongue includes metallic silver Jumpman branding to highlight the look. Underfoot, the midsole houses the usual visible Air in the heel to provide cushioning, giving way to a herringbone rubber outsole for traction.

The Air Jordan 4 RM 'University Blue' nods to Michael Jordan's alma mater with a leather upper complemented with neutral grey accents and an off-white cage that starts at the midfoot and wraps around the heel. The latter is adorned with University Blue detailing, while the tongue tag features premium branding. The foam midsole is anchored by a herringbone-patterned outsole, with an Air-Sole heel unit providing responsive cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro SE Craft Medium Olive (GS)
description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro SE Craft GS in 'Olive' features an upper made from layers of nubuck and suede, with side panels in embossed suede in a grid pattern, replacing the original TPU netting. Contrasting black details arrive on the leather support wings, molded eyelets, and the lining inside the collar. The shoe has a lightweight foam midsole with visible Air-sole cushioning. The tongue tag and a semi-transparent tab at the back display cream-colored Jumpman logos.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Messy Room' for older kids presents a playful design inspired by a child’s untidy living space. The upper in blue nubuck is lined with red textile with a matching synthetic leather overlay. The cushioned collar, netting on the quarter panel, and TPU support wings, which are adorned with molded orange eyelets, appear in white. Beneath the sneaker, a white foam midsole provides cushioning with a visible Air-sole unit atop a two-tone rubber outsole. The tongue and the heel tab display Jumpman branding.

The Air Jordan Tatum 4 Smoke Grey delivers a refined and layered take on the silhouette through a mix of neutral and accent tones. Smoke grey and anthracite create a strong and structured base, while metallic silver adds subtle shine. Bright crimson and university gold accents introduce pops of color that enhance the overall design.

Fans of balanced colorways appreciate how this version combines understated tones with vibrant highlights, creating a dynamic but wearable look. The layered palette gives it depth without overwhelming the silhouette. It is a sneaker that reflects modern performance design with a versatile edge.

The Air Jordan Tatum 4 Smoke Grey was released with a retail price of $130.

Inspired by Japanese sashiko stitching, the Air Jordan 4 Retro SE 'Sashiko' emerges with a textile construction. The upper features a series of abstract prints and decorative embroidery, finished in a mix of Deep Ocean and Sail. The usual mesh inserts mark the quarter panel and vamp, while the tongue includes Fire Red to contrast the look. Underfoot, the Sail midsole houses visible Air in the heel for cushioning, with a rubber outsole included for traction.

Released in May 2019, the Air Jordan 4 Retro OG GS 'Bred' 2019 pays tribute to the 30th anniversary of the Air Jordan 3. Emerging in the OG colorway that Michael Jordan wore when he hit 'The Shot' in the 1989 playoffs, the shoe's black nubuck upper includes tonal mesh vents, complemented by Cement Grey on the eyelets and lining. Fire Red accents emerge on the tongue branding and outsole, while the midsole houses visible Air in the heel of this grade-school shoe.

Inspired by spacesuits, the Wmns Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Starfish' emerges with a unique construction. The shoe's upper features a black metallic mesh build, with raw edges revealing the Starfish underlays. Black mesh inserts appear at the quarter panel and vamp, with further Starfish on the tongue branding. Underfoot, visible Air in the heel of the midsole provides cushioning, giving way to a rubber outsole for traction.

This KAWS x Air Jordan 4 Retro black colorway was released in November 2017, several months after the first Air Jordan 4 collaboration by the famous Brooklyn artist – a gray colorway that droped in March 2017. The shoe features an all-suede cap like its predecessor, featuring a subtle tonal print portraying the cartoon hands of the popular Companion figure of KAWS. Under the translucent glow-in - the-dark outsole are the same hands. The signature of the artist ' XX, ' juxtaposed above the trademark of Nike's ' AIR, ' is engraved on the heels.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Oxidized Green' has a white leather upper, including support wings and heel tab. The latter gets a dark green Jumpman logo, matching the collar lining, netted quarter panel and plastic eyelets. The Jumpman logo appears again on the insoles and tongue. These shoes have a dual-tone foam midsole, equipped with an exposed Air-sole heel unit and anchored by a light grey rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro TD 'Valentine's Day' honors the day of romance with a white pebbled leather upper and a mint-green side panel netting. Partially see-through, blue-hued support wings match the molded eyelets for bold contrast. A pink Jumpman logo lands on the heel tab as well as the tongue, matching the foam midsole underfoot.

Transforming the OG colorway with a retooled build designed for the golf course is the Air Jordan 4 Golf 'Bred.' The upper recreates the 1989 original, highlighted by a black nubuck upper with tonal quarter panel netting, grey TPU eyelets, and red Jumpman branding on the woven tongue tag with another Jumpman logo on the molded heel tab. The AJ4's distinctive midsole comes with a visible Air-sole unit in the heel, and a translucent outsole plate has seven removable spikes for better grip.

The Air Jordan Tatum 4 Bloodline delivers a classic and heritage inspired take on the silhouette through a bold mix of black, red, and white tones. The black upper creates a strong base, while university red accents add a sharp and energetic pop. White details provide contrast that highlights the structure.

Fans of bloodline colorways appreciate how this combination continues to define Jordan footwear across different models. The contrast between black and red gives it a timeless and aggressive look. It is a sneaker that reflects performance design with a heritage driven identity.

The Levi's x Air Jordan 4 'Black Denim' overhauls the classic silhouette with the iconic American denim brand's traditional materials and details. Besides the black denim covering the upper and midsole, the shoe is accentuated on the quarter panel with Levi's signature red tab. Another trademark of Levi's – the paper patch 'Two Horses' – is rebranded with a red Jumpman logo and placed on the tongue, featuring a tan color matched by a gum rubber outsole.

The release of Air Jordan 4 'Bred' was released in 2012 as part of Nike's Black Friday launch. One of the four initial colors released in 1989, it has the same colorway as its original Black, Red, and Cement Grey counterpart. In 1999 and 2008, as part of the Collezione pack, the Air Jordan 4 was retro'd. Also, it swaps the OG Nike Air branding for a Jumpman logo on the heel in this 2012 retro release.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro Valentine's Day Sierra Red (PS)

description: Dropping in 2015 as part of Jordan Brand’s 30th anniversary celebration, the Air Jordan 4 Retro ‘30th Anniversary Laser’ brings back the distinctive laser-etched leather upper first featured on the Air Jordan 4 in 2005. The kicks are accented with metallic silver hits on the eyelets, midsole and tongue tag, the latter treated with a 3M reflective finish. An icy translucent rubber outsole is the shoe’s finishing touch.

The Air Jordan Tatum 4 Siren Red delivers a bold and aggressive take on the silhouette through a vibrant and high contrast color palette. The siren red upper creates a strong and energetic base, while metallic silver accents add shine and depth. Football grey details provide balance, keeping the design cohesive.

Fans of red based Jordans appreciate how this colorway emphasizes intensity and presence on the court. The combination of bright red and metallic tones gives it a standout look. It is a sneaker that reflects performance and expressive design within the Tatum lineup.

The Air Jordan Tatum 4 Siren Red was released on October 10, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro PS 'Cave Stone' has a dark taupe nubuck upper with black molded eyelets, a matching side netting, and a knit collar lining. An embroidered Jumpman adorns the tongue, while a raised Nike logo embellishes the heel tab. A full-length foam midsole keeps every step soft and resilient, while the rubber outsole gets a herringbone pattern for traction in all directions.

The 2024 iteration of the Air Jordan 4 Retro PS ‘Military Blue’ returns in this sized-down version for little kids. These kicks have an off-white leather upper with the recognizable side panel netting and support wings to promote stability. The Jumpman logo stands out on the tongue tag, matching the color of the molded eyelets and back tab. A two-tone foam midsole is hoisted by a herringbone-pattern rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Pizza' rolls out a pale yellow leather upper with a matching suede forefoot overlay and side panel netting. Black shoelaces match the molded eyelets, support wings, and knit collar lining. A white and red checkerboard print on the insoles adds a touch of flair, whole a black and white midsole is equipped with a visible Nike Air unit. A red herringbone-pattern outsole wraps up this kids' exclusive design.

Launching in 2017, the Air Jordan 4 Retro ‘Motorsports’ is modeled after an extremely limited pair that was gifted to the 16 members of MJ’s motorcycle racing team back in 2006. Unlike its predecessor, there is no Mars Blackmon graphic on the lateral heel, but the larger design remains the same, highlighted by a white leather upper with black and Game Royal accents.

The 2024 version of the Air Jordan 4 Retro TD 'Fear' keeps most details from the 2013 original, sporting a black nubuck upper complemented by grey and silver accents. The molded eyelets, collar lining and Jumpman logos on the tongue and heel tab contrast the look in clean white. Matching speckles on the black foam midsole complete the look alongside a white rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro TD ‘Thunder’ for 2023 reintroduces the 2006 colorway to a new generation of sneaker enthusiasts. The black nubuck upper is complemented by bold Tour Yellow highlights on the eyelets, lower tongue and quarter panel. The tongue and sockliner bear the iconic Jumpman logo, while the quarter panel and lower tongue retain the OG 1989 design's classic black netting. The sneaker features a yellow foam midsole that provides excellent cushioning, and a black herringbone traction outsole that delivers superior grip.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro '11Lab4 - Black' was created by the Air Jordan Lab as a hybrid of the Air Jordan 11 and Air Jordan 4 silhouettes. The design features an upper all-black patent leather with black wax laces, a black outsole, and a white hit close the Air unit midsole heel. In July 2015, the '11Lab4' was also released in a 'Red' colorway.

Step into low profile luxury with the Jordan 4 RM "Grimace". Redefining a classic silhouette, this modern low top sneaker showcases a rich, monochromatic "Vintage Purple" upper constructed from a premium mix of suede and durable canvas materials. Featuring sculpted TPU cage overlays, visible Air cushioning, and a tonal rubber outsole, it delivers exceptional comfort alongside an edgy, contemporary streetwear look for sneaker enthusiasts looking to make a bold statement.

The Air Jordan 4 RM 'Black Sail' has an off-white cage that bolsters the blackout mesh upper complemented with leather and suede overlays. A red Jumpman logo decorates the tongue tag, adding a burst of color to the monochromatic design. The cream-colored foam midsole packs Air-Sole cushioning in the heel for a plush feel.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro NRG ‘Raptors’ hit stores in 2018, featuring a colorway inspired by the OG Air Jordan 7. Like its predecessor, the mid-top features a black nubuck upper with red and purple accents, the latter hue prominently featured on the shoe’s speckled midsole and Jumpman heel logo. A second Jumpman is embossed on the all-black tongue tag.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Metallic Pack - University Red' released as part of the three-shoe Metallic Pack. The shoe's upper is built with white leather, with tonal netting on the quarter panel and vamp. The eyelets accent the look in metallic University Red, with the color also accenting the tongue, branding and visbile Max Air unit in the heel of the midsole.

colorway: Dark Grey / Green Glow - Cement Grey
description: Featuring vibrant accents, the Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Green Glow' otherwise appears with a neutral look on its classic design. The shoe's upper is built with synthetic nubuck in a greyscale finish, contrasted by black on the wings and mesh inserts. The molded eyelets and heel branding highlight the design in green, matched underfoot by the rubber outsole that combines flex grooves with a herringbone pattern for flexible traction. Visible Air in the heel of the midsole offers cushioning.

Introduced in January 2019, the Air Jordan 4 Retro ‘Laser’ commemorates the iconic silhouette’s 30th anniversary. Laser-etched designs return on this iteration, which features the adornments in subdued tonal style on a full-grain black leather upper. Eye-catching white contrasts appear on the Jumpman emblems that decorate the heel and tongue tag, while a gum rubber outsole promises superior traction.

The Air Jordan Tatum 4 Black Pinksicle delivers a bold and energetic take on the next iteration of the signature line through a high contrast color palette. The black base creates a strong and sleek foundation, while pinksicle accents add a vibrant pop that enhances the design. White elements provide balance, keeping the look cohesive.

Fans of the Tatum series appreciate how new models continue to push both performance and visual identity forward. The combination of dark and bright tones gives it a dynamic and modern feel. It is a sneaker that reflects innovation and expressive styling within the Jordan lineup.

The Air Jordan Tatum 4 Black Pinksicle was released on December 13, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro Where the Wild Things Are (GS)
description: Only available in kids sizing is the Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Wild Things.' It updates Tinker Hatfield's original design with a cozy build and has an upper crafted from tan leather with tonal fleece construction on the collar and tongue. Molded eyelets are featured in neon green, pink, royal blue, and crimson, with matching colored structural wings. Jumpman branding is on the molded heel tab and woven tongue tag, both rendered in a dark beige finish. Lightweight cushioning is provided by a white foam midsole, enhanced with visible Air-sole cushioning and reinforced with grippy gum rubber under the forefoot and heel.

The Air Jordan 4 ‘Dunk from Above’ dropped in 2016, featuring a design inspired by Michael Jordan’s aerial game. The mid-top sports a navy leather upper, accented with pops of yellow on the collar lining, molded eyelets and tongue tag. On the heel, a Jumpman logo hit in white matches the netting used on the shoe’s quarter panel. The kicks are finished with a gum rubber outsole for grippy traction.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro Levi's Denim (Tag with Levi's Logo)
description: For this January 2018 release, Jordan Brand teamed up with Levi's to rework the Air Jordan 4. The Levi's x Air Jordan 4 Retro ' Denim ' features an upper indigo denim washed with orange contrast stitching and a Levi's tab. A nod to Levi's signature ' Two Horses ' patch is seen on the Air sole unit and the Jumpman logo-stamped paper patch on the tongue. The design is completed on the outsole with detailed gum rubber.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro PS 'Midnight Navy' features a classic color scheme reminiscent of the 1989 'White Cement' release. The upper combines quarter panel netting, navy eyelets, and speckled grey support wings against a base in white tumbled leather. The foam midsole has speckled grey accents and a touch of Midnight Navy in the forefoot, while the tongue and heel display Jumpman branding.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro Where the Wild Things Are (TD)
description: Bringing a winterized version to the classic silhouette is the Air Jordan 4 TD 'Wild Things.' The upper is made of tan leather with plush fleece construction on the collar and tongue. Individually colored eyelets are finished in neon green, pink, blue, and red, with blue and red hues repeated on the sneaker's mismatched wings. Jumpman branding decorates the tongue and dark beige heel panel. The shoe is built on a soft foam midsole, reinforced with grippy gum rubber under the forefoot and heel.

The Air Jordan 4 Golf 'White Cement' brings the iconic basketball silhouette to the links. Featuring an OG colorway from 1989, the shoe's upper is built with white leather, highlighted by cement detailing on the quarter panel wings, heel overlay and midsole. The midsole itself houses visible Air in the heel for cushioning, giving way to a full-length outsole plate with seven removable spikes for traction on the course.

The Air Jordan 4 RM 'Military Black' nods to the 2022 AJ4 colorway that bears the same name. The white mesh and leather upper is complemented with a pale grey suede forefoot overlay. A matching white plastic cage engulfs the heel, where a black Nike Air is positioned. More black accents arrive on the collar and Jumpman-stamped tongue, along with the Air-assisted foam midsole. A gum rubber outsole uses a herringbone pattern for steady traction underfoot.

shoeName: Jordan 4 RM Premium White Black Smoke Grey Fire Red
description: The Air Jordan 4 RM Premium 'Motorsports' rolls out grey mesh panels paired with white microperforated leather on the heel and toe box, complete with a charcoal suede forefoot overlay. A plastic cage extends from the midfoot and wraps around the Nike Air-branded heel. Grey suede tongue tags take turns showcasing red Jumpman and '23' logos. The foam midsole contains Air-sole cushioning in the forefoot and a visible Air heel unit underfoot.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Taupe Haze' is a grade-school shoe with a neutral look. The shoe's upper is built with a mix of textured suede and cracked leather, finished in Taupe Haze and complemented by Oil Grey on the molded eyelets, support wings and heel panel. The tongue tag and tongue lining highlight the look in Infrared 23, while underfoot, visible Air in the heel of the midsole provides cushioning, giving way to a rubber outsole for traction.

Part of the three-shoe Metallic Pack, the Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Metallic Pack - Pine Green' features a two-tone look with an elevated touch. Built with white leather, the upper includes tonal netting on the quarter panel and vamp. The eyelets accent the look in metallic Pine Green, with the color also featured on the tongue, branding and visible Max Air unit in the heel of the midsole.

Releasing in January 2015, the Air Jordan 4 Retro LS ‘Columbia’ brings back a colorway from 1999. A remastered version of the Air Jordan 4 ‘Columbia,’ the shoe’s white tumbled leather upper features two different shades of blue. Hits of Midnight Navy appear on most of the 4’s signature features, including the eyelets and Air-infused midsole, while the brighter Legend Blue appears on the Jumpman logos.

The 2024 iteration of the Air Jordan 4 Retro PS 'Fear' rocks a primarily black upper accented with stitched grey and silver overlays. The Jumpman logo appears on the tongue tag and heel, matching the white molded eyelets and collar lining. A full-length, black foam midsole is dusted in white speckles, anchored by a white rubber outsole.

The 2024 version of the Air Jordan 4 Retro TD ‘Military Blue’ celebrates 35 years of this signature look. True to the OG, these sneakers have an off-white leather upper with side panel netting and support wings. The eyelets and heel tab get blue accents to pair with the inside of the netting. The two-tone foam midsole is soft and lightweight, bolstered by a herringbone-style rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro PS 'Military Black' references the 'Military Blue' original 1989 release. The white leather upper has a grey suede forefoot overlay to contrast it. Black pops arrive on the molded eyelets, the Jumpman heel tab, and knitted window portion of the side panel. A black foam midsole matches the Jumpman logo adorning the tongue.

The 2012 Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Fire Red' is based on the OG colorway from 1989. The design combines an upper white leather, black and Fire Red accents. The sneaker also features Jumpman branding on the tongue and heel, released in August 2012.

Nike introduced their 'Elements Series' in 2013, where they implemented esthetics of inspiration and design from one classic model to another classic style. Mashing up the Air Air Jordan 4 and Air Jordan 11, the 11LAB4 series sees inspiration from the Air Jordan 11 patent leather accents and the Air Jordan 4 silhouette overlays them. The ' Red ' colorway features the Jordan 4 classic model with a bright red all-over monochromatic leather patent finish.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Metallic Pack - Total Orange' emerges with an elevated two-tone look on its classic basketball construction. Built with leather, the upper appears primarily in white, including on the signature wings and mesh inserts. The eyelets accent the look in metallic Total Orange, with more Total Orange on the branding, tongue lining and Air unit in the heel of the midsole.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro ‘Tattoo’ returns the classic profile to its 1989 origins as a performance basketball sneaker. The mid-top’s leather upper is completely dressed in a black-and-white basketball print, highlighted by contrasting hits of Fire Red on the molded eyelets and outsole. The Chicago Bulls-influenced color scheme also boasts basic black on the structural wings, quarter-panel netting, and signature Jumpman heel.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro TD 'Flight Club' calls back to the Air Jordan fan mail-in membership program that ran from the late '80s to the early '90s. These kicks have an off-white leather upper, bolstered by a matching suede forefoot overlay and contrasted with black molded eyelets, foam midsole, and a Nike-stamped heel tab. An embroidered red Jumpman emblem adorns the tongue, while the Flight Club insignia decorates the insoles.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro PS 'Rare Air' dons a black nubuck upper with a dark grey suede forefoot overlay. Black side panel netting and matching support wings complement the classic design. Red molded eyelets and a blue, Nike-stamped heel tab add a burst of lively color, joining a red embroidered Jumpman on the tongue. A black-and-cream foam midsole works closely with a grey-and-red rubber outsole below.

Resurrecting the timeless color scheme with a modernized black leather upper, the Air Jordan 4 Retro TD 'Bred Reimagined' showcases eyelets and lining in Cement Grey with a vibrant crimson Jumpman logo on the tongue. To add to its OG-inspired look, the heel tab is adorned with Nike Air branding. This sneaker is supported by a lightweight foam midsole, reinforced by an aged grippy herringbone-traction rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 4 RM SP Nigel Sylvester Grandma's Driveway
description: The Nigel Sylvester x Air Jordan 4 RM SP 'Grandma's Driveway - Fence Green' brings the BMX star's take on the popular silhouette. An emerald suede upper is held together by a supportive cage, while a white mini-Swoosh is embroidered on the side of the forefoot. A 'Bike Air by Jordan' signoff is inscribed on the tongue, paired with an embossed Bike Air logo on the heel. A black-and-white foam midsole keeps the visible Air-sole unit for plush cushioning underfoot.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro TD 'White Thunder' keeps colors intact from the 2006 'Thunder' release, rocking a black nubuck upper with contrasting white accents on the eyelets and mesh side panels. The Jumpman logo, also in white, adorns the tongue and heel area. A white foam midsole keeps every step plush and lightweight.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro TD 'Red Cement' is designed for young children and appears in familiar color-blocking that takes inspiration from the original 'White Cement.’ Branding includes a Jumpman logo on the woven tongue tag and an embossed black Jumpman on the crimson-speckled support wings and heel tab. The foam midsole offers lightweight cushioning, and displays another pop of red. The white leather upper features matching netting on the quarter panel, along with contrasting black eyelets.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Toro Bravo' relased in July 2013, bringing back a colorway that debuted in 2009's Defining Moments pack. Featuring a nubuck upper in Fire Red, the look is complemented by black detailing and Cement Grey on the eyelets, tongue tag and outsole. Visible Air in the white midsole provides cushioning.

The Women's Air Jordan 4 RM 'Legend Light Brown' dons a subtle ivory mesh upper with a leather toe box and suede forefoot overlay. A plastic cage blends into the lacing system, extending from the midfoot and wrapping around the heel. A raised Nike Air logo and a Jumpman logo on the tongue and insoles bring a signature touch.

Designed for older kids, the Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Cacao Wow' showcases rich dark teal accents on the molded eyelets and the inner lining against a suede-and-brown-textile upper and a chocolate brown leather overlay on the forefoot. The off-white foam midsole rests on a beige herringbone-traction rubber outsole and stands out with subtle speckling and a visible Air-sole unit in the heel. Jumpman logos adorn both the tongue and heel tab.

shoeName: Jordan 4 RM SP Nigel Sylvester Driveway Grey (GS)

description: Updating the classic basketball silhouette for the links, the Air Jordan 4 Golf 'Military Blue' is a performance golf shoe. Built with leather, the shoe's Air Jordan 4 upper includes a series of blue accents throughout, including below the white netting that marks the quarter panel and vamp. The forefoot overlay and structural wings add grey to the look, while underfoot, removable spikes on the outsole plate are included for traction.

Dipped entirely in Hot Punch, the women’s Air Jordan 4 Retro NRG ‘Hot Punch’ sports a lively, bold finish. The mid top’s leather upper features patent leather paneling, while black and Volt dappling highlights the midsole and eyelets. The herringbone outsole is constructed of partially translucent rubber and offers superior traction.

The Jordan Tatum 4 'Black Ice Blue' sports a black mesh upper complemented with suede and nubuck accents. A metallic copper Jumpman logo adorns the side panel, matching the iridescent molded '0' on the heel. An ice blue Cushlon 3.0 foam midsole contains a stability shank and springy Zoom Air forefoot unit for a springy feel.

The 2012 Military Blue ' Air Jordan 4 is based on the colorway of the 1989 OG. The design combines an upper white leather with accents of Military Blue and Natural Grey. The sneaker also features Jumpman branding on the tongue and heel, released in August 2012.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro Where the Wild Things Are (PS)
description: The Air Jordan 4 PS 'Wild Things' are shoes for little kids and made for colder weather. It has fleece on both the padded collar and Jumpman icon embroidered tongue. The rest of the upper is built with tan leather and a quartet of color-popped eyelets in neon green, pink, blue, and red. An additional Jumpman logo is featured on the molded heel panel in dark beige and its two-tone foam midsole is supported by an outsole built with gum rubber under the forefoot and heel.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro Golf Black Cat Pony Hair

description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro PS ‘Thunder’ is designed for little kids and features the two-tone colorway first released in 2006 and later in 2012. The upper is made from smooth black nubuck and is contrasted by Tour Yellow accents on the molded eyelets, quarter panel, and lower tongue. The heel tab is adorned with a raised white Jumpman logo, while the woven tongue tag features a matching Jumpman. The mid-top is supported by a yellow foam midsole, paired with a black herringbone-patterned traction rubber outsole for traction underfoot.

A toddlers' iteration of the shoe, the Air Jordan 4 Retro TD 'Lightning' 2021 is a reissue of a colorway that originally released 15 years earlier. The shoe's upper is built with nubuck, finished in Tour Yellow, with the quarter panel and vamp adding contrast via black netting. Grey marks the wings to further contrast the design, matched underfoot by the rubber outsole that offers traction. A white foam midsole is included for cushioning.

The Air Jordan 4 RM 'Canyon Rust' retouches the Air Jordan 4 design, rocking a white mesh base with a black suede forefoot overlay and a matching midfoot panel. The Jumpman logo decorates the tongue tag, while the Nike Air logo adorns the back heel. An off-white foam midsole is fitted with an exposed Air-sole heel unit, anchored by a rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 4 RM 'Bruce Lee' nods to the jumpsuit worn by the martial artist wore in 'Game of Death.' These shoes have a black leather toe box, a matching suede forefoot overlay, and a yellow cage that goes from the midfoot and heel. The latter gets a raised, red Nike Air logo, while the tongue tag sports a yellow Jumpman. The cushioning setup comes directly from the OG, starting with a foam midsole and finishing with an Air-Sole heel unit underfoot.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Light Lemon Twist' sports a white leather upper tooled with grey molded eyelets and side panel netting. Neon yellow support wings match the Jumpman logos on the heel tab and tongue. The latter has a subtle pixelated graphic that also lands on the forefoot overlay and collar. The foam midsole contains a visible Nike Air heel unit for all-around cushioning.

The Air Jordan 4 Golf 'Masters Tournament' debuted at the 2021 Masters, where it was worn by Bubba Watson. Sporting accents drawn from the tournament's signature colors, the shoe's upper is built with a white leather base, highlighted by green molded eyelets, with further green on the tongue tag and heel. The textile-lined tongue sports a yellow finish on the interior side, while underfoot, visible Air provides cushioning, with removable spikes on the outsole for traction.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro Photon Dust Blue Chill (PS)
description: The Jordan 4 Retro PS 'Photon Dust Blue Chill' sports a pale grey leather upper with a knit side panel netting and pewter-hued molded eyelets. A pastel blue Jumpman logo on the back tab matches the herringbone pattern on the rubber outsole. These shoes have a white foam midsole, contrasted by dark grey details on the forefoot.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro Photon Dust Blue Chill (TD)

description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro TD 'Forget Me Not' uses pastel blue floral patches to signify the beginning of spring. The white leather upper gets blue accents on the molded eyelets, support wings, heel tab, and the soft collar lining. An embroidered Jumpman logo lands on the tongue and side panel netting. The foam midsole brings a soft feel with every little step.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro PS 'University Blue' is a preschool iteration of the shoe. Featuring a University of North Carolina-style look, the shoe's upper includes a suede construction, finished in University Blue and highlighted by cement detailing that recalls the 'White Cement.' The tongue includes a woven jock tag similiar to the labels on retro Nike basketball jerseys, while visible Air in the midsole underfoot provides cushioning.

Designed with the help of Isaiah Scott, who was diagnosed with acute lymphoblastic leukemia, the Air Jordan 4 Retro DB 'Doernbecher' features inspiration from Superman. The shoe's black nubuck upper includes vibrant green on the laces, midsole and heel branding, while the tongue tag has been outfitted with Superman's 'S.' A red Air bubble in the heel adds a further nod to the Man of Steel, with Scott's silhouette on the heel.

shoeName: Jordan Why Not Zer0.4 Triple White
description:
The Air Jordan Why Not Zer0.4 in Triple White is a 2021 general release of Russell Westbrook's fourth Jordan Brand signature basketball shoe in an all-white colorway, featuring the Why Not Zer0.4's performance basketball construction across the full upper, midsole, and outsole in a clean white-on-white execution that makes the shoe's technical construction and distinctive silhouette the visual focus in the absence of color contrast. The Why Not Zer0.4 is built around Jordan Brand's React foam cushioning for responsive court feel, a reinforced upper construction designed to support Westbrook's physically aggressive and explosively athletic playing style, and the lateral support and lockdown features developed to accommodate the triple-double machine's demanding movement patterns that required particularly durable and responsive basketball footwear across his peak NBA seasons. The Triple White colorway is the most broadly versatile and most lifestyle-crossover-ready expression of the Why Not Zer0.4's design, with the clean all-white execution removing the shoe from its specifically performance-athletic context and making it more accessible as a casual lifestyle sneaker for non-basketball wearers who appreciate the silhouette's distinctive aesthetic outside of game day settings. At $130 retail the Why Not Zer0.4 Triple White is available through Nike and select Jordan Brand basketball retailers with style code CQ4433-100, released January 1, 2021.

The Air Jordan Why Not Zer04 Triple White was released on January 1, 2021 with a retail price of $130.

shoeName: Jordan 4 RM Black White Varsity Red
Jordan 4 RM Black Gorge Green University Red
Jordan 4 RM PSG Paris Saint-Germain Off Noir
Jordan 4 Retro Fire Red Singles Day (2018) (Women's)
description: The women’s Air Jordan 4 Retro NRG ‘Singles Day’ celebrates the Chinese holiday with a leather build that’s entirely finished in Fire Red. The shoe shows off contrasting hits of black on the tongue tag, eyelets, and Jumpman emblem on the heel. The gum rubber outsole provides support. The red coating on the upper is purposely designed to eventually wear away, revealing an ornamental design underneath.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Pale Citron' released to help celebrate the 30th anniversary of the iconic silhouette. The shoe's upper is built white leather, with mesh vents for breathability. Contrasted by black on the lining, heel and eyelets, a unique Bright Crimson graphic emerges on the quarter panel flange and midsole. Visible Air in the heel provides cushioning, giving way to a multicolor herringbone outsole for traction.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro Valentine's Day Sierra Red (TD)

description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro PS 'Pizza' rolls out a Sesame-hued leather upper with a matching suede forefoot overlay and contrasting black touches on the laces, collar lining, support wings and molded heel tab.
