A red Jumpman logo adorns the tongue tag as well as the red-and-white checkerboard-print insoles. The foam midsole works closely with a red rubber outsole below.

Inspired by the classic palette of its predecessor, the Jordan Hydro 4 Retro Slide ‘Black Cement’ is crafted with black synthetic leather and an adjustable strap that has a Jumpman logo laid over its signature netting. A textured footbed provides a comfortable fit, while a foam midsole gives you lightweight cushioning. Flex grooves in the outsole allows for a flexible and natural stride.

The 2012 edition of the Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Cement’ brings back the iconic silhouette’s beloved OG colorway. This reissue is mostly true to the original 1989 release, with Jumpman branding at the heel in lieu of the OG Nike Air. The rest of the upper is constructed from white full-grain leather, accented with a red Jumpman and Cement Grey hits on the shoe’s midsole and structural ‘wings.’

The Air Jordan 4 Retro TD 'University Blue' is a toddlers' shoe with a University of North Carolina look. Built with suede, the shoe's upper appears primarily in University Blue, with 'White Cement'-style detailing on the wings, heel and midsole adding to the aesthetic. That foam midsole provides cushioning, giving way to a rubber outsole with a herringbone pattern for traction.

Limited to friends and family, the Nike SB x Air Jordan 4 Retro SP 'Varsity Red' dons an off-white leather upper tooled with the classic netting, plastic support wings, and a grey suede forefoot overlay. A red Jumpman tongue tag matches the molded eyelets and the Nike SB-branded heel tab. The midsole showcases a visible Nike Air heel unit while the outsole uses sturdy gum rubber.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro PS 'Forget Me Not' sports a white leather upper with the iconic grid-like netting on the side panel. Blue accents land on the molded eyelets, support wings, and heel tab. A blue chenille flower patch hovers above the lace bed. The full-length foam midsole undergirds this spring-inspired design.

shoeName: Jordan 4 RM Light Cream Midnight Green

description: The Women's Air Jordan 4 RM 'Oxidized Green' revamps the original Air Jordan 4 through a modern lens. A dark emerald mixed-material upper uses mesh, leather and suede. The Jumpman logo hits the tongue tag, while a raised Nike Air logo graces the heel cage. An off-white foam midsole contains an exposed Air-sole unit, undergirded by a rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan One Take 4 Bred delivers a performance driven silhouette with a classic and recognizable color palette. The black upper creates a strong and streamlined base, while university red accents add a bold pop that ties into the iconic Bred theme. White and flat pewter details provide contrast, keeping the design balanced.

Fans of Bred colorways appreciate how this combination continues to define Jordan footwear across different models. The mix of dark and vibrant tones gives it a dynamic and athletic feel. It is a sneaker that reflects performance design with a heritage inspired edge.

The Air Jordan One Take 4 Bred was released on November 22, 2022 with a retail price of $100.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro Golf US Open Torrey Pines Pack ACG
description: Inspired by Nike's All Conditions Gear line, the Air Jordan 4 Golf NRG 'ACG' brings a vibrant look to the basketball classic, which has been updated for the links. The shoe's upper is built with water-resistant textile in place of the usual leather or nubuck, finished in teal and complemented by purple on the signature netting. Black contrast emerges throughout, while the heel and tongue branding add orange to highlight the look. Underfoot, visible Air in the heel of the midsole provides cushioning, giving way to a full-length plate with removable spikes for traction.

The Air Jordan 4 Premium Retro 'Pinnacle' features an upper layered black premium leather with faux pony hair on the tongue and faux snakeskin leather on the collar. Released in April 2016, waxed laces, quilted insoles, a blacked-out Nike Air unit and a Sail outsole are also featured. The sneaker comes with a custom dust bag, hangtag, additional laces and a special card in a premium box.

A grade-school shoe, the Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Royalty' features a black suede upper complemented by metallic gold eyelets. More metallic gold emerges on the branding, while a contrasting white sole unit includes visible Air in the heel.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro TD 'Pizza' dons a Sesame-colored leather upper with a matching suede forefoot overlay. Black shoelaces match the collar lining, support wings and molded heel tab, which is stamped with a red Jumpman logo. Another Jumpman adorns the tongue tag and insoles, which have a red and white checkerboard print. A traditional, red rubber outsole completes the look.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro SE Craft Medium Olive (TD)
description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro SE Craft TD in 'Olive' features an upper with different green shades in nubuck and suede. The support wings, stitched eyelets, and the heel tab with a Jumpman logo arrive in black leather, while another Jumpman appears on the tongue. The shoe has a white foam midsole and a two-tone rubber outsole in black and grey. Instead of regular TPU netting, the quarter panel is made of suede with an embossed grid pattern.

Released in 2019, the Air Jordan 4 TD 'Bred' offers a scaled-down version for kids of the classic sneaker that commemorates the silhouette's 30th anniversary. This iteration replicates the iconic red, black, and grey colorway worn by Michael Jordan during his legendary 'The Shot' moment, etching its place in basketball history. The combination of nubuck and mesh materials in the upper honors the past and future, with the inclusion of Nike Air branding—a feature present in this 2019 rendition as well as the versions that launched in 1989 and 1999.

The Air Jordan 4 RM GS 'Black Metallic' remixes the original look of the Air Jordan 4, including a black leather upper with a midfoot cage that engulfs the heel. The latter gets a Nike Air logo, while a reflective tongue tag showcases a red Jumpman logo. 3M accents on the synthetic leather overlays reinforce the vamp and toe areas. A foam midsole contains a red Air-sole heel unit for a plush feel.

shoeName: Jordan ADG 4 Golf White Pure Platinum

description: A toddlers' iteration of the shoe, the Air Jordan 4 Retro TD 'White Oreo' emerges with a neutral look. The shoe's upper is built with leather, finished in white and maintaining key design features, including netting inserts and structural wings. Tech Grey emerges throughout, including on the speckled midsole underfoot, while the tongue sports a Fire Red Jumpman to add the only color to the look.

The sneaker icon that exploded on the court after Michael Jordan's 1988-89 season, the Nike Air Jordan 4 Retro TD, receives a wintry revamp. Issued in October 2019, this kids' variant provides warm protection and comfort in waterproof Loyal Blue leather with a soft dual-tone sockliner, ventilated inserts, and lace wings. True to the model, 'Flight' branding appears on the tongue, and a Jumpman emblem adorns the heel. The sneaker delivers support via an Air-imbued midsole and rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro TD 'Messy Room' for little kids is inspired by the chaos of a child's bedroom, with an upper in blue nubuck lined in crimson textile and a blue patent leather forefoot overlay. To add contrast, white details are featured on the heel tab, which is adorned with a blue Jumpman logo, as well as the support wings and ribbed textile collar. The foam midsole rides on a stabilizing two-tone rubber outsole in white and red.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Lemon Venom' is a grade-school shoe with vibrant accents. Built with a white leather base, the upper sports Lemon Venom and Pink Blast, with the latter color notably on the mesh inserts. Underfoot, the white midsole houses visible Air in the heel for cushioning, giving way to a tonal rubber outsole that provides traction.

First designed by Tinker Hatfield in 1989, the Air Jordan 4 Retro TD ‘Midnight Navy’ gives the classic Jordan style a look especially for little kids. A white leather upper delivers ventilated quarter panel netting and navy eyelets, and navy splatter print on grey side wings is repeated on the heeltab with a Jumpman logo. A second embroidered Jumpman appears on the tongue. A plush foam midsole and a herringbone-traction rubber outsole deliver cushioned comfort and traction, and is accented with additional speckles in navy.

The Paris Saint-Germain x Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Bordeaux' is a grade-school shoe. A collaboration between Paris Saint-Germain and Jordan Brand, the shoe's upper is built with a white leather base, with mesh netting at the quarter panel and vamp providing breathability. Black and Bordeaux add color to the look, while a 'Paname' flag emerges on the forefoot. The heel includes a PSG Jumpman logo, while 'Ici c'est Paris' on the sockliner completes the collaborative look.

shoeName: Jordan 4 RM Black Gorge Green Varsity Red (GS)
description: The Air Jordan 4 RM GS 'Black Gorge Green' is made with a mix of black leather, mesh and suede on the upper, tooled with a green cage that engulfs the collar and heel areas. A touch of red decorates the top of the tongue, stamped with a green embroidered Jumpman logo. A red Nike Air logo appears on the heel to denote the signature design. A black foam midsole contains Air-sole cushioning in the heel, anchored by a green rubber outsole that uses a herringbone pattern below.

Inspired by the Air Jordan 1 Metallic Pack, the Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Purple Metallic' brings an elevated two-tone look to grade-school sizes. The shoe's upper is built with white leather, highlighted by hits of metallic Court Purple on the eyelets, with more Court Purple on the tongue and branding. Mesh inserts emerge at the quarter panel and vamp, while underfoot, the white midsole sports visbile Air in the heel for cushioning.

A May 2017 release, the Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Pure Money' brings the classic minimalist colorway to boys' and girls' sizes. Featuring a white leather upper with mesh vents along the side wall, metallic silver on the eyelets and Jumpman branding bring subtle color. 'Pure $' is embroidered inside the heel tab.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro OG PS 'Fire Red' 2020 is a preschool iteration of the shoe. Released in November 2020, the shoe emerges with an OG colorway, built with a white leather base and tonal netting at the quarter panel and vamp. Black provides conrast, while Fire Red highlights the design. Underfoot, the foam midsole provides cushioning, with the usual visible Air in the heel noticeably absent.

Featuring a subdued colorway, the Air Jordan 4 Retro PS 'White Oreo' is a preschool iteration of the shoe. The retro basketball design emerges with a white leather build on the upper, complemented by Tech Grey on the eyelets and inner lining, matched by the speckled foam midsole. The usual mesh inserts mark the quarter panel and vamp, while underfoot, the look forgoes visible Air in the heel, with a rubber outsole included for traction.

Releasing in September 2019, the women’s Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Mushroom' displays a muted earth-tone colorway on the occasion of the silhouette’s 30th anniversary. The sneaker’s tan suede upper is contrasted by black hits on the laces, midsole and structural wings, while iridescent Jumpman branding at the tongue and heel add subtle pops of color.

In celebration of the Jordan franchise's 30th anniversary, this Air Jordan 4 Retro released in January 2015 as a girls' exclusive. On the eyelets, outsole and Jumpman logos, the upper is constructed with black nubuck, contrasted by Fuchsia Flash. On the lining, mesh inlay and encapsulated Air sole unit, neon green pops appear, providing another dose of contrast coloring.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro TEX Denim Worn Blue (PS)
description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro TEX PS 'Worn Blue Denim' dons a washed denim upper adorned with a grid-like contrast stitching on the side panel, replacing the AJ4's window netting. The Jumpman emblem adorns the tongue tag and heel areas for a signature look, while an off-white foam midsole works next to a gum rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro TD 'Abundance / Seafoam' has a pale green nubuck upper tooled with silver eyelets for a bit of contrast. True to the signature AJ4 details, the side panel netting, support wings, and Jumpman-stamped heel tab remain intact. Another Jumpman logo adorns the tongue, while an off-white foam midsole undergirds the design.

The Women's Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Net - Rattan' transforms the classic look, using an enlarged deco-sheath design on the side panel as well as the tongue. The cream-hued leather upper keeps some of the traditional details like the molded eyelets and support wings. The Jumpman logo lands on the heel tab, accompanied by metallic gold hangtags. The foam midsole contains a visible Air-sole unit for soft cushioning underfoot.

The 'Blank Canvas' Women's Air Jordan 4 Retro is crafted from off-white canvas material, featuring raw edges and stitching in the same tone. The Jumpman logo, embroidered on the tongue and heel, pairs with molded eyelets and maintain the monochromatic look of the shoe. A light ivory PU midsole houses a visible Air-sole unit in the heel rests on a herringbone-traction rubber outsole with multi-color paint splatter details.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro SE 'Somos Eternos' nods to the Día de Muertos, using a cream-hued leather upper surrounded by a gold floral pattern. The off-white leather forefoot overlay matches the support wings and Jumpman-branded heel tab for a cohesive vibe. Dusted in speckled details, the molded eyelets and rubber outsole sport a pastel green hue. A metallic gold Jumpman logo on the tongue is stamped with skull and sun motifs as a reference to the Day of the Dead.

shoeName: Jordan Tatum 4 & Jordan 11 Retro Low IE Jayson Tatum World Tour Pack
description: The Air Jordan Tatum 4 x Air Jordan 11 Retro Low IE 'Tatum World Tour Pack' honors Jayson Tatum's hometown of St. Louis. Both pairs are inspired by the St. Louis Cardinals' classic road uniforms. The Tatum 4 sports a gradient blend of red and yellow outlining powder blue panels comprised of nubuck, mesh, and hairy suede. The Air Jordan 11 Low IE rocks a pastel blue hairy suede upper with stitched suede overlays that go from the forefoot and wrap around the heel. These kicks have a color-shifting design that goes from yellow to red.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro Premium ‘Snakeskin’ treats Tinker Hatfield’s original 1989 design to a luxurious makeover, highlighted by a grey snakeskin texture on the leather upper. The reptilian finish is complemented by perforated quarter panels and tumbled leather construction on the shoe’s mudguard, ‘wings’ and tongue, the latter embossed with a Jumpman logo.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro PS 'Red Cement' brings smaller sizes for young children in the iconic color blocking of the original design. This mid-top sneaker draws inspiration from the 'White Cement' colorway, featuring a white leather upper with matching netting on the quarter panel and contrasting black eyelets. The support wings, Jumpman-branded heel tab, and full-length foam midsole are adorned with crimson accents and black speckled detailing. Reliable traction is provided by the durable herringbone-patterned rubber outsole.

Made for little feet, the Air Jordan 4 Retro TD 'Light Lemon Twist' rolls out a white leather upper with a pixelated graphic on the collar and forefoot overlay. Grey molded eyelets match the side panel netting, while the neon yellow support wings stand out — also landing on the Jumpman logos on the tongue and heel.

Part of the 30th anniversary of the Air Jordan 4, the Air Jordan 4 Retro BG 'Teal' is a boys' and girls' shoe that features varying shades of teal on its design. The shoe's darker leather upper sports mesh panels for breathability, while the eyelets, tongue tag and lining emerge in a lighter design. Black accents appear throughout, while the white midsole houses Air cushioning, and the outsole sports flex grooves.

shoeName: Jordan 4 RM White Black Neutral Grey Varsity Red (GS)

description: The Wmns Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Splatter' is a contrasting women's colorway. The shoe's leather upper appears in Silt Red, accented by a splatter pattern throughout. Contrating black emerges on the mesh inserts and eyelet flange, with metallic gold eyelets accenting the design. Underfoot, Air in the midsole gives way to a Phantom midsole.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro PS 'Abundance / Seafoam' dons an off-white foam midsole, bolstered by a herringbone-patterned rubber outsole. A layered, mint green nubuck upper keeps the classic side net panels, support wings, and silver molded eyelets. The Jumpman logo adorns the tongue and heel tab for a signature touch.

In September 2019, Nike introduced the Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'FIBA' as a tribute to the 18th international basketball tournament held in China. Designed for kids, this edition showcases a 'Gym Red' tumbled leather upper, complemented by coordinating lace wings and Obsidian anchors. The heel is adorned with a prominently displayed golden Jumpman emblem. The shoe features molded flag graphics on the vamp and quarter panel, symbolizing the global nature of the tournament. Completing the design is a tricolor rubber cupsole, with an Air unit for enhanced cushioning and comfort.

A grade-school shoe, the Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Cool Grey' 2019 released as part of the 30th anniversary of the silhouette. The shoe's leather and synthetic upper appears in Cool Grey, with Dark Charcoal on the signature eyelets. Flight branding marks the tongue tag, while underfoot, the contrasting white midsole sports visible Air in the heel for cushioning. A black rubber outsole with a herringbone pattern provides traction.

For a re-imagined version of the classic silhouette, the Levi's x Air Jordan 4 Retro ' White Denim ' puts together two iconic American brands. Both the upper and mid-sole of MJ's fourth signature shoe is clothed in pristine white denim, contrasted with Levi's signature red tab and the tongue tag Jumpman logo – itself a radically altered version of Levi's ' Two Horses ' paper patch. An outsole of gum rubber complements the all-white construction.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro Flyknit 'Hyper Royal' released as part of the Flyknit Pack in June 2019 to help celebrate the 30th anniversarty of the Air Jordan 4 silhouette. The shoe's upper is built with the flexible Flyknit while maintaining the signature design lines, finished in Hyper Royal. The signature eyelets remain intact, while underfoot, the Hyper Royal look continues onto the midsole, which houses visible Air in the heel. A rubber outsole is included for traction.

The Levi's x Air Jordan 4 'Black Denim' overhauls the classic silhouette with the iconic American denim brand's traditional materials and details. Besides the black denim covering the upper and midsole, the shoe is accentuated on the quarter panel with Levi's signature red tab. Another trademark of Levi's – the paper patch 'Two Horses' – is rebranded with a red Jumpman logo and placed on the tongue, featuring a tan color matched by a gum rubber outsole.

Made for preschoolers, the Air Jordan 4 Retro PS 'Platinum Gold' dons a platinum leather upper, contrasted by black netting on the side panel and throat. More black touches land on the forefoot overlay, support wings, molded eyelets and Jumpman-branded back tab, while another adorns the tongue. An off-white, full-length foam midsole completes the look.
Released in October 2016, the Air Jordan 4 Retro Premium ' Wheat ' features Ginger's premium leather top, tonal laces, a Air unit, and gum outsole.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GG 'Denim' emerges with a Dark Obsidian denim construction throughout its upper. The look maintains the usual Air Jordan 4 features, including molded eyelets, breathable quarter panel netting and extended heel tab, but the tonal construction is overshadowed by the Vivid Pink on the woven tongue tag, lining and Jumpman branding. The Air-infused midsole gives way to a Vivid Pink outsole.

The 'Obsidian' Air Jordan 4 Retro Premium features an upper-leather quilted Obsidian, waxed laces, all-white sole, and a heel-printed Jumpman. Released in September 2016, the sneaker also includes metallic gold lace eyelets and heel studs.

The Jordan Zion 4 'Flight' has a white knit and synthetic upper touched with speckled details on the mudguard. A red Jumpman logo embellishes the tongue of the right shoe, while a Zion emblem adorns the other tongue. These shoes have a full-length parabolic Zoom Air strobel, which pairs with a drop-in Cushlon 3.0 midsole. The see-through rubber outsole gets a computationally-designed pattern for steady traction on the court.

colorway: Pro Green/Treeline/Total Orange/Team Orange/Citron Pulse/Coconut Milk
description: The Jordan Luka 4 'Gone Camping' is inspired by Luka Doncic's love of the great outdoors. These kicks have a speckled, nature-inspired design on the knit upper. Doncic's logo adorns the tongue, while an embroidered forest graphic decorates the green leather heel tab. These signature shoes have a full-length Cushlon midsole with a Zoom Air forefoot unit. A partially see-through gum rubber outsole brings traction underfoot.

shoeName: Jordan Luka 4 Light Orewood Tangerine Tint
Jordan Tatum 4 & Jordan 11 Retro Low IE Jayson Tatum World Tour Pack Welcome to Tokyo

description: A follow-up to the Air Jordan 4 'Motorsport,' the Air Jordan 4 Retro BG 'Motorsports Alternate' sports an inverse colorway. The boys' and girls' shoe features a premium black leather upper accented by grey on the signature eyelets. Black mesh inserts provide breathability, while the toe and heel sport Game Royal, which appears on the eyelets and midfoot on the OG model.

A women's-exclusive colorway, the Air Jordan 4 Retro GS ‘Linen’ retroed the look in girls' sizes. The subdued scheme features a white upper with complementary Light Sand accents on the heel, signature eyelets, midsole base and outsole, while Jumpman branding emerges in an understated Border Blue. Air in the heel provides cushioning.

Made for toddlers, the Air Jordan 4 Retro TD 'Platinum Gold' has a platinum-colored leather upper with contrasting black pops on the grid webbing that covers the side, throat, eyelets, support wings, forefoot and back tab. The latter gets a metallic gold Jumpman, matching the other Jumpman logo on the tongue. An off-white foam midsole keeps every step soft and comfortable.

Showcasing an upper composed of beige suede with brown textile accents, the Air Jordan 4 Retro PS 'Cacao Wow' for preschoolers delivers a leather forefoot overlay in a richer brown hue and contrasting off-white support wings. Underfoot, a midsole with speckled detailing rests on a tan herringbone-patterned rubber outsole. Leather eyelets in a vibrant teal hue coordinate with the tongue and heel Jumpman logos.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro TD 'Oxidized Green' shoes have contrasting green accents on the collar lining, quarter panel and stitched-on eyelets that give them that rusty aesthetic. The dark emerald returns on the Jumpman logos on the tongue, heel tab and foam midsole. A grey rubber outsole wraps up the look in style.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS ‘Toro Bravo’ dropped in 2013, featuring a design reminiscent of the red suede Air Jordan 5 from 2009’s ‘Toro Bravo’ pack. Here, the grade-school edition of the Air Jordan 4 carries a nubuck upper coated in Fire Red, accented with black hits on the shoe’s wings, heel panel and midsole. Cement Grey eyelets match the rubber outsole underfoot.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro '25th Silver Anniversary' dropped in 2010, commemorating 25 years of Jordan Brand. Reminiscent of the silhouette’s classic ‘Pure Money’ colorway from 2006, the mid-top makes use of a white tumbled leather upper with metallic silver accents on the shoe’s molded eyelets, as well as the Jumpman logo that adorns the heel panel.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro LS 'Lightning' features inspiration from seasonal colors of Michael Jordan's motorcycle racing team. The shoe's nubuck upper appears in Tour Yellow, accented by grey and black on the eyelets, heel branding and mesh inserts. Air in the heel provides cushioning, while the shoe released exclusively to Team Jordan members and came with a Rare Air shirt.

Inspired by the disarray of a child's bedroom and available in pre-school sizes, the Air Jordan 4 Retro PS 'Messy Room' delivers an upper in blue nubuck with white quarter panel netting and a glossy patent leather overlay in a matching hue on the forefoot. This timeless silhouette rests upon a solid white foam midsole atop a sturdy rubber white-and-red outsole. The padded, mid-cut collar in ribbed white textile is lined with red fabric, and Jumpman branding appears on the tongue and back tab.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro LS GS 'Columbia' brings a look similar to the Air Jordan 4 'Columbia' to grade-school sizes. Featuring a white tumbled leather upper, perforations on the quarter panel replace the usual mesh netting. The lining, midsole, outsole and eyelets appear in subdued Midnight Navy, while the Jumpman branding on the tongue and heel add pops of Legend Blue.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro 'White Laser' features an allover laser-cut design on its white leather upper, with the design showing off various Air Jordan models. The signature eyelets emerge in black and Varsity Red, with more Varsity Red on the lining and outsole to complete a familiar 'Bred' look. Visible Air in the heel provides cushioning.

Paying tribute to traditional Southern style and inspired by the Kentucky Derby, the Air Jordan 4 Golf NRG 'Seersucker' emerges with a seersucker construction on its upper. Finished in a mix of Sail and Apricot Agate, the shoe's upper maintains signature design features, including quarter panel inserts and structural wings. Underfoot, the midsole houses the usual visible Air in the heel for cushioning, giving way to a translucent outsole plate with removable spikes to offer grip on the links.

Designed for younger sneaker enthusiasts, the Air Jordan 4 Retro TD 'Cacao Wow' showcases brown textile panels against a foundation in beige suede. Eye-catching Geode Teal accents are used for the leather eyelets while a deeper brown shade is applied to the leather overlay on the forefoot. The foam midsole is speckled and supported by a tan herringbone-patterned rubber outsole. Geode Teal Jumpman logos appear on the tongue and heel.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'DIY' features a look designed to be customized. The shoe's upper is built with leather, finished in white and contrasted by black throughout, including on the TPU eyelets and structural wings. The vamp includes the usual netting, but the quarter panel forgoes it, instead adding pen-and-ink grapics. Those designs can be filled in using markers, adding color to the look. Underfoot, the lightly speckled midsole houses visible Air in the heel for cushioning.

Inspired by Michael Jordan's first NBA contract, which included a 'Love of the Game' clause, the Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'For The Love Of The Game' released ahead of Valentine's Day 2019. The shoe's leather and netted upper appears in Rush Pink and True Berry, highlighted by a heart-shaped basketball on the lateral heel. Dotted detailing emerges throughout, while underfoot, a white Air midsole gives way to rubber outsole for traction.

shoeName: Jordan Max Aura 4 Cool Grey White

description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro Flyknit 'Volt' released in June 2019 to help celebrate the 30th anniversary of the silhouette. Built with Flyknit, the flexible, breathable material appears entirely in Volt. The signature eyelets remain intact, while underfoot, the midsole houses visible Air in the heel for cushioning. A tonal rubber outsole provides traction.

shoeName: Jordan Max Aura 4 White Black University Red

description: The remastered Air Jordan 4 Retro LS GS 'Oreo' 2015 was originally released back in 1999 and features a premium folded black leather top with sprinkled gray cement on the midsole and eyelets.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro SE TD 'Lemon Venom' is a toddlers' shoe with vibrant accents. The shoe's white leather base is highlighted by hits of Pink Blast and Lemon Venom, with mesh inserts included for breathability. Forgoing visible Air, a white foam midsole provides cushioning, giving way to rubber on the outsole for traction.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro OG TD 'Fire Red' 2020 is a toddlers' shoe with an OG colorway. Releasing in November 2020, the shoe's upper features a white leather construction, with netting on the quarter panel and vamp. Fire Red accents highlight the look throughout, while black provides contrast. Underfoot, a foam midsole that forgoes the usual visible Air in the heel offers cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan 4 RM Black Gorge Green Varsity Red (PS)

description: The 2016 reissue of the Air Jordan 4 Retro OG 'White Cement' brings back one of the silhouette’s original colorways from 1989. This grade-school edition features a design that’s true to the original, highlighted by a white leather upper accented with OG Nike Air branding on the heel panel. An additional branding hit takes the form of a red Jumpman logo on the woven Flight tongue tag.

colorway: Citron Pulse/Flash Crimson/Laser Orange/Orange Peel/Hyper Jade/Igloo

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro Olivia Kim No Cover (Women's)
description: The Olivia Kim x women’s Air Jordan 4 Retro 'No Cover' dropped in 2019 as part of a retro footwear collection conceived by Nordstrom’s VP of Creative Projects. As Olivia came of age in the ‘90s, it’s no surprise that the assortment features an Air Jordan 4. Inspired by MJ’s ‘Black Cat’ nickname, the sneaker boasts an all-black calf hair upper, complete with Nike Air branding on the heel.

shoeName: Jordan 4 RM Black Summit White Racer Blue

description: This kids' exclusive, the Nike Air Jordan 4 Retro SE GG, displays Michael Jordan's famous signature in a fun light. Debuted in November 2019, this version sports a tiger-striped textile upper with leather elements, mesh inserts, and optimized lace wings. The tongue and heel features iconic Jordan Flight branding. An Air-equipped midsole and herringbone-patterned rubber outsole in Rush Violet complete this playful offering.

shoeName: Jordan One Take 4 Black White Metallic Gold

description: With perforations across the vamp and cushioned collar, the Eastside Golf x Jordan ADG 4 '1961' features a black nubuck upper with water-resistance and lined with green textile. An external TPU heel counter features a metallic gold Jumpman emblem while the tongue displays Eastside Golf's player logo. The black rubber outsole underfoot incorporates an integrated traction pattern for exceptional grip. Marking the year the PGA stopped restricting non-white athletes, the insoles of each shoe carry the words 'Change' and '1961.’

shoeName: Jordan ADG 4 Golf Football Grey Alabaster

description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro GS 'Motorsports' features a design that replicates the ultra-limited release given to the 16 members of Michael Jordan’s motorcycle racing system. The design on the retro mid-top utilizes the same color blocking as the silhouette’s ‘Mars Blackmon’ colorway from 2006, featuring royal blue accents instead of the original’s Varsity Red.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro PS 'Oxidized Green' rolls out a white leather upper with vivid green pops on the collar lining, knit quarter panel and eyelets. Green Jumpman logos distinguish the tongue and the leather heel tab. Dark emerald appears again on the lightweight foam midsole, anchored by a sturdy grey rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro MCS 'White Cement' rolls out a white leather upper with a padded collar with a side panel netting, black molded eyelets, and grey support wings wrapped in speckled details. The tongue tag gets a red Jumpman, while another decorates the speckled grey heel tab. The outsole has widely-placed studs to facilitate quick cuts on the field.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro PS 'Light Lemon Twist' dons a white leather upper with a subtle pixelated graphic on the forefoot overlay as well as the collar. Grey molded eyelets and a matching side panel netting complement the design. Neon yellow support wings match the Jumpman emblem on the tongue and heel.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro TD 'Hyper Violet' rocks a white leather upper with violet eyelets, support wings and the Jumpman logos on the tongue and back tab. These toddler shoes ride on a soft foam midsole, contrasted by a sturdy violet rubber outsole to finish out the look.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro BG ‘30th Anniversary Laser’ dropped in 2015 as part of a special collection celebrating the 30th anniversary of Jordan Brand. The shoe’s defining feature is the laser-etched leather upper, a motif that made its first appearance on the Jordan 4 in 2005. This grade-school edition is finished with an icy translucent outsole and pops of metallic silver on the simplified midsole and 3M reflective tongue.

shoeName: Jordan 4 Retro Travis Scott Cactus Jack (Friends and Family)
Jordan 4 Retro Fire Red Mars Blackmon
description: Based on the 1989 OG 'Fire Red' colorway, the Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Mars Blackmon' gives the nod to Mars Blackmon, Spike Lee's character who was a staple in Air Jordan commercials in the 80s and 90s. A graphic of Blackmon graces the lateral heel, while the shoe itself sports a familiar mix of white, black and Varsity Red. Mesh inserts are included for breathability, with visible Air in the heel for cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan 4 RM Sail Dark Team Red Coconut Milk (Women's)
Jordan 4 RM Diffused Blue Ashen Slate (GS)
colorway: White/Prism Pink/Diffused Blue/Ashen Slate/Football Grey/Coconut Milk

description: The Jordan Luka 4 GS 'Gone Camping' displays a nature-inspired design reminiscent of Luka Doncic's love of the great outdoors. Flightwire technology supports the speckled, orange knit upper. Doncic's logo decorates the tongue, while a forest graphic is etched on the green leather heel tab. The Cushlon foam midsole contains a responsive Zoom Air forefoot unit for a springy feel underfoot.

Jordan Brand teamed up with Virgil Abloh's luxury streetwear label to create the Off-White x Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Fire Red' in October 2020. A follow-up to an early 2020 Air Jordan 5 collaboration, the shoe's upper features an off-white textile construction, with the midfoot, collar and reflective silver tongue sporting circular cutouts. Helvetica text marks the medial side, while underfoot, a contrasting black midsole houses Air in the heel for cushioning. A pre-yellowed finish on the outsole, which provides traction, completes the look.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Fire Red Black Tongue (2025) (GS)
description: The 2025 edition of the Air Jordan 5 Retro GS 'Fire Red' rolls out a white leather upper with a see-through side panel netting and an embroidered '23' on the heel. Red knit lines the padded collar, while a red Jumpman logo stands out on the tongue against a black background. Black shark tooth details decorate the red foam midsole, backed by a see-through, herringbone-patterned outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro PSG Paris Saint-Germain Off Noir
description: The Paris Saint-Germain x Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Off Noir' has a blackout leather upper complemented with ripstop textile on the midfoot overlay and toe box. The side panel netting is replaced by black nubuck covered in a PSG debossed Eiffel Tower logo monogram. A rose-colored embroidered Jumpman adorns the reflective tongue, matching the satiny collar lining. Soft pink shark tooth details embellish the foam midsole, which works with a pre-yellowed, partially see-through rubber outsole.

Giving the nod to the University of Oregon, the Air Jordan 5 Retro SE 'Oregon' emerges with the school's colors on its classic basketball construction. Built with suede, the upper appears in Apple Green, with black constrast on the eyelets, tongue and mesh inserts. Underfoot, more black emerges on the Air midsole, which is accented by Yellow Strike on the signature shark-tooth detailing.

Revisiting a color scheme from Jordan Brand's 2006 Lifestyle Series, the 2024 version of the Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Olive' delivers a textured suede upper in an olive-green shade, with matching molded eyelets and ventilated netting on the quarter panels. The olive-hued PU midsole is adorned with orange shark-tooth patterns, houses visible Air-sole cushioning, and is reinforced by a clear rubber outsole. Vibrant orange accents are found on the interior lining and the Jumpman logo details adorning the rear heel and reflective tongue.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro SoleFly Black Aurora Green

description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Alternate Grape' brings an updated look to a colorway that debuted as an OG look in 1990. Built with purple suede, the upper includes mesh inserts at the quarter panel and New Emerald on the tongue and lace lock. Underfoot, the midsole sports more New Emerald on the shark-tooth detailing, while Air in the heel provides cushioning.

Bringing back a two-tone colorway first released in 2006 is the 2022 edition of the Air Jordan 5 'Green Bean.' Similar to the original mid-top, a light grey nubuck upper is entirely coated in a reflective finish. Bright green accents make their way to the interior lining and the embroidered Jumpman logo on the heel and tongue, which is repeated on the shark-tooth detailing that enlivens the dark grey polyurethane midsole. It's built on a translucent herringbone-tread rubber outsole. The Jordan 5 'Green Bean' 2022 will drop on May 28, 2022.

Originally released in 2013, the Air Jordan 5 Retro brings back the two-tone look with this 2021 release. Faithful to the original, the shoe's upper is built with suede, finished in black and contrasted by white on the collar lining, interior tongue and heel branding. Translucent netting marks the quarter panel, while tonal TPU eyelets bolster the lacing system. Underfoot, a white polyurethane midsole includes visible Air in the heel to provide cushioning, with speckled shark-tooth detailing accenting the forefoot. An icy translucent rubber outsole offers traction and deviates from the black-and-white design.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro OG 'Black Metallic' 2016 brings back an OG colorway from 1990. Featuring the same black nubuck upper with a 3M reflective tongue, Fire Red accents emerge on the branding and lace lock, with metallic silver on the shark tooth detailing. Air in the heel provides cushioning, while the outsole includes icy blue translucent sections. This 2016 release was the fourth retro of the shoe.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro OG Black Metallic Reimagined (GS)
description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro OG GS 'Black Metallic Reimagined' has a black nubuck upper tooled with overlays outlined in reflective piping. Molded eyelets, lace locks and the traditional panel netting comprise some of the key details. 3M reflective touches land on the Jumpman-branded tongue, as well as the Nike Air heel logo. Metallic silver sharktooth details adorn the black midsole, which contains an Air-sole heel unit and a partially see-through rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Jade Horizon' floods Tinker Hatfield's classic 1990 design in a pastel colorway. A pale green shade coats the suede upper, with translucent quarter panel netting on the lateral side and tonal TPU eyelets. A pink Jumpman logo stands out against the silver reflective tongue. The same shade of pink arrives on the signature shark-tooth detailing that appears on the black polyurethane midsole. Air-sole cushioning is visible in the heel, with an icy translucent outsole underfoot.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Awake NY Arctic Pink
description: The Awake NY x Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Boro - Arctic Pink' brings a black foam midsole detailed with a red shark tooth design and a classic rubber outsole. These shoes sport Awake NY's 'A' logo built into the side panel netting, along with a red Jumpman, layered above a matching Awake wordmark on the silver reflective tongue. 'NY' and '23' signoffs are embroidered on the heel of the right and left shoe, respectively, as a final signature touch.

Adding some color to the 1990s silhouette designed by Tinker Hatfield and brought to the public by Mars Blackmon is the Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Racer Blue.' It features a black nubuck upper with tonal TPU eyelets, translucent quarter panel netting and a reflective silver tongue. The mid-top's latter has contrasting touches of royal blue on the embroidered Jumpman and interior lining. The blue polyurethane midsole has lightweight cushioning with black shark tooth detailing and visible Air-sole cushioning in the heel. It rides on a translucent rubber outsole for a better grip.

Early-era AJ5 PE's reminiscent of Chris Paul's New Orleans Hornets tenure are revisited in the Air Jordan 5 Retro ‘Aqua.’ The upper in solid black nubuck is brightened by the bright-yellow specked shark-tooth elements on the black midsole and the turquoise outsole detailing. Branding is subtle, with the signature Jumpman on the metallic tongue backed with cushioned teal which repeats at the heel. Clear quarter panel netting provides ventilation and Air-sole cushioning delivers easy wear on and off the court.

The 2025 version of the Air Jordan 5 Retro GS 'Grape' dons a white leather upper with the side panel netting and molded eyelets. A teal-hued embroidered Jumpman contrasts the purple tongue, while the Nike Air logo adorns the heel. A purple foam midsole gets turquoise sharktooth details and a visible Nike Air heel unit. A see-through rubber outsole completes the look in style.

This iteration of the Air Jordan 5 Retro takes color inspiration from the Air Jordan 11 'Concord'. A white leather upper is matched with a black midsole, while pops of Concord appear on across various parts of the shoe including the collar lining, shark teeth, and Jumpman logo on the tongue and back heel. Traditional AJ5 details remain, including the trancluent herringbone rubber outsole and 3M reflective silver hit on the tongue.

Released in April 2021, the Air Jordan 5 Retro GS 'Raging Bull' 2021 brings back one half of the 2009 Raging Bull pack. Emerging in grade-school sizing, the shoe's suede upper appears in Varsity Red, with the signature quarter panel netting marking the side wall. Black contrast throughout, including on the molded eyelets, completes the familiar 'Bred' look, with reflective silver detailing highlighting the tongue. Underfoot, the midsole houses visible Air in the heel for cushioning.

The 2026 remake of the Air Jordan 5 Retro OG 'Sunset' celebrates the 20th anniversary from the 2006 release. These sneakers have a see-through side panel netting and an orange Jumpman logo embroidered on the heel. Another Jumpman emblem lands on the matte silver reflective tongue. Orange shark tooth details adorn the white foam midsole, which gets an Air-Sole heel unit, anchored by a herringbone patterned rubber outsole.

Giving the classic silhouette a pastel springtime makeover is the Air Jordan 5 Retro SE 'Easter.' The smooth nubuck upper finished in Regal Pink features traditional AJ5 elements, including TPU eyelets, lace locks, and quarter-panel netting. Embroidered Jumpman branding is on the heel overlay and pale green padded tongue. On the inside, the sockliner displays vibrant bands of color in a nod to the tradition of dyed Easter eggs. On the bottom is an Air-assisted polyurethane midsole with speckled shark-tooth detailing and a green-tinged translucent rubber outsole that glows in the dark.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro DJ Khaled We The Best Sail
description: The DJ Khaled x Air Jordan 5 Retro ‘Sail' uses pastel hues and subtle logo highlights for its part in the ‘We the Best’ capsule collection. An off-white leather upper is highlighted by pastel embellishments and a powder-blue quilted lining, contrasting with the Air-assisted polyurethane midsole in Violet Star. The tongue features the classic Jumpman logo against a reflective silver finish, with 'Keep Going' hidden on its interior side. The two heel overlays contrast, with one adorned by the Nike Air log while the other proclaiming 'We the Best,' which also decorates the right shoe's translucent rubber outsole.

The Women's Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Golden Ticket' dons an off-white leather upper, contrasted by dark brown touches on the collar lining and eyelets. Michael Jordan's jersey number is embroidered on the heel, while the lace locks nod to the OG design. A metallic gold Jumpman logo lands on the tongue and heel, maintaining the signature look. A brown foam midsole gets sharktooth-style details, complemented with an Air-sole heel unit for a resilient feel.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'White Black', also known as the Jordan 5 'Reverse Metallic', rocks a white leather upper with matching molded eyelets and signature netting on the side. Black knit touches the padded collar, while the tongue is treated with a reflective, silver finish and a bold Jumpman logo. The foam midsole packs an Air-sole heel unit and a speckled, silver shark tooth area. A partially see-through rubber outsole keeps the herringbone pattern designed for enhanced traction on the court.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro SE 'Sail' maintains classic AJ5 details, including lace locks, molded eyelets and the iconic quarter panel netting. A black embroidered Jumpman logo adorns the tongue and the back of the heel, contrasting the off-white suede on the upper. The midsole is equipped with an Air-sole heel unit and bolstered with speckled black sharktooth details to give these shoes their iconic look.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Shattered Backboard' brings a classic Jordan Brand look to a different classic silhouette. Drawing from the Air Jordan 1 colorway, the shoe's upper emerges with a white leather base on the upper, sporting textile mesh on the collar, throat and quarter panel, with the latter replacing the usual netting. The reflective silver tongue includes Total Orange Jumpman branding, matched underfoot by the polyurethane midsole, which includes visible Air in the heel for cushioning. A herringbone rubber outsole offers traction.

Inspired by the 1990s Red and Black flight suits and the 2009 Air Jordan 5 'Raging Bull' sneaker, the 'Red Suede' Air Jordan 5 Retro features an upper University Red suede with black shark teeth on the midsole. Released in July 2017, a 3M reflective tongue and an ice-white translucent outsole are also included in the sneaker.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro SE 'Midnight Navy' features a monochromatic textile and suede upper, with netting on the quarter panel and a cushioned heel collar. The sneaker rests upon a white polyurethane midsole with speckled shark-tooth patterns and a visible Air-sole unit in the heel. Black molded eyelets complement the Jumpman logos on both the tongue and rear heel. Below, a clearrubber outsole with a hint of blue offers excellent traction with a classical herringbone pattern.

Celebrating the 10th anniversary of the Jordan Brand's scholarship program, the Women's Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Wings' is highlighted by a hand-print graphic on the see-through rubber outsole. These shoes have a silver satin upper with grey molded eyelets and the classic side netting. '10' is embroidered on the heel, while an inscription across the toe of each shoe reads 'In This Family No One Flies Alone.' The Jumpman logo decorates the tongue and heel, where the logo joins the Wings emblem.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'El Grito - Sail' lauds Mexico's cultural heritage, using a moniker alluding to the historic battle cry that sparked the Mexican War of Independence. These shoes have an off-white tumbled leather upper with midfoot perforations replacing the typical side netting. Embossed patterns inspired by Mexican architecture grace the toe, heel and tongue — the latter stamped with an embroidered burgundy Jumpman logo. An Air-sole heel unit encased within the foam midsole has red and green sharktooth details on the left and right shoe, respectively.

The Women’s Air Jordan 5 Retro ‘Lucky Green’ takes colorblocking cues from the 1990 ‘Fire Red’ release. The white leather upper reveals a breathable quarter panel netting and a bright green lining. The jumpman logo appears on the tongue and heel, in addition to an embroidered ‘23’ on the side of the heel. These shoes have a lightweight midsole that has black shark tooth details and an exposed Air-sole heel unit. A see-through rubber outsole reveals a herringbone-style pattern for smooth grip.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro A Ma Maniére Black Collective
description: The A Ma Maniere x Air Jordan 5 'Black Collective' rocks a white leather upper with a pre-yellowed quarter panel netting and an embroidered '23' signoff. Rich quilted burgundy lines the interior, matching the Nike Air heel logo as well as the tongue. The latter has a Jumpman logo on the right shoe and A Ma Maniere's 'A' emblem on the left. Another splash of burgundy occupies the midsole, accented with matching sharktooth details, complemented by an aged, see-through rubber outsole.

The Supreme x Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Desert Camo' dropped alongside white and black colorways of the retro silhouette in October 2015. Featuring a unique desert camo print on a textile upper, the mid-top features a silver reflective tongue and ‘Sup’ branding on the quarter panel. Additional unique details take include ‘94’ on the lateral heel and dual Jumpman and Supreme logo hits on the outsole.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Blue Suede' features a Game Royal suede upper with black shark teeth in the midsole, inspired by the flight suits worn by Michael Jordan during the initial Air Jordan campaigns. The Air Jordan 5 'Blue Suede' was released in September 2017 and joins the 'Red Suede' colorway as part of the ' Flight Suit ' pack.

The artistry and culture of China are showcased in the CLOT x Air Jordan 5 Retro Low ‘Black Classic Jade.’ The shoe’s quarter-panel netting, lace locks, and glow-in-the-dark translucent rubber outsole feature jade-and-crimson accents echoing traditional jade ornaments. The black satin upper provides sharp contrast, with mismatched Jumpman and CLOT branding on the back heel. The lateral heel is embellished with '2 3' in Chinese characters. A black Air-assisted midsole, featuring speckled shark-tooth detailing in a metallic silver finish, provides superior support for this low-top interpretation.

The Women's Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Luminous Green' brings an off-white leather upper with perforated leather side panels, replacing the see-through netting from the original design. Subtle green pops land on the molded eyelets, shoelaces, and collar lining, as well as the '23' embroidered on the heel and the Jumpman emblems adorning the tongue and heel. These kicks ride on a black foam midsole with pale green shark-tooth details and a visible Nike Air unit. A slightly see-through herringbone patterned outsole keeps traction strong underfoot.

Released in March 2021, the Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Stealth 2.0' updates the 2006 Air Jordan 5 'Stealth.' Built with tumbled white leather, the shoe's upper is highlighted by reflective silver detailing on the tongue and Hyper Royal on the lace toggle and inner lining. Underfoot, the midsole includes visible Air in the heel for cushioning, with the signature shark-tooth detailing contrasting the look in black.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro SP 'Michigan' gives the nod to the Michigan Wolverines. Released in August 2019, the shoe features a nubuck upper finished in Amarillo, supported by the classic TPU mesh inserts at the midfoot. The tongue, eyelets and collar lining emerge in College Navy to complete the team look, while a toggle lacing system supports the fit. A retro tag is stitched onto the heel, while underfoot, the midsole incorporates both colors as well as the usual shark tooth detailing, with a visible Air unit providing cushioning.

The 2026 reissue of the Air Jordan 5 Retro TD 'Wolf Grey' rocks a grey nubuck upper equipped with a side panel netting, molded eyelets, and an embroidered '23' on the heel. The Jumpman logo appears on the elongated tongue as well as the heel. Taking cues from an American WWII fighter plane, speckled shark tooth details decorate the grey foam midsole, anchored by a pale blue, herringbone-patterned rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro SE Craft Light Orewood Brown
description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro SE Craft 'Light Orewood Brown' modernizes a classic Jordan design. Constructed from a combination of suede and textile in a taupe hue, the upper is fastened with two-tone laces and features clear quarter-panel mesh. The tongue is lined with orange textile material and is decorated with the iconic Jumpman logo. The mid-top silhouette is mounted on An off-white polyurethane midsole with speckled shark-tooth detailing and a visible Air-sole unit in the heel provides support. The translucent herringbone-traction rubber outsole provides excellent traction for quick pivots on the hardwood.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro OG Black Metallic Reimagined (TD)
description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro OG TD 'Black Metallic Reimagined' brings back the 1990 original with a new twist. These shoes have a black nubuck upper, with its characteristic panel netting and overlays piped in silver reflective piping. More 3M accents arrive on the Nike Air heel logo and Jumpman-branded tongue. The black foam midsole gets speckled, metallic silver sharktooth-style details to finish the look.

The 2013 edition of the Air Jordan 5 Retro ‘Grape’ brings back one of the silhouette’s OG colorways from 1990. The reissue features a design that’s mostly true to the original, though Jumpman branding replaces the traditional Nike Air heel embroidery. The shoe’s unique purple and teal accents are complemented by signature Jordan 5 details, including lace locks and a translucent rubber outsole.

The Wmns Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Blue Bird' features a vibrant look on its classic basketball construction. The shoe's upper emerges in suede, finished in Photo Blue and secured by molded TPU eyelets and a lace lock. The quarter panel includes clear netting, while more blue marks the Jumpman on the silver tongue. Underfoot, the signature shark-tooth detailing also appears in silver, with visible Air in the heel offering cushioning. A translucent rubber outsole provides traction.

Mars Blackmon, the iconic Spike Lee character who co-starred with #23 in many ads, was the inspiration for the Women’s Air Jordan 5 Retro ‘Dunk on Mars.’ The legacy shoe's Air-assisted black midsole in leaping red-and-orange flames is topped with a suede upper in brilliant scarlet-red with clear netting on the quarter panel and a see-through lace lock securing black laces. The ubiquitous Jumpman decorates the tongue in the silver metallic reflective tongue, and a stitched ‘23’ appears on the lateral heel.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Low Chinese New Year (2021)
description: The Air Jordan 5 Low 'Chinese New Year 2021' released as part of Nike's 2021 Chinese New Year collection. Inspired by a celebratory temple fair, the shoe's upper features a tearaway construction, appearing in Sail and eventually revealing a multicolor firecracker pattern. The heel includes an embroidered banner graphic, while hits of Chile Red highlight the look througout. Visible Air in the heel underfoot provides cushioning.

Michael Jordan's fifth signature shoe gets a new identity with the women’s Air Jordan 5 Retro Gore-Tex ‘Off-Noir.' The upper is in faded black nubuck layered with quarter-panel netting and a waterproof Gore-Tex membrane. Gore-Tex branding on the left lateral heel and '23' on the right add popd of color alongside a crimson Jumpman, which also adorns the tongue. The midsole features shark-tooth detailing and a visible Air-sole unit in the heel, while the translucent rubber outsole has a vintage, pre-yellowed hue.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro JSP Laney Varsity Royal
description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Laney' features a look inspired by Michael Jordan's high school alma mater. Dressed in the Varsity Royal and Varsity Maize colorway of Emsley A. Laney High, the shoe features a nubuck construction with mesh inserts for breathability. The tongue Jumpman branding is built with chenille, while underfoot, a speckled Light Charcoal midsole houses a visible Air unit in the heel.

An alternative black-based version of the classic 'Grape' colorway is the Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Black Grape.' The design features an upper black nubuck with accents of New Emerald and Grape Ice. The sneaker also comes with an icy blue translucent outsole, which was released in June 2013.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Laney' 2013 gives the nod to Michael Jordan's high school. Originally released in 2000, the shoe's white leather upper is accented by hits of Royal Blue and Varsity Maize to complete the E.A. Laney High School look. Visible Air in the heel and an icy blue translucent outsole maintain the signature Jordan 5 tooling.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro ‘Olympic’ dropped in 2016 to coincide with the Rio Summer Olympics. The celebratory design makes use of a white leather upper, complemented by metallic gold accents on the padded tongue and lace locks, as well as the signature shark-tooth detailing on the contrasting black midsole. A final touch of gold appears on the Jumpman logo beneath the translucent outsole.

The Air Jordan 5 'Camo' features an upper Dark Stucco suede with tongue and heel camouflage accents. The design also involves Fire Red accents, released in September 2017, and sits on top of an icy translucent outsole.

The Off-White x Air Jordan 5 Retro SP TD 'Sail' released as part of a collaboration with Virgil Abloh's luxury streetwear brand. A toddlers' shoe, the upper is built with stitched textile, finished in Sail and Muslin and highlighted by '23' on the heel. A zip-tie hang-tag and Helvetica text on the medial side bring signature Abloh touches to the look, while the midfoot, collar and left tongue include circular cutouts. Underfoot, a pre-yellowed translucent rubber outsole provides traction.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro ‘Oreo’ lives up to its unofficial moniker with a monochromatic black nubuck upper and contrasting white detailing. The latter appears on the sneaker’s interior tongue and midsole, which is embellished with a speckled black shark-tooth design. Exterior branding takes the form of dual Jumpman hits, one in dark grey on the tongue and the other embroidered in white on the heel.

Paris Saint-Germain and Jordan Brand continue their partnership with a new Air Jordan 5 Retro Low. Details of this generational collaboration can be found all over the shoe, including a tricolor 'Paname' tag on the lateral middle panel, a wax seal Jumpman badge on the back heel, and PARIS stitched on the inside of the tongue. A visible Air-sole unit can be found on the black midsole, while a translucent outsole reveals a circular Jumpman PSG logo underneath.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro ‘Satin Bred’ is based on by an old color sample from 1990. This colorway maintains the basic design DNA of the classic silhouette, including the signature netting at the quarter panel, the 3M reflective coating on the tongue, and the outsole's icy translucent rubber. Those details complement an upper constructed entirely in black satin, with contrasting pops of University Red on the Jumpman logo and midsole to finish the Bred color scheme.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Bronze' released in celebration of the 2016 Rio Summer Olympic Games. The design combines a white midsole and ice-blue translucent outsole with a Bright Grape and Obsidian upper. The sneaker was released in September 2016 with a Metallic Red Bronze tongue inspired by the third-place medals.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Fire Red Black Tongue (2025) (PS)
description: The 2025 version of the Air Jordan 5 Retro PS 'Fire Red' uses white leather on the upper, including a side panel netting and an embroidered '23' signoff on the heel. A red Jumpman logo adorns the black tongue, while the Nike Air logo lands on the heel. These shoes have a red foam midsole with black sharktooth details. A see-through, herringbone-patterned outsole keeps the traction strong.

The Air Jordan 5 'Pre-Grape' is influenced by a sample from Tinker Hatfield in 1990 to be released instead of the iconic 'Grape' colorway. The sneaker features an upper, gray and turquoise leather of the Midnight Navy and a reflective tongue of 3M. The structure also features turquoise shark teeth and an icy blue translucent outsole, released in May 2015.

A follow-up to 2013's Air Jordan 5 'Bel Air,' the Air Jordan 5 Retro GS 'Alternate Bel-Air' released in 2020. A grade-school shoe, the upper is built with white leather, highlighted by a geometric print on the collar lining. Mismatched branding brings further color to the look, while a lace lock secures the fit. Underfoot, the midsole sports speckling on the signature shark-tooth detailing, with visible Air in the heel of the midsole providing cushioning.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Anthracite' brings a unique construction to the classic basketball silhouette. Built with suede and textile, the shoe's upper appears in Anthracite, contrasted by the eyelets and quarter panel netting. Rather than the tongue, the usual reflective detailing makes its way to the quarter panel, while underfoot, speckled shark-tooth detailing highlights the midsole. Visible Air in the heel is included for cushioning, giving way to a rubber outsole for traction.

The 2025 version of the Air Jordan 5 Retro TD 'Grape' stays true to the original 1990 release, consisting of a white leather upper with the customary side panel netting and a Nike Air-branded heel. Purple touches decorate the tongue, contrasted by a turquoise Jumpman logo and a foam midsole. The latter gets the classic shark tooth details in the same turquoise hue from above.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Trophy Room Ice Blue
description: The Trophy Room x Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Ice Blue' is inspired by the trophy room in the Jordan family home. The shoe's rich suede upper emerges in Ice Blue, accented by University Red on the tongue and lining. Metallic gold appears on the lace lock and heel branding, which sports '23' on the right shoe and '5' on the left, the jersey numbers of Michael Jordan and his son Marcus. Underfoot, the translucent outsole reveals a wood-grain look modeled after the flooring in Jordan's trophy room, while the release was limited to 7,000 individually numbered pairs.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'White Metallic' 2015 recreates a look that debuted in 2000. Featuring a white tumbled leather upper, metallic silver accents emerge on the tongue, branding, lace lock and midsole detailing, with black on the toe and branding. Underfoot, Air provides cushioning, and the outsole features icy translucent sections.

The Off-White x Air Jordan 5 Retro SP PS 'Sail' is a preschool shoe. Made in collaboration with Virgil Abloh, the shoe's upper is built with semitranslucent textile, finished primarily in Sail. The tongue sports a reflective silver finish, with a circular cutout on the left tongue matched by the midfoot and collar. A zip-tie and lines of Helvetica text on the medial side add signature Abloh details, while underfoot, the midsole forgoes the usual visible Air, giving way to a pre-yellowed translucent rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan XXXV Low Cosmic Deception Luka Doncic PE
description: The Luka Doncic x Air Jordan 35 Low 'Galaxy' was made for the star NBA player. The shoe's upper is built with a mix of leather and textile, finished with a white and lime green base that's highlighted by celestial graphics on the heel, medial eyestay and tongue. The tongues sport a silver iridescent Jumpman on the right shoe and Luka Doncic's personal logo on the left, while a pink tongue pull-loop provides easy on and off. Underfoot, the Eclipse Plate 2.0 houses visible Zoom Air in the forefoot and heel for cushioning, giving way to a semitranslucent rubber outsole for traction.

Dropping in October 2015, the Supreme x Air Jordan 5 Retro ‘White’ showcases a rare collaborative effort centered around Jordan 5. Like its black and desert camo counterparts, this pair features a reflective silver tongue with ‘94’ branding and ‘Sup’ lettering on the quarter panel. The rest of the upper is built with white leather, mounted atop a matching white midsole with red shark tooth detailing.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro '3Lab5' borrows the Air Jordan 3’s signature elephant print detailing and blows it up, applying the unique design in all-over fashion to the upper of the AJ5. The neutral combination of black and grey is accented by pops of Gamma Blue on the lace locks and shark tooth detailing, contrasting a solid black midsole. A translucent rubber outsole delivers durable traction underfoot.

Released in March 2021, the Air Jordan 5 Retro GS 'Stealth 2.0' is a follow-up to the 2006 'Stealth' colorway. Built with tumbled leather, the shoe's upper appears in white, with tonal netting on the quarter panel. Hyper Royal marks the inner lining and tongue branding as well as the lace lock, which secures the fit. Underfoot, the usual shark-tooth detailing accents the midsole, which houses visible Air for cushioning, while an icy rubber outsole is included for traction.

The Supreme x Air Jordan 5 Retro ‘Black’ launched as part of the New York skate brand’s Fall/Winter 2015 collection. Dropping alongside white and camo colorways, this pair makes use of a black nubuck upper with a reflective silver tongue and pops of Fire Red on the collar lining and midsole. Supreme branding adorns the shoe’s quarter panel netting and beneath the translucent outsole underfoot.

Releasing for the 30th anniversary of the silhouette, the Air Jordan 5 Retro SE GS 'What The' is a grade-school shoe. Drawing from previous non-OG colorways, the mismatched shoes incorporate elements of the 'Tokyo,' 'Raging Bull,' 'Laser,' 'Green Bean,' 'Army Olive' and 'Quai 54.' Reflective 3M detailing marks both tongues, while underfoot, the midsoles both include visible Air in the heel for cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan Luka 5 Year of the Horse
colorway: Light British Tan/Baroque Brown/Team Red/Metallic Red Bronze

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Low Girls That Hoop (Women's)
description: Adding new materials and colors to the classic silhouette is the women's Air Jordan 5 Retro Low 'Artic Pink.' The low-top's pink nubuck upper has molded eyelets and OG plastic lace locks. A TPU grille shows a reflective finish on the quarter panel underlay. It's built on a red polyurethane midsole with black shark tooth detailing and a visible Air-sole unit in the heel with a translucent rubber outsole that features a herringbone traction pattern.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Island Green' takes on a tropical aesthetic, highlighted by Island Green accents on a white leather upper embellished with a tonal palm tree print and a 3M reflective finish. Completing the distinctive design are the silhouette’s signature flourishes, including clear lace locks, shark tooth detailing on the midsole and a translucent rubber outsole underfoot.

The 2025 iteration of the Air Jordan 5 Retro PS 'Grape' sports a white leather upper with the classic side panel netting and a Nike Air-branded heel. The purple tongue has a turquoise, embroidered Jumpman logo for contrast. These shoes have a purple foam midsole, complemented with a turquoise shark tooth detail and a see-through rubber outsole.

Reintroducing a beloved colorway from Jordan Brand's 2000s archives is the 2023 release of the Air Jordan 5 Retro SE GS 'Burgundy' for big kids. Clear netting on the quarter panel pairs with contrast stitching against the luxurious burgundy nubuck upper. Molded eyelets, a cushioned mid-cut collar, and the iconic Jumpman logo on the reflective silver tongue contribute to its heritage appeal. The back heel is also adorned with a Jumpman. The burgundy PU midsole boasts speckled shark-tooth patterns and rides on a grippy clear rubber outsole with herringbone-patterned traction.

Adapted for the links, the Air Jordan 5 Low Golf 'Wolf Grey' largely maintains its classic construction. The shoe's upper is built with leather, finished in grey and sporting the usual netting on the quarter panel. Molded eyelets support the lacing system, while the silver tongue sports reflective detailing. Underfoot, the midsole includes the usual shark-tooth detailing, with visible Air in the heel offering cushioning. Removable spikes on the outsole provide traction.

colorway: Deep Royal Blue/Team Orange-Midnight Navy-Atomic Red
description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro Low 'Knicks' takes color inspiration from Michael Jordan's Eastern Conference nemesis. A Deep Royal Blue hue makes up the nubuck upper, with Team Orange accents on the midsole, collar lining and Jumpman logo on the tongue. A white midsole with visible Max Air unit and translucent outsole finish the look.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Pro Stars' is celebrating the short-lived 90s Saturday Morning cartoon, "Pro Stars", featuring Michael Jordan, Wayne Gretzky, and Bo Jackson. Released in June 2015, the design features a black netting white leather top, a midsole Cement Grey and Poison Green, Infrared shark teeth, and a translucent ice-blue outsole.

The Air Jordan Luka 5 Venom delivers a vibrant and high energy take on the silhouette through a bold and tonal color execution. Illusion green dominates the upper, creating a bright and eye catching base, while black accents add contrast that highlights the structure. The design feels dynamic and expressive, emphasizing movement and speed.

Fans of the Luka line appreciate how colorways like this push visual boundaries while maintaining performance focus. The bright green palette gives it a standout presence on and off the court. It is a sneaker that reflects modern basketball design with a bold and experimental twist.

The Air Jordan Luka 5 Venom was released on January 8, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro ‘The International Flight’ dropped in 2018 as part of a thematic pack inspired by some of MJ’s memorable overseas trips. This pair gives the nod to a 1990 stop in Barcelona, where Michael scored 37 points in an exhibition game. The mid-top’s off-white leather upper is accented with Barcelona street art-inspired designs on the quarter panel and collar lining.

The Air Jordan XXXV Bayou Boys features multiple colors that define its appearance, with white, black, Gum Light Brown, and Lime Blast coming as the main tones.

This Zion Williamson x Air Jordan 35 'Bayou Boys' shoe is a follow-up version of the athlete's Air Jordan 34 PE, both designed to commemorate Zion joining the New Orleans Pelicans. The main highlight of this Bayou Boys Air Jordan XXXV shoe is a cracked imitation alligator leather layer that curves from the heel to the toe and surrounds the sneaker's Flightwire system. The Eclipse Plate 2.0 has a marbled green appearance, and it transitions into a gum rubber outsole with a herringbone traction pattern.

We found the gum rubber outsole of this shoe to be the most outstanding feature that makes it a long-lasting sneaker. The Air Jordan XXXV Bayou Boys was set to retail for $200 at the time of its market debut on November 21st, 2020.

At the midsole and bottom eyelets, the Air Jordan 5 Retro ' White Cement ' presents a black leather top with spliced Cement Grey highlights. The sneaker released in August 2017 also features a translucent ice-blue outsole, 3M black reflective tongue, and Red Jumpman University.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro Low 'Alternate 90' features a top black nubuck, 3M tongue metallic silver, and branding Gym Red Jumpman. The Air Jordan 5 was released in January 2016 and fell in a three-pack next to the Air Jordan 2 'Alternate 87' and the Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Alternate 89.'

The Air Jordan XXXV Center of Gravity was made to pay homage to the Air Jordan 5 for its 30th anniversary. It utilizes previous Nike designs such as the midfoot Eclipse plate, Jordan 5 mid panels, and Nike Air-branded heel tags. It also encompasses multiple colors including are black, silver, red, blue, and grey. There are Zoom Airbags located in the forefoot of the shoe, and a mini Jumpman logo is displayed on both sides of the shoe.

The Air Jordan XXXV Center of Gravity was released in October of 2020 and retailed for $180.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro OG Black Metallic Reimagined (PS)
description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro OG PS 'Black Metallic Reimagined' is crafted from black nubuck, using reflective piping throughout. The customary quarter panel netting meets a padded collar as two of the key elements. A reflective finish embellishes the Jumpman-branded tongue, while the heel gets a Nike Air logo. These kicks have a black foam midsole, accented with metallic silver sharktooth details and bolstered by a rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro GS ‘Green Bean’ brings back a colorway known for nearly two decades. The leather upper in trademark grey has a modern, reflective finish, and vivid green details embellish the collar lining and Jumpman logo at the tongue and heel. The dark grey polyurethane midsole provides lightweight cushioning alongside a visible Air-sole heel unit and shark tooth detailing, another 'Green Bean' accent. The outsole in translucent herringbone-tread rubber outsole provides superior grip and traction.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Fire Red Black Tongue (2013)
description: The Ne Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Fire Red' features an upper white leather, black tongue, accents of Fire Red, and an '23' ankle emblem. Released in August 2013, a red midsole, black shark teeth and a translucent outsole are also included in the sneaker.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Quai 54' 2021 released to celebrate the annual Parisian streetball tournament. The shoe's upper is built with a white leather base, highlighted by University Red on the TPU eyelets and accented by a Quai 54 logo, partially visible through the quarter panel netting. The inner lining and laces add an abstract print to the design, while reflective detailing marks the tongue. Underfoot, visible Air in the heel offers cushioning, giving way to a Quai 54-branded translucent rubber outsole for traction.

A March 2016 release, the Air Jordan 5 Low 'Fire Red' 2016 features a simple white leather upper with black mesh vents replacing the usual clear vents. Fire Red accents emerge on the tongue branding and lining, but the color is most prominently featured on the midsole. The signature shark tooth detailing is contrasted in black, while visible Air in the heel provides cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan Hydro 5 Retro Slide White New Emerald Grape Ice Black
description: The 2025 version of the Jordan Hydro 5 Retro Slide 'Grape' takes cues from an original Air Jordan 5 colorway. The Jumpman logo decorates the white synthetic leather strap, accented with teal shark tooth details and lined in soft knit. A cushy, purple foam midsole is stamped with a Jordan wordmark, while the synthetic outsole has flex grooves for a comfortable stride.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro Low Wings 'Class of 2020-21' released as part of Jordan Brand's Wings program in May 2021. Giving the nod to that year's class, the shoe's upper is built with a mix of textile and nubuck, finished in black and highlighted by metallic gold '20' and '21' on the lateral heels of each shoe. The lace-lock sports a tassel design, with the sockliner sporting a diploma seal-style design. Underfoot, a polyurethane midsole is included for cushioning, housing visible Air for cushioning. Shark-tooth detailing at the forefoot further highlights the design, while underfoot, an icy translucent rubber outsole offers traction.

Bringing back a 2013 colorway, the Air Jordan 5 Retro GS 'Oreo' 2021 appears here in grade-school sizes. Built with suede, the shoe's upper appears in black, accented by translucent quarter panel netting and contrasted by the white inner lining. Underfoot, the two-tone look continues onto the tooling, which includes a white foam midsole with black shark-tooth detailing, sporting visible Air in the heel to provide cushioning. A translucent rubber outsole is included for traction.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Bel Air' draws inspiration from the colorful ‘90s aesthetic on display throughout Will Smith’s classic NBC sitcom, ‘The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air.’ The mid-top sports a Cool Grey nubuck upper, contrasted by a purple midsole with speckled shark tooth detailing. Mismatched pink and green Jumpman hits can be found on both the tongue and heel of the left and right shoe.

Releasing for the Year of the Ox, the Air Jordan 35 'Chinese New Year' dropped in January 2021. The shoe's upper is built with tear-away textile in black and University Red, which reveals a vibrant multicolor print. Reflective detailing marks the laces, while yellow hits highlight the look throughout. Flightwire supports the upper, and underfoot, a gradient Eclipse Plate 2.0 and visible Zoom Air anchor the build. A herringbone rubber outsole is included for traction.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Fire Red Silver Tongue (2020) (GS)
description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro GS 'White Fire Red' 2020 brings an OG colorway to grade-school sizes. Released in 2020, the shoe remains true to the original look with a white leather upper and a reflective silver tongue. The signature Fire Red accents the tongue branding, inner lining and heel, with the same color on the Shark Tooth detailing. Visible Air in the heel provides cushioning.

Originally slated to drop as part of the 2012 Doernbecher Freestyle collection, the Air Jordan 5 Retro ‘Doernbecher’ features a radical new look conceived by 12-year-old Isaac Arzate, who tragically passed during the creative process. His family finalized the design, which features a black patent leather upper with glow-in-the-dark elements that include the quarter panels, eyelets, Air sole unit and more.

A collaboration between Jordan Brand and soccer star Neymar, the Air Jordan 5 Retro Low 'Neymar' features a speckled Reflect Silver upper accented by hits of Infrared. The left shoe replaces Michael Jordan's '23' jersey number with Neymar's '10,' while the shoe also released with a special hang-tag and a Neymar's Air Jordan logo on the insole.

Combining a premium build with an elevated colorway, the Air Jordan 5 Retro Premium 'Bordeaux' features a luxe look. Built with a premium leather upper finished entirely in Bordeaux, the shoe's side wall perforations replace the usual mesh vents. Quilted Vachetta Tan leather emerges on the lining and footbed, while a milky white outsole provides contrast and traction.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro TD 'Olive' takes inspiration from a well-loved colorway in the Lifestyle Series dating back to 2006. An olive-green suede upper is complemented by airy quarter-panel netting, with vibrant orange accents displayed on the inner lining. Eye-catching orange shark tooth detailing adorns an olive-toned foam midsole, while Jumpman logos are displayed on rear heel and the silver reflective tongue.

The Air Jordan XXXV Bred is an iteration of the Air Jordan 35 silhouette paying homage to the iconic Bred colorway, which was first introduced by Nike with the release of the Air Jordan 1 in 1985.

The shoe features a primarily black upper, constructed with a mix of materials such as mesh and synthetic overlays with leather accents. The black base is complemented by Vibrant Red accents seen on the inside of the tongue and outer sole while the midsole is white with tiny speckles of black. It maintains the classic Air Jordan branding details such as the Jumpman logo on the tongue and lateral ankle as well as a protruding heel tab that bears the Jumpman on one side and the Nike logo on the other.
