What we love about the Air Jordan XXXV Bred is the Zoom Air units in the forefoot and a stabilizing Eclipse Plate on the midsole, which helps with stability and support. The shoe was released for retail at $180 on January 8, 2021.

A heritage favorite gets a new look with an abstract-patterned suede upper that varies from the right shoe to the left. The women’s Air Jordan 5 Low ‘Expression’ features an allover print in shades of charcoal and tan alongside lace locks and the quarter panel clear netting in cream. Jumpman branding appears on the heel overlay and tongue. Underfoot, the midsole in cream PU with an exposed Air-sole unit in the heel is adorned with jagged shark-tooth in metalic chrome.

The Ne Air Jordan 5 Retro 'White Fire Red' features an upper white leather, black tongue, accents of Fire Red, and an '23' ankle emblem. Released in August 2013, a red midsole, black shark teeth and a translucent outsole are also included in the sneaker.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro WNBA Pinksicle Safety Orange (TD)
description: A low-key silhouette is ready for balmy weather with the Air Jordan 5 Retro TD ‘Pinksicle.’ Clear netting on the quarter panel pairs with white leather on the upper. A herringbone-patterned tread underfoot provides optimal grip and traction on the court or beach. Branding appears on the back heel and mesh tongue with Jumpman logos in pink. The pastel hue is repeated on the foam midsole and pairs with shark tooth details in orange.

The Air Jordan 5 'Raging Bull Pack' is a two shoe pack, with an all red suede version and this black 3M version. The upper showcases a dark charcoal colorway, coated with a 3M reflective finish. Varsity Red details can be found on the Jumpman logo on the tongue and the '23' on the side profile. Translucent tones are applied to the webbed quarter panels, and the clear rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro WNBA Pinksicle Safety Orange (GS)
description: A heritage shoe for big kids is given a pastel makeover with the Air Jordan 5 Retro GS ‘Pinksicle.’ The upper appears in white leather highlighted by clear netting at the quarter panel. Hits of color include orange lace locks and vibrant pink Jumpman branding on the ventilated mesh tongue and heel overlay. The pink and orange hues repeat on the PU polyurethane midsole with an exposed Air-sole unit in the heel and shark tooth details in Safety Orange.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro GS 'White Black' brings a layered upper with a padded mid-cut collar and netting on the side. A reflective silver finish on the tongue gets an embroidered Jumpman logo, matching the heel and insoles. A black foam midsole has an exposed Air-sole unit and black speckles adorning the shark tooth area. A partially see-through rubber outsole is aged for a vintage aesthetic.

shoeName: Air Jordan 5 Retro Low Golf Black Metallic

description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro SE GS 'Midnight Navy' combines a suede build on the cushioned collar and heel overlay with textile material on the midfoot and toe box. The white foam midsole has speckled shark tooth accents and a visible Air-sole unit in the heel atop a clear rubber outsole for optimal traction. An embroidered black Jumpman logo is displayed on the heel overlay while another Jumpman emblem appears on the tongue.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro Low GS 'Hurricanes' nods to the University of Miami, rocking a white leather upper accented by a glossy patent leather overlay. An orange Jumpman logo matches the collar lining and lace locks, while a silver Jumpman logo adorns the heel area. A green-and-orange foam midsole pairs perfectly with an exposed Air-sole heel unit.

Introducing the Air Jordan 5 Retro GS 'Concord', designed for big-kid sneaker enthusiasts. This classic silhouette gets pops of vibrant purple color against its white leather upper, complete with sleek molded eyelets and clear quarter panel netting. The silver reflective tongue is embellished with a purple stitched Jumpman logo, the hue mirrored by the lace locks and textile lining. A second Jumpman appears on the heel overlay. The bold black polyurethane midsole is finished with standout purple shark tooth detailing and an exterior Air-sole unit.

One of four OG colorways of the Jordan 5, the Air Jordan 5 OG BG ‘Black Metallic’ 2016 is a remaster that stays true to the original. Releasing in boys’ and girls’ sizes, the shoe features a black nubuck upper, reflective 3M tongue and speckled silver shark tooth detailing. Hits of University Red mark the tongue branding and lace lock, while the outsole’s icy blue look brings the only minor change from the 1990 model before it.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Low Golf Lucky and Good
description: The Air Jordan 5 Low Golf NRG 'Lucky and Good' updates the classic basketball silhouette for the links. The shoe's upper is built with corduroy in place of leather, finished entirely in Sail. The quarter panel insert remains intact, as does the toggle lacing system. The Starfish inner lining adds color to the look, while Neptune Green emerges on the tongue branding and shark-tooth detailing. Underfoot, the translucent outsoles reveal 'Rather Lucky' and 'Than Good,' while removable spikes provide traction.

A hybrid look, the Air Jordan 5 Retro 3Lab5 'Infrared' features elements of the Air Jordan 3 on the shape of the Air Jordan 5. The black upper features elephant print detailing throughout, accented by hits of Infrared 23 on the lace toggle, branding and midsole. The heel sports visible Air for cushioning, while the translucent outsole inserts sport an icy blue finish.

Drawing from the East-meets-West ethos of the Hong Kong streetwear brand, the CLOT x Air Jordan 35 'Sepia Stone' released in February 2021. The shoe's textile and suede upper appears with a neutral base, bolstered by Flightwire cables that highlight the look in red. The green hit on the quarter panel is matched underfoot by the Eclipse Plate 2.0, with Zoom Air providing cushioning. As a nod to the collaboration, the heel patch and toe box include co-branding, while the lateral heel sports miniature tiles with two and three dots.

shoeName: Jordan ADG 5 White Midnight Navy University Blue

description: Because of the beneficial role played by teachers in the formative years of Michael Jordan, he established Wings, a scholarship fund devoted to providing equal access to quality education for young adults. The Air Jordan 5 'Wings' edition honors this mission by covering the upper leather with doodles and sketches by Little Black Pearl learners, a non-profit art and design center that serves the South Side youth of Chicago. On the bottom of the tongue, next to the declaration 'Everyone Can Fly' appears the Jordan 'Wings' logo.

Another addition to Nike's collection celebrating USA basketball, the Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Olympic 2011' most notably features a Midnight Navy midsole with speckled Varsity Red on the signature shark tooh detailing. The white leather upper features mesh side panels for breathability. The sole unit sports visible Air and translucent outsole inserts, while a lace-lock is designed for a locked-down fit.

For breathability, the Jordan 5 Retro GG ' Hot Lava ' features a Wolf Grey upper suede with corresponding mesh window panels on the sides. The sneaker also sports a toggle lacing system, accents of hot lava, black details throughout, and a partially encapsulated air unit.

As its unofficial name suggests, the Air Jordan 5 Retro GS ‘Oreo’ showcases a simple two-tone color scheme. The upper is built with monochromatic black nubuck, contrasted by a crisp white finish on the collar lining and midsole. The latter is accented with speckled black shark-tooth detailing and reinforced underfoot by an icy translucent rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro 3Lab5 is a hybrid Air Jordan 3 x Air Jordan 5 released as part of the Lab series from Jordan Brand. The design combines the Air Jordan 5 silhouette with a black elephant leather upper inspired by Air Jordan 3. Released in July 2014, the sneaker also sits with an ice-blue translucent outsole on a sprinkled cement and black midsole.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Year of the Snake (Women's)
description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Year of the Snake' brings an ivory leather upper tooled with molded eyelets and the signature quarter netting. The Jumpman logo adorns the tongue and heel. These kicks have an off-white foam midsole, accented with shimmering pastel hues on the sharktooth layer of the midsole. A see-through rubber outsole provides smooth traction underfoot.

Releasing in October 2020, the Air Jordan 35 'Dynasties' celebrates the 600th anniversary of the Forbidden City. As a result, the palace complex informs the design of the shoe, including suede overlays that draw from yellow-tiled roofs. The crimson pillars, doors and windows become apparent on the red accents, while stylized detailing emerges throughout. Underfoot, the Eclipse Plate 2.0 works with Zoom Air to provide stability and cushioning, giving way to a green rubber outsole for traction.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro Premium 'Take Flight' features a premium Sequoia leather top with a Vachetta Tan leather tongue and leather lace locks based on the P51 flight bomber jacket. The sneaker comes with a unique "shark teeth" midsole shoe bag featuring the fighter jet graphic. Released in February 2016, a Sequoia Air Jordan 8 and an all-black stealth jet-inspired Air Jordan 15 were also included in the ' Take Flight ' pack.

In celebration of Will Smith’s 50th birthday, Nike released this Air Jordan 5 Retro in a nod to one of the actor’s most engaging roles: The Fresh Prince. Inspired by the laceless AJ5 model that Smith was known to wear on the set of The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air, the NRG 'Fresh Prince' seals up the eyestays entirely and wraps the high-top in a vibrant Grape Ice and New Emerald colorway. The design’s clearest tribute to the sitcom can be found on the insole, where ‘Air Jordan’ branding appears in the style of the show’s title sequence graffiti.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Fear' released alongside an Air Jordan 3 and Air Jordan 4 as part of the Fear Pack. Built with suede, the shoe features a neutral look finished in Medium Olive and Sequoia. The Jumpman branding and midsole speckling add hits of Fire Red, while the outsole incorporates icy blue sections. The Fear Pack is based on a commercial featuring the line ‘I’m scared of what I won’t become, and you’re scared of what I could become.’

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Low Golf Fire Red (Silver Tongue)
description: The Air Jordan 5 Low Golf 'White Fire Red' takes an OG colorway and outfits it for the links. Built with a white leather base, the shoe's upper maintains the shoe's signature features, including the lace lock. Reflective silver emerges on the tongue, while the quarter panel maintains the signature netting. The midsole, which sports shark-tooth detailing, houses visible Air in the heel for cushioning. The outsole sports removable spikes for traction.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro LS ‘Burgundy’ 2006 treats Tinker Hatfield’s 1990 design to a luxurious makeover, featuring a soft suede upper finished in a rich maroon hue. Contrast stitching and semi-translucent netting on the quarter panel break up the monochromatic design. The kicks are finished with a grey reflective tongue up top and a translucent rubber outsole underfoot.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro BG ‘Pre Grape’ recreates an early sample pair that was originally intended to be the silhouette’s original ‘Grape’ colorway. The mid-top features a Midnight Navy leather upper, accented with pops of teal on the reflective silver tongue and midsole. Signature Air Jordan 5 details are present and accounted for, including lace locks and an icy translucent outsole.

The Jordan 5 Retro PS 'Concord' features a white leather upper with a purple Jumpman logo on the heel and see-through netting on the side. The shiny silver tongue displays a Concord Jumpman logo. The black foam midsole has a herringbone-traction rubber outsole for with purple shark-tooth details.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Green Bean' recreates the OG look with a notable addition: reflective detailing on the silver sections of the upper. The lining, tongue and shark tooth detailing are all finished in Green Bean, with another hit of the color on the Jumpman branding underfoot.

A women's shoe, the Wmns Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Oil Grey' released for the 30th anniversary of the silhouette. Built with Oil Grey leather, the upper sports 3M reflective detailing throughout its construction. Underfoot, a white midsole with visible Air in the heel provides cushioning and contrast, with a semitranscluent rubber outsole providing traction.

The Air Jordan 35 'DNA' emerges with a Chicago-inspired colorway on its heritage-inspired construction. Borrowing elements of the Air Jordan 5 for its 30th anniversary, the shoe's upper includes a padded tongue, sculpted collar and Kurim side netting drawn from the inconic silhouette. Iridescent detailing marks the side wall, while underfoot, an Eclipse Plate 2.0 works with Zoom Air in the forefoot and heel to anchor the design.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Wolf Grey' features a Wolf Grey nubuck bottom with Light Graphite accents. The sneaker released in May 2011 also comes with white shark sprinkled teeth and a translucent ice-blue outsole.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro SE GS 'Sail' remixes a classic with a chalk white suede upper. These shoes keep most of the original elements, including the lace locks, molded eyelets and the signature quarter panel netting that made them popular. An embroidered Jumpman on the foam tongue and the back heel give them an iconic touch. The white foam midsole gets a speckled sharktooth accent, packed with Air-sole cushioning for a soft feel underfoot.

Showcasing vibrant bursts of color on the vintage 1990 silhouette is the Air Jordan 5 Retro GS 'Racer Blue.' Made for older kids, its' upper is made from black nubuck with royal blue Jumpman branding on the heel overlay and silver reflective tongue. Quarter panel netting gives more breathability while lace locks secure the foot. It's built on a blue foam midsole with a visible Air-sole unit in the heel and reinforced by a grippy translucent rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Low Chinese New Year
description: Paying tribute to the Year of the Monkey, the Air Jordan 5 Retro Low ‘Chinese New Year’ released in 2016. The classic basketball silhouette emerges with a series of vibrant designs on its construction, with the heel and tongue highlighting a black nylon base. Tonal TPU netting marks the quarter panel, while the eyelets add Bright Crimson to the look. More Bright Crimson marks the shark-tooth detailing and visible Air in the midsole, with an icy translucent outsole offering traction.

The 'Indigo Haze' edition of the Women's Air Jordan 5 Retro Low features a reflective surface in a light purple shade. This low-cut shoe has characteristics the AJ5 is known for, including molded eyelets, transparent netting on the side panels and lace locks. The tongue is made of silver reflective material and is adorned by a cream-colored Jumpman logo in stitching while the collar is lined with soft material in a matching color. The shoe rests on a Flint Grey polyurethane midsole with a visible Air-sole cushioning system and the recognizable shark-tooth pattern. The bottom of the shoe has a durable clear rubber outsole that offers traction underfoot.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro GG 'Easter' is a girls' shoe with a vibrant look fit for the springtime holiday. Built with leather, the upper sports a series of confetti-style specks throughout its construction. Laser Crimson accents the Jumpman branding, with a similar finish on the shark-tooth misole detailing. The midsole itself forgoes the usual visible Air in the heel.

A PE colorway made for Rui Hachimura, the Rui Hachimura x Air Jordan 35 'Warrior' draws from his Japanese and Beninese backgrounds. As a result, the shoe emerges in a mix of red and black, with his kanji-inspired personal logo on the tongue and sockliner. Underfoot, an Eclipse Plate 2.0 provides stability, with Zoom Air in the forefoot and heel providing cushioning.

The Heiress collection celebrates the flight theme with a sequence of colorways in camo material. The Air Jordan 5 Retro Premium GS ' Heiress ' presents an upper dark leather in camo print with highlights from the Metallic Field. A toggle lacing system, mesh side panels, a padded collar for added convenience, a Light Bone midsole, and a partly encapsulated air unit are also available in the mid top.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Low Golf Black Grape

description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro GS 'Laney' gives the nod to Michael Jordan's high school alma mater, Emsley A. Laney High. A grade-school shoe, the Varsity Royal and Varsity Maize colorway is modeled after the school's colors, emerging on a genuine and synthetic leather construction. Mesh inserts provide breathability, while a toggle lacing system supports the fit. A speckled Light Charcoal midsole houses a visible Air unit in the heel for cushioning, with the signature shark-tooth detailing in Varsity Maize.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro SE TD 'Burgundy' returns in 2023 in a color scheme from 2006. The burgundy nubuck upper has contrasting stitching and clear netting on the quarter panel. Underfoot, the blue-tinted rubber outsole supports a burgundy foam midsole adorned with speckled shark-tooth patterns. The back heel and tongue proudly display a stitched Jumpman logo, and reminiscent of the 1990 original is the latter’s silver reflective coating.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Black Metallic' 2011 features a look similar to the OG colorway from 1990. Build with black suede, 3M reflective detailing emerges at the tongue, with Varsity Red on the lace lock and tongue Jumpman bringing color to the design. The black midsole with visible Air is accented by speckled metallic silver shark tooth detailing.

Originally releasing as part of the Countdown Pack alongside an Air Jordan 18, the Air Jordan 5 Retro ‘Countdown Pack’ appears with a familiar ‘Fire Red’ look similar to the OG Jordan 5. The signature color appears on the lining, branding and midsole detailing, while a silver tongue complements the look. The black midsole, which houses Air in the heel, gives way to a translucent outsole.

One of four OG colorways of the Air Jordan 5, the Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Black Metallic' 2000 is a 2000 retro of the shoe. The shoe features a black nubuck upper accented by a reflective silver tongue. Mesh inserts provide breathability, while the signature midsole detailing incorporates a speckled silver finish. The outsole, which sports translucent sections, provides traction via a herringbone pattern.

shoeName: Jordan XXXV Jayson Tatum Women in Power PE
description:
The Air Jordan XXXV Jayson Tatum Women in Power PE is a special edition sneaker is part of a collaboration between Air Jordan and Jayson Tatum, a professional basketball player who has been with the Boston Celtics since 2017.

The Jayson Tatum Women in Power Air Jordan XXXV PE has the signature of Jayson Tatum, which is printed on the insole - adding a personal touch to the design. The midsole contains the Eclipse Plate 2.0 technology, which adds extra bounce and responsiveness to your steps. The sneaker has a mesh-like material on the lateral side of the shoe that allows for increased breathability.

We believe that the notable feature of Air Jordan XXXV Jayson Tatum Women in Power PE is its bold colorway, which includes a mix of light blue, lime, and red. The shoe is inspired by the power that women have in sports, as well as in everyday life. The Air Jordan XXXV Jayson Tatum Women in Power PE was released on March 19, 2021 at a retail price of $180.

Nike debuted a Chicago-inspired release to honor Michael Jordan’s connection to the great city. The Air Jordan 5 Retro GS 'Wings' features a white leather upper highlighted by an all-over graphic of the city of Chicago and its diverse neighborhoods. The sneaker also features a toggle lacing system, black inner lining, red details on the Jumpman logo, and a midsole Air unit for impact and cushioning.

The Air Jordan 1.5 The Return 'Reverse Fragment' earns its unofficial moniker with a color scheme that resembles a flip on the highly coveted Fragment Design collaboration from 2014. The complementary blue, black and white tones are executed on a hybrid silhouette that blends the upper of the Air Jordan 1 with tooling borrowed from the Air Jordan 2.

Jordan's fifth signature sneaker, originally released in 1990, debuted in this now-classic colorway in 2006. One of the first to use University Blue, it covers the internal lining and contrast stitching in the blue color of Carolina, offsetting a black nubuck-dominated top. Other details of the signature include transparent lace locks, heel-stitched Jumpman logo, midsole shark teeth design, and icy translucent outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Trophy Room University Red (F&F)
Jordan Melo 1.5 Black Gym Red White

description: A 2006 colorway of this heritage sneaker is built for kids in the Air Jordan 5 Retro PS ‘Green Bean.’ The 2022 version is true to its legacy with a grey synthetic leather upper in a reflective finish; the 'Green Bean' contrasting bright green details in the collar lining and Jumpman branding are its modern touch. A dark grey polyurethane midsole with signature shark-tooth detailing in vibrant green is reinforced underfoot by a rubber outsole with herringbone-traction.

Before the Air Jordan 1 became an international icon, Michael Jordan wore a prototype that would be known as the Air Jordan 1.5. The Air Jordan 1.5 ‘The Return’ is a retro look of that unreleased shoe. Sporting a familiar ‘Bred’ colorway, the shoe features a few small differences from the AJ1, including a lower profile and a Nike ‘Wings’ logo, as well as a modified outsole pattern.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro ‘Quai 54’ dropped in 2011 as part of Jordan Brand’s annual collection dedicated to the Parisian streetball tournament. The mid-top features a white leather upper with neon green accents on the shoe’s eyelets and translucent rubber outsole. Additional pops of Radiant Green appear on the Quai 54 heel embroidery and Jumpman logo atop the grey reflective tongue.

The Jordan XXXV Black White is an iteration of Luka Dončić Air Jordan 35 Low silhouette to celebrate its 30th anniversary.

The Air Jordan XXXV is designed in a black-and-white color combination, with subtle hints of red throughout the sneaker. The black mesh base upper is contrasted by smooth white and perforated leather overlays, with shimmering silver hits on the Jumpman logo on the tongue. Other features include a sculpted collar, black padded and branded tongues, iridescent detailing on the side wall, black and white speckled laces, and Kurim side netting.

Something our experts consider as the standout feature about the Jordan XXXV Black White sneaker is the combination of the Eclipse Plate 2.0, which works with Zoom Air in the heel and forefoot to not only provide comfort, but also round off the sneaker's design. The shoe was released on May 26th, 2021, with its retail price set at $180.

shoeName: Jordan XXXV Guo Ailun Jade Green

description:
The Jordan Why Not Zer0.5 Childhood transforms Russell Westbrook's signature shoe with an explosion of vibrant colors, resulting in a dynamic design and a nod to the athlete’s three kids.

The Childhood Air Jordan Why Not Zer0.5’s textile upper, tinted in lavender hues, receives reinforcement from striking black synthetic overlays and a coordinating black heel counter, with a distinctive outline in Bright Crimson. This heel component, in conjunction with aqua-colored webbing eyelets and a cushioned internal collar, ensures a secure and comfortable fit. The sneaker boasts lightweight cushioning thanks to a sculpted foam midsole, which houses a substantial Zoom Air unit under the forefoot for responsive and comfortable strides.

The standout feature of the Jordan Why Not Zer0.5 Childhood is its captivating and vibrant color scheme. The dynamic color combination is not only visually appealing but also pays homage to the distinct personalities of Westbrook's children. The sneaker sold for $150 on March 1st, 2022.

The Jordan Luka 5 'Black Thunder Blue' brings a black mesh upper with matching no-sew overlays and a padded nubuck collar. Luka Doncic's logo lands on the tongue, while the Jumpman logo decorates the insoles. A light blue IsoPlate extends from the forefoot and around the heel for 360-degree control. The foot frame pairs with a Cushlon 3.0 midsole and a full-length Zoom Strobel for a responsive feel. The partially see-through rubber outsole has a herringbone pattern for swift traction on the court.

shoeName: Jordan Why Not 0.5 HTG Honor the Gift
description:
The Jordan Why Not 0.5 HTG Honor The Gift was a collaborative effort between Jordan Brand and Russell Westbrook's Honor The Gift fashion label. It took Westbrook's Jordan Why Not Zer0.5 signature sneaker and put a unique twist on it.

This Jordan Why Not Zer0.5 featured a cream-colored upper with tan overlays that covered everything from the mudguard and toe box on the front of the sneaker to the heel counter on the back of it. It also had special eyelets, a foam tongue, and a jagged midsole that made this sneaker look like it was still a work in progress.

But the best part about this sneaker was that it included both Jumpman logos and "HONOR THE GIFT" branding on it. It was a celebration of just how far Westbrook has come in a lot of ways while also seemingly highlighting that there is still work to be done. The Jordan Why Not 0.5 HTG Honor The Gift was released on February 17, 2022, when it retailed for $150.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Low Golf Tie Dye
description: The Air Jordan 5 Low Golf 'Peace, Love, and Golf' updates its basketball construction for the links. Inspired by San Francisco, host of the 2020 PGA Championship, the shoe's white leather upper is highlighted by a series of tie-dye prints throughout its construction. A ball marker replaces the usual lace lock, while the translucent outsoles read 'Peace' and 'Love.' Removable spikes provide traction.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro A Ma Maniére Dawn (PS)
description: The A Ma Maniére x Air Jordan 5 Retro PS ‘Dawn’ comes together in a pale grey leather upper fortified with a pre-yellowed netting in a signature ‘A’ monogram pattern. Branding elements include mismatched ‘A’ and Jumpman logos on the reflective silver tongue, a ‘23’ on the side of the heel and ‘Nike’ wording on the back. These kicks have a black foam midsole with blue shark tooth detailing. A yellow rubber outsole rounds out the look.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro DJ Khaled We The Best Crimson Bliss (PS)
description: The DJ Khaled x Jordan 5 Retro PS ‘Crimson Bliss’ takes a familiar hoops silhouette and gives it a modern makeover for small feet. A pale pink infuses the leather upper and is complemented by quarter-panel netting and a minimized collar with a rich blue quilted lining. Distinctive shark-tooth patterning appears on the white foam outsole’s lateral sidewall. The sneaker salutes MJ, Nike and the ‘We the Best’ collection with a Jumpman on the reflective tongue and heel overlays alternating between ‘Nike’ and ‘We the Best.’

shoeName: Jordan Hydro 5 Retro Slide Black Metallic (GS)
description: The Jordan Hydro 5 Retro Slide GS 'Black Metallic' gets a black nubuck strap, stamped with a red Jumpman up top and metallic silver sharktooth details on the side. Soft knit lines the textured footbed for a comfortable feel. A glossy black foam midsole pairs with a synthetic outsole with flex grooves that encourage natural movement.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro PS 'Raging Bull' 2021 is a preschool shoe. Bringing back one half of the 2009 Defining Moments pack, the shoe features a suede construction on the upper, finished in Varsity Red and contrasted by black on the eyelets and inner lining. The usual mesh inserts provide breathability, while underfoot, the midsole forgoes visible Air in the heel but maintains its signature shark-tooth detailing.

Made for little kids with a two-tone colorway on a condensed silhouette is the Air Jordan 5 Retro TD 'Racer Blue.' The mid-top features a black nubuck upper with quarter panel netting for enhanced ventilation. Royal blue Jumpman branding embellishes the heel overlay and silver reflective tongue. A blue foam midsole has black shark-tooth detailing and is supported by a herringbone-traction translucent rubber outsole.

Giving a contemporary twist to the timeless design, the Air Jordan 5 Retro TD 'Midnight Navy' incorporates a suede and textile upper in this downsized version, with ventilated netting on the quarter panel and embroidered tongue-and-heel Jumpman branding. The white foam midsole with speckled shark tooth accents delivers cushioning while the rubber outsole with a herringbone pattern ensures sturdy traction for young wearers.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro Low PS 'Hurricanes' brings the colors of the University of Miami, using crisp white leather on the upper highlighted by a quarter panel netting and a patent leather overlay. Orange touches land on the collar and Jumpman logo embroidered on the tongue. A silver Jumpman icon decorates the back heel, while a green-and-orange foam midsole keep the theme strong.

The Air Jordan 5 GS ‘Bel-Air’ features a vibrant color scheme that draws inspiration from Will Smith’s NBC sitcom, The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air. The retro mid-top features a Cool Grey nubuck upper, accented with a multicolor collar lining and a pink and green ‘23’ embroidered on the lateral heel. Underfoot, a purple midsole is contrasted by blue shark-tooth detailing, treated with neon green speckles.

The first release in the Alternate Collection, which recognized past Player Exclusives and imagined the PEs that Michael Jordan would have worn, the Air Jordan 5 Retro Low BG ‘Alternate 90’ features a familiar black and red look. The low-top upper appears primarily in black, with a Gym Red Jumpman on the 3M reflective tongue. The sole and lining also sport Gym Red, while Air in the heel is included for cushioning.

Pastel hues hint at spring in the Air Jordan 5 Retro SE GS ‘Easter,' which remakes a 1990 classic for the elementary school set. Pastel sockliners, an Air-sole unit in the heel and a clear rubber outsole underfoot contribute to soft landings on the court and playground. The leather upper is in muted pink with hints of lavender, with Jumpman branding stitched on the reflective silver tongue and heel overlay.

A thematic addition to the Air Jordan XXXV lineup, the Air Jordan XXXV Sisterhood is a women's athletic sneaker commemorating women in sports, built for ultimate performance. Constructed from a mixture of leather and mesh, it features a predominately white colorway with blue accents and a brown gum rubber outsole.

Prominent components of the Air Jordan XXXV Sisterhood are the "Sisterhood" themed graphics adorning the insoles, along with Nike Air tabs along the heels and logos on the side. A logo also decorates the sneakers’ silver tongue, which has its own large tab. Mesh runs along the side of the upper, and small iridescent strips displayed above complete the look.

What our experts like most about the Air Jordan XXXV Sisterhood are the large Nike Zoom Air units found in the midsole. Encased in royal blue highlights, they’re both pleasing aesthetic visuals and cutting-edge athletic performance technology. Originally released December 11th, 2020, its retail price was $180.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Low Peanut Butter & Jelly (GS)
description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro Low GS 'Peanut Butter & Jelly' brings a suede, ivory-colored upper complete with plastic eyelets and side panel netting. A red Jumpman logo adorns the tongue and heel areas. Much like peanut butter, the midsole sports a light brown hue. Red sharktooth details adorn the design, which ride on a purple, partially see-through rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro SE Craft Light Orewood Brown (GS)
description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro SE Craft GS 'Light Orewood Brown' is a big kids’ shoe that features a suede and textile upper in a chalky color, complete with two-tone laces that pass through semi-clear eyelets. The mid-cut collar is cushioned for comfort, and ventilation is supplied by the quarter-panel mesh. The tongue is lined with orange textile material and has a Jumpman logo in a matching citrus shade, while the heel overlay is adorned with additional grey stitched Jumpman branding. The classic design is elevated with an off-white polyurethane midsole that has speckled shark-tooth detailing and rests on a clear rubber outsole.

The grade school version of the Air Jordan 5 Retro GS 'Satin' features a black satin upper with mesh window panels on the side for airflow. The sneaker also features a lace-up structure and a toggle top for an adaptive fit, a padded collar for superior comfort, University Red accents, and leather overlays on the heel.

The Nike Air Jordan 1 Retro High 'Black Elephant' features a black leather and cement-gray elephant print bottom reminiscent of the iconic 2002 Supreme x Dunk Low Pro SB. Released in January 2016, the look is completed with Varsity Red accents, a white midsole and a black outsole.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro Premium ‘Triple Black’ puts a subdued colorway on its elevated build, covering the shoe entirely in black. Built with premium leather, the usual mesh vents are replaced with a ribbed texture, a design that also makes its way to the tongue. The lace lock is also built with leather and sports ‘Flight’ branding. A visible Air unit in the heel and a partially translucent outsole maintain heritage Jordan elements.

Designed for young children, the Air Jordan 5 Retro PS 'Plaid' has a textile upper with various patterns. It includes orange rope laces, black molded eyelets, and TPU netting on the side. A black foam midsole with orange shark tooth detailing provides lightweight cushioning. The tongue and heel overlay have orange-stitched Jumpman branding.

A toddlers' shoe, the Air Jordan 5 Retro TD 'Raging Bull' 2021 released more than a decade after the original colorway, which dropped in 2009 as part of the Defining Moments pack. Built with suede, the shoe's upper appears in Varsity Red, with translucent netting marking the quarter panel. Reflective silver detailing accents the tongue, while underfoot, the black foam midsole forgoes the usual visible Air in the heel, but it maintains the classic shark-tooth detailing.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Fire Red Silver Tongue (2020) (PS)
description: Released for the 30th anniversary of the silhoeutte, the Air Jordan 5 Retro PS 'White Fire Red' 2020 brings back an OG look. A preschool shoe, the upper features a white leather construction, accented by a reflective silver tongue and Fire Red on the inner lining and heel branding. Underfoot, the midsole sports the usual shark-tooth detailing, but it forgoes visible Air in the heel.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro DMP 'Raging Bull Pack' released in 2009 as part of a collection paying tribute to Michael Jordan's signature moments. The two shoes, the last silhouette Jordan wore before winning his first title, emerge in a classic mix of Chicago Bulls colors. One model appears in red, built with suede, contrasted by black and highlighted by reflective silver on the tongue. The other model sports a synthetic construction, finished in black and highlighted by red accents. The shoes share the signature quarter panel inserts, with visible Air underfoot cushioning both designs in the midsole. Partially translucent rubber outsoles offer traction.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Black Metallic' 2007 is a retro of a 1990 OG colorway. The shoe features a black nubuck upper that's accented by 3M reflective detailing on the tongue, with translucent inserts on the quarter panel for breathability. The signature shark tooth detailing appears in speckled silver, with Fire Red bringing color to the tongue Jumpman, lace toggle and 'Air Jordan' inside the tongue. The '23' on the heel, finished in metallic silver, adds a touch not seen on the OG.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Low Dunk From Above
description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro Low 'Dunk from Above' draws inspiration from Michael Jordan’s ability to take flight at will. The low-top sports a white leather upper with contrast yellow stitching and Midnight Navy hits at the tongue, eyelets and quarter panel. The midsole is similarly finished in navy, accented with the silhouette’s signature shark tooth detailing in a dull metallic gold hue.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro DMP Raging Bull Red Suede
description: This red suede Air Jordan 5 Retro dropped in 2009 as part of the 2009 DMP ‘Raging Bull’ Pack, which also featured a black reflective Jordan 5. Here, a red suede upper is accented with contrasting black hits on the shoe’s molded eyelets, collar lining and midsole. The latter is embellished with the Jordan 5’s signature ‘shark tooth’ design, finished in white with red tips for a blood-chilling detail.

Originally released as a kids' exclusive, the Air Jordan 5 Retro GS 'Wolf Grey' featuers a simple palette highlighted by a black speckled midsole. The upper features Wolf Grey throughout its construction, matched by the shark tooth detailing that defines the silhouette. Air technology provides cushioning, while an icy blue outsole adds a touch of color to the design.

shoeName: Jordan ADG 5 White Metallic Silver Blue Tint Fire Red (Wide)

description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro TD 'Plaid' gives the iconic shoe a bold new look with a multi-pattern textile upper featuring different plaid designs. It has a comfortable navy lining on the padded collar and breathable black TPU netting on the side. The Total Orange laces and shark tooth accents on the black foam midsole match the Jumpman logo stitched on the tongue and heel.

The Air Jordan 1.5 'Chicago' is a retro version of an unreleased prototype that Michael Jordan wore briefly during his rookie season. Finally released in July 2015, the shoe features a familiar mix of Varsity Red, black and white. The upper has a slightly lower profile than the Air Jordan 1, and a Nike 'Wings' logo replaces the usual Air Jordan 'Wings' branding. Underfoot, the sole unit is pulled from the Air Jordan 2.

shoeName: Jordan ADG 5 White Black Pure Platinum Iron Grey

description: The Jordan ADG 5 'Black Laser' rocks a lasered design over the black, waterproof leather upper. A roomy toe box and padded collar add a distinctive feel, while an embossed Jumpman on the 3M reflective tongue delivers that signature touch. A stitched 'XXIII' on the eyestay and another Jumpman logo on the heel counter reinforce the classic look. A Formula 23 foam midsole works in tandem with a lugged rubber outsole for deep traction.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Low Golf Grape Ice
description: The iconic basketball construction of the Air Jordan 5 is prepared for the links with the Air Jordan 5 Low Golf NRG 'Wing It.' Built with a white leather base, the shoe's upper includes the classic quarter panel netting. The lace lock doubles as a ball marker, while underfoot, the midsole maintains the usual visible Air in the heel, with shark-tooth detailing on the forefoot. The outsole sports a series of spikes for traction, revealing 'Wings' to call out New York's Winged Foot Golf Club.

A black nubuck upper with hits of Fierce Purple on the center sole and the interior lining of this grade school iteration of the Air Jordan 5. Underneath the embroidered Jumpman logo is a translucent lace toggle on the tongue, the emblem also on the heel. The detail of the signature shark teeth stands out in a speckled shade of Ember Glow.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro PS 'Olive' is a 2024 version for little feet that revisits a color scheme from the Lifestyle Series. First seen in 2006, this AJ5 showcases molded eyelets and breathable netting on the quarter panels against a rich olive suede upper. The padded collar is lined with vibrant orange fabric, echoed by the stitched Jumpman logos on the rear heel and the silver reflective tongue. A burst of orange appears on the foam midsole's speckled shark tooth detailing adds a burst of orange.

Although a limited edition that made its debut solely in China, the 2013 'Shanghai Shen' colorway has become one of the Air Jordan 5's most sought-after iterations. The color scheme is a virtual black version of the 'Laney' look with an upper, light blue and yellow synthetic nubuck accent. It features a traditional medallion detail on the heel, a shout to Shanghai.

shoeName: Jordan ADG 5 Golf White Black Varsity Red

description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro Premium gets a minimalist makeover, featuring a monochromatic Pure Platinum finish on the all-leather upper. Notable revisions include a leather tongue and woven construction on the quarter panel, replacing the shoe’s traditional TPU netting. Finally, a tonal finish on the midsole lessens the visual impact of the signature shark tooth detailing.

The Titan x Air Jordan 35 '10th Anniversary' released to celebrate a decade of the Manila retailer. The shoe's upper is built with a mix of translucent textile, genuine leather and suede, finished in neutral tones and highlighted by the red Flightwire cables. More red emerges on the tongue pull-loop and heel tab, which includes three gold stars as a nod to the Philippines. The lateral heel sports Titan's lightning bolt logo in a debossed fashion, while underfoot, an Eclipse Plate 2.0 works with Zoom Air for stability and cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan Max Aura 5 White University Blue
Jordan Max Aura 5 Black White Wolf Grey Metallic Gold
Jordan XXXV Black White Chile Red (GS)

description: Inspired by the 1990s Red and Black flight suits and the 2009 Air Jordan 5 'Raging Bull' sneaker, the 'Red Suede' Air Jordan 5 Retro features an upper University Red suede with black shark teeth on the midsole. Released in July 2017, a 3M reflective tongue and an ice-white translucent outsole are also included in the sneaker.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro Premio 'Bin23' released as part of the Bin23 program, which showcased previously unreleased Air Jordan models. The shoe's premium black leather upper includes tonal mesh inserts on the side wall for breathability, with red accents on the Jumpman branding. The midsole and tongue add hits of metallic silver, while the usual Air in the heel provides cushioning.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro A Ma Maniére Dawn (TD)
description: The A Ma Maniére x Air Jordan 5 Retro TD ‘Dawn’ rolls out a pale grey leather upper with ‘23’ embroidered on the side of the heel. The see-through netting has an aged ‘A’ monogram while the reflective silver tongues are touched up with mismatched ‘A’ and Jumpman logos. These kicks have a black foam midsole with eye-catching blue shark tooth detailing. A yellow rubber outsole gives it bold contrast underfoot.

Released 15 years after the colorway's debut, the Air Jordan 5 Retro TD 'Stealth 2.0' is a toddlers' shoe. The shoe's upper features a tumbled leather construction, finished in white and sporting translucent netting on the side wall. A Hyper Royal Jumpman marks the reflective silver tongue, with more Hyper Royal on the inner lining. Underfoot, the foam midsole forgoes the usual visible Air, but its keeps the shark-tooth detailing at the forefoot.

A retro of an OG 1990 colorway, the Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Fire Red' 2006 features Fire Red prominently on the midsole and inner lining. The shark-tooth detailing adds contrast in black, as does the tongue. Both colors come together on the '23' on the ankle, while the white leather upper includes mesh inserts for breathability.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro BG ‘Pro Stars’ gets its name from a ‘90s Saturday morning cartoon starring the all-star trio of Michael Jordan, Bo Jackson and Wayne Gretzky. The classic mid-top features a white leather upper accented with black quarter-panel netting and matching black eyelets. Underfoot, a speckled Poison Green midsole is embellished with ‘shark tooth’ detailing in Infrared.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro TD 'Oreo' is a 2021 iteration that rekindles the beloved colorway that initially debuted in 2013, this time in a scaled-down version. Just like the original release, this shoe features an upper in black nubuck with quarter panels dressed in translucent netting. The tongue displays a silver Jumpman logo, while the back heel showcases a second Jumpman in white stitching. Sitting atop a white foam midsole, the mid-top is further adorned with speckled shark tooth detailing on the lateral sidewall, adding an extra touch of flair.

Released in September 2021, the Air Jordan 5 Retro PS 'Oreo' 2021 brings back the 2013 colorway in preschool sizes. Built with nubuck, the shoe's black upper is contrasted by semitranslucent netting on the quarter panel, with a translucent lace lock securing the fit. The tongue and heel add silver via Jumpman branding, with white contrast provided by the inner lining. Underfoot, visible Air in the heel of the midsole provides cushioning, giving way to a rubber oustole for traction.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Stealth' emerges with a pared down colorway. Releasing in 2006, the shoe's leather upper appears in a neutral Retro White, with the silhouette's signature mesh paneling worked tonally into the side wall. The iconic midsole with shark tooth detailing brings a touch of color to the look via Sport Royal, but the understated Stealth maintains the upper's minimalism. A 3M reflective tongue adds a flash, while the toggle lacing system is designed for a more supportive fit.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro SE PS 'Midnight Navy' is crafted with a mix of rich navy textile and suede on the upper, secured by laces threaded through black molded eyelets. Ventilation is enhanced by the quarter panel netting, and stitched Jumpman logos appear on both the tongue and the rear heel. The white foam midsole displays speckled shark tooth accents atop a grippy herringbone-traction rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro GS ‘Teal’ was unveiled in 2005 and arrives in teal, pink and purple tones. The midsole-outsole combination features geometric perforations, a visible Air unit, and a touch of speckling. The generously proportioned tongue is adorned with the Jumpman logo, alongside a sizable, transparent lace toggle and lateral-side clear plastic texturing.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro T23 'Tokyo' released to celebrate the opening of Japan's Jordan Tokyo 23 store. Featuring a suede upper in Varsity Maize, the neutral Wolf Grey on the tongue, eyelets and mesh inserts complements the look. Black contrast appears on the toe, laces and heel, matched by a Japanese character. The heel includes visible Air for cushioning.

One of the Air Jordan 5 Retro's oldest non-OG colorways, the 'Olive' features a suede cap on the mesh midfoot panel and eyestays with tonal colors of green. Bright accents come on the tongue through the orange internal lining and metallic silver finish, with a translucent lace toggle just below a Jumpman logo. The midsole shark tooth graphic, possibly the Air Jordan 5's defining function, features a sprinkled pattern.

shoeName: Jordan AJF 5 Black Blue Ribbon Varsity Red

description: This iteration of the Air Jordan 5 comes in a Black Grape colorway with purple and teal accents on the shark-tooth detail of the midsole. The same tones go on to the tongue, sockliner, and branding, while the remainder of the top is produced with a premium black suede.

shoeName: Jordan One Take 5 PF White Arctic Punch (White Midsole)

description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro LS 'Grape' 2006 brings back a look that debuted in 1990 and was made famous on The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air. The shoe's white leather upper is accented by a mix of emerald green and Grape Ice, which emerge on the tongue and midsole detailing. The outsole incorporates icy blue translucent inserts, while the usual Nike Air branding on the heel has been replaced with a Jumpman.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro WNBA Pinksicle Safety Orange (PS)
description: A mid-top shoe for little kids is delivered in a vivid color scheme with the Air Jordan 5 Retro PS ‘Pinksicle.’ MJ’s fifth signature shoe features an upper in white leather with clear quarter-panel netting and molded eyelets. The textile lining of the collar, foam midsole and stitched Jumpman logo on the airy padded tongue arrive in pink. Signature shark-tooth imagery decorates the midsole in Safety Orange.

Part of the Countdown Pack in the build up to the Air Jordan 23, the Air Jordan 18/5 Retro ‘Countdown Pack’ features two more silhouettes that add up to 23. The Air Jordan 18 and the Air Jordan 5 both appear in Chicago-inspired colorways. The AJ18 features a familiar ‘Bred’ look, with a black suede upper complemented by a red sockliner and midsole. The AJ5 is instead finished in the ‘Fire Red’ colorway, with the white leather upper and black midsole highlighted by red on the iconic shark tooth detailing.

shoeName: Jordan Max Aura 5 White Yellow Ochre

description: Introducing a touch of familiarity to the timeless silhouette, the Jordan 5 Retro TD 'Concord' showcases a well-known accent color. The upper in pristine white leather is accompanied by translucent netting on the quarter panel, facilitating improved airflow for added comfort. The tongue proudly displays a stitched Jumpman logo in Dark Concord, with a silver reflective finish that enhances visibility in darker situations. Violet accents can be found on a second Jumpman logo located on the back heel, as well as on the signature shark tooth detailing that embellishes the black foam midsole. The mid-cut collar is padded to provide a snug and cozy fit.

Rocking smooth white leather on the upper, the Air Jordan 5 Retro TD 'White Black' keeps the signature quarter netting that made it famous. These shoes have a matte silver reflective tongue, which is accented with a black, embroidered Jumpman logo, matching the one in the heel. A black foam midsole gets a speckled shark tooth panel, while the outsole is treated to an off-white finish.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Low White Desert Berry Black Coral Chalk (PS)
description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro Low PS 'Crafted For Her' is designed for young children and modernizes the classic sneaker with soft pops of pastels. The shoe is constructed with an upper in white tumbled leather, accompanied by a Desert Berry textile lining and clear netting on the quarter panel. The bright berry hue reappears on the tongue and heel via Jumpman branding. The low-top sneaker is stabilized by a two-tone foam midsole with iconic shark-tooth detailing atop by a rubber outsole with herringbone-patterned tread.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro PS 'Pink Foam' is a preschool iteration of the shoe. Built with leather, the shoe's upper features a white base, highlighted by Gym Red throughout and complemented by Pink Foam on the quarter panel netting and heel. More Pink Foam marks the shark-tooth detailing on the midsole, while visible Air in the heel provides cushioning.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro PS 'White Black' keeps some of the iconic AJ5 details, including a padded mid-cut collar, plastic eyelets and the signature netting on the side panel. A silver, reflective Jumpman logo graces the heel and tongue, while a black foam midsole gets black speckles on the silver shark tooth area. A partially see-through rubber outsole keeps the same herringbone pattern from the original design.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro PS 'Top 3' is a preschool shoe that combines three OG colorways. Built with black nubuck on the upper, drawn from the 'Black/Metallic Silver' colorway, the look is highlighted by a Fire Red '23' and midsole drawn from the 'Fire Red.' The Grape Ice and New Emerald tongue instead borrows from the 'Grape.'

The Air Jordan 5 Retro GS ‘White Cement’ features a look drawn from the OG Air Jordan 4 'White Cement.' Sporting a white leather upper, the grade-school shoe features its signature cement detailing throughout the Air-infused midsole, with an additional hit of cement on the upper eyelets. University Red on the 3M reflective tongue and the lace lock add a hit of color.

The Air Jordan 5 GS ‘Bronze’ showcases a simple two-tone design, highlighted by a leather upper finished in a monochromatic Obsidian hue. Contrasting hits of metallic bronze appear on the shoe’s padded tongue and signature shark-tooth detailing, accenting an otherwise crisp white midsole. The latter is reinforced underfoot by an icy translucent rubber outsole.

Bringing bold flashes of color to the legacy silhouette made for kids is the Air Jordan 5 Retro PS 'Racer Blue.' Smooth black nubuck is on the upper with tonal TPU eyelets and breathable quarter panel netting. Jumpman branding in royal blue is featured on the heel overlay and silver reflective tongue. It's built on a blue foam midsole with black shark-tooth detailing with a translucent rubber outsole and herringbone traction pattern.

shoeName: Jordan ADG 5 Black Metallic Silver Blue Tint Fire Red (Wide)
Jordan Max Aura 5 White Gym Red

description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro GS ‘Camo’ brings a utilitarian look to the basketball staple. A grade-school shoe, the suede upper appears in Dark Stucco, a subdued look that’s subtly accented by the camo pattern on the heel and 3M reflective tongue. University Red brings color the branding and signature shark-tooth detailing, with the color featured most prominently on the inner lining.

Released for the 2016 Summer Olympics in Rio de Janeiro, the Air Jordan 5 Retro GS 'Olympic' is highlighted by the metallic gold detailing on its tongue, lace lock and shark-tooth midsole detailing. The rest of the shoe appears in a classic construction, including a white tumbled leather upper with mesh inserts, a black lining and an Air midsole. The outsole incoporates icy translucent sections.

The second women’s Air Jordan 5 colorway, the Wmns Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Stealth' is also known as the 'Shy Pink.' The upper's nubuck construction is finished entirely in silver, with mesh on the side wall for breathability. Hits of Shy Pink emerge on the 3M reflective tongue, with more pink on the lining and signature shark tooth midsole. The rest of the midsole appears in Stealth, with visible Air cushioning giving way to a translucent outsole.

Released exclusively in grade-school sizing, the Air Jordan 5 Retro Low Premium Low GG 'All Star' released for the 2016 NBA All-Star Game. The shoe's leather upper features a unique camo print in grey and silver, with contrasting black on the tongue, laces and eyestay. Mesh inserts are included for breathability, while the sockliner is finished in red. The contrasting white midsole houses visible Air in the heel.

shoeName: Jordan Hydro 5 Retro White Fire Red
Jordan ADG 5 White Emerald Rise Grape Ice
Jordan XXXV Low Metallic Silver (Clear Sole)

description: The 'Blue Suede' was released based on vintage Air Jordan flight suits to complement a previous red colorway. A suede upper finished in Game Royal, leading to a corresponding midsole, features this grade school model. The icy outsole offers an additional touch, while the reflective silver tongue produces a burst of color.

A familiar 2006 colorway gets a reboot in the Air Jordan 5 Retro TD ‘Green Bean.’ Like its earlier incarnation, the grey synthetic upper has a reflective hue and a vibrant green plush interior lining. Branding consists of the Jumpman logo embroidered on the tongue and heel overlay. A cushioned foam midsole in black contrasts with green shark tooth detailing across the lateral sidewall.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Fire Red Silver Tongue (2020) (TD)
description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro TD 'White Fire Red' 2020 is an OG colorway that released for the silhouette's 30th anniversary. Faithful to the original, the shoe's upper is built with white leather, with metallic silver on the inner lining Fire Red accenting the inner lining, heel branding and shark tooth detailing. A mesh insert emerges at the quarter panel, while the midsole forgoes the usual visible Air in the heel.

A girls'-exclusive shoe, the Air Jordan 5 Retro GG 'Floridian' features a black nubuck upper highlighted by a Miami-inspired palette. Both Bright Citrus and Fusion Pink emerge on the tongue, a color combination matched by the midsole and its signature shark tooth detailing. Air in the heel provides cushioning, while an icy translucent outsole complements the look.

A preschool iteration of the shoe, the Air Jordan 5 Retro PS 'Stealth 2.0' brings back a 2006 colorway with this March 2021 release. Built with tumbled leather, the shoe's upper appears in white, with translucent netting marking the quarter panel. A reflective silver tongue accents the look, marked by Hyper Royal Jumpman branding that's matched by the inner lining. Underfoot, the full-length foam midsole maintains the usual shark-tooth detailing but forgoes visible Air in the heel.

To celebrate Valentine's Day in 2013, the Air Jordan 5 Retro GG 'Valentines Day' receives a festive makeover in vibrant red and pink tones. Designed specifically for girls, this iteration features a Gym Red leather upper embellished with Ion Pink accents on the laces, panels, and midsole. The iconic shark teeth design of the Air Jordan 5 is highlighted in a speckled red pattern along the midsole, while a fusion heart basketball emblem with the heel counter displaying the phrase 'Love of the Game.'

The Air Jordan 5 'Grape' was worn on The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air by Will Smith, gaining prominence off the court. This grade school edition features an upper premium white leather contrasting on the midsole, sockliner and branding with Grape and Emerald tones. The shoe keeps the lace-lock that debuted as a performance element on the Jordan 5.

The Air Jordan 18.5 appears in a blacked-out colorway, with a nearly monochromatic upper made with leather. A large debossed Jumpman is still featured near the ankle, while a padded collar and tongue are designed for comfort. Chrome eyelets and University Blue details bring the only color to the look.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro+ 'Laney' dropped in 2000, the first year that saw the classic silhouette returning to store shelves. This non-OG colorway draws inspiration from Michael Jordan’s high school alma mater, featuring a white leather upper with a blend of Varsity Royal and Varsity Maize accents at the tongue, midsole and ‘23’ embroidery. The kicks are finished with royal blue Jumpman at the heel.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Low Crafted For Her Desert Berry (GS)
description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro Low GS 'Crafted For Her' is designed for older kids and features a pristine colorway with pastel accents. The vintage silhouette from 1990 has been converted into a low-top with an upper in a white tumbled leather and translucent quarter panel netting with molded eyelets. The tongue and heel overlay have Coral Chalk embroidery displaying the Jumpman branding, while the interior lining and sockliner come in a darker shade of Desert Berry. The midsole repeats these hues and includes shark-tooth detailing along with an exposed Air-sole unit in the heel. The outsole, which has a herringbone-traction pattern, is translucent and offers excellent grip.

The Jordan 5 GS appears in a vibrant makeup, accentuating a white upper with a sequence of peach and aqua hues. The design of Tinker Hatfield borrows unique components from WWII fighter aircraft, highlighted on the midsole by the unique shark teeth formation of the shoe.

shoeName: Jordan Max Aura 5 White Cardinal Red
description: Inspired by details from the Air Jordan 3, the Jordan Max Aura 5 'White Cardinal Red' dons a white tumbled leather upper with perforated details and round, orange eyelets that match the Jumpman logos on the heel and tongue. A grey molded heel overlay and a red heel counter adorn the design. A full-length foam midsole contains an exposed Air-sole heel unit for a plush feel.

shoeName: Jordan Max Aura 5 Cement Grey Topaz Gold White Anthracite
Jordan One Take 5 Black Habanero Red (GS)
Jordan 5 Retro DJ Khaled We The Best Polar (Friends and Family)
description: This bright-blue high-top is a friends-and-family exclusive from the ‘We the Best’ capsule collection. The DJ Khaled x Air Jordan 5 Retro ‘Polar’ delivers an all-over blue leather upper alongside a teal-blue interior lining that is repeated with the reflective tongue's Jumpman. Shark-tooth patterning on the midsole, also in teal, and pastel pink 'We the Best' and 'Nike Air' on the heels provide additional pops of color. Underfoot, cushioning and comfort is provided by an Air-sole unit in the heel, an off-white midsole in PU and clear outsole in grippy rubber.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro Low BG 'Neymar' is the result of a collaboration between Nike and Neymar. Featuring a cement print upper finished entirely in reflective 3M, both Michael Jordan's and Neymar's jersey numbers appear on the shoes—'23' on the right and '10' on the left. 'Neymar' is stitched inside the tongue, and Infrared hits throughout bring color to the look.

The women’s Air Jordan 5 Retro ‘Sunset’ treats Tinker Hatfield’s original1990 design to a minimalist makeover that pushes aside color to the edges of an all-white exterior. Complementing the leather upper is a reflective grey tongue adorned with an orange Jumpman, while darker Fire Red appears on the collar lining. The same blend of warm hues reappear on the midsole and rubber outsole underfoot.

In 2016, we saw the reintroduction of the 1990 classic Air Jordan 5 Fire Red in a low-top edition. The OG design is dressed on the internal lining, Jumpman logo, and midsole in a black leather upper with Fire Red accents. An icy translucent outsole on the midfoot mesh panel and black hits, midsole shark teeth, and heel polish off the look.

shoeName: Jordan XXXV Low Light Silver Hasta
Jordan 5 Retro DJ Khaled We The Best Court Purple (Friends and Family)
Jordan XXXV Guo Ailun Jade Green (GS)
Jordan Hydro 5 Retro Black Particle Grey University Red

description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro 'White Fire Red' 2000 brought back the OG 'Fire Red' colorway a decade after it debuted. The shoe's white leather upper features minimal color, limited to the Fire Red Nike Air branding on the heel and the lace lock, with the color featured more prominently on the inner lining and shark tooth detailing. The tongue includes a reflective finish, while the Air midsole sports contrasting black.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Fire Red Black Tongue (2013) (GS)
description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro GS ‘Fire Red’ brings the bold colorway to grade-school sizes. Inspired by the OG Jordan 5, this 2013 release features a more prominent use of Fire Red, featuring it on the majority of the midsole rather than just the shark tooth detailing. Additional Fire Red also makes its way to the outsole, while the black 3M reflective tongue adds contrast.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro PS 'Alternate Bel-Air' is a preschool shoe that released as a follow-up to a 2013 Air Jordan 5. The shoe's upper is built with a white leather base, highlighted by a vibrant print on the inner lining. The mismatched branding further accents the look, while underfoot, the midsole includes speckled shark-tooth detailing but does not have visible Air in the heel.

shoeName: Jordan XXXV Jayson Tatum Women in Power PE (GS)

description: The last Air Jordan 5 colorway to be released in 2000, the Air Jordan 5 Retro+ 'White Metallic' 2000 was also one of the first Air Jordans to sport an embroidered '23' at the heel. The simple colorway incorporates a mix of smooth and tumbled leather on the white upper, with metallic silver on the signature midsole detailing. Air in the heel provides cushioning.

Releasing as a girls’ exclusive, the Air Jordan 5 Retro is finished in understated grey leather, accented with vibrant pops of pink, magenta and purple on the tongue, interior collar and midsole. Additional flashes of color appear on the shoe’s branding elements, including the Jumpman logo on the heel and MJ’s 23 jersey number on the side panel.

shoeName: Jordan One Take 5 White Arctic Punch Purple Pulse University Red (Translucent Outsole)

description: Celebrating the exhilarating victory of the athlete against the Spanish All-Star Team in a thrilling 1990 exhibition game, the Air Jordan 5 Retro 'International Flight' arrives in August 2018 as a vibrant kids' sneaker. Drawing inspiration from Barcelona street art, this iteration features an eye-catching 'International Flight' design. The leather upper creates a striking contrast, while pops of Hyper Royal and Orange Peel adorn the tongue, lining print and quarter panel window. Showcasing a speckled sidewall graphic the midsole provides exceptional cushioning and incorporates a visible Air unit in the heel.

shoeName: Jordan ADG 5 Anthracite Black Cool Grey Action Green

description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro Low GS introduces the iconic silhouette to young sneaker enthusiasts, showcasing a clean and refreshing white colorway. Tinker Hatfield's Air Jordan 5 was first released in 1990 and its distinctive shark teeth accents on the midsole were inspired by WWII planes, symbolizing Michael Jordan's aggressive playing style during the 1989-1990 season. This low-top kids' version features a monochrome in white leather adorned with mesh paneling, providing both durability and breathability. The visible Air unit at the heel ensures responsive cushioning, while the icy blue translucent outsole adds a touch of style and traction.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Low Peanut Butter & Jelly (PS)
description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro Low PS 'Peanut Butter Jelly' sports an ivory suede upper with molded eyelets and the traditional side netting. A red Jumpman emblem adorns the tongue and heel areas, while a peanut-butter brown foam midsole is assisted by Air-sole cushioning and fuchsia sharktooth details. A purple, partially see-through rubber outsole underfoot rounds out the look.

shoeName: Jordan One Take 5 Black Habanero Red (Translucent Outsole)
Jordan Max Aura 5 White Varsity Red Wolf Grey Black (GS)
Jordan XXXV Luka White Deep Royal Blue Pink Blast Multi-Color (GS)
Jordan Max Aura 5 Black Bright Mandarin Sail Sky J Light Olive
description: The Jordan Max Aura 5 'Black Sky J Light Olive' takes elements from the Air Jordan 3, rocking a black tumbled leather upper with perforated details and round, orange eyelets. Olive green pops land on the Jumpman tongue tag and the molded overlay wrapping around the heel. An off-white foam midsole contains an Air-sole heel unit for a plush feel and is anchored by an orange-and-olive rubber outsole.

shoeName: Jordan 5 Retro Low Dunk From Above (GS)
description: Part of Jordan Brand's Dunk From Above collection, the Air Jordan 5 Retro Low GS 'Dunk From Above' apperas in grade-school sizing. The low-top sports a premium tumbled leather upper accented by navy on the tongue, eyelets and mesh inserts. More navy emerges on the Air-infused midsole, which sports metallic gold on the signature shark tooth detailing.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro PS 'Laney' honors Emsley A. Laney High School in Wilmington, North Carolina, Michael Jordan's alma mater. Launched in February 2019, this kids' sneaker is wrapped in Varsity Royal, Light Charcoal, and Varsity Maize. The shoe integrates components of the profile first seen in 1990 with Jumpman branding, a premium upper, and a shark-tooth pattern on the midsole. FInishing the model is MJ's number '23' stitched on the heel counter.

White and black leather Air Jordan 5 Retro sneakers from jordan featuring a round toe, a lace-up front fastening, an oversize tongue, a flat sole, a jumpman logo at the tongue, a stitched number 75 on each heel and transparent mesh side panels. These styles are supplied by a premium sneaker marketplace. Stocking only the most sought-after footwear, they source and curate some of the most hard to find sneakers from around the world.

shoeName: Jordan Max Aura 5 Black Wolf Grey White Magma Orange

description: Releasing in 2017 as a grade school exclusive, the Air Jordan 5 Retro GS ‘Sunblush’ showcases an essential two-tone design with an unexpected pop of color. The mid-top’s white leather upper is contrasted by black hits on the collar lining, quarter panel and midsole. The latter features signature shark tooth detailing in Sunblush, matching the padded tongue up top.

A toddlers' shoe, the Air Jordan 5 Retro TD 'Top 3' looks to three OG colorways for its construction. The shoe's upper looks to the 'Black/Metallic Silver' with its black nubuck construction, while the 'Fire Red' becomes apparent on the '23' branding and midsole. Underfoot, the two-tone tongue is taken from the 'Grape' to complete the hybrid look.

shoeName: Jordan One Take 5 Paris Grey Fog
Jordan One Take 5 Quai 54 Summit White Off Noir Burnt Sunrise Game Royal
description: Honoring Paris' streetball tournament, the Jordan One Take 5 'Quai 54' rocks an off-white suede upper with matching mesh accents on the toe box. Contrasting black accents hit the mesh collar, leather eyestay and forefoot overlay. Both logos are showcased on the tongue tag, while Russell Westbrook's 'RW' logo embellishes the heel strap. A plush Phylon midsole is fitted with a Zoom Air forefoot unit for all-around cushioning.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro GS ‘Deadly Pink’ updates the classic silhouette with unexpected pops of vibrant color. The accents are made even sharper when contrasted by the minimalist black nubuck upper, complete with matching black eyelets and quarter-panel netting. Up top, the interior tongue is finished in fuchsia, matching the shark tooth detailing found on the otherwise white midsole.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro PS 'Red Suede' puts a University Red suede construction throughout its signature build, with mesh on the side wall for breathability. Black accents emerge on the inner lining and shark tooth detailing, while the silver tongue sports reflective detailing. This preschool shoe hides the Air cushioning that's traditionally visible in the heel.

description: Nike introduced a new color scheme for the AJ5 Retro in 2000, and then in 2015 it was reissued as the Nike Air Jordan 5 Retro BG 'White Metallic' for kids. This retro-style shoe features a tumbled leather upper in mostly white, including overlays and a cutout on the mid-lateral side. It has a large Jumpman logo on the tongue, heel, and the clear outsole. Additional details include a clear lace toggle and Michael Jordan's number "23" on the rear side.

In this Air Jordan 'Countdown Pack,' both the Jordan 5 and Jordan 18 appear. The Jordan 5 includes a premium white leather construction on the bottom side with a black midsole and Fire Red accents all over. Inspired by WWII fighter jets, the midsole sports the signature shark tooth design. The AJ18 is inspired by Italian design and sports cars and features a largely suede upper that is protected over the laces with a sleek cover.

The Air Jordan 1.5 ‘The Return’ nods to Michael Jordan’s return from a broken foot, which cost him 64 games during his sophomore NBA season. These shoes have a Sand Dune suede upper taken from the Jordan 1, tooled with green leather accents and red touches — a nod to the Milwaukee Bucks uniform, the team he first faced upon his return. A white midsole pairs with a gum rubber outsole, a mix previously used for the Air Jordan 2.

description: The Air Jordan 35 GS 'Bred' is a grade-school shoe with a classic Jordan Brand colorway on its modern basketball construction. Built with a mix of suede and mesh, the shoe's upper appears primarily in black, with reflective silver on the tongue and an iridescent overlay at the midfoot. Hits of Fire Red complete the 'Bred' look, while Flightwire cables support the fit. Underfoot, the speckled midsole includes an Eclipse Plate 2.0 and dual Zoom Air units for stability and cushioning, giving way to a herringbone rubber outsole for traction.

description: The preeminent Nike designer Tinker Hatfield proclaimed that Michael Jordan reminded him of the World War II Mustang fighter plane, 'Floating around the edges of the game and coming out of nowhere to attack.' The original Air Jordan V, launched in 1990, sought to emulate the plane and MJ's style of play. Sporting flame 'teeth' on the midsole and staying true to authentic AJ1 details, the contemporary Air Jordan 5 Retro TD 'Satin Bred' kids' shoe reminds young people of their potential to soar.

description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro PS 'White Cement' has the same color blocking as the iconic 'White Cement' color palette on the Jordan 4. On the quarter panel, the white leather upper sports tonal webbed paneling, while on the upper eyelets and midsole, cement accents come through. The graphic of the iconic shark tooth appears in black.

The Air Jordan 18.5 ‘White Black Chrome’ is modeled after the Air Jordan 18 that came before it, but it removes the usual lace cover. The white leather upper features a prominent Jumpman debossed on the ankle, with perforations on the medial side near the toe. The black midsole maintains the build from the Jordan 18, while velour is used on the inner lining. The heel sports ‘.5’ and the heel loop has a Jumpman surrounded by ‘1984’ and ‘2003,’ representing Michael Jordan’s pro career.

The Wmns Air Jordan 5 Retro Low 'White Metallic' 2006 features a clean look on its low-top design. The shoe's tumbled leather upper is finished entirely in white, with 3M reflective detailing bringing a flash to the tongue. A lace lock supports the fit, while the signature shark tooth detailing includes a speckled finish. Visible Air in the heel is included for cushioning.

A nod to Carmelo Anthony’s alter ego, ‘Hoodie Melo,’ the Jordan Melo 1.5 SE ‘Anthracite Black’ boasts a blacked-out aesthetic across its synthetic and terry cloth construction. An embroidered ‘Wings’ logo can be seen in Oklahoma City Thunder colors on the collar’s medial side, while Anthony’s signature (along with ‘XLT’ lettering, his hoodie size) appear on the opposite side. The sneaker was released in May 2018.
